The Goro Goro no Mi is a Logia-type Devil Fruit that grants the power to create, control, and become lightning at will, making the user a ; it is one of the few abilities touted as "invincible" according to Nico Robin. The fruit was eaten by Enel.

The Goro Goro no Mi is a round, pear-shaped fruit that tapers off towards the stem, resembling a . Its golden-yellow peel features the overlapping swirl pattern typical of Devil Fruits while forming sharp, jagged outgrowths all over that vary in length, width, and direction, resembling sparks of electricity. Topping the fruit is a green, T-shaped stem that zigzags into a stylized lightning bolt, with one end pointy and the other flat.

The holder of this Logia can create, control, and transform into electricity, effectively becoming lightning incarnate. They can discharge varying amounts of electricity from their body to manipulate as they please, including regulating the : 200 million volts being the maximum output (roughly in the range of natural lightning). Given the sheer destructive power inherent to lightning, this ability seems remarkably strong even by Logia standards and grants overwhelming attack power, as well as high speed and versatility; Nico Robin has mentioned that, among the many existing Devil Fruits, this Logia is one of the few powers that can be considered invincible.

By physically morphing into lightning, the ability user becomes intangible and can let attacks (save those involving Haki or Seastone) phase through them harmlessly. Enemies are dissuaded from striking the user—directly with their body or a conductive weapon—lest they be , thus affording a melee-combat advantage. By transforming fully, the user can move at the speed of lightning, allowing them to zip into and out of sight, cross large distances nigh-instantaneously, dodge most attacks, and overtake any fleeing target. Merging their lightning self with conductive materials (e.g., gold) to stealthily travel through them also becomes possible for the user, as does traversing thunderclouds in the sky. On top of that, being wholly immune to electricity, the Goro Goro no Mi user can freely spawn it inside their body without repercussion; they can even restart their own heart with electricity in case they suffer cardiac arrest.
enrichments.short_description: The Goro Goro no Mi is a Logia-type Devil Fruit that grants the power to create, control, and become lightning at will, making the user a ; it is one of the few abilities touted as "invincible" according to Nico Robin.…

enrichments.description:
Gorobe is a citizen of Okobore Town in the Kuri region of Wano Country.

He is a man with wrinkled skin and some missing teeth. He wears his hair in a bun, and as an inhabitant of Wano, he wears a kimono, decorated with rhombuses.

Gorobe is shown to be very honorable, as he was worried about wasting Luffy's charity before his own well-being.

After he was badly wounded because of Shutenmaru's food theft, he was taken care of by Tsuru. As Tsuru tended to his injuries, he regretted having lost the food given by Luffy-tarou.
enrichments.short_description: Gorobe is a citizen of Okobore Town in the Kuri region of Wano Country.

enrichments.description:
The Goru Goru no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to telekinetically manipulate gold at will. It was eaten by Gild Tesoro.

The Goru Goru no Mi is a dark yellow fruit that appears to resemble a combination of a gourd and a pineapple. It has a few leaves on top, and expands at the middle. Like all natural Devil Fruits, its surface is covered with swirling patterns. It is about the same size as the palm of Tesoro's hand.

The main strength of the fruit is that it allows the user to manipulate any gold they touch. They can quickly change the gold from solid to liquid and vice versa, as well as into a powder form, which is actually pure or nearly pure gold reduced to very small particles (micrometer or even nanometer-sized), allowing it to be shaped in any way desired. The user can also encase living beings in gold, effectively turning them into statues. In addition, they are capable of covering their own body with golden armor to increase their power, to the point of transforming into a massive golden golem. Although gold is normally a relatively soft metal, when the user is actively manipulating it, it becomes hard enough to withstand extremely powerful attacks, including blows from Luffy's Gear 4 and slashes from Zoro's Three Sword Style techniques. The user can also exponentially increase the amount of gold present, as shown when Gild Tesoro uses one of his rings to transform it into a large loop and capture a fugitive.

If this power is "awakened," the range of the user's influence over gold will increase, extending their senses to the gold that are under their powers, potentially creating a complex sensory network. Any disturbances on such gold will be noticed.
enrichments.short_description: The Goru Goru no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to telekinetically manipulate gold at will. It was eaten by Gild Tesoro.

enrichments.description:
The Gosa Village was a village near Cocoyasi Village in the region of the Conomi Islands.

Due to its inability to fully deliver the monthly tribute demanded by Arlong, all of Gosa Village's buildings were quite literally overturned by Momoo, the colossal sea cow under the command of the Arlong Pirates, as a show of force and punishment. The devastation occurred just two to three weeks prior to the arrival of Roronoa Zoro, Johnny, and Usopp. The only known resident of the village is a young boy, Chabo.

In the aftermath of the destruction, some of the survivors of Gosa Village sought aid from the Marines' 77th Branch, led by Commodore Pudding Pudding. However, the Marines' intervention failed to stop Arlong's reign. After the Arlong Pirates were defeated by the Straw Hat Pirates, Nami demanded that Nezumi's 16th Branch undertake the reconstruction of Gosa Village.

ca:Gosa es:Pueblo de Gosa fr:Village de Gosa it:Gosa pl:Miasteczko Gosa Category:East Blue Locations Category:Villages
enrichments.short_description: The Gosa Village was a village near Cocoyasi Village in the region of the Conomi Islands.

enrichments.description:
"Hit Man" Gotti is an assassin, a combatant in the Fire Tank Pirates, and the husband of Charlotte Lola.

Along with his crew, he is a temporary ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Whole Cake Island Arc. He is also one of the central characters in "Gang" Bege's Oh My Family Cover Page Serial.

Gotti is a very large man with spiky light purple hair (dark purple in the anime) on the sides of his head and beard, although the top of his head is bald. Having lost his right forearm sometime after joining the Fire Tank Pirates, he had a giant red, green, and yellow (orange, black, and yellow in the anime) three-barreled machine gun installed in its place, which has a pulling chain as the trigger.

Gotti wears a black vest with a white suit underneath it, a green cape, a red cravat and black shoes with white polka-dots. He has a large silver metal plate or shield (black in the anime) hung from his left shoulder, having his name and the same symbol as Vito's tattoos inscribed on it.
enrichments.short_description: "Hit Man" Gotti is an assassin, a combatant in the Fire Tank Pirates, and the husband of Charlotte Lola.

enrichments.description:
Gourmet Island is a non-canon island filled with food. It acts as the setting of The True Food! Devil Fruit!!.

Gourmet Island is a small but mountainous island, with many small peaks that get higher as they approach the center of the island. In the center, something resembling giant spaghetti rises into the air, with an equally giant fork floating at the top.

The island contains both forested and barren areas, as well as multiple small rivers and ponds.

Gourmet Island is also home to strange weather phenomena, specifically consisting of rain of various foods including meat, cotton candy, chocolate, and milk coffee.
enrichments.short_description: Gourmet Island is a non-canon island filled with food. It acts as the setting of The True Food! Devil Fruit!!.

enrichments.description:
Grabar is a dwarf from Tontatta Kingdom who first appeared on Green Bit. She is Leo's grandmother.

Grabar is an average-sized stout female dwarf with a wrinkled face, raised cheekbones, and a light colored tail. She has light colored hair tied back into two bun-like ponytails. She wears a light colored sleeveless shirt, dark colored pants, a dark colored belt, a dark colored hair band, dark glasses, and has a tattoo on her right arm.

In the anime, she has gray hair and wears a reddish-pink sleeveless shirt, indigo pants, brown belt, blue and black headphones and brown tinted shades.

Grabar cares for Leo's well-being, since she packed him a lunch for his mission.
enrichments.short_description: Grabar is a dwarf from Tontatta Kingdom who first appeared on Green Bit. She is Leo's grandmother.

enrichments.description:
Gram was one of the archaeologists of Ohara.

Gram was a young average sized girl, with short blond hair under a purple cap. She wore a coat that matched her hat, with a light blue shirt underneath that was darker blue at the collar, and had four white buttons.

Gram was a very devoted scholar who stayed behind to help ditch books into a lake in an effort to protect them. She, along with the other scholars, were friendly towards Nico Robin.

Gram was very close to Nico Olvia, who she considered like an older sister.
enrichments.short_description: Gram was one of the archaeologists of Ohara.

enrichments.description:
Gran Tesoro is a massive ship with a metropolis built on it, described as the largest entertainment city in the world. It was formerly ruled by Gild Tesoro, but after he was deposed and most of the population evacuated, Carina took command over the ship.

It is acknowledged as an independent state by the World Government due to Tesoro's wealth, and they also classify it as a demilitarized zone. It is referred to as the "moving country of dreams". Nevertheless, the country is still required to pay a Heavenly Tribute to maintain affiliation with the World Government.

One way of reaching the ship is by Gild Tesoro's Vivre Card, which is considered as a personal invitation by Tesoro himself. The invitation is delivered in a closed envelope sealed by the Gran Tesoro emblem. One invite was given to Mad Treasure by Tanaka so that the treasure hunter could deliver the Pure Gold to him. The envelope was later taken by Nami and the Vivre Card was used to guide the Straw Hat Pirates to the casino.

A large portion of the Gran Tesoro is composed of gold, and its bow resembles a cruise ship, only much more massive in scale. The entire ship is ten kilometers long and a city is built inside it, with no roof covering it. The stern is a large circle with a tall golden tower in the center (designed to look like a wheel), and at the very back is a large green area (designed to look like a card table). The front of the ship allows others ships to enter inside the Gran Tesoro. Its name and two pirate flags can be seen when entering the ship. As a means of locomotion, the ship appears to be drawn by two gigantic sea turtles armed with cannons.
enrichments.short_description: Gran Tesoro is a massive ship with a metropolis built on it, described as the largest entertainment city in the world. It was formerly ruled by Gild Tesoro, but after he was deposed and most of the population evacuated,…

enrichments.description:
The Gray Terminal is a massive junkyard located on Dawn Island north of Mt. Colubo, just outside the great gate of Goa.

Filled with unwanted goods and people ejected from the city of Goa, it is a lawless community without proper medical care, leaving many ravaged by disease. Sabo lived here in secret, along with various other refugees. Many, or possibly all of the inhabitants of the Gray Terminal make their livelihood by selling various wares found in the slum or surrounding mountains to the citizens of Edge Town.

In order to pass inspection by the World Government in preparation for the arrival of a World Noble, the royal family planned to burn the Gray Terminal and all its inhabitants. With the false promise of nobility, they hired the Bluejam Pirates to place gunpowder and oil around the Terminal. With their task complete, the pirates set the Gray Terminal on fire, shooting anyone fortunate enough to escape, but were left to die as the king locked the gates with them still trapped in the inferno. However, thanks to the assistance of Dragon and the Revolutionaries, many inhabitants were able to escape to the safety of their ship.

After the inspection was over, and Saint Jalmack departed, the kingdom returned to its old ways, and the Gray Terminal returned to being a dump site for garbage. It is unknown if the place was inhabited again or if it is still deserted.
enrichments.short_description: The Gray Terminal is a massive junkyard located on Dawn Island north of Mt. Colubo, just outside the great gate of Goa.

enrichments.description:
The "Great Kingdom" was an ancient kingdom that was said to be vast, proud, and powerful. All mentions of it and its history have been erased, with even its name remaining a secret.

It was an enemy of the Twenty Kingdoms (which are now the World Government), as implied by Professor Clover, and was seemingly destroyed utterly by them over 800 years ago at the end of the Void Century. In fact, it seems its defeat allowed the Ancient Alliance to seize global control and establish the World Government.

Furthermore, the ancient kingdom is the real reason the World Government has banned any Poneglyph deciphering and research, as the mere "existence and idea of this kingdom presents a threat to the World Government".

Vegapunk has theorized that the Great Kingdom had technological advancements that far surpasses the science of the modern day. The theory is technically unconfirmed, though Vegapunk considers it undeniable proof that the World Government is willing to obliterate entire nations just to keep the truth hidden.
enrichments.short_description: The "Great Kingdom" was an ancient kingdom that was said to be vast, proud, and powerful. All mentions of it and its history have been erased, with even its name remaining a secret.

enrichments.description:
Great Michael is an infamous New World pirate captain who allied with Whitebeard.

Great Micheal is an average sized man, with curly hair and a beard. He wears a tricorne with a black jolly roger, that could possibly be his. He wears a black captain's coat.

Having only appeared on a small number of occasions, there is little of his personality that can be ascertained as of late, other than that he has apparently a great respect for Whitebeard as he is willing to risk his life in order to save Ace from being executed. He also appears to have a confident stance and a somewhat laid-back demeanor.

Great Michael is a fearsome pirate who has managed to achieve an infamous reputation in the New World, and to make an alliance with Whitebeard. In One Piece Green: Secret Pieces, he's seen with a sword.
enrichments.short_description: Great Michael is an infamous New World pirate captain who allied with Whitebeard.

enrichments.description:
The Great Tree is an island-sized, flora-based organism created by a now-lost civilization over a millennia ago for the purpose of electing future leaders through ordeals. An entity of immense power, she has the ability to host people's thoughts and create presents whose natures are decided according to the character of her candidates. However, she failed to live up to her purpose and was so thrown away to wander the sea, eventually coming to rest in the latter half of Paradise.

In the present day, the Straw Hat Pirates came across the Great Tree and accidentally reactivated her. Promising the crew a present if they were to clear her ordeals, the Great Tree produced islands with different ordeals on them for the Straw Hat Pirates to clear and created Gaburi, a companion for the crew, to record their actions. When the Straw Hat Pirates became qualified for their present and came to claim it, the Great Tree prepared to turn Gaburi into it, only to get frighten by the evil in human nature and turn Gaburi into the Doom Guardian. Although the Straw Hats Pirates managed to escape with the original piece of Gaburi, they soon returned to the Great Tree and had Gaburi reclaim the Doom Guardian from her for his own survival while making the Great Tree come to an understanding with him about humanity.

The Great Tree serves as the main antagonist of One Piece Unlimited Cruise 1: The Treasure Beneath the Waves and One Piece Unlimited Cruise 2: Awakening of a Hero.

Before taking physical form, the Great Tree's appearance is that of a floating green energy orb at the size of Luffy.
enrichments.short_description: The Great Tree is an island-sized, flora-based organism created by a now-lost civilization over a millennia ago for the purpose of electing future leaders through ordeals. An entity of immense power, she has the ability…

enrichments.description:
Green Bit is a seemingly uninhabited island in the New World located immediately north of Dressrosa. Law first mentioned the island when he was speaking to Smoker on Punk Hazard. Its underground is home to the Tontatta Kingdom.

Green Bit is connected to Dressrosa by an iron bridge and a secret underground passage. The presence of the Fighting Fish has forced the bridge to be closed for 200 years.

Befitting its name, Green Bit is a very green place, with a large forest and huge plants. Some animals, namely birds, foxes, and boars have been seen on the Island. Underneath the forest, there is a village which is formed by plants.

As a result of a meteor summoned by Issho, a large crater was formed on one side of Green Bit's shore.
enrichments.short_description: Green Bit is a seemingly uninhabited island in the New World located immediately north of Dressrosa. Law first mentioned the island when he was speaking to Smoker on Punk Hazard. Its underground is home to the Tontatta…

enrichments.description:
Guanhao is an island in Paradise where the World Government organized a training camp for future Cipher Pol agents.

The island is covered by a forest. The only known building on the island is a high tower with trees on a roof.

The World Government uses Guanhao as a training camp for future Cipher Pol generations. Rob Lucci and other CP9 members had trained on the island until they became strong enough to become full-fledged agents.

Lucci and other CP9 members returned to Guanhao after recovering in St. Poplar. Very Good pursued them but he was easily defeated.
enrichments.short_description: Guanhao is an island in Paradise where the World Government organized a training camp for future Cipher Pol agents.

enrichments.description:
Guernika was a masked agent of CP0. While in Wano Country for negotiations with Shogun Kurozumi Orochi, Guernika played a relevant role in the Raid on Onigashima. On the World Government's order, he interfered in the duel between Kaidou and Monkey D. Luffy, resulting in the latter's temporary loss, for which he was murdered by Kaidou as punishment.

Due to his actions and role, he was a supporting antagonist during the Wano Country Arc.

Guernika wore a white bowler hat, a dark purple and blue polka dotted scarf, a white long coat, and what looks like a dark blue, light yellow-gold, red award ribbon on his blazer. He wore his tie loosely. He had a flat face with a thin mustache and beard, a scar under his light-colored right eye, and markings under his pure black left eye. What appeared to be a mask seemed more likely to be white make-up, as his mouth was moving while he addressed the people.

Like most of CP0's agents, Guernika was professional and prioritized his missions above all else. However, he could be quick to anger as shown when he attacked Apoo at point blank range for calling him and Maha the World Nobles' dogs, and was even willing to eliminate Drake, an undercover agent of SWORD whom he considers to be an inconvenience. He also expressed envy towards Drake for his self-determination. When Guernika was confronted by Kaidou for his interference, he allowed himself to be attacked by Kaidou without fear or attempting to flee.
enrichments.short_description: Guernika was a masked agent of CP0. While in Wano Country for negotiations with Shogun Kurozumi Orochi, Guernika played a relevant role in the Raid on Onigashima. On the World Government's order, he interfered in the…

enrichments.description:
Guillotine is a Marine Vice Admiral and one of the nine that took part in the Egghead Incident.

He serves as a minor antagonist in the Egghead Arc.

Guillotine is a tall man with orange hair with a yellow stripe on the right side of his head and also with a long orange beard with the end being curly, reaching done to his abdomen, with a yellow line on the right side of the beard. On the right side of his neck, what appears to be a purple tattoo in the form of two jagged stripes is visible. He wears sunglasses and a crescent-shaped blade on top of his head. He also wears a light double-breast suit with his long sleeves rolled up and a dark green suit and a tie underneath it. As a high ranking officer, he wears a Justice coat draped over his shoulders with dark green cuffs.

He seems to be a calm and reasonable man who understands that the Pacifista, which has come under the control of a pirate, must be destroyed, despite the fact that due to this they will lose some of their military power. He showed disgust when Pomsky was transformed into a child and attacked by Bonney, commenting that it felt wrong to see a child being hit.
enrichments.short_description: Guillotine is a Marine Vice Admiral and one of the nine that took part in the Egghead Incident.

enrichments.description:
The Gunyo Gunyo no Mi is an unknown-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to create and control clay, making the user a . It was eaten by Prince Grus.

A user of this fruit's power can generate clay from their body and mold it into different shapes akin to . This includes the creation of human-like, animated figures called "golems" that can fight on the user's behalf, being invulnerable to damage. It seems that the ability's user can freely alter the hardness of the clay, from creating large massses of soft, mushy clay to making smaller, hardened constructs to wield as weapons.

No weaknesses of this ability are known apart from the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.

Grus uses the clay he creates for offensive, defensive, and auxiliary purposes. He chiefly uses his power to create animated golems that fight for him while he can stay out of harm's way, observing at a safe distance. He can manipulate clay in its soft state (such as summoning large, shapeless masses to cushion a ship's fall onto land) or harden clay to fashion solid weapons to wield by hand (e.g., a spiked morning star), or large defensive structures.
enrichments.short_description: The Gunyo Gunyo no Mi is an unknown-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to create and control clay, making the user a . It was eaten by Prince Grus.

enrichments.description:
The Gura Gura no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit which allows the user to create vibrations, or "quakes", making the user a . It was eaten by Edward Newgate, but upon his death, its power was stolen by Marshall D. Teach.

This fruit is fearsomely reputed to be able to destroy the world, and is considered to be the strongest Devil Fruit within the Paramecia class, having powers no weaker than those of a Logia Devil Fruit.

The Gura Gura no Mi resembles a blue pear, albeit with a "cracked" lower appearance resembling the kind created by the user. The upper section features various swirls. Similar to other fruits, it also has a green T-shaped stem that curls up at one end.

The major strength granted by this fruit to the user is its ability to generate massive vibrations, or shockwaves, which can travel through virtually any medium, including the ground, the seafloor, and even the air. Because of this, Fleet Admiral Sengoku has stated that Whitebeard holds the power to destroy the world, and Vice Admiral Tsuru stated that, even if she retreated to the ends of the ocean, there would be no safe place left in the world for her to go when faced with the full power of the Gura Gura no Mi.
enrichments.short_description: The Gura Gura no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit which allows the user to create vibrations, or "quakes", making the user a . It was eaten by Edward Newgate, but upon his death, its power was stolen by Marshall D.…

enrichments.description:
The Guru Guru no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to transform any part of their body or piece of worn clothing into propellers capable of rotation at high speed, becoming a . It was eaten by Buffalo.

The Guru Guru no Mi grants its eater the power to transform any part of their body or piece of worn clothing into propellers capable of rotation at high speed. The force of the spinning is strong enough to enable propelled flight by the user over very long distances, to assist in the carrying or thrown launch of objects and other people, and to create powerful windstorms.

A person of sufficient strength can grab onto the user's rotational parts and stop the spinning, and can even do damage by twisting the parts themselves. Besides that, the user is also vulnerable to the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.

Buffalo mastered the Guru Guru no Mi to the point where he can turn his whole body into a mode of transportation. Even though Buffalo usually assumes a specific pose when he flies, he is still capable of moving his body freely when needed while still remaining midair. While on the ground, he can rapidly rotate his legs in a vertical fashion, allowing him to use them like roller skates.
enrichments.short_description: The Guru Guru no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to transform any part of their body or piece of worn clothing into propellers capable of rotation at high speed, becoming a . It was eaten by…

enrichments.description:
Gurutaro is a samurai who was part of the Mimawarigumi 41 years ago. He was also a retainer of the Kouzuki Family.

Gurutaro is a thin man of significant height, reaching up to the nearly thirteen-feet Oden's shoulders. He has long, brown hair that he keeps in a ponytail, and wears a dark yukata with a leaf design and the white coat typical of Mimawarigumi members.

Gurutaro appears to have immense respect for Oden, offering to accept a bribe from him as an excuse not to arrest him. However, despite this respect, he values his official orders, and still went to arrest Oden.

As a samurai and member of the Mimawarigumi, Gurutaro presumably has some fighting prowess. Even among the Mimawarigumi, Gurutaro seems to be respected, having been selected for the job of informing Oden about his disownment.
enrichments.short_description: Gurutaro is a samurai who was part of the Mimawarigumi 41 years ago. He was also a retainer of the Kouzuki Family.

enrichments.description:
Gustav is a student at the Walrus School on Elbaph.

Gustav is a stocky giant child with light brown hair, a pointy nose, and round teeth. He wears rectangular glasses and a black skullcap. He also wears a red shirt, a blue jacket, a wide belt, black pants and white boots.

Gustav has mischievous streak as he and Axel attempted to capture humans for their amusement. However, he is quick to fold under pressure.

When the Straw Hat Pirates visited the Walrus School, Gustav and Axel chased Luffy, Zoro and Usopp, attempting to capture the humans. However, they were stopped by Ylva, Ronja and a third girl. When they were berated, Gustav and Axel quickly apologized.
enrichments.short_description: Gustav is a student at the Walrus School on Elbaph.

enrichments.description:
The Gutsu Gutsu no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to turn their body into a blast furnace and melt metals inside it, making them a .

The fruit was eaten by two different characters under different media: the first was in the One Piece Premier Show 2013 by Lambor Bukini, and it was reused in the Silver Mine Arc, where it was eaten by Bill.

The main strength of this fruit is the ability to become a human-blast furnace, able to consume ore, melting said ore down in their bodies, and then solidify the molten ore in the user's body and shape it into anything the user desires, including metal weapons, which he can pull out from his abdomen. The user can even launch the ore in its molten state to attack others. They can encase people in solid silver by pouring the molten ore on them; the user will also become encased in silver if covered in ore, but they will still have freedom of movement. They are also granted immunity from being burned by the molten ore, initially hot metal it is formed into, and most forms of heat including fires. The more ore the user consumes, the larger and more powerful they become, as Bartolomeo pointed out that the resultant effect appears similar to Logia.

It seems that the user requires a supply of ore inside them in order to be able to form weapons, forcing them to constantly consume ore in order to produce weapons. The weapons created from the fruit will also quickly become molten again when it is destroyed. Also, overeating ore would cause the user to exude a tremendous amount of heat, capable of melting everything around inadvertently, which, if left unchecked, can potentially sink an entire island. Other than that, the user is also affected by the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.
enrichments.short_description: The Gutsu Gutsu no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to turn their body into a blast furnace and melt metals inside it, making them a .

enrichments.description:
Gyaro is a member of the Macro Pirates. He is a pop-eyed goldfish fish-man. He was also a member of the Sun Pirates, before its disbanding.

As a pop-eyed goldfish fish-man, Gyaro has beige skin and black hair in a ponytail. He has incredibly large eye sockets but incredibly small eyes. He has a long jaw with large lips and a small mouth. He wears a normal t-shirt and pants. He has his Sun Pirates tattoo on his left and right biceps.

Unlike Macro, Gyaro does not appear to be very bright, easily falling for Hatchan's offer of octopus fritters in exchange for his freedom. Also, unlike most other fish-men seen in the series, he and the rest of the Macro Pirates have no qualms about selling other fish-men and merfolk into slavery.

Like many characters in One Piece he has a distinct laugh: "Ehehehe".
enrichments.short_description: Gyaro is a member of the Macro Pirates. He is a pop-eyed goldfish fish-man. He was also a member of the Sun Pirates, before its disbanding.

enrichments.description:
Gyasta is a town located in Drum Island. It was only mentioned as one of Kureha's stops, and a sign pointing to it was shown.

Gyasta is a lakeside town north of Cocoa Weed. Because it borders a lake, ice skating is the most popular activity in this town.

On the outskirts of Gyasta, there is a huge tree that once served as Kureha's home and also the place where she performed her medical examinations.

When King Wapol fled from Drum after the Blackbeard Pirates ravaged the country, Kureha moved out to Drum Castle at some point. The tree, however, was not completely abandoned as a long white rope was tied between it and somewhere atop the Drum Rockies. By running along this ropeway while pulling Kureha's sleigh, Tony Tony Chopper could freely transport her back and forth through both locations.
enrichments.short_description: Gyasta is a town located in Drum Island. It was only mentioned as one of Kureha's stops, and a sign pointing to it was shown.

enrichments.description:
Gyogyo is a member of the Bonney Pirates. He was once a resident of the Sorbet Kingdom, having been a friend of Bartholomew Kuma and Ginny since childhood.

After the Summit War of Marineford, he was arrested by Admiral Akainu following his crew's defeat against the Blackbeard Pirates.

Gyogyo is an overweight man with large lips, freckles, a bulbous nose and a full beard. He has tribal tattoos on his biceps.

Gyogyo wears a tank top with the phrase "GREAT MAN" printed on it, trousers with a pair of suspenders, and a cowboy hat.
enrichments.short_description: Gyogyo is a member of the Bonney Pirates. He was once a resident of the Sorbet Kingdom, having been a friend of Bartholomew Kuma and Ginny since childhood.

enrichments.description:
Gyoncorde Plaza is a notable location within the center of Fish-Man Island, specifically within the Ryugu Kingdom.

Thirteen years before the start of the series, Gyoncorde Plaza was one of the places Queen Otohime would approach every day to make her speeches about how humans and fish-folk should be united. She chose to make personal appearances in order to remove the boundaries between herself and the people, in order to increase influence. The signatures for her petition were kept in a box, where people were free to drop them in or retract them.

After returning with a World Noble's support, Otohime managed to get far more signatures than the box could hold, but one day the box was set ablaze. The arson was committed by a human pirate who was also believed to have then shot Otohime in the midst of the chaos. Hody Jones, then a soldier of the royal army, took the supposed culprit and held him high on a rooftop of the plaza and screamed out loud for the entire community to hear that it was a human who assassinated Otohime.

In truth, Hody paid the pirate to set the box of signatures on fire, and then Hody himself shot the queen. After the queen's death, Hody then shot the pirate and used him as a scapegoat.
enrichments.short_description: Gyoncorde Plaza is a notable location within the center of Fish-Man Island, specifically within the Ryugu Kingdom.

enrichments.description:
Gyoro, Nin, and Bao were a trio of oddly shaped Soldier Zombies that were first seen reporting to Moria about the Straw Hats' arrival.

They are relatively small Soldier Zombies and they are all roughly the same size as Chopper when he is when using his Brain Point. Gyoro is the zombie that looks like a one-eyed samurai with an ovular head. Nin is the pinkish-red zombie archer with a triangular head. Bao is the yellow zombie that looks like some sort of super hero with a bucket shaped head.

They all seem to be very scared of Gecko Moria, but are still loyal to him, as they notified him when the Straw Hat Pirates came to the island because they thought it would be useful to him. They also respect the Mysterious Four.

Gyoro, Nin, and Bao's physical abilities are unknown, as they have not been shown fighting.
enrichments.short_description: Gyoro, Nin, and Bao were a trio of oddly shaped Soldier Zombies that were first seen reporting to Moria about the Straw Hats' arrival.

enrichments.description:
Gyoru is a fishmonger in Foosha Village and the husband of Chicken. Luffy bought fish from him when he was a kid.

Gyoru is an average sized middle aged man with black hair, a widow's peak, and a spiky tuft of hair on the top of his head. He has small round eyes, thick eyebrows, and stubble on his chin. He has always been seen sporting a large smile. He wears a yellow shirt with a black apron over it and a pink rope tied around his head. 12 years ago, he lacked stubble.

Gyoru has had multiple color schemes in the anime. In all of his appearances in the anime he has brown hair instead of black. In his first appearance in Episode 45, his shirt was beige, his apron was green, and the rope around his head was pink. In Episode 504, his shirt was white with gray cuffs, his apron was brown, and the rope around his head was white. In Episode of East Blue, his shirt was gray, his apron was black, the rope around his head was white, and he also lacked the tuft of hair on his head.

Gyoru is kind, as he was nice to Luffy and supported him in his dream of becoming a pirate.
enrichments.short_description: Gyoru is a fishmonger in Foosha Village and the husband of Chicken. Luffy bought fish from him when he was a kid.

enrichments.description:
Gyoverly Hills is one of the wealthier towns on Fish-Man Island.

Pappag lives in a mansion in Gyoverly Hills due to his wealth and fame from designing the Criminal clothing line. On the exterior, it looks like a giant seashell. It has a Criminal clothing store on the first floor. The prices of these clothes are apparently very high. According to a store clerk, 10,000 is below half of the original price. Camie usually travels there to bring Pappag orient clams.

es:Gyoverly Hills pl:Ryberly Hills Category:Fish-Man Island Locations Category:Towns and Cities
enrichments.short_description: Gyoverly Hills is one of the wealthier towns on Fish-Man Island.

enrichments.description:
Crab-Hand Gyro is the captain of the Gyro Pirates from South Blue that was on its way to the New World before an unfortunate meeting with the New Fish-Man Pirates.

Gyro is a skinny man of average height with a child-like, oval face, and a square nose. He has two red distinctive spots on his cheeks, dark hair, beard and mustache, he's missing a tooth and has what appears to be a massive on top of his head. He also has well-developed pectorals and abdominal muscles.

He sports a bicorne adorned with his Jolly Roger, tied around his neck with a string, much like Luffy with his straw hat. He wears a partially unbuttoned black vest underneath a light blue captain's coat worn with the arms in the sleeves, with the left sleeve being cut right below his elbow, and has a large buckled belt hanging on his chest from his right shoulder. He wears striped pants reaching down to his calves, with many purple and white stripes at the ends, and sandals. He carries around a katana with him.

His most distinctive feature, as well as the source of his epithet, is the giant crab claw where his left hand should be. It is orange and made of metal with spikes coming out of the arm. This is a weapon attachment, as his human arm is seen bitten off and floating next to him after being defeated by Hody Jones.
enrichments.short_description: Crab-Hand Gyro is the captain of the Gyro Pirates from South Blue that was on its way to the New World before an unfortunate meeting with the New Fish-Man Pirates.

enrichments.description:
The H-1 is an anime-only boat that Henzo designed.

The ship is a small, metal raft shaped like a bullet. It is yellow with green underneath, and has a red "H-1" painted on the front. The craft can also mount Henzo's Rainbow Mist tracking device on the back of it. The ship is pedal operated.

Henzo first used the H-1 to travel out to the sea to investigate the Tarielishin. When he found nothing on the ship, he said H-1 couldn't go to the Rainbow Mist, because she wasn't designed to be capable of going long distances.

es:H-1 fr:H-1 pl:H-1 Category:Non-Canon Ships
enrichments.short_description: The H-1 is an anime-only boat that Henzo designed.

enrichments.description:
Hachinosu, also known as , is a New World island known to be a that is currently occupied by the Blackbeard Pirates. It is said to be where the Davy Back Fight originated and where the legendary Rocks Pirates were formed.

Following the downfall of the Rocks Pirates during the God Valley Incident, the island was ruled by Ochoku until the Rocky Port Incident, where he was ousted by Blackbeard. Blackbeard intends to turn Hachinosu into a World Government-allied nation, under the preliminary name of .

Hachinosu is a small-to-mid-sized island (still large enough to dwarf Thriller Bark) whose foundation consists of dark-gray rock. Centrally on it are constructions made of yellowish rock, most prominently a large, skull-fashioned formation in its center, towering over all else. A city of many smaller buildings (all square, crudely brick-built ones) surrounds said skull, as do a series of proportionally huge palm trees. When Shakuyaku lived on the island, Shakky's Rip-off Bar was located here.

The skull's inside is carved into what appears to be a fortress (where Blackbeard has been shown to reside), with the "nose" hole being a giant glass window (plus featuring additional, smaller windows dotting the skull here and there), and both "eye" holes go right through the whole structure. On the outside, the skull is carved to look like it is wearing a bandana, including a rocky protrusion on the left side shaped like the ends of a knot. Originally, this rock lacked its eyeholes and was simply described as "fish-like" until Rocks D. Xebec blasted the holes into existence.
enrichments.short_description: Hachinosu, also known as , is a New World island known to be a that is currently occupied by the Blackbeard Pirates. It is said to be where the Davy Back Fight originated and where the legendary Rocks Pirates were…

enrichments.description:
"Hundredth Dan" Hack is a fish-man and a member of the Revolutionary Army, which he serves as combat instructor. He went to Dressrosa to investigate the arms trafficking there and competed at the Corrida Colosseum for the Mera Mera no Mi.

Hack is a fish-man with yellow skin that has brown spots on the upper part of his head, along with scales under his eyelids, sharp teeth, and gills on the sides of his neck. The fish-man has a muscular stature, with long light blue flowing hair and a thick blue mustache. Similar to Kuroobi, he wears an open gi with a black belt.

When he was transformed into a toy, he appeared to be shaped like a dog while maintaining the same color scheme.

Hack is a calm and proud person, and follows a dream where a path of friendship may be formed by fighting. For that reason, he will continue fighting. He finds fighting battles to be honorable and thus, dislikes those who show a lack of respect toward a fight such as Bartolomeo. He is very honorable and dislikes attacking an opponent from the back, but he will do it if said opponent is not worthy of his respect, as he did to Bartolomeo, who was urinating on the side of the fighting ring and was, in Hack's opinion, not taking the battle seriously.
enrichments.short_description: "Hundredth Dan" Hack is a fish-man and a member of the Revolutionary Army, which he serves as combat instructor. He went to Dressrosa to investigate the arms trafficking there and competed at the Corrida Colosseum for…

enrichments.description:
Hack was one of the archaeologists of Ohara.

Hack was an average sized man, with small eyes and a round nose. He had curly hair, and wore a striped short sleeved shirt, with light colored pants.

Not much is known of Hack's personality, but he did seem to care for knowledge, as he tried to save the library of Ohara.

As an archaeologist of Ohara, it can be assumed that Hack was able to decipher the poneglyphs.
enrichments.short_description: Hack was one of the archaeologists of Ohara.

enrichments.description:
Hajrudin is a giant warrior described as being from the "new generation" of Elbaph. He is the illegitimate son of the late King Harald and his original lover Ida, as well as the older half-brother of Prince Loki.

A century after the Giant Warrior Pirates' disbandment, Hajrudin formed the New Giant Warrior Pirates in an attempt to revive the legendary crew; they formerly served as S-class pirate mercenaries for Buggy's Pirate Dispatch Organization. Hajrudin competed in the Corrida Colosseum on Dressrosa, where he would team up with Monkey D. Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates to overthrow Donquixote Doflamingo's regime. Following this, Hajrudin swore his crew's allegiance to Luffy and became the captain of the sixth ship of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet.

He is a major ally during the Dressrosa and Elbaph Arcs, and one of the central characters of The Stories of the Self-Proclaimed Straw Hat Grand Fleet Cover Page Serial.

Hajrudin is a muscular giant, well proportioned, and has long dark brown hair, mustache, and beard. He wears a metal helmet (gold in the manga) with protector shades over his eyes. He sports large metal (gold in the manga) with shields on each one. He also wears a pair of black underwear covered by a skirt of brown leather strips. He also has a gold belt buckle, and sports big black boots. After leaving Buggy's Delivery, Hajrudin wears armor plates over his belt and below his chest, a thick fur cape, and bigger vambraces.
enrichments.short_description: Hajrudin is a giant warrior described as being from the "new generation" of Elbaph. He is the illegitimate son of the late King Harald and his original lover Ida, as well as the older half-brother of Prince Loki.

enrichments.description:
Hakowan is Wapol's pet dog, acquired after Wapol was permanently deposed from Drum Island.

Hakowan used to be a regular dog with small beady eyes and a tongue sticking out, similar to Chouchou, but smaller in size and without a frown.

After Wapol altered him with his Baku Baku no Mi abilities, he now has a box for a head and lenses for eyes.

Hakowan is somewhat disrespectful of others, since he urinated on Wapol when he first met him and kept doing so occasionally. Despite this, he is loyal to the former king, as he stood by his side through the entire cover story and beyond.
enrichments.short_description: Hakowan is Wapol's pet dog, acquired after Wapol was permanently deposed from Drum Island.

enrichments.description:
Hakugan is the helmsman of the Heart Pirates.

Hakugan is an average-sized man with light brown hair. He covers his face with a white mask featuring a smile design, and like most members of the Heart Pirates, he wears a white boiler suit with the crew's jolly roger on the left breast.

In One Piece novel Law: The Hour of Kikoku, it is revealed that he wears his mask to hide severe burn scars.

Hakugan is loyal to his crew and captain, listening to his orders to the letter.
enrichments.short_description: Hakugan is the helmsman of the Heart Pirates.

enrichments.description:
Ham Burger is the king of the Ballywood Kingdom, acting as chairman of the most recent Levely.

Ham Burger is a stern-looking older man with prominent cheekbones, a pointy pink nose, and a square jaw. He has bushy black hair and beard.

He wears a black suit with a white frilly shirt and a dark blue bow tie. He also has white gloves and a blue top hat with red stars.

Ham Burger appears to be a man of conviction, as even though he walks slowly, he has stated that he has never turned around.
enrichments.short_description: Ham Burger is the king of the Ballywood Kingdom, acting as chairman of the most recent Levely.

enrichments.description:
Hamburg is a combatant of the Foxy Pirates and the leader of the Groggy Monsters. Alongside Porche, he is one of Foxy's last remaining crewmates.

Due to his actions, he is a major antagonist during the Long Ring Long Land Arc.

Hamburg is a huge gorilla-like human who is almost always seen laughing. He wears the typical clothing of a Foxy Pirate from the mask to the long-sleeved gloves. He is the smallest member of the Groggy Monsters. He also wears a leopard patterned scarf. In the 4kids version of the game One Piece: Pirates Carnival, Hamburg has very dark skin and wears red instead of blue.

Hamburg is very unintelligent, similar to his fellow Groggy Monsters. He laughs at anything, whether it is his crew cheating or his depressed captain. He also laughs when he is nervous, as seen when the Straw Hats are deciding who to pick for their crew after the last round of the Davy Back Fight. Like the rest of the Foxy Pirates, he is quite dishonest and cheats whenever the opportunity presents itself.
enrichments.short_description: Hamburg is a combatant of the Foxy Pirates and the leader of the Groggy Monsters. Alongside Porche, he is one of Foxy's last remaining crewmates.

enrichments.description:
Hamlet is a Shinuchi in the Beasts Pirates. After being tamed by Tama, he became an ally of the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance.

Due to the nature of his SMILE transformation, Hamlet has an entire giraffe's body growing from his backside starting from the neck, thus leaving his main body hanging several meters in the air. He has long, shaggy bright green hair and possesses the ears and ossicones of a giraffe. He wears a regal-looking cloak that leaves his chest exposed and has pronounced shoulder pads, dark gloves, and also wears giraffe-printed pants and boots with spurs.

Hamlet is very cocky, speaking in a condescending tone to his underlings and being confident that he would easily deal with the threats they were afraid of.

As a Shinuchi, Hamlet has authority over the lower-ranking members of the Beasts Pirates.
enrichments.short_description: Hamlet is a Shinuchi in the Beasts Pirates. After being tamed by Tama, he became an ally of the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance.

enrichments.description:
Hammond is a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Daggertooth_pike_conger Daggertooth pike conger] fish-Man and a member of the now disbanded New Fish-Man Pirates.

He serves as a supporting antagonist in the Fish-Man Island Arc.

Hammond is a slim-looking bright yellow skinned Fish-Man with medium-length, puffy orange hair and a long and squarish neck with a small beard. His facial features are quite sinister: they include a long and sharp beak-like muzzle, razor-like teeth, and dark, glaring eyes. On his neck he has the tattoo of the Arlong Pirates symbol near his left shoulder, in honor of Arlong and his ideals. He also wears the New Fish-Man Pirates tattoo on the right side of his abdominals.

Hammond wears a long-sleeved black coat with a striped undershirt, both of which he keeps open to display his tattoos. Hammond wears shin-high, frayed white pants with a mint-green sash and black sandals. On his head he has a black fedora and earrings on both ears.
enrichments.short_description: Hammond is a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Daggertooth_pike_conger Daggertooth pike conger] fish-Man and a member of the now disbanded New Fish-Man Pirates.

enrichments.description:
O-Hana is a citizen of Wano Country, residing in the Flower Capital.

Hana is an average size woman with fair skin and blonde hair tied up in a shimada with a hairpin. She wears a blue flower over her right temple, and a light teal kimono with a purple obi.

Not much is known about Hana's personality since she was only shown in dire situations, during which she was timid and frightful.

Twenty-five years ago, Hana was one of the people abducted by Kurozumi Orochi and was meant to be used as a slave until being freed thanks to Kouzuki Oden.
enrichments.short_description: O-Hana is a citizen of Wano Country, residing in the Flower Capital.

enrichments.description:
The Hana Hana no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to replicate and sprout pieces of their body from the surface of any object or living thing. As further allusion to this, pinkish-white petal-like particles form at and then swirl away from where the parts sprout and vanish, as well as around the user itself. It was eaten by Nico Robin.

The power of the fruit was first demonstrated but not clearly seen before Luffy and crew when they first met Robin on the Going Merry. The fruit's actual power was fully revealed during Robin and Pell's confrontation.

The Hana Hana no Mi is a pink flower shaped fruit with a stem sprouting out of the top, with swirls that go in a curly "S" like-pattern on the petals. Its overall appearance greatly resembles a .

The fruit's major strength, as demonstrated by Nico Robin, is the ability to sprout multiple body parts on almost any surface, including the user's own body, and then manipulate said body parts remotely, as if they were an extension of the user's own original limbs. Since the user is practically the only one who knows where their limbs will sprout out, they almost always have the element of surprise on their side, which, coupled with the fruit's long range and almost instantaneous speed of limb sprouting, turns Robin into a massive threat during combat situations. Enemies may find themselves in an extremely compromising position if they do not possess enough strength or an ability that lets them somehow counter or escape from her myriad of summoned limbs.
enrichments.short_description: The Hana Hana no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to replicate and sprout pieces of their body from the surface of any object or living thing. As further allusion to this, pinkish-white petal-like…

enrichments.description:
Hanafuda, also known as the "King of Lizards", was a former Warlord of the Sea and affiliate of the Beasts Pirates who was defeated by Portgas D. Ace four years ago. Following his expulsion and eventual death at the hands of rival pirates, his Warlord position was given to Bartholomew Kuma. He was also the father of Ulti and Page One.

Hanafuda was an extremely tall and muscular man with sharp teeth. He had thick light-colored hair, partly coming out from under a dark, pointed hat that covered most of his face.

Hanafuda wore a long, knee-length, dark jacket that he kept unbuttoned and prominent, curved shoulder pads. He wore metal gloves on both hands, a belt that crossed his chest diagonally, light-colored trousers with irregular rectangular patterns with a wide metal belt over another fur-lined one, and tall dark boots.

Hanafuda had an interest in collecting Ancient Zoan Devil Fruits. He was a man captivated by strong individuals as he formed a partnership with Kaidou after clashing with him and for their shared goal, believing that the Emperor would be the next Pirate King. This admiration for Kaidou was strong enough for him to entrust the Emperor with his own children, who he apparently loved.
enrichments.short_description: Hanafuda, also known as the "King of Lizards", was a former Warlord of the Sea and affiliate of the Beasts Pirates who was defeated by Portgas D. Ace four years ago. Following his expulsion and eventual death at the…

enrichments.description:
Hand Island is a non-canon island in the New World, famous for its craftsmen, that was formerly under the protection of Whitebeard. After Whitebeard's death, the island was ruled by the Marine Commodore Bilić, until he was defeated by the Straw Hat Pirates.

The entire island is perfectly shaped like a human hand, thus giving it its name.

Hand Island was under Whitebeard Pirates' protection until Edward Newgate's death in the Summit War of Marineford.

After the Whitebeard Pirates' flag lost its protection value, some pirates began to attack the island and the Marine Commodore Bilić intervened, protecting the island in exchange of inhabitants' submission and male adults' enrollment in the Marines, starting the construction of the base and of the Josephine cannon. At the same time Diego's son, Regis joined the Marines. A year later the cannon was completed and Bilić started to shoot everyday at the island.
enrichments.short_description: Hand Island is a non-canon island in the New World, famous for its craftsmen, that was formerly under the protection of Whitebeard. After Whitebeard's death, the island was ruled by the Marine Commodore Bilić, until he…

enrichments.description:
Hangan is an infamous New World pirate captain who allied with Whitebeard.

Hangan is a man with an abnormally long neck, and blue-grey hair. His cheekbones are square, along with parts of his forehead. He sports a dark coat with a white fur lined hood. He also has a black cowboy hat, and a spotted shirt under his coat.

His personality is not known, but he seems to care about Ace as he was willing to risk his life to save him from execution instead of fleeing through the path he had cleared that Whitebeard with his power.

Hangan is a fearsome pirate who has managed to achieve an infamous reputation in the New World, and to make an alliance with Whitebeard. It is still unknown what abilities and weapons he possesses.
enrichments.short_description: Hangan is an infamous New World pirate captain who allied with Whitebeard.

enrichments.description:
Hanger is an employee at Robecca Hanberg, a clothing store in Loguetown. Nami tried on all of his best clothes, but did not buy any.

Hanger is a normal-sized man, with black hair, with part that resembles a clothes hanger. He has a large forehead, and thick black eyebrows. He has a round, long nose that goes down, and a black mustache that curls up. He wears a purple vest with vertical lines on it, with a pink long-sleeved shirt underneath, and a light green tie. He also has black pants.

He was an enthusiastic man that enjoyed customers visiting his shop. He has displayed patience towards customers, as shown when he was later upset at Nami for walking out of the shop after trying on all of his clothes, but still bid her farewell in a nice manner.

While Nami was trying on the clothes in his store, Hanger kept complimenting her on how good she looked. After letting Nami try on all of the clothes in his store, Hanger prepared to checkout and asked if she was going to buy it all. However, she simply declared that she was not interested in anything and wanted something more casual to travel in. Upset by her decision, Hanger was seen crying, but he still asked for her to please come again.
enrichments.short_description: Hanger is an employee at Robecca Hanberg, a clothing store in Loguetown. Nami tried on all of his best clothes, but did not buy any.

enrichments.description:
Hanji is a resident of Wano Country who has been running a pawn shop for over 10 years.

Hanji is a portly man with a thick neck, drooping eyes, a large mouth, and a thin mustache. He has chin-length brown hair that curls outward on the sides, and he has a topknot. Hanji wears a teal kimono with green rippled patterning, and a burgundy coat.

Little is known about Hanji's personality. He initially had trouble recalling who purchased the blueprints to Kaidou's fortress from him.

Ten years ago, Hanji purchased the blueprints to Kaidou's fortress from Minatomo.
enrichments.short_description: Hanji is a resident of Wano Country who has been running a pawn shop for over 10 years.

enrichments.description:
Hanji is a former prisoner of Udon's Prisoner Mine.

Hanji is a middle-aged man with tanned skin and a scar over his left eye. He has lavender-colored hair and is mostly bold at the top apart from a orange flame-like mohawk. At Udon, he wears the standard prisoner outfit.

In the anime, he wears a red kimono after discarding the prison uniform.

Hanji believes that there is no freedom in Wano Country and is willing to obey the Beasts Pirates rather than rebel. He does not want to be given "unnecessary" hope and cries tears of anguish while restraining Luffy. In the anime, he also showed himself to be a rather restless person, which forced Hyougoro to calm him down.
enrichments.short_description: Hanji is a former prisoner of Udon's Prisoner Mine.

enrichments.description:
Hannyabal is the warden of Impel Down. Formerly the Vice Warden, he was promoted to Magellan's position following the mass breakout.

Due to his actions and role, he is a major antagonist in the Impel Down Arc.

Hannyabal is a large pot-bellied man that resembles a cross between a demon and an Egyptian pharaoh. On the one hand, his face is reminding of a mask, with the brow ridge shaped like horns and large jawline; on the other hand, he has a long chin much like a pharaoh's false beard and wears a with yellow and green stripes. Like all Impel Down personnel, he wears small bat-like wings on his back and carries a pitchfork around, in addition to his personal weapon Kessui.

Twenty-two years before the main events, when Shiki escaped the prison, Hannyabal wore the standard militaristic white uniform like other normal guards. He already wore the nemes. As Vice Warden, he used to go bare-chested.
enrichments.short_description: Hannyabal is the warden of Impel Down. Formerly the Vice Warden, he was promoted to Magellan's position following the mass breakout.

enrichments.description:
Hanzo is a ninja and a member of the Beasts Pirates. He previously was a member of the Orochi Oniwabanshu which served the shogun of Wano Country, Kurozumi Orochi.

Due to his actions and role, he is a minor antagonist in the Wano Country Arc.

Hanzo is a very large and thickset man. He wears a yellow mask over his face that only exposes his eyes, and has a skull design on the forehead. He also wears a yellow kimono with shuriken designs on it and a light green scarf around his neck, and his entire body below his head appears to be covered in dark green netting.

Like the other members of the Orochi Oniwabanshu, Hanzo is loyal to the shogun Orochi and is dedicated to his job. While appearing calm most of the time he is on the job, he became gripped by fear when he encountered the renowned kunoichi Shinobu.
enrichments.short_description: Hanzo is a ninja and a member of the Beasts Pirates. He previously was a member of the Orochi Oniwabanshu which served the shogun of Wano Country, Kurozumi Orochi.

enrichments.description:
Happa Yamao is a civilian of Water 7 whom Usopp bought wood and supplies from in order to repair the Going Merry. He is an old bandit turned carpenter who moved to Water 7 from the "Gourmet City", Pucci.

Happa is a tall fat man, easily towering over Usopp, with spiky dark hair and a beard of the same shape. He has a scar under his right eye. He also wears an unbuttoned blue collared shirt with a brown leaf design on it, with a white shirt beneath it.

He appears to be a kind man, as he gave Usopp some rice balls when he realized that Usopp was hungry and he was willing to take what little money Usopp had for him despite it not being enough to pay for what he bought.

As a carpenter, he has at least some skill in carpentry.
enrichments.short_description: Happa Yamao is a civilian of Water 7 whom Usopp bought wood and supplies from in order to repair the Going Merry. He is an old bandit turned carpenter who moved to Water 7 from the "Gourmet City", Pucci.

enrichments.description:
Happygun is an infamous New World pirate captain who allied with Whitebeard.

Happygun is a tall man with long black hair, a long pointed nose, and a triple pointed chin. He wears a purple coat with pink inner edges that exposes his chest.

In his original concept art, he wore a light colored coat with light colored buttons and lines at the end of the sleeves over a light colored vest underneath. Under the vest, he wore a button up white shirt. He also has a light colored sash and dark colored pants with long boots that go to his thighs.

Since Happygun was willing to put his life on the line to save Ace from execution, it can be deduced that Happygun is a person that values loyalty and friendship. Furthermore, since he was willing to brave the fight against Marine Headquarters, it can be concluded that Happygun is a daring and fearless pirate captain.
enrichments.short_description: Happygun is an infamous New World pirate captain who allied with Whitebeard.

enrichments.description:
Hara is a resident who lives in the Flower Capital of Wano Country.

Hara is a stocky man with a double chin and lumps under and above his eyes. He has long, curly brown hair which is tied in a topknot but loose on the sides. He wears light green kimono with yellow dots and light blue line patterns, as well as a gray cape with green leaf patterns.

Hara is a timid man who is visibly afraid of the consequences of talking negatively about Shogun Orochi. He is also easily scared by stories such as Kyoshiro's retelling of the "vengeful ghosts" interpretation of Toki's prophecy. However, he seems somewhat curious as he woke Kyoshiro up to finish his story.

Hara was present at Kyoshiro's residence when the latter started criticizing Shogun Kurozumi Orochi for fearing vengeance by "ghosts" of the Kouzuki Family. Hara attempted to stop Kyoshiro from speaking loudly but was rebuffed. When Kyoshiro fell asleep in the middle of his story, Hara woke him up to finish it.
enrichments.short_description: Hara is a resident who lives in the Flower Capital of Wano Country.

enrichments.description:
Harald was the most recent king of Elbaph and a member of the Knights of God. He is the father of Hajrudin and Loki, born respectively from Ida, his original lover, and Estrid, his official spouse.

Celebrated as Elbaph's greatest king, Harald spent most of his reign campaigning to undo his homeland's reputation as a warmongering nation and affiliate it with the World Government. Among his local accomplishments were the construction of the Walrus School and the several branch routes that connect Elbaph's villages together. However, 14 years ago Harald was betrayed by the World Government, which corrupted him in an attempt to enslave his subjects. Despite this, Harald foiled their plot by having his son Loki kill him, though the true reason for his death would not become known by the rest of Elbaph until the present day.

Harald's life and death make him a major figure in the events of the Elbaph Arc.

Harald was a broad-shouldered muscular giant who sported jagged eyebrows and a curved double-line tattoo framing his left temple and going through his left eye. Due to his lineage as a descendant of ancient giants, Harald was larger than most modern giants and was born with a pair of horns poking from his head.
enrichments.short_description: Harald was the most recent king of Elbaph and a member of the Knights of God. He is the father of Hajrudin and Loki, born respectively from Ida, his original lover, and Estrid, his official spouse.

enrichments.description:
Haredas is an old man who lives in Weatheria. He was Nami's tutor in weather-manipulation during the timeskip.

Haredas is an old man who has a long, white beard and long, straight hair of the same color, that fall on his back. He wears a blue pointed hat that matches his wizard-like robe, which stretches down to his feet. In the manga, he is fairly tall, whereas in the anime, he is rather short. Sometimes, Haredas' eyes are shown large and shining, much like Nyon's when she admires Hancock's cuteness.

Haredas has shown to have a rather carefree upbeat personality, smiling and seemingly enjoying himself mostly. He is also slightly absent-minded and bumbling and tends to repeat certain many things he already said and introduced before. Also, he is shown to be very patient and even after Nami kept (inappropriately) hitting him, and still maintained his friendly attitude with her. He has a habit to address to people repeatedly "oi, oi, oi, oi, oi, oi, oi, oi, oi, oi" ("hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey") instead of only one time.

Haredas is very patient with Nami, despite her ungrateful and, at times, physically abusive attitude toward him. He was shocked by her idea of using the Weather Ball as a weapon, but he gladly mentored her in the science of Weatheria regardless. When Nami returned to her crew on Sabaody Archipelago, Haredas commented that Weatheria would be lonelier without her. He and the other scientists want to impress her, as seen from their choice to dress better after she left.
enrichments.short_description: Haredas is an old man who lives in Weatheria. He was Nami's tutor in weather-manipulation during the timeskip.

enrichments.description:
Hareji is a former prisoner of Udon's prisoner mines. In the past, he was a resident of the Flower Capital. In the anime credits and closed captions, he was named .

Hareji is a man of average height with a crescent-shaped scar on the left side of his face. He has turquoise hair formed in a pompadour at the front and a topknot at the back. At Udon, he wore a standard prisoner outfit.

In the anime, he wears a black and yellow striped kimono with a white after discarding the prison uniform.

41 years ago, in the anime, Hareji wore a lilac kimono. In the manga, he was dressed in a light-colored kimono with a pattern of four squares that form a larger square. In those days, he also did not have a scar on his face.
enrichments.short_description: Hareji is a former prisoner of Udon's prisoner mines. In the past, he was a resident of the Flower Capital. In the anime credits and closed captions, he was named .

enrichments.description:
Haritsu Kendiyo is a pirate captain whose crew was captured by the Kid Pirates as they tried to escape back to Paradise from the New World.

Kendiyo is a large man, bigger than Kid, and slightly fat as well. He has bushy brown hair and a scraggly beard, and wore a red captain's coat over a white shirt and brown pants. He has a sword over his back.

Kendiyo is shown to be a weak-hearted pirate. After his defeat and capture by the Kid Pirates, he wanted to run away and return to Paradise with his crew.

He seems to be very caring toward his crew as he begged Kid to let him and his crew escape alive from the New World and return to Paradise.
enrichments.short_description: Haritsu Kendiyo is a pirate captain whose crew was captured by the Kid Pirates as they tried to escape back to Paradise from the New World.

enrichments.description:
Haruta is the former 12th division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates.

Haruta has a crop of short brown hair, blue eyes, and is fairly short. He wears a green and white 16th century-style ruffed outfit with white tights and carries a saber whose hand guard resembles the ruffles of his shirt.

Haruta was loyal to Whitebeard, and wanted to save Portgas D. Ace at Marineford. Haruta cried when Ace died, showing that he cared for him.

As the commander of the 12th division of the Whitebeard Pirates, Haruta has authority over the lower-ranking subordinates. He is presumably very strong: this statement was bolstered when Jinbe remarked that all of the Whitebeard commanders have great strength.
enrichments.short_description: Haruta is the former 12th division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates.

enrichments.description:
Hasami is a giant desert crab from Sandy Island, and a friend of Matsuge the camel. Originally an inhabitant of the deserts near Rainbase, he currently works as an employee of Ukkari Hot-Spring Island.

He serves as an ally to the Straw Hat Pirates during the Arabasta Arc.

Hasami is a red-shelled crab the size of a small house, with a human-like mouth in a perpetual leer. His claws are sharply asymmetric, with the right being much larger than the left. While he aided the Straw Hats, he wore a pair of reins hooked to the corners of his mouth, and bore a thick green matting atop his shell; it remains unknown whether the latter was some sort of tarp, or naturally-growing plant life.

Under the employment of Ukkari Hot-Spring Island, he now wears a howdah-esque carriage (large enough to hold dozens of average-sized humans) shaped after a bus driver's cap; its "hatband" is decorated with a scissors emblem, and equipped with a massive flashlight. His face also bears the resort's logo—UKKARI bisected by an old-fashioned rendering of the kanji for .
enrichments.short_description: Hasami is a giant desert crab from Sandy Island, and a friend of Matsuge the camel. Originally an inhabitant of the deserts near Rainbase, he currently works as an employee of Ukkari Hot-Spring Island.

enrichments.description:
Hatcha is a member of the Numbers in the Beasts Pirates, representing the number "eight".

Due to his actions and role, he is a minor antagonist in the Wano Country Arc.

Like the other Numbers, Hatcha is an enormous humanoid larger than a typical giant, standing at a height of 36.7 meters. Like his fellow Numbers and most of the Beasts Pirates in general, Hatcha has a pair of horns atop his head. While some of the other Numbers have more animal-like features, Hatcha looks very humanoid, having peach skin, a set of rounded teeth and indigo hair arranged in a bowl cut. On the left side of his abdomen is a tattoo of the daiji "捌", which means eight.

He wears a yellow track-jacket that remains unzipped, leaving his bare chest exposed, dark pants and light shoes with laces. He also possesses a pair of oval sunglasses.
enrichments.short_description: Hatcha is a member of the Numbers in the Beasts Pirates, representing the number "eight".

enrichments.description:
Hatchan, nicknamed , is an fish-man who was an officer of the Arlong Pirates before their defeat, and a member of the Sun Pirates before that.

After the rest of the Arlong Pirates were arrested, Hatchan was the sole member to escape, and went on many adventures which ended in him opening a floating takoyaki restaurant and meeting up again with the Straw Hat Pirates.

He was one of the major antagonists of the Arlong Park Arc. He is also the central character of the Hatchan's Sea-Floor Stroll Cover Page Serial. Later, along with Camie, he is one of the main supporting characters of both the Sabaody Archipelago and Fish-Man Island Arcs as an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates.

Hatchan, being an octopus fish-man, has eight appendages (six arms and two legs) and an octopus-like face. He has pink skin and grey hair styled into five spikes. By the time he had become a takoyaki salesman, he had a second row of spikes. He has a muscular build and suction cups on his six arms, which he can use to cling on to walls. Hatchan has a tattoo in the shape of a sun on his forehead, as a result of being in the Sun Pirates.
enrichments.short_description: Hatchan, nicknamed , is an fish-man who was an officer of the Arlong Pirates before their defeat, and a member of the Sun Pirates before that.

enrichments.description:
Hatsume is a samurai and member of the Beasts Pirates. She was formerly a member of the Mimawarigumi serving Kurozumi Orochi until Orochi's seeming death.

Hatsume is a short woman with long blonde hair kept in two ponytails with red flowers. She wears a red mask over her face, as well as a red kimono with flower and leaf patterns on it and a white cloak.

Little is known about Hatsume's personality. She was presumably loyal to Kurozumi Orochi until the latter's seeming death, but had no issue with defecting to the Beasts Pirates afterward in spite of what the samurai code of honor held. She was shown with a sullen expression following this event.

She is known for never removing her mask, and apparently nobody has ever seen what's under it.
enrichments.short_description: Hatsume is a samurai and member of the Beasts Pirates. She was formerly a member of the Mimawarigumi serving Kurozumi Orochi until Orochi's seeming death.

enrichments.description:
Hattori is Rob Lucci's pet pigeon, and initially acted as the target of his ventriloquism.

Hattori is a white pigeon and is always seen wearing a light red tie while Lucci was undercover as a shipwright and a black one afterwards. He wore a light green coat identical to his master's while Lucci wore his during the Sea Train ride to Enies Lobby and the meeting at the Tower of Justice.

After the timeskip, Hattori wears a white coat and hat resembling those worn by Lucci, though with the addition of a white necktie.

Why Hattori is with Lucci is unknown considering the man's reputation as a heartless mass-murderer, though Lucci has had him since he was a child. He apparently is not afraid of Lucci and is very loyal to him, as he stays close to his master even in dangerous situations like the Buster Call. He even attempted to bandage him after his fight with Luffy and was happy when Lucci finally woke up in the hospital in St. Poplar. When Lucci is not fighting, Hattori is usually perched on his master's right shoulder.
enrichments.short_description: Hattori is Rob Lucci's pet pigeon, and initially acted as the target of his ventriloquism.

enrichments.description:
Hawkman is a man of average size. Due to the SMILE that he consumed, a large green hawk is present on the back of his body, acting as a sort of hood over his head, and possessing large wings. Unlike other Gifters, he does not possess a pair of horns. He wears a blue-green fur coat over his shoulders, red pants, brown boots, and a belt bearing the symbol of the Beasts Pirates.

Like most pirates, Hawkman seems to revel in causing violence and chaos. He had little issue with blowing up various ships and infrastructure on Orochi's orders, and didn't hesitate to gloat about it when given the chance. He also showed great confidence in Kaidou's abilities, going as far as to completely disregard the Straw Hats and their allies' attempts to overthrow him.

Hawkman seems quite capable of fighting, given his status as a Gifter, as well as his confidence in his own strength. However, when confronted by three members of the worst generation, he was unable to harm any of them.

As a Gifter, Hawkman has consumed a SMILE fruit, giving him the power of flight through the hawk on his back.
enrichments.short_description: Hawkman is a man of average size. Due to the SMILE that he consumed, a large green hawk is present on the back of his body, acting as a sort of hood over his head, and possessing large wings. Unlike other Gifters, he…

enrichments.description:
Headband Catfish Village is a small village located beneath the seas of Paradise where many catfish reside.

Headband Catfish Village is located on the Sea Floor, and it is composed of small, shorts dwellings with small round windows. One of the damaged buildings was a medicial facility.

The village's citizens are all catfish who wear carpenters coats and rope headbands. They are also skilled carpenters, building Hatchan's Takoyaki 8 overnight.

Headband Catfish Village was the home of the catfish until it was destroyed by a sunken ship. Octopako laughed at them when she saw their village in ruin. Hatchan, Camie, and Pappag came across the starving villagers as they were struggling to rebuild. Hatchan ran away from his friends and the village, taking all the treasure he found with him. However, he used it to purchase cooking equipment. He and his friends saved the catfish villagers from starvation by making them takoyaki. They returned to the surface, and an old catfish came to Hatchan for takoyaki right before he gave his last batch to Octopako. Hatchan gave it to the old catfish instead of Octopako, and she punched him for it. The catfish villagers decided to reward him by making him a ship that he could use to sell takoyaki.
enrichments.short_description: Headband Catfish Village is a small village located beneath the seas of Paradise where many catfish reside.

enrichments.description:
The Headband Catfish Village Elder is the chief of the Headband Catfish Village.

The Elder is an old catfish with a droopy face, long beard, and thick eyebrows. Like all other villagers, he wears a carpenter's coat and a rope headband.

The Elder cares deeply about his village and was sad about its destruction by a sunken ship. He was a kind person who encouraged his hungry villagers, and even when Hatchan treated him to takoyaki, he prioritized others getting food first.

Like the rest of his village, the Elder is a skilled carpenter. Alongside his villagers, they were able to build Takoyaki 8 overnight.
enrichments.short_description: The Headband Catfish Village Elder is the chief of the Headband Catfish Village.

enrichments.description:
Heat has long light blue, shaggy hair. His mouth stretches to the sides of his face like a Glasgow smile. He has black sunken eyes and visible bone ridges on his forehead.
