enrichments.description:
Kikunojo of the Lingering Snow, more commonly referred to as Kiku, is a samurai from Wano Country and a retainer for the Kouzuki Family, serving as one of Kouzuki Oden's Nine Red Scabbards. She is also the younger sister of Izou and the daughter of the dancing school head of the in Ringo.

After traveling forward in time, she worked as a tea house poster girl in Okobore Town while gathering information for the planned rebellion. She participated in the Raid on Onigashima where she battled Kaidou alongside the other Scabbards, losing her left arm to one of Kaidou's attacks. Following Kouzuki Momonosuke's ascent to shogun, she serves as the daimyo of Ringo.

She is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Wano Country Arc.

Kikunojo has a feminine appearance and she is noted for her beauty given her past reputation as the . She has long dark-violet (dark-blue in the anime) hair that falls onto her back with square bangs hanging above her eyebrows while she has shoulder-length hair strands hanging on either side, indigo eyes and she is very tall, easily towering over the likes of Monkey D. Luffy and Roronoa Zoro as well as her older brother at 287 cm.
enrichments.short_description: Kikunojo of the Lingering Snow, more commonly referred to as Kiku, is a samurai from Wano Country and a retainer for the Kouzuki Family, serving as one of Kouzuki Oden's Nine Red Scabbards. She is also the younger…

enrichments.description:
Kikyo is a Kuja warrior from Amazon Lily.

Kikyo is a slim normal-sized Kuja woman with tan skin and long black hair arranged in a ponytail.

Like all Kuja, she wears revealing clothes and carries a snake weapon. Kikyo’s attire is composed of black one piece swimsuit. The top straps being decorated with studs attached to a ring link connecting the bottom straps to form a cross, exposing a plunge neck. She also wears a white cape.

She seems to be one of the toughest and most mature of the Kuja. Kikyo discouraged Luffy's presence on the island, especially after seeing the return of Boa Hancock. Of the Kuja at the party after the arena fight, she is the only one not amused at Luffy's antics. She also shouts at the Kuja who put sticks in their mouths and noses during Luffy's departure from the island with Hancock.
enrichments.short_description: Kikyo is a Kuja warrior from Amazon Lily.

enrichments.description:
"Massacre Soldier" Killer is a pirate from the South Blue and a combatant of the Kid Pirates. He is one of twelve pirates who are referred to as the "Worst Generation". After the timeskip, his bounty has been raised from 162,000,000 to 200,000,000.

Following the confrontation with Kaidou, Killer ate a defective SMILE and took on the alias of Kamazo the Manslayer, a street murderer in Wano Country who secretly acted as an assassin working for the shogun, Kurozumi Orochi, until the shogun discarded him after he had failed his mission to kill Toko. He later reunites with his crew and becomes an ally member of the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance during the Wano Country Arc.

Killer is a tall muscular man with fair skin, he has long wild messy blonde hair sticking up in all distance reaching down to his thighs he wears a plain, white and light-blue striped full-head helmet with many rows of holes in it, and what look like modern headphones on both sides. He also wears a black shirt with white polka-dots and an open collar that shows his chest, with blue riding chaps over his ankle-length blue-grey pants. Additionally, Killer has a red sash around his waist.

He carries a pair of handguards which have very long detachable scythes connected to them. When not fighting, these scythes are placed in a green large sheath tied to his right hip.
enrichments.short_description: "Massacre Soldier" Killer is a pirate from the South Blue and a combatant of the Kid Pirates. He is one of twelve pirates who are referred to as the "Worst Generation". After the timeskip, his bounty has been raised…

enrichments.description:
Killkhan is a member of the Giant Warrior Pirates.

Killkhan is an overweight giant with green semi-long hair, a green mustache, a large double chin, and a button nose. He wears a spiked metal helmet which hides his eyes, a chainmail tunic, and a cape attached with suspenders.

Killkhan appears to be gluttonous as he carried a piece of meat into combat. As a member of the Giant Warrior Pirates, he does not shy away from combat, and was willing to fight to defend his homeland. However, when the likes of their MMA relatives attacked the giants, Killkhan, like everyone else, admitted that he did not have the guts to fight against them. Like other giants, he admires Nika.

As a giant, Killkhan possesses superhuman strength and resistance.
enrichments.short_description: Killkhan is a member of the Giant Warrior Pirates.

enrichments.description:
Kimel is a short man with a pointed nose. He wears a light-colored top with a frilled collar and puffy sleeves. He also wears light-colored pants, light-colored shoes, and a light-colored hat with triangles on the front of it.

Kimel cares greatly about his captain, Portgas D. Ace, since he was willing to defend him from Edward Newgate. Kimel can also be somewhat disrespectful, laughing at Deuce's adventure diary despite the fact that it is his main aspiration of their travels.

Like the rest of the Spade Pirates, Kimel cares greatly for his captain, defending him from an Emperor. However, he was not seen at the Summit War of Marineford.

Most of the Spade Pirates' crew members (excluding Skull, Mihar, and Kotatsu) read and laughed at Deuce's poor writing in his adventure diary. Because of this, their names were excluded from the diary.
enrichments.short_description: Kimel is a short man with a pointed nose. He wears a light-colored top with a frilled collar and puffy sleeves. He also wears light-colored pants, light-colored shoes, and a light-colored hat with triangles on the front…

enrichments.description:
"Foxfire" Kin'emon is a samurai from the region of Kuri in Wano Country who currently serves the shogunate as a in the Flower Capital. Once a thug in his youth, he became a retainer of the Kouzuki Family and the leader of Kouzuki Oden's Nine Red Scabbards. He was born 56 years before the present day, but traveled 20 years forward in time when he was 36 years old.

Due to Wano Country having been taken over by Shogun Kurozumi Orochi, an ally of Kaidou of the Four Emperors, Kin'emon set out on a seafaring quest to recruit warriors for his cause, bringing alongside him his master Kouzuki Momonosuke and his fellow retainers Kanjuro and Raizo. After a series of misadventures, Kin'emon ended up on the island of Punk Hazard, where he met and joined forces with the Straw Hat Pirates, posing as Momonosuke's father during the journey to Zou.

He is one of the central allies of the Straw Hats during the Dressrosa, Whole Cake Island and Wano Country Sagas.

Kin'emon's appearance matches the stereotype of samurai found in ancient Japan, with a black topknot and goatee. At 295 cm (9'8"), he is taller than Brook who stands at 277 cm (9'1"). He is also quite muscular. His eyes are asymmetrical, with his right eye opening more than his left.
enrichments.short_description: "Foxfire" Kin'emon is a samurai from the region of Kuri in Wano Country who currently serves the shogunate as a in the Flower Capital. Once a thug in his youth, he became a retainer of the Kouzuki Family and the leader…

enrichments.description:
Kinbo is a boy who lives in Okobore Town of Kuri with his mother Yame and his little brother.

Kinbo is a small boy with round eyes and nose, and dark brown hair which is very short apart from a tuft in the back. He wears a tattered green kimono with yellow patches.

Kinbo was unable to hold back tears due to extreme hunger despite his mother's insistence that Wano Country boys do not complain.

Kinbo and his little brother cried from hunger due to Okobore Town's shortage of food while their mother Yame tried to calm them down. When Zoro, Kiku and Law arrived with the Treasure Ship of Provisions, Kinbo and his family were able to eat as much as they wanted.
enrichments.short_description: Kinbo is a boy who lives in Okobore Town of Kuri with his mother Yame and his little brother.

enrichments.description:
Kinderella, also known as Miss Universe, is a woman who married Wapol after he became the head of his own corporation. Two years after that, she became the queen of the Evil Black Drum Kingdom when Wapol became its king.

Kinderella is a tall, slender woman with purple hair whose mouth is often seen open. She wore long purple dresses, and was seen by others as beautiful. After becoming the queen, she added a dark cape with bat wings on the shoulders, a hood with a crow design, long light-colored gloves, and an eye-mask.

Kinderella enjoys listening to her husband insulting other people and laughs profusely when he does so, indicating that she is as rude as he is. She sometimes adds "-universe" as a suffix at the end of her sentences.

Kinderella is a rather shallow person, as she only "loves" Wapol for his money.
enrichments.short_description: Kinderella, also known as Miss Universe, is a woman who married Wapol after he became the head of his own corporation. Two years after that, she became the queen of the Evil Black Drum Kingdom when Wapol became its king.

enrichments.description:
King the Conflagration is one of the three All-Stars of the Beasts Pirates and Kaidou's right-hand man. Born as Arber, he is a member of the near-extinct lunarian race from the Red Line, noted for their ability to create fire.

He was a prisoner and test subject on Punk Hazard 34 years ago, where a sample of his Lineage Factor was extracted from him before he was freed and recruited by Kaidou. That same genetic material would be used by Dr. Vegapunk decades later as a key component in the creation of the Seraphim.

Due to his actions and role, he is a major antagonist in the Wano Country Arc.

King is a towering man at 613 cm tall, with a well-muscled, broad-shouldered frame and long limbs. Being a lunarian, he has his race's telltale features: large, black-feathered wings on his back that reach down to knee length, a brown complexion, and silver-white hair. Said hair is shaved on the sides but kept long on top, where it is mostly drawn back and bound at King's occiput before flowing freely down past his nape; some sidelocks hang down on the right of King's face, to his collarbone, and include a thin braid. King's face is characterized by his narrow red eyes, prominent dark eyebrows, a straight nose, prominent lips, and a square, stubbly chin. Circling halfway around his left eye, on its outer side, is a black tattoo resembling a or . In addition, a plume of fire constantly rises from King's upper back, also owing to his heritage (though it may extinguish), and when King transforms into a pteranodon, these flames further engulf his back and wings while his natural lunarian wings are replaced by his pterosaur ones. When being dealt the finishing blow by Roronoa Zoro amid the conclusion to their fight, King had half his right wing sliced off.
enrichments.short_description: King the Conflagration is one of the three All-Stars of the Beasts Pirates and Kaidou's right-hand man. Born as Arber, he is a member of the near-extinct lunarian race from the Red Line, noted for their ability to…

enrichments.description:
Kinga is an infamous New World pirate captain who was once a member of the Whitebeard Pirates before forming his own crew subordinate to Whitebeard.

He is a rather tall man with brown hair and a thin mustache. His hair sticks up into the air, and he wears an open blue shirt.

In the anime, he does not have a mustache.

Thirty years ago, Kinga was visibly younger, and kept his hair straight upward. He wore a dark yellow kimono.
enrichments.short_description: Kinga is an infamous New World pirate captain who was once a member of the Whitebeard Pirates before forming his own crew subordinate to Whitebeard.

enrichments.description:
Kingbaum is a tree homie, a member of the Big Mom Pirates, and the master of the Seducing Woods on Whole Cake Island. However, he was forced to serve the Straw Hat Pirates due to them possessing Charlotte Linlin's Vivre Card.

Kingbaum is an extremely large tree homie with a wide light gray trunk and a large amount of blueish gray foliage. He has small eyes, a very long and pointy nose, a very long handlebar mustache, a mouth full of sharp teeth, a large tongue, and two rather small arms that cannot even reach across his body.

During Luffy and Cracker's battle, the top of Kingbaum's head was cut off, removing most of his branches. When the Big Mom Pirates' army attacked the Straw Hats, Kingbaum was bisected vertically by Amande. However, he was later stitched back together. After being struck with Big Mom's "Ikoku" technique, Kingbaum lost the upper left corner of his body, just before reaching the eye but after reaching the left arm, down to the waist. After suffering a direct hit from Prometheus, Kingbaum was left burnt char black.

Kingbaum takes his duties very seriously and will ensure that all intruders in the Seducing Woods are killed. He carries some pride with his position, viewing outside assistance as unnecessary and being confident in the abilities of himself and his subordinates. He is the only homie so far to not fear Charlotte Cracker; like other homies, however, he fears the power of a Vivre Card containing Big Mom's soul.
enrichments.short_description: Kingbaum is a tree homie, a member of the Big Mom Pirates, and the master of the Seducing Woods on Whole Cake Island. However, he was forced to serve the Straw Hat Pirates due to them possessing Charlotte Linlin's Vivre…

enrichments.description:
Kingdew is the former 11th division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates.

Kingdew is a large tanned man with short blonde hair and hollowed-out cheeks. He wears a pair of long, armored blue gauntlets. He also wears a brown cape that he seems to have pierced to his shoulders, and black and golden yellow striped pants tucked inside simple boots, with a light blue sash around his waist. On the right side of his chest there is a large, elaborate tattoo, which seems to incorporate a dark blue Whitebeard's iconic mustache in it.

Kingdew is very loyal to the Whitebeard Pirates and Whitebeard, as he was willing to risk his own life in order to save Ace from execution during the war at Marineford.

As the 11th division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates, he has authority over a number of subordinates. He's presumably a proficient combatant, as Jinbe remarked that each commander is very strong.
enrichments.short_description: Kingdew is the former 11th division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates.

enrichments.description:
Kinoko is a former prisoner on Level 5 of Impel Down and is currently a member of the Buggy Pirates, joining after his escape from Impel Down and the Summit War of Marineford.

Kinoko is a very large, corpulent man, with tan skin, a round nose, small eyes, a large mouth, and a predominant lower lip. For the size of his abdomen, he has rather short, skinny limbs. He also has brown hair that comes to a peak at the top. He wears a standard prisoner suit with black and white horizontal stripes.

When he was locked in Level 5 of Impel Down, Kinoko was negative to any possibility of running away from the Great Prison. He tried to convince Luffy to accept his death, stating that wanting to save someone else is just an absurdity. After being freed, he was revealed to still be wary of strong opponents, like Marshall D. Teach.

Kinoko is also gullible, believing Buggy to be a powerful savior because he stood up to directly addressed two Emperors when, in reality, Buggy was a friend of emperor Shanks.
enrichments.short_description: Kinoko is a former prisoner on Level 5 of Impel Down and is currently a member of the Buggy Pirates, joining after his escape from Impel Down and the Summit War of Marineford.

enrichments.description:
The Kinoko Islands is a non-canon archipelago in the East Blue, located near the Gecko Islands. It appears in Set Sail Pirate Crew!.

The Kinoko Islands are made up of four small islands, respectively known as the "West", "Left", "Right", and "East" islands (from left to right).

The archipelago is located roughly southeast of Syrup Village, between it and Pescatore Island.

The Kinoko Islands is home to the extremely rare Amanita Truffle.
enrichments.short_description: The Kinoko Islands is a non-canon archipelago in the East Blue, located near the Gecko Islands. It appears in Set Sail Pirate Crew!.

enrichments.description:
The Kira Kira no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit which allows the user to transform their body into diamond. It was eaten by Jozu.

The fruit allows the user to turn parts of their body into diamond, granting them exceptional toughness. As diamond is one of the hardest substances in the world, the user's defenses seem to enhance exponentially. Not even Dracule Mihawk, the world's strongest swordsman known for his unparalleled swordsmanship, and his renowned "strongest slash in the world," can penetrate Jozu's body.

One noticeable drawback is the user is Therefore, Jozu cannot harden his entire body or he will be rendered completely unable to move.

This fruit's ability is not to be confused with a Logia, as the user cannot create or control diamonds outside his body. The fruit also does not offer the intangibility given to most Logia users.
enrichments.short_description: The Kira Kira no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit which allows the user to transform their body into diamond. It was eaten by Jozu.

enrichments.description:
Kirintauros is a former member of the Centaur Patrol Unit under Brownbeard, having served as one of Caesar Clown’s henchmen. He is a giraffe centaur.

Kirintauros is a tall, lanky giraffe centaur with a long abdomen and limbs, medium-length black hair, a pointed nose, and a slightly wrinkled face. He has a very undefined chin, and he wears a maroon tank top.

Kirintauros dislikes intruders and is allegiant to Caesar Clown, as shown when he attacked Luffy.

In the anime, he is shown to be smarter and more observant than Hyoutauros.
enrichments.short_description: Kirintauros is a former member of the Centaur Patrol Unit under Brownbeard, having served as one of Caesar Clown’s henchmen. He is a giraffe centaur.

enrichments.description:
The Kiro Kiro no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to change their weight from 1 to 10,000 kilograms without, in any way, affecting the overall size of their body. It was eaten by Mikita.

The Kiro Kiro no Mi is a cylindrical pink fruit with the typical swirl pattern on its skin. It has a thick T-shaped green stem on top that curves up at one end. The fruit's shape also bears a slight resemblance to a balance weight.

This fruit's primary ability is to manipulate the user's weight at will, as measured in kilograms. The minimum weight achievable is one kilogram, light enough to float with the wind using an umbrella. The user's maximum weight is ten thousand kilograms (equal to ten tons), dropping with intense force to crush their opponents below or shatter the ground where they land. At full weight, the user can severely injure even animals as large as dinosaurs.

Even with one's weight increased, it seems as though the user of the fruit can move normally, their movement being unaffected by their weight. They also do not seem to be particularly affected by the collisions they make with the ground, sustaining minimal damage from their descent. Meanwhile, with their weight decreased, the user can dodge enemy attacks from the ground with rather ease, simply needing to float away from the attack's range.
enrichments.short_description: The Kiro Kiro no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to change their weight from 1 to 10,000 kilograms without, in any way, affecting the overall size of their body. It was eaten by Mikita.

enrichments.description:
Kisegawa is a geisha from the Flower Capital of Wano Country. She once possessed the blueprints of Kaidou's fortress on Onigashima.

Kisegawa is a youthful-looking woman with large dark-brown eyes, Indian red lipstick and golden blonde hair that is gathered at the back with four, pastel flowers. She had light-red fingernails and wears an kimono with white and light-purple vertical stripes.

Kisegawa had a lack of understanding of what the Onigashima blueprints were about, leading her to use them as coasters.

At some point in the past, Kisegawa received the blueprints for Kaidou's lair on Onigashima from an old man named Kobe. Not knowing what the blueprints were for, she used them as a coaster for a pot until a man named Tokijiro eventually acquired them from her.
enrichments.short_description: Kisegawa is a geisha from the Flower Capital of Wano Country. She once possessed the blueprints of Kaidou's fortress on Onigashima.

enrichments.description:
Kitton is a boy who lives in Karakuri Island. He has a grandfather who takes care of him, as well as a cyborg dog named Taroimo.

Kitton is seen wearing a parka, a pair of boots, and a gun during his first appearance. Later on in his house, he is seen wearing a sweater. His house appears to be a mechanical looking igloo.

He is shown to be brave and courageous. This was evident when he was willing to face the unknown by confronting Franky.

He seems to have a close relationship to his grandfather, as he lives with him and went to confront Franky with him.
enrichments.short_description: Kitton is a boy who lives in Karakuri Island. He has a grandfather who takes care of him, as well as a cyborg dog named Taroimo.

enrichments.description:
Koala is a high ranking officer of the Revolutionary Army, serving as the Fish-Man Karate assistant instructor. She started as a slave on Mary Geoise, but was then set free by Fisher Tiger's rampage. She sailed along with the Sun Pirates to reach her home town. Approximately two years later, she left her family to join the Revolutionary Army, where she often works alongside both Sabo and Hack.

She first debuted as a child during a flashback in the Fish-Man Island Arc. She made her reappearance during the Dressrosa Arc.

When she appeared twelve years ago, Koala was a skinny girl with long, unkempt brown hair. She also had distinctively large and round purple eyes, similar to that of a koala, and was always smiling. She had on a dirty, short-sleeved collared shirt, which she wore under dark-brown overalls and a smudge on her right cheek. As a slave of the World Nobles, she had the mark of the Celestial Dragons on her back, which was replaced by the mark of the Sun Pirates by Fisher Tiger.

After a few weeks she had neat, shoulder-length hair, a yellow dress with an orange diamond pattern on the bottom of the dress that went around it, and a pair of orange loafers.
enrichments.short_description: Koala is a high ranking officer of the Revolutionary Army, serving as the Fish-Man Karate assistant instructor. She started as a slave on Mary Geoise, but was then set free by Fisher Tiger's rampage. She sailed along…

enrichments.description:
The Koala Mercenaries are a trio of bodyguards who watch over Rain Dinners.

Not much is known about their personalities, it can be assumed that they are loyal to Crocodile since he is their boss.

As bodyguards, they must surely be powerful enough to ensure their role. Nevertheless, they were easily defeated by Luffy.

When Luffy rushed through Rain Dinners to find Crocodile, they tried to stop him from rushing in but were defeated easily.
enrichments.short_description: The Koala Mercenaries are a trio of bodyguards who watch over Rain Dinners.

enrichments.description:
Kobe is a resident of the Flower Capital in Wano Country and the landlord for the Longhouses. He once possessed the blueprints of Kaidou's fortress on Onigashima.

Kobe is an elderly man with a mostly bald head, all of his light-grey hair is kept in the back although there is still enough to make a topknot. He wears a olive-green dotted kimono over a navy coat with a light-blue diamond patterns. As well as round, small glasses on his face. He smokes a pipe.

Kobe appears to not be particularly intelligent, as he gave fortress blueprints to a geisha to show his appreciation for her. However, he does seem to be an effective landlord, as he took those blueprints as payment when his tenant Kumagoro was unable to pay his rent.

At some point in the past, Kobe took a set of blueprints of Kaidou's fortress on Onigashima from his tenant Kumagoro due to the latter letting his rent pile up. After this, he gave the blueprints to his favorite geisha Kisegawa.
enrichments.short_description: Kobe is a resident of the Flower Capital in Wano Country and the landlord for the Longhouses. He once possessed the blueprints of Kaidou's fortress on Onigashima.

enrichments.description:
The Kobu Kobu no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to awaken the latent strength of others by encouraging them. It was eaten by Belo Betty.

The biggest strength of this fruit is the ability to increase other people's fighting spirit and physical strength by simply encouraging them with words. The user can encourage and strengthen multiple people at once, allowing them to turn entire groups of average people into powerful fighters, possibly turning the tide of battle and making this fruit best applicable in group combat. On the Lulusia Kingdom, Betty was able to turn a group of helpless citizens into strong fighters, capable of overwhelming a Grand Line pirate crew with only sticks.

However, its effectiveness in battle largely depends on the strengthened targets being willing to help the user, as encouragement is the most the user can do to influence their targets' actions, and the targets must make the choice to fight on their own. It is unknown if the user is capable of being strengthened by their own words or could they be selective with whom they empower; that it, encourage acknowledged allies while simply letting be those that are not. Otherwise, the user is affected by the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.

Betty used this fruit in combat while fighting the Peachbeard Pirates in the Lulusia Kingdom. By encouraging the citizens to stand up for themselves, the citizens were granted an increase in strength and became able to overwhelm the pirates with only sticks.
enrichments.short_description: The Kobu Kobu no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to awaken the latent strength of others by encouraging them. It was eaten by Belo Betty.

enrichments.description:
Koby the Hero is a Marine Captain, currently serving in the SWORD special forces unit. Alongside fellow SWORD member Helmeppo, he was trained and mentored into prominence under the legendary Vice Admiral Garp.

Originally a cabin boy enslaved by the Alvida Pirates, Koby was freed and befriended by Monkey D. Luffy, becoming Luffy's first traveling companion. Though he soon left to pursue his dream of Marine service, he continues to regard Luffy highly; after entering full-fledged service, he briefly reunited with Luffy on two occasions, as both friend and adversary. Overall, Koby has experienced a meteoric rise in the Marines, with many accomplishments and the Rocky Port Incident in particular cementing him as a public hero. During an arrest attempt on Boa Hancock, he was captured by the Blackbeard Pirates but eventually escaped with the help of Perona, his SWORD colleagues, and his mentor Garp.

For his atypical status, the Cross Guild has assigned Koby a 5-star bounty, worth 500,000,000.

He is Luffy's ally during the Romance Dawn Arc, and co-features with Helmeppo as a central character in the Diary of Koby-Meppo cover arc. Since then, he has appeared as a supporting character in the Post-Enies Lobby Arc, in the Marineford Arc, and in the Egghead Arc (with brief antagonistic roles in the former two) with more tertiary appearances in the Levely Arc and the Wano Country Arc.
enrichments.short_description: Koby the Hero is a Marine Captain, currently serving in the SWORD special forces unit. Alongside fellow SWORD member Helmeppo, he was trained and mentored into prominence under the legendary Vice Admiral Garp.

enrichments.description:
Koda is a Marine Chef, Kyuji's wife and mother of Moda.

Koda is a short, relatively pudgy woman who wears a marine apron and a dotted shirt.

Koda is a very loving mother who cares deeply for her daughter, as she was overjoyed when she met Moda after coming back from the Marine Base.

As she is a Marine chef, her cooking skills are assumed to be good enough for the Marines.
enrichments.short_description: Koda is a Marine Chef, Kyuji's wife and mother of Moda.

enrichments.description:
Koito is a young girl residing in Ebisu Town of the Wano Country.

Koito has a rather wide mouth with large teeth, and is missing a tooth in the right side. She has brown hair done in a bun.

Due to consuming a failed SMILE, Koito is always happy, sporting a big smile. She was considerate as she offered Zoro some clean water.

She offers Zoro a clean cup of water and assures him that it won't make his stomach hurt. He then takes the cup and drinks the water, putting a smile on her face.
enrichments.short_description: Koito is a young girl residing in Ebisu Town of the Wano Country.

enrichments.description:
Koiwa is a man who lived in the Wano Country 41 years ago.

Koiwa is a thin man of average height. He wears a top with a cloud design and a dark hood with shurikens on it, as well as a metal mask covering his eyes.

Koiwa is fairly greedy and not very superstitious, being willing to kidnap a white boar for the Kurokoma Family's bounty. He was quite dedicated in this goal, spending an entire year searching for the animal with Oiwa and Nakaiwa. His greed is strong enough that he is even willing to kidnap bystanders to get paid.

He aspired to eventually join the Kouzuki Oniwabanshu, but gave up on his dream halfway.
enrichments.short_description: Koiwa is a man who lived in the Wano Country 41 years ago.

enrichments.description:
Kojuro is a samurai who allied with the Kouzuki Family. After waiting 20 years for the return of the Nine Red Scabbards, he affiliated with the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance to raid Onigashima.

Kojuro is a man of medium height, but wide at the shoulders. He has a square face, black eyebrows and shoulder-length pink hair. Kojuro wears a purple kimono with dark blue piping and a light yellow cape with a pattern of light green spirals. He also has a reverse crescent moon tattoo on his ankle.

Kojuro is quite an emotional person. He is very happy to learn of the raid against Kaidou, stating that he will be there and that this is the spark that was expected in Wano. After Dotaku's words that they are not allowed to carry swords, Kojuro speaks in expression and rage that he is ready to fight with his bare hands and will not miss his chance. While imprisoned in Rasetsu, Kojuro cried upon receiving a message from Shimotsuki Yasuie about a new meeting place. There, he tried to trick the guards to release him and his comrades for the sake of the Fire Festival, but the attempt failed. During the raid on Onigashima, Kojuro wholeheartedly supported Kin'emon's words regarding their samurai honor. He showed tremendous willpower while battling the Ice Oni virus that hit him, but shortly before creating the antidote, he began to become discouraged, for which Dotaku had to mentally support him.

Kojuro is a skilled samurai who fought the Beasts Pirates to protect himself. He also has a strong will, allowing him to resist Queen's virus for a long time. Despite the isolation of the country, Kojuro possesses some information about Big Mom and its power, while samurai like Ukon do not know anything about it.
enrichments.short_description: Kojuro is a samurai who allied with the Kouzuki Family. After waiting 20 years for the return of the Nine Red Scabbards, he affiliated with the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance to raid Onigashima.

enrichments.description:
Kokoro is an mermaid and the stationmaster for Shift Station, a Sea Train station near Water 7. She was also Tom's secretary during the days of Tom's Workers.

Kokoro poses as a human, hiding her mermaid physique because her tail fin forked in two around the age of 30 and allowed her to walk on land. She has a granddaughter named Chimney, who accompanies her everywhere.

She is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Water 7 Arc and, later on, the Enies Lobby Arc.

Her facial features make it look as if she is perpetually smiling regardless of her actual emotions. Her overweight body shape, along with her strange smile, makes her look like a frog. She is actually an mermaid, meaning that her legs are a fish tail that has been split in two (as it happens to mermaids when they reach age 30). According to the Straw Hats at least, she resembles more a in terms of appearance and shape due to her obese physique. In mermaid form, she wears a pearl necklace and has seashells stuck onto her breasts like pasties.
enrichments.short_description: Kokoro is an mermaid and the stationmaster for Shift Station, a Sea Train station near Water 7. She was also Tom's secretary during the days of Tom's Workers.

enrichments.description:
"Winter Cuisine" Komakkov is a chef under the employment of the Marines as one of its Four Head Chefs.

Komakkov appears to be a portly, wrinkled, middle-aged man with a prominent nose and chin, as well as long, wavy black hair. He wears a relatively small chef's hat and a pair of dark-lensed goggles.

Not much is known about Komakkov's personality.

Komakkov is one of the four elite chefs within the employment of the Marines, so he is likely considered a very talented cook. As further acknowledgment of his skills, he was trusted with cooking for Jaygarcia Saturn, one of the Five Elders, during his escort trip to Egghead.
enrichments.short_description: "Winter Cuisine" Komakkov is a chef under the employment of the Marines as one of its Four Head Chefs.

enrichments.description:
Komane is the deposed princess of the Lulusia Kingdom, being the daughter of the former king Seki.

Komane is a fit woman of average height, with black long hair with two hair rose ornaments. She wears a dark colored strapped short dress, light skirt, and dark high heel shoes. She also has a dark coat.

After she was abducted by pirates, she was shown crying for her father to be contacted so he would pay for her release, showing some sort of trust in him as much of a scared sense of self-preservation. She also appeared to be vindictive as after she was saved by Koby and Helmeppo, she attacked the pirates angrily while threatening to have them tortured, and insisted to her father to let her kill some rebels herself once the Marines rescue them from imprisonment.

As the princess, Komane had great authority over her home country. However, she lost her power after being deposed.
enrichments.short_description: Komane is the deposed princess of the Lulusia Kingdom, being the daughter of the former king Seki.

enrichments.description:
Konbu is a child who lived in Punk Hazard's Biscuits Room. He was freed with the rest of the children by the Straw Hat Pirates.

Konbu is a young boy with dark hair and no neck. Due to Caesar Clown's experiments, he is larger than normal children.

Despite being a very caring and friendly child, Konbu turned hostile while going through withdrawal symptoms from Caesar's drugs.

After tasting Sanji's cooking, he has developed an interest in becoming a chef himself.
enrichments.short_description: Konbu is a child who lived in Punk Hazard's Biscuits Room. He was freed with the rest of the children by the Straw Hat Pirates.

enrichments.description:
The Kone Kone no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to transform individuals into different people. It was eaten by Bildy.

The main strength of the fruit is being able to turn normal people into copies of others, giving them the appearance, abilities, and strength of those they are copying. This gives the user great strength when they have subordinates who can follow commands in their new, stronger forms. With this strength, Bildy helped Smash establish the DX Marines and take over Madatascar Island when, in reality, the two of them are the only notable members.

One unique weakness is that people who are transformed return to their original state once they are incapacitated. Furthermore, the user cannot transform themselves. Otherwise, the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses apply as well.

Bildly uses his abilities to make an army of specialized warriors for the DX Marines. He has made fake versions of the following:
enrichments.short_description: The Kone Kone no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to transform individuals into different people. It was eaten by Bildy.

enrichments.description:
Kong is the Commander-in-Chief of the World Government. He was a Fleet Admiral of the Marines at the time of the Battle of Edd War twenty-seven years ago. Some time after, he was promoted while Sengoku eventually became the new Fleet Admiral.

Kong is an extremely muscular, broad-chested, tan-skinned, strong-shouldered elderly man who has his whitened hair and beard arranged in an array of spikes, and some fuzz on both sides of his face, similar to a lizard's spine. He also has a stitched scar under his left eye.

He wears a sleeveless dark shirt adorned with medals, revealing his muscular arms, dark green armbands, a light yellow scarf around his neck, and a white and dark grey Marine coat draped over his shoulders. The epaulettes are similar to those worn by an Admiral and Fleet Admiral, fully covered in yellow as a standard color.

38 years before the present, Kong was noticeably younger, as well as lacking both his beard and scar.
enrichments.short_description: Kong is the Commander-in-Chief of the World Government. He was a Fleet Admiral of the Marines at the time of the Battle of Edd War twenty-seven years ago. Some time after, he was promoted while Sengoku eventually became…

enrichments.description:
Kop is a very tall and thin man. He has a rectangular shaped face and a triangle shaped nose. He has a piece of orange cloth tied around his head.

When he met Franky, Kop came to deeply respect him and called him "Big Bro" just like the other Franky Family members.

Kop is seen with a sword, its not known how skilled he is. Like the rest of Franky Family he wears armor that can protect him against cannonballs.

He joined Zambai's group during some point of his life. Afterwards, Kop, along with the rest of Zambai's gang, was given a job by Franky and the whole gang was assimilated into the Franky Family.
enrichments.short_description: Kop is a very tall and thin man. He has a rectangular shaped face and a triangle shaped nose. He has a piece of orange cloth tied around his head.

enrichments.description:
The Kopi Kopi no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to copy other people's appearances and abilities. It was eaten by Chameleone.

"Kopi" is the Japanese way to pronounce the word "copy".

The main power of this fruit is to copy other people's abilities. It seems that the user needs to see the person once in order to copy their power, making it a dangerous gamble to engage or even be near the user. However, the user needs a great concentration in using this ability as seen when Chameleone stops using his powers whenever he sneezes. Otherwise, the user is affected by the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.

Chameleone uses his power to steal others powers for his own sake. Some of the Devil Fruit users he has copied are Luffy, Smoker, Ace and Kizaru.
enrichments.short_description: The Kopi Kopi no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to copy other people's appearances and abilities. It was eaten by Chameleone.
enrichments.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
enrichments.image_alt: Identification thumbnail for Kopi Kopi no Mi

enrichments.description:
The Koro Koro no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to turn their hands and feet into train wheels, making them a . It was eaten by Aveyron.

The fruit allows the user to spin their wheels at will, allowing them to roll at high speeds and attack people by running into them. The wheels also attach to train tracks, allowing the user to roll on tracks in any location, and they can even keep rolling with only two wheels on the track, allowing them to use their hands to attack. They can also use their wheels to spin other objects such as drills.

Due to the high speeds the user can roll at, it is very difficult for them to stop, so they are punished if they miss a high-speed attack. The inability to easily brake also prevents them from stopping at cutoff tracks, causing them to fly into the air. Other than that, the user is affected by the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.

Aveyron has his fruit constantly activated, using it to get around the underground mines in Silver Mine. He keeps various weapons such as bombs and a drill inside a compartment on his back, and uses them in conjunction with his power, even storing parts to upgrade his own body with cannons, it is unknown if anything is may be stored inside. He also attacks people by ramming into them at high speeds.
enrichments.short_description: The Koro Koro no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to turn their hands and feet into train wheels, making them a . It was eaten by Aveyron.

enrichments.description:
Koshi Falcon is a larger man. Due to the SMILE that he consumed, he possesses a pair of large, pink wings on his lower back. Unlike other Gifters, he does not possess a pair of horns. He wears a simple white tank-top, white pants, and white boots. He has brown hair in a mohawk style, with a pointed mustache, and a tattoo on his left arm.

Koshi Falcon is a man of few words, allowing his partners to do most of the talking, although he was unable to contain his surprise at their failure to destroy the Sunny.

Koshi Falcon seems quite capable of fighting, given his status as a Gifter.

Koshi Falcon ate a SMILE|ハヤブサの|Hayabusa no Sumairu}}, an artificial Zoan-type Devil Fruit that giving him the power of flight through the wings on his lower back.
enrichments.short_description: Koshi Falcon is a larger man. Due to the SMILE that he consumed, he possesses a pair of large, pink wings on his lower back. Unlike other Gifters, he does not possess a pair of horns. He wears a simple white tank-top,…

enrichments.description:
The Kote Kote no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to summon large gauntlets with which they can grab and manipulate any non-living thing. It was eaten by Adio Suerte.

The main power of this fruit is to summon large gauntlets that are projected from the user's hands. These gauntlets can be used to grab anything and manipulate it as the user wishes, the only exception being the user themselves (althought the user can still make contact with the gauntlets, being able to use them to raise him from the ground).

The user can also use the gauntlets to strike enemies with great force, and they can also conjure solid lightning barriers to reflect projectiles or protect the user by creating a protective shield.

Otherwise, the user is affected by the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.
enrichments.short_description: The Kote Kote no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to summon large gauntlets with which they can grab and manipulate any non-living thing. It was eaten by Adio Suerte.

enrichments.description:
Kotetsu was a swordsmith who crafted the cursed Great Grade sword Nidai Kitetsu. He is an ancestor of the present-day Kouzuki Family in Wano Country, namely Sukiyaki, Oden, Momonosuke, and Hiyori.

Kotetsu is an excellent master swordsmith, having forged the legendary Nidai Kitetsu which is powerful enough to be classified as one of the 21 Great Grade swords. Through unknown means, he was also able to place curses on his swords, which certain individuals, such as Zoro, can even sense.

Kotetsu lived sometime long ago. During his life, he crafted the sword Nidai Kitetsu. He also had children that continued his lineage.

enrichments.short_description: Kotetsu was a swordsmith who crafted the cursed Great Grade sword Nidai Kitetsu. He is an ancestor of the present-day Kouzuki Family in Wano Country, namely Sukiyaki, Oden, Momonosuke, and Hiyori.
