enrichments.description:
The Majiatsuka Kingdom is a southern country in the New World that Rolling Logan comes from.

Nothing is known about the country's geography, but it is described as a "tropical country".

Rolling Logan is the only citizen to be shown so far.

Nothing is known about the kingdom's history because it has yet to make an appearance.
enrichments.short_description: The Majiatsuka Kingdom is a southern country in the New World that Rolling Logan comes from.
enrichments.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.

enrichments.description:
Maki is a member of the Blackbeard Pirates.

Maki is a young woman with shoulder-length purple hair. She wears an orange cowboy hat with a light green plume, a pink tank top, a white mini-skirt and black high heels.

Maki appears to enjoy cozying up to her admiral, Blackbeard. She was amused watching Gecko Moria's fight with her crewmates.

Maki sat on a couch with Blackbeard, Tori, and Kikipatsu when Blackbeard conversed with Gecko Moria.
enrichments.short_description: Maki is a member of the Blackbeard Pirates.

enrichments.description:
The Maki Maki no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to create and control scrolls at will, which have special properties including storing objects and generating drawings. It was eaten by Raizo.

With this power, the user can manifest and telekinetically control scrolls. These scrolls can change size as the user wills, being capable of growing big enough to dwarf people in size and extending long enough to wrap around Kaidou's extremely long dragon body. Scrolls can be summoned and unrolled almost instantaneously.

The scrolls possess the special ability of storing objects inside them, allowing them to intercept and capture any attacks performed by the user's opponents, even energy attacks like Kaidou's fire breath. On the user's command, the attack can be released from the scroll at any time, potentially allowing the user to turn their opponent's attack directly against them. With the scroll being able to fully wrap around anyone, this gives the user the opportunity to hit their opponent's entire body with the attack.

It also appears as though the user can summon drawings from scrolls and manifest them into lifelike objects. This is shown with Raizo's clone jutsu, in which he generates duplicates of himself after unrolling scrolls below him. The exact nature and composition of the manifested drawings is currently unknown.
enrichments.short_description: The Maki Maki no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to create and control scrolls at will, which have special properties including storing objects and generating drawings. It was eaten by Raizo.

enrichments.description:
Makino is the owner and bartender of Partys Bar in Foosha Village, Monkey D. Luffy's home town. She is also the mother of an unknown child.

Makino is a young woman of average height with brown eyes and black hair (dark green in the anime) that goes up to just above her shoulders. When she was first introduced, ten years before the current storyline, she wore a yellow kerchief, an orange blouse with black sleeves and a long light blue skirt and orange sneakers with white soles. Although her clothing changes with her appearances, they are usually similar to the ones she was introduced with. By the time she met Ace, she wore a white blouse with no sleeves, and underneath it a pink-striped shirt. Twenty two years ago, her appearance was the same as it is now except her bandana around her head was yellow and covered her forehead more. After the timeskip, she wears what appears to be a wedding ring. She lacks this ring in the anime.

Makino is a prominent figure in Foosha Village and a very kind woman with a listener's ear.

Makino is well acquainted with Luffy, having known him since he was a child. She gave him food under the joke about him running up a "treasure tab". Her fondness for Luffy makes her appear as an adoptive mother or adoptive older sister, showing interest in and supporting whatever Luffy's dream is. She seems content with whatever lifestyle Luffy chooses so long as he is happy and amongst friends. When Luffy left on his journey, Makino stated how much she would miss him. She has been keeping up to date with his exploits. After Ace's death, Makino was deeply shocked and upset when Dadan told her that Luffy was suffering the most. After the timeskip, Makino was pleased to hear that Luffy returned and a short time later when his bounty had risen. The fact Makino's child, still held in their mother's arms, have learned to recognize Luffy's face from newspapers and reacts positively to him shows again how strong Makino's care for Luffy is, despite her previous misunderstanding.
enrichments.short_description: Makino is the owner and bartender of Partys Bar in Foosha Village, Monkey D. Luffy's home town. She is also the mother of an unknown child.

enrichments.description:
Ensign Makko is a senior member of Hina's death squad who was on one of the ships that attacked the Straw Hat Pirates as they fled Arabasta.

Makko has a shaved head with a semicircle hairline. He has been sporting this hairstyle since his days as a young Marine. He also has a thick scar on the right side of his forehead that did not exist before he enlisted in the Marines. In addition, he has what appear to be three lines at the bottom of each of his eyes, which may be his eyelashes. He sports a Marine coat and shirt that is standard among Marine officers.

As a Marine, Makko has a strong sense of justice, and as such, has no patience for failure. This is shown when he got very angry at his subordinates for failing to make progress against the Straw Hat Pirates.

As an Ensign, it appears that Makko has had some fighting experience for him to have been able to obtain his rank. Furthermore, as an Ensign, he has authority over those subordinate to him.
enrichments.short_description: Ensign Makko is a senior member of Hina's death squad who was on one of the ships that attacked the Straw Hat Pirates as they fled Arabasta.

enrichments.description:
Mamana Island is a non-canon island in Paradise. It can be used, alongside Samua Island, to locate Shellfish Island.

Mamana Island, Shellfish Island, and Samua Island all form a straight line. Because of this, sailing from Mamana Island to Samua Island, or vice-versa, in a straight line (such as with an Eternal Pose) allows one to reach Shellfish Island, which cannot be reached normally with any Log or Eternal Pose.

At some point in the past, Amanda's father discovered Shellfish Island, establishing that it was reachable by travelling in a straight line between Mamana Island and Samua Island.

After Amanda and her siblings were captured by the Bayan Pirates and escaped with Maccus and Bonney, they travelled to Mamana Island and set off towards Samua Island using an Eternal Pose.
enrichments.short_description: Mamana Island is a non-canon island in Paradise. It can be used, alongside Samua Island, to locate Shellfish Island.
enrichments.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.

enrichments.description:
Manboshi is an merman and the third son of the royal Neptune Family on Fish-Man Island.

Manboshi is a rotund, stocky and large merman (shown when he spoke with Madame Shyarly). Like his brothers, he has a polka dot tail, with a black variation along with white polka dots and red scales. He also has brown hair and red fins on his head.

He wears a blue hat with a dirty white stripe going across the middle of it. The stripe is serrated on the bottom side and there is a dot pattern inside the stripe. He also wears a yellow sash, like his two older brothers.

When he and his family arrived at the Red Port for the Levely, he wore a dark shirt.
enrichments.short_description: Manboshi is an merman and the third son of the royal Neptune Family on Fish-Man Island.

enrichments.description:
The Mane Mane no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to turn themselves into a physical double of anyone they touch, making the user an . It was eaten by former Baroque Works agent Bentham, also known by the alias Mr. 2 Bon Kurei.

It had previously been eaten by Kurozumi Higurashi before she was killed by Kaidou.

The Mane Mane no Mi resembles a pair of fruits with connected stems. Each fruit is orange with pink stripes, with various swirls present on the orange backdrop.

The fruit allows the user to impersonate someone they touch with their right hand, adopting their face, physique, and voice. The fruit keeps a perfect recollection of every person whose form they have ever copied, so the user will not forget any person's appearance whom they imitate. There's no time limit for the transformation, and the user can revert back to their own body by touching their face with their left hand, even if unintentionally.
enrichments.short_description: The Mane Mane no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to turn themselves into a physical double of anyone they touch, making the user an . It was eaten by former Baroque Works agent Bentham, also…

enrichments.description:
Mani is a combatant of the former Bellamy Pirates.

She is a curly-haired, dark-skinned woman with thick lips and dark colored eyes. She sports a long sleeve white collar shirt decorated with blue feathers, dark purple pants and sandals.

She has a mocking personality, as she laughed at the Straw Hat Pirates for believing in a Sky Island.

As a fighter of the crew, Mani may have some combat skills, but she, like the rest of the crew, simply stand on the sidelines while the two main fighters, Bellamy and Sarquiss, do most of the fighting.
enrichments.short_description: Mani is a combatant of the former Bellamy Pirates.

enrichments.description:
Manjaro is a member of the Fake Straw Hat Crew and masqueraded as Zoro. When the crew switched to posing as the Kid Pirates, Manjaro impersonated Heat.

Manjaro is a man with a beer gut, chubby face, thick eyebrows, and thick lips. His hairstyle, earrings, and plain shirt are similar to those seen worn by the real Zoro, but otherwise, he is nothing like the real Zoro. He also wears a metal-studded belt, shorts with the number "34" on the left front side of it, and white shoes.

When impersonating Heat, Manjaro has shaggy hair with a similar stringed corset and pants.

Manjaro is friendly with Fake Sanji, unlike the real Zoro with Sanji. However he is loyal to Fake Luffy, automatically agreeing to forget about Fake Robin just after Fake Luffy ordered so. So far out of all the Fake Straw Hats, Fake Zoro (along with Fake Sanji) has shown to be one of the most intelligent of the impostors, quickly identifying the real Chopper, discerning that Luffy (in disguise) has a connection with the real Straw Hats, and luring him to Fake Luffy without arousing the Straw Hat's suspicion. Upon the truth coming out, he was discovered to be very cowardly, begging Caribou for mercy.
enrichments.short_description: Manjaro is a member of the Fake Straw Hat Crew and masqueraded as Zoro. When the crew switched to posing as the Kid Pirates, Manjaro impersonated Heat.

enrichments.description:
Saint Manmayer Gunko is a World Noble from the Manmayer Family and a member of the Knights of God. Previously, she was a Devoted Blade of God serving under the Knights 38 years ago during the events of the God Valley Incident.

She was born as , the illicit daughter of Queen Candelle of the Esperia Kingdom and the Knight of God Manmayer Gurou. However, during her childhood her lineage was unknown to her and the public, as she was raised by Candelle and her husband Reuven, Esperia's King. She was a close friend and trainee of Brook in her youth. After being demonized, Shuri killed Reuven and made a failed attempt on Brook's life; her memories of the past have seemingly since been repressed by Nerona Imu.

Due to her actions and role, Gunko is a major antagonist in the Elbaph Arc.

Gunko is a woman of average height who has shown no signs of aging despite her old age. She has long blue hair that usually appears short due to it being partially hidden under either her jacket or hat. She has , with a cyan right eye and a red left one, called Bipolar Irises. The lower half of her face and her knees are wrapped in bandages. She wears a black newsboy cap with golden goggles, a double-breasted black jacket with extremely long sleeves and what appears to be black panties underneath it, a pink cape, and black boots with cylindrical structures on them. Upon being possessed by Nerona Imu, Gunko's eyes changed to his distinctive double-layered irises, and her hair lengthened. Her appearance was described by nearby children as "scary."
enrichments.short_description: Saint Manmayer Gunko is a World Noble from the Manmayer Family and a member of the Knights of God. Previously, she was a Devoted Blade of God serving under the Knights 38 years ago during the events of the God Valley…

enrichments.description:
Saint Manmayer Gurou is a World Noble from the Manmayer Family and a member of the Knights of God 62 years ago. He is the biological father of Manmayer Gunko from an unclear relationship with Esperia Kingdom's Queen Candelle during his stay there 77 years ago.

Gurou is a large man with a flat nose, pronounced lips, visible eyelashes, long hair, and a flat jaw. Much like his daughter, he has a rare form of , called Bipolar Irises. He wears a decorated greatcoat over his shoulders, which is lined with fur, a similarly decorated , a scarf, and striped socks. In addition, he wears a cap with goggles affixed around the band.

Like all World Nobles, and similar to other Knights of God, Gurou appears to be a man of low moral character. The nature of his relationship with Candelle is unknown, but considering her devotion to Reuven, it's heavily implied that it was not consensual. Likewise, he did not care for the resulting offspring, being his daughter Shuri, and was only willing to retrieve her at the request of Imu.

Being a World Noble of the Manmayer family, Gurou is above the law of the lower world and is permitted to do anything he pleases, so long as it does not go against the laws of the Celestial Dragons. He has tremendous political influence and can summon a Marine Admiral to handle anyone he feels is trying to bring harm to himself. However, being one of the Knights of God, he likely possesses more than sufficient combat prowess to defend himself without the needs of an Admiral.
enrichments.short_description: Saint Manmayer Gurou is a World Noble from the Manmayer Family and a member of the Knights of God 62 years ago. He is the biological father of Manmayer Gunko from an unclear relationship with Esperia Kingdom's Queen…

enrichments.description:
Mansherry is a dwarf and the princess of the Tontatta Kingdom. She is the daughter of Gancho, the king of the Tontatta Kingdom.

Mansherry has very thick and wavy blonde hair, partially tied up in two buns, that covers her body and tail. She wears a short white dress with stockings and shoes of the same color. Her eyes are light blue.

In her first appearance, she wore two small, green flowers in her hair. Giolla and Tsuru, among others, seem to consider her very cute.

Leo claimed that she is selfish, mean, capricious, and short-tempered. However, this is merely a misinterpretation on Leo's part. Mansherry is truthfully benevolent and kindhearted, as shown when she realized she had been tricked by Doflamingo and refused to heal the injured officers of his crew, knowing they would just keep hurting people and exploiting the dwarves of her kingdom. This trait was fully confirmed by Kabu, who stated that Mansherry is really kind to everyone.
enrichments.short_description: Mansherry is a dwarf and the princess of the Tontatta Kingdom. She is the daughter of Gancho, the king of the Tontatta Kingdom.

enrichments.description:
The Mansion's Guards are employees of the , hired by Klahadore to act as security guards to keep Kaya's mansion safe.

The guards are composed of two men, wearing black suits, ties, white shirts, and sunglasses.

The one on the left, in a green tie, is a skinny man with a mustache and beard. He has brown hair that is spiked up at the top.

The guard on the right, in a red tie, is larger than his partner, and is clean-shaven. He has slicked back black hair, that is long in the back.
enrichments.short_description: The Mansion's Guards are employees of the , hired by Klahadore to act as security guards to keep Kaya's mansion safe.

enrichments.description:
Saint Marcus Mars is a World Noble and one of the Five Elders who publicly head the World Government, holding the title of Warrior God of Environment.

Due to his actions and role, he is one of the secondary antagonists of the Egghead Arc. Along with the other Elders, he is one of the main antagonists of the Final Saga and one of the overarching antagonists of the One Piece series.

Mars is a very tall and thin, elderly man with long white hair, including a mustache and goatee which reach down to his upper chest. He wears a black (navy blue in the anime and colored manga) suit over a black tie and a white buttoned shirt, as well as navy blue pants.

Like the other Elders, Mars cares about the balance in the world maintained by the Three Great Powers and wishes to maintain it. This also includes preserving the image of the World Government by keeping the events of the Void Century a secret, and he and the other Elders will immediately have anyone destroyed who is found to be studying it. During the Ohara Incident, he was courteous to Clover, acknowledging the scholar's achievements and justifying the danger of reviving the ancient weapons. At the time of ordering the killing of scholars, Mars was seriously grieved when he gave that order, which proves that he has some humanity. He appears to view the Nefertari Family's rejection of life on Mary Geoise harshly, as he stated that such an action makes them traitors. He will obey any order given by Imu without question, as he views Imu to be a "creator" who alone has the power to shape the course of the world. Mars has been shown to be extremely callous, as he had no issue with annihilating a highly populated country and justified it because its populace had started to show signs of rebellion.
enrichments.short_description: Saint Marcus Mars is a World Noble and one of the Five Elders who publicly head the World Government, holding the title of Warrior God of Environment.

enrichments.description:
Margarita is the owner of the shadow that was inserted into Victoria Cindry's corpse twelve years ago. She currently works as a maid for Egana.

Margarita is a young, average-sized girl with freckles, dark blue eyes and light brown, wavy hair worn in a ponytail. She was seen wearing her working clothes: a maid outfit.

Twelve years ago, Margarita had an intense hatred of plates due to an incident with her former fiancé. This state of her personality was reflected by her shadow while it was possessed by the zombie Cindry.

In the present day, Margarita has managed to overcome her dislike of plates. She seems very humble and emotional, as she starts crying with relief when her employer was not angry with her for breaking his plates.
enrichments.short_description: Margarita is the owner of the shadow that was inserted into Victoria Cindry's corpse twelve years ago. She currently works as a maid for Egana.

enrichments.description:
Marguerite is a member of the Kuja tribe living on the island of Amazon Lily. She, along with Aphelandra and Sweet Pea, saved Luffy after he ate mushrooms that completely covered his body. During the timeskip, she became a member of the Kuja Pirates.

Marguerite is a young Kuja lady who is tall for her age. She has short, unruly blond hair, long slender legs, and a slim, curvaceous figure.

Like her fellow Kuja, she dresses in a revealing bikini top and miniskirt made out of animal skin that greatly show off her cleavage and long legs, and a white cape that seems to resemble a Marine jacket. She keeps her snake (which almost all Kuja women seem to have) who is black and green striped wrapped around her waist at most times. She is also known to wear some type of black and white striped legging similar to a stocking on her right leg, along with high-heeled boots.

Although it is forbidden to have men on the Amazon Lily, Marguerite seems to have developed an interest in them ever since seeing Luffy. She also seems to have developed an interest in Luffy's "Kintama" (a Japanese slang term for the male testicle, which literally translates to "golden ball(s)"), wanting Luffy to take them off so she could have a look at them. This is mostly due to her misunderstanding and naïveté towards men, taking everything Luffy said as literal. She deems men as "useless" based on the impressions left by Luffy, but at the same time admitted that she risked becoming attached to him if she stayed with him for too long, resulting in attacking him as a way of stopping herself.
enrichments.short_description: Marguerite is a member of the Kuja tribe living on the island of Amazon Lily. She, along with Aphelandra and Sweet Pea, saved Luffy after he ate mushrooms that completely covered his body. During the timeskip, she…

enrichments.description:
Mari is the king of the and one of fifty monarchs who took part in the Levely.

Mari is a middle-aged man with a large, triangular nose, prominent lips and a full beard. He appears to be balding, with hair only present at the sides of his head coupled with a pronounced forehead, although the anime gives him a head full of hair.

He wears a turban over his head, with his crown resting atop it, plus royal robes and some jewelry around his neck.

Not much is known about Mari's personality yet.
enrichments.short_description: Mari is the king of the and one of fifty monarchs who took part in the Levely.

enrichments.description:
The Mari Mari no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to create copies of people and command them, turning them into a . It was eaten by Ven Vendler.

The main strength of this fruit is that it allows the user to create copies of people and command them as subordinates. However, the user needs to know a person's name and see them directly in order to create a copy. Notably, because the user has seen themself and knows their own name, they can use the fruit's abilities to clone themselves.

Marionettes created by the Mari Mari no Mi appear to have a fairly low strength ceiling; while they can copy the abilities and Devil Fruit powers of those they recreate, strong figures will be significantly weakened, to the point where a marionette of King was defeated in a single attack from Roronoa Zoro. Once a marionette takes too much damage, it disappears, leaving a limp puppet in its place.

Aside from this, the user is also susceptible to the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.
enrichments.short_description: The Mari Mari no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to create copies of people and command them, turning them into a . It was eaten by Ven Vendler.

enrichments.description:
Maria Napole is a mermaid and a famous singer considered the pride of Fish-Man Island.

Maria Napole is a mermaid with a rubenesque figure. She has large lips, curly dark hair, and a very long eel-like tail. She wears hoop earrings and a pearl necklace. She is seen singing in a dark colored dress, with thick tassels on the arms and bottom, that accentuates her cleavage.

Maria Napole's personality is not known at this time.

Maria Napole is an extremely skilled and talented singer, being hailed as the number one diva on Fish-Man Island. Usopp and Nami were quickly entranced upon hearing her voice. Even Luffy was temporarily distracted by her voice and did not seem to mind waiting quietly for the food to arrive.
enrichments.short_description: Maria Napole is a mermaid and a famous singer considered the pride of Fish-Man Island.

enrichments.description:
Marianne, also known as the "Flag-Bearer of Freedom" and more commonly by her alias Miss Goldenweek, is a former officer agent of Baroque Works and the partner of Mr. 3. She is currently working as a painter at the new Spider's Cafe alongside many of her former colleagues.

She is the secondary antagonist of the Little Garden Arc and the protagonist in Miss Goldenweek's "Operation: Meet Baroque Works".

Marianne is a teenager with a childish appearance, with relatively large eyes and circles of blush on her cheeks. She is fairly short in stature and wears her dark red hair tied in twin braids. Her attire consists of a wide-brimmed pink hat with a green band, a dark blue T-shirt with the word "GOLDEN" written on it in pink (orange in the anime), a sky blue cloud-patterned button-down shirt, a maroon-colored overalls skirt with the top folded down, blue striped stockings, and big red shoes with white cuffs and white soles.

After the events of her cover story, Marianne now wears an apple-shaped beret in place of her brimmed hat, as well as a scarf.
enrichments.short_description: Marianne, also known as the "Flag-Bearer of Freedom" and more commonly by her alias Miss Goldenweek, is a former officer agent of Baroque Works and the partner of Mr. 3. She is currently working as a painter at the new…

enrichments.description:
Marie is the thirteenth wife of Saint Charlos. Before being enslaved by Charlos, she worked as a nurse in the Sabaody Archipelago, and was the fiancée of Judy.

Marie is a young woman with shoulder-length black hair and large dark eyes (depicted as dark brown in the anime). She is seen wearing a light pink nurse uniform that reached her upper thighs, with a red medical cross on the left side of her chest. She also wore a matching light pink nurse's cap, pink lipstick, a gold engagement ring on the middle finger of her right hand, and a pair of white pumps.

Marie appears to have been very dedicated to her job as a nurse, as she was willing to attempt to sneak by a Celestial Dragon while helping a dying man reach the hospital, rather than stopping to kneel. She was also visibly shaken after Charlos kicked her patient. She was extremely distraught and pleaded for her freedom as Charlos' guards began to apprehend her. Marie clearly loves her fiancé Judy, as she cried when he was shot and called for someone to help him despite the fact that she was being actively abducted.

As a crowd of people were kneeling to a passing Celestial Dragon, Saint Charlos, Marie and other medical staff attempted to sneak through the crowd to reach a nearby hospital while carrying a stretcher holding a man who was bleeding to death. However, they were noticed by Charlos, who was offended by their actions and kicked the stretcher and the man out of their hands. Charlos then noticed Marie in particular, and decided that he wanted to take her as his next wife. As she began to object to this, her fiancé Judy rushed out in an attempt to help her but was quickly shot by Charlos. She then begged for help as she was apprehended by Charlos' guards and taken to a harbor to be transported to Mary Geoise.
enrichments.short_description: Marie is the thirteenth wife of Saint Charlos. Before being enslaved by Charlos, she worked as a nurse in the Sabaody Archipelago, and was the fiancée of Judy.

enrichments.description:
Marilyn is a woman that lives in Skypiea. She was Miss Skypiea forty-two years ago.

Marilyn is a rather chubby woman with dark brown curly hair. Part of her hair is put up like antennae like other Skypiean people. She wears a dark purple dress, with a black belt. She also wears dark red lipstick.

She appears to be a kind woman, and a fun loving person, as she danced with Sanji at a party.

Forty-two years ago, she became Miss Skypiea.
enrichments.short_description: Marilyn is a woman that lives in Skypiea. She was Miss Skypiea forty-two years ago.

enrichments.description:
Marin is a male slave who was forced to dress as a mermaid by his owner.

Marin is a large, overweight man. He dresses like a woman, with long blonde hair and makeup. He has stubble around his mouth and sports a swimsuit that covers his chest. He wears a fake mermaid tail, and has a slave chain around his neck.

Marin seemed quite tired and distressed while swimming in his aquarium-like cell, since he is not a real mermaid and cannot breathe underwater.

Sometime before he was presented to Luffy, Hatchan, and Pappag while they were searching slave shops for Camie, he was captured by slavers and became a slave. Marin was restrained by a chain collar and could barely swim in his aquarium-like cell. The owner of the slave shop presented him to the group, but the terrible disguise did not fool them.
enrichments.short_description: Marin is a male slave who was forced to dress as a mermaid by his owner.

The bases have living quarters with bunkbeds and a kitchen and common area. Most bases have numbers. Some bases are attached to major port cities, and thus bear only the city's name. Of the bases with numbers, these seem to be either or the larger 支部|Kaigun Gurando Rain Shibu}}. The latter term is often shortened to a G before the branch number.

The Marine GS General Hospital is a hospital for Marines.

The GS General Hospital is large complex that encompasses the entire island it is located on, much like a typical Marine base.

After the raid on Hachinosu, members of SWORD were recovering in this hospital.

enrichments.description:
The Marine Headquarters is the main division of the Marine organization that has jurisdiction over the Grand Line. It is one of the Three Great Powers in the world, alongside the Four Emperors and the Seven Warlords of the Sea, who were later replaced by the SSG's Seraphim.

The Marines stationed there are considered "super-elites" among their comrades, and a rank at the other Marine bases is about equivalent to three ranks lower at Headquarters.

The Headquarters' base of operations is currently at New Marineford in the New World. It was previously in Paradise's Marineford until Sakazuki moved it after the Summit War of Marineford.

Marineford is the former location of Marine Headquarters. It is located in Paradise, and could only be accessed through the Gates of Justice along with Enies Lobby and Impel Down.

enrichments.description:
The Marine Headquarters Court consists of three judges and was seen in Jango's cover story.

The judge on the left has a wide nose, thick lips, long white colored hair, a widow’s peak, and a scar above the bridge of his nose. He wears the standard judge hat and robes but rolls up the sleeves to expose his forearms.

The middle judge is elderly with a wider nose and face, a bushy beard, and long, bushy hair. He also wears the standard judge robes, but his judge hat is black and white instead of the typical black.

The judge on the right has a long, thin nose, glasses, and a scar on his left cheek. He also wears the standard judge hat and robes.
enrichments.short_description: The Marine Headquarters Court consists of three judges and was seen in Jango's cover story.

enrichments.description:
Marine Ships are ships that serve the Marines, acting as their transportation and means of fighting naval warfare.

They have two to four masts with two to three sails per mast. The decorations and paint job is always kept within the same style and there is little variation between ships beyond size and armaments. The standard paint covering the outer hull is normally a bluish green basis, patterned with darker streaks of the same, a style also found on the exterior of most Marine bases. Superstructures are usually painted black. Only a few notable Marines have ships that do not follow the standard design and paint job.

Marine ships are among the few vessels in the world that can safely traverse the Calm Belt. The two features that make this possible are Seastone, which lines the bottom of the ships and makes them undetectable by Sea Kings, and paddle-wheels, which propel the ship forward despite a complete lack of wind. Only battleships have been seen with these features.

The standard ship is a cruiser-like vessel that has three masts, two with two sails and one with a lateen sail. It has six cannons on each side of its hull and four larger cannons situated on the bow. A large circular structure is located in the middle of the ship, and the Marine symbol and name are painted on the sides. They come in two standard sizes, "Small" and "Midsized", with the naming convention stemming from their size compared to the Marine's ubiquitous Battleship.
enrichments.short_description: Marine Ships are ships that serve the Marines, acting as their transportation and means of fighting naval warfare.

enrichments.description:
Mario is a dog that tore off the arm of a toy citizen of Dressrosa.

He is a brown dog, with floppy ears and a red studded collar.

He seems to be a free spirited animal, as he tore off the arm of a stuffed citizen of Dressrosa and ran off with it.

Mario was seen stealing an arm from a living toy citizen in Dressrosa. He ran off with it as the man tried to keep his stuffing from falling out as he ran after the dog.
enrichments.short_description: Mario is a dog that tore off the arm of a toy citizen of Dressrosa.

enrichments.description:
Don Marlon was a member of the Rocks Pirates and a gangster from the West Blue. He joined Rocks D. Xebec after losing a Davy Back Fight, but was later killed during the World Government's abduction of Shakuyaku.

Marlon was a stocky man of large stature. His most prominent feature was a protruding, square jawline. He had squinty eyes, teal hair, a scribbly mustache and full lips.

Fitting for a mafia don, Marlon's outfit consisted of a dark suit, a similarly dark coat, a light-colored tie and a dark fedora. He often had a cigar in his mouth.

As a mafia don, Marlon was a very serious individual. While the rest of his crewmates were feasting or talking, he remained silent, with a scowl on his face. Despite that, like the rest of his male crewmates, he was lovestruck the moment he first saw Shakky, and was willing to do whatever she asked.
enrichments.short_description: Don Marlon was a member of the Rocks Pirates and a gangster from the West Blue. He joined Rocks D. Xebec after losing a Davy Back Fight, but was later killed during the World Government's abduction of Shakuyaku.

enrichments.description:
The Marubenny is a non-canon ship created as part of the Adventure of the Marubenny collaboration project and advertising campaign. Based on the general trading company Marubeni, the ship travels around the One Piece world, interacting with various locations and characters using Marubeni's technology.

The Marubenny is a normal-sized ship with two masts and a large "M" emblem as its figurehead. Its front mast bears the Marubeni logo and name, with the slogan "Global crossvalue platform" between them.

Its unique features tie into different parts of Marubeni's business:

The Marubenny first met the Straw Hat Pirates in the New World. Together, they installed floating offshore wind turbines.
enrichments.short_description: The Marubenny is a non-canon ship created as part of the Adventure of the Marubenny collaboration project and advertising campaign. Based on the general trading company Marubeni, the ship travels around the One Piece…

enrichments.description:
Marumieta is the only daughter of Bimine, the mayor of Pucci.

Marumieta has long light-colored hair tied in a curling ponytail. She wears a semi-formal dress and a tiara. She had binoculars in both of her appearances.

Marumieta is a person who is "ignorant of the ways of the world", thus she is a curious one. She appears to be benevolent, as she went to Water 7 in order to deliver supplies after the Aqua Laguna.

She used her binoculars to look at a catalog her father was holding despite standing right next to him. It is unknown if it is because using binoculars is a habit or if she is extremely nearsighted.
enrichments.short_description: Marumieta is the only daughter of Bimine, the mayor of Pucci.

enrichments.description:
The |聖地マリージョア|Seichi Marījoa}} is the capital of the World Government where its top brass reside and govern, the Knights of God have jurisdiction, and where the Celestial Dragons reside as its citizens. It also hosts the Levely, a council of royalty from various World Government-affiliated nations that is in session every four years.

Mary Geoise is located on top of the Red Line at the opposite side of the world from Reverse Mountain and serves as the official route for people to cross between the two halves of the Grand Line, although only people acting inside the law are allowed passage; thus, pirates and other criminals must go under the Red Line through Fish-Man Island to cross. Because of its isolation and security, assaults on Mary Geoise by pirates and other criminals tend to be historic events.

Mary Geoise is the main setting of the Levely Arc.

The general architecture of Mary Geoise has an 18th and 19th century European style. Since the World Nobles, the world's highest social class, live here, it is kept in pristine condition. It is located very high above sea level, so it is surrounded by clouds and fog. Around the city are artificially planted forests as well as rivers; their source of water is unknown. The city's conveyor belt walkways, called , are continually moved by slave labor pushing them from below. Because of its high altitude, being situated above the cloud layer, it never rains in Mary Geoise.
enrichments.short_description: The |聖地マリージョア|Seichi Marījoa}} is the capital of the World Government where its top brass reside and govern, the Knights of God have jurisdiction, and where the Celestial Dragons reside as its citizens. It also hosts…

enrichments.description:
Chief Petty Officer Mashikaku is a subordinate of Smoker and Tashigi. However, it is unknown if he remained with the two after they transferred to G-5 as he is not seen with the G-5 Marines.

Mashikaku's facial structure resembles that of a monkey, with bushy brown hair and sideburns, tanned skin, and a square jaw. His signature features are his sideburns that are curved and pointed inwards towards his face and his mouth that is pointed upwards when closed. He wears the standard Marine shirt and cap. In the manga, he wears epaulettes which may serve to differentiate himself in rank as a Chief Petty Officer. In the anime, however, he lacks the epaulettes and so, in terms of uniform, looks no different from a common Marine sailor.

During the Summit War of Marineford, he wore a Marine officer's coat over his standard Marine shirt.

Mashikaku is somewhat afraid of those with a higher authority than him, as shown when he was afraid of what the higher-ups would say if Smoker disobeyed them, and was also afraid of Smoker when he shouted at him that he did not care.
enrichments.short_description: Chief Petty Officer Mashikaku is a subordinate of Smoker and Tashigi. However, it is unknown if he remained with the two after they transferred to G-5 as he is not seen with the G-5 Marines.

enrichments.description:
"Salvage King" Masira is the |bosu}} of the Masira Pirates and the head of a simian ship salvage operation near Jaya Island. His sworn brother is Shoujou and both of them are members of the Saruyama Alliance, headed by Mont Blanc Cricket. He and Shoujou are both fans of Mont Blanc Noland's exploits and the fairy tale book based on them.

He became an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Jaya Arc.

Masira is a human with ape-like features, he wears an orange-yellow jumpsuit, and also has headphones and goggles. What makes him interesting is he apparently has a tail, although sometimes it cannot be seen. An example of when it clearly can be seen is when Bellamy first tackles him from behind, during the Bellamy Pirates vs. Saruyama Alliance fight, or when he is carrying wood to fix the Going Merry. Masira also has huge arms and some kind of piercing around his wrists.

After the timeskip he no longer wears the jumpsuit, but has a shirt with the same design on the front. Other than this he looks the same as before.

enrichments.description:
Masked Deuce is an alias used by the first member of Ace's pirate crew, the Spade Pirates, usually referred to as just "Deuce" or "Deu". He abandoned his real name, which remains unknown, but is known to have come from a prominent East Blue family of medical professionals. Despite nominally being the head of the crew besides Ace, Deuce could struggle being respected by the crew, often relying on Skull and Mihar, the crew's other officers. Deuce also came to be referred to as "Doc" by at least Whitebeard after being integrated into the medical staff of the Whitebeard Pirates.

In the non-canon One Piece episode A, Deuce became a journalist for "Big News" Morgans after the dissolution of the Whitebeard Pirates, specializing in the Straw Hat Pirates and the Revolutionary Army. Despite Morgans' protests, he refused to publicize his writings on Ace.

Masked Deuce's defining feature is the mask he wears over his eyes to hide his identity. He is a muscular man with spiky long light blue hair, and wears a very long open coat which stretches down to his knees and leaves his chest exposed. He also wears a belt diagonally across his chest, trousers with a rose design on the bottom left that are held up by a belt, and a pair of dark boots that go up to his knees.

Deuce's primary goal is to seek adventure, though he initially did not wish to incriminate himself as a pirate. He appears to act seriously, and was initially off-put by, though eventually gained respect for Ace's cheerful nature. He is reliable and anxious at the same time. He enjoys writing and took the opportunity to write a story of his experiences on Ace's crew. If someone mocks his writing, he will respond by portraying them in a bad light and leaving their names out of the story. He also seems to be an avid thinker and planner, as shown when he developed and executed a plan to lead a Marine warship battalion into dangerous waters, and later calmly assessed his situation when he was stuck on the Sabaody Ferris wheel with Marine Ensign Isuka.
enrichments.short_description: Masked Deuce is an alias used by the first member of Ace's pirate crew, the Spade Pirates, usually referred to as just "Deuce" or "Deu". He abandoned his real name, which remains unknown, but is known to have come from…

enrichments.description:
Massui is a Waiter in the Beasts Pirates.

Massui is a muscular man with tan skin and a square jaw. He has a scar on the right side of his neck. Massui wears a dark blue cape with a brown fur collar, blue pants, and a brown belt with a gold and green buckle. He also wears a mask with bat ears on it, as he is not yet a Gifter.

Massui has the desire of becoming a Gifter someday, which is why he wears a bat ear mask since he wants to get used to the look of a SMILE user.

Massui is as cruel as his crewmates, wanting to capture Luffy and make him a slave. He also looks down on comrades who cannot complete tasks quickly and commented that his bodyguard Hihimaru's reputation had sunk for not finishing off one Komainu.
enrichments.short_description: Massui is a Waiter in the Beasts Pirates.

enrichments.description:
The Master is a digger who works on an unnamed island in Paradise.

The Master is an average-sized man with thick eyebrows, a stubble and prominent lips. His hair is short and curls inwards at the ends.

He wears typical excavation attire, including a pickaxe and safety helmet with his rank on it.

The Master is dedicated to his digging job, finding it a rewarding experience. He is a bit dim-witted, mistaking Buggy, Mohji, and Cabaji for new mining recruits.
enrichments.short_description: The Master is a digger who works on an unnamed island in Paradise.

enrichments.description:
Mato is a giant bartendress from Elbaph.

Mato is a slender giant woman with a round face, a long nose, and orange eyes. She has long eyelashes, a few freckles on her cheeks, and straw-colored hair that grows thickly to the sides rather than downwards, creating a kind of wing on either side of her head. She wears a light-colored tunic, over which she wears a maroon apron with the inscription "WAR" ("WARLAND" in the anime), as well as a necklace of round white pearls.

Much like her idol Ida, Mato grew up to be a thoughtful, kind and sympathetic woman, treating people of all kinds with respect. As a child, she was shown to be a bit sensitive, bursting into tears over Loki's insults towards Ida.

44 years ago, Mato already worked at Ida's tavern as a child. Mato greatly admired the kind Ida and felt hurt by the way Loki insulted her employer, since she saw her as a maternal figure who consoled her when she was sad. Mato cared deeply for Ida, refusing to leave Ida's side when she was ill. Over time, under Ida's care, Mato became able to scold Loki for his rude behavior. Upon Ida's death, Mato cried terribly. She inherited Ida's bar and ran it since then.
enrichments.short_description: Mato is a giant bartendress from Elbaph.

enrichments.description:
The Mato Mato no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that makes the user capable of aiming at whichever "target" he decides upon from any location and at any time with anything at ease. It was eaten by Flying Pirates captain Vander Decken IX.

Due to Decken telling others that this power is a "curse", it has also been referred to as the .

This fruit makes the user capable of aiming at whoever they touch with their hands. The user can also memorize as many targets with as many hands as he has (in Vander Decken IX's case, two). After the user's hand is imprinted with the memory of the target, the user is able to target the person from any location and at any time with anything at ease, regardless of whether or not they are aware of the target's actual location. Even if the targets move away from their current locations, the thrown objects will pursue them, immediately changing their trajectory in order to chase their targets. Also, if the target the user has chosen happens to be anywhere near them, the thrown projectile will actually even swerve back in a manner not unlike to a boomerang coming back to its thrower. In addition, while the user is affected by the sea water, the objects used to target the recipient(s) can still travel underwater, without the sea affecting or decreasing the intended function.

The user can send any kind of object towards a marked target, no matter how big or small it is. Decken was able to throw the Noah, a ship nearly equal to the size of Fish-Man Island, towards Shirahoshi in an effort to destroy her along with the entire island. Furthermore, as shown with Noah, the user does not even need to actually throw an object for it to fly towards the target. All Decken had to do was touch the giant ship with a memorized hand and the ship itself rose off the sea bed without any assistance, aimed towards Shirahoshi. The user can also turn living organisms as projectiles, as Decken threw a large group of human pirates towards Shirahoshi by touching each one of them. Outside of combat, the power can serve as a sort of homing device to find the target's location. Decken used this idea to find Shirahoshi when he realized she was not in the tower. He threw a large piece of coral and then jumped on it, riding it to Shirahoshi's location.
enrichments.short_description: The Mato Mato no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that makes the user capable of aiming at whichever "target" he decides upon from any location and at any time with anything at ease. It was eaten by Flying Pirates…

enrichments.description:
The Matryo Princesses are the princesses of the Roshwan Kingdom. Their names, in order from largest to smallest, are , , , and .

The princesses heavily resemble s, with each one being thickset and ranging in size. Matryosaka is the largest, followed by Matryosuka, Matryoseka, and Matryosoka. One spectator at Red Port called them "cute."

They have black eyes, blonde hair parts at the middle of their forehead, and pink blush marks on their cheeks. They all wear a red headscarf topped with a small gold tiara. They also wear white buttoned up shirts and red skirts with pink polka dots, dark blue and gold striped belts, and blue suspenders. They all carry straw baskets.

As princesses of the Roshwan Kingdom, the Matryo Princesses have some level of authority over it and are able to attend the Levely.
enrichments.short_description: The Matryo Princesses are the princesses of the Roshwan Kingdom. Their names, in order from largest to smallest, are , , , and .

enrichments.description:
Matsuge is a yasa camel who accompanied the Straw Hat Pirates during the Arabasta Arc. He is classified as a Type-A creature, "Big Friendly" and currently works as a member of the Super Spot-Billed Duck Troops.

Matsuge is a light brown camel who wears a bridle and saddle. His saddle is square shaped, with a fur seat. Under the seat is a purple blanket, with a yellow stripe with an orange diamond pattern on it. There is also a silver seat with an orange cloth on it. Matsuge has noticeable eyelashes on the bottom of his eyes, which he is named after.

After the timeskip, Matsuge appears to wear a sort of tufted metal helmet.

Matsuge seems to especially like women as he only allowed Nami and Vivi to ride him. However, later during the Arabasta Arc, he allowed Usopp to ride him due to his injuries.
enrichments.short_description: Matsuge is a yasa camel who accompanied the Straw Hat Pirates during the Arabasta Arc. He is classified as a Type-A creature, "Big Friendly" and currently works as a member of the Super Spot-Billed Duck Troops.

enrichments.description:
The , also known as the , is a non-canon sea at the start of New World, known for its bizarre weather phenomena.

The weather conditions in the Maubeugemour Sea is outrageous, which includes mirages, giant raindrops and hailstones larger than warships, snowfall like an avalanche, and the ocean separating to leave spontaneous trenches. Less outrageous phenomena include heavy rainstorms and sweltering heat. This weather, like in the first half of the Grand Line, can change from one to another in a matter of seconds.

The sea also possesses a unique current known as the Thrust Up Stream, a scaled down version of the Knock Up Stream. It's power is enough to lift up a Marine battleship, and though it appears briefly, it has a high frequency of appearances in a given area.

enrichments.short_description: The , also known as the , is a non-canon sea at the start of New World, known for its bizarre weather phenomena.

enrichments.description:
Maujii is a dwarf from Tontatta Kingdom and the aide of Princess Mansherry.

Maujii, like all other dwarves, is quite short. He has a white beard and mustache and wears a helmet with a pompom that has goggles on it. He also wears an orange coat, purple gloves, blue pants, and purple boots.

Not much is known about his personality, but he seems to have great care and concern for Princess Mansherry.

Maujii has yet to be seen fighting, but it is likely that he has the strength and speed similar to other dwarves. Sure enough, he ran with such speed that he failed to stop in time, resulting in him ramming open the storage door via sheer force despite his small stature.
enrichments.short_description: Maujii is a dwarf from Tontatta Kingdom and the aide of Princess Mansherry.

enrichments.description:
MAX Marx is the cook of the former Roger Pirates.

Marx is a tall, muscular man with broad shoulders, large arms, and slim legs. He has medium-length, dark-colored hair, a mustache, a beard, a widow's peak, and prominent lips. He also has a tattoo on his neck and a tattoo that stretches down his left arm.

Marx was shocked at seeing the Sky Island of Skypiea.

As the Roger Pirates' ship cook, he had the responsibility of feeding his captain and the crew.
enrichments.short_description: MAX Marx is the cook of the former Roger Pirates.

enrichments.description:
The Ark Maxim is Enel's colossal flying ark. It was built by Gan Fall's men for Enel.

The ark contains a throne that is beneath a golden face, and a large storage room. The gears and generators are quite large, and it has a line of oars whose use was not shown. The ark also has multiple rotors and propellers to help it fly.

The Maxim is capable of flight, even in space. Enel's electrical energy is its main power supply, while two hundred Jet Dials from Birka are used as a backup power supply to keep the ark in the air for an hour if something were to happen to the Ark's mechanism. Enel used the gold from the Shandora ruins as a conductor for his electricity.

Enel can use Maxim to create massive lightning storms via a combination of chemical vats that produce storm clouds and his own lightning abilities. One of these thunderbolts is enough to burn down an entire village, and Enel can create a giant thundercloud that can destroy an entire island.
enrichments.short_description: The Ark Maxim is Enel's colossal flying ark. It was built by Gan Fall's men for Enel.

enrichments.description:
Maynard the Pursuer is a vice admiral who appears in the Dressrosa Arc. He was registered as a gladiator to compete at the Corrida Colosseum for the Mera Mera no Mi, but was defeated before he could participate.

Maynard is a muscular, broad-chested man with dark hair tied up in a wild ponytail that sticks out to one side. He also has a dark beard and a mustache.

His outfit as a gladiator consists of a dark red cap, studded belt, briefs, a studded band on his left thigh which holds a knife, and sandals that reach just below his knees and are studded down the front. Under his cap he wears sunglasses.

After leaving the colosseum, he wears the typical Marine coat with on the back. His cap is also different, with the word MARINE across the front, though it is still dark-colored unlike the white caps worn by most the Marines. In the anime, it is white.
enrichments.short_description: Maynard the Pursuer is a vice admiral who appears in the Dressrosa Arc. He was registered as a gladiator to compete at the Corrida Colosseum for the Mera Mera no Mi, but was defeated before he could participate.

enrichments.description:
Mayushika is one of the Shandia warriors who fought against Enel.

Mayushika is a bald, tanned man, with dark, red tattoos on his face, upper arms, chest, and knees. He has white wings on his back, like other Shandia, and wears a dirty, white cloth around his waist held up by a grey rope, and it hangs down to his feet. Under the cloth he wears a dark, brown, grass skirt. He also wears the same dial skates worn by Wyper. He carries a polearm that is attached to what appears to be massive, white, animal antlers.

As a Shandia warrior, Mayushika is brave and is proud of his people. He was startled when Nola began to laugh uncontrollably. He was also surprised at Holy's strength, warning his allies that the dog might be trouble.

It is assumed that Mayushika has an inordinate amount of strength, since he is able to handle wielding his heavy weapon fairly easily during his clash against the enforcers. Despite this, he was still easily defeated by Holy.
enrichments.short_description: Mayushika is one of the Shandia warriors who fought against Enel.

enrichments.description:
"Thunder Lord" McGuy is an infamous New World pirate captain who allied with Whitebeard.

McGuy has a long face with a big nose and prominent chin, along with a defined jawline and wavy blonde hair reaching to his waist, and a black mustache shaped like a lightning bolt. He sports a blue shirt with loose sleeves and ruffled edges under a black vest. Due to his legs not being visible enough in the manga, in the anime he was given dark bermuda shorts and an orange sash decorated by a silver colored ornament with a red jewel in it.

Though little can be said regarding McGuy's personality in the manga, he is shown having huge respect towards Whitebeard instead of fleeing through the path he had cleared with his power. He also seems to be very loyal with high levels of courtesy. In the anime, he was shown to be perceptive enough to see through Sengoku's tactic to lure the pirates in for the Pacifista to attack. McGuy cried tragically after the death of Whitebeard.

McGuy has managed to make himself an infamous reputation in the New World, becoming a subordinate of Whitebeard. Also, he was very observant, as he managed to understand why Whitebeard ordered his subordinates to split up in order to avoid being trapped by the Pacifista. He also avoided injuries from the war.
enrichments.short_description: "Thunder Lord" McGuy is an infamous New World pirate captain who allied with Whitebeard.

enrichments.description:
McKinley is a member of God Guardians (previously known as the White Berets), Skypiea's police force. He initially serves as a minor antagonist in the Skypiea Arc, but later becomes an (indirect) ally to the Straw Hat Pirates.

McKinley is a tall, well-built Skypiean man who bears the typical wings, as well as a small scar under his left eye. He wears the standard White Beret uniform, consisting of the namesake , a short-sleeved shirt, cloud-patterned , and black boots; his rank is distinguished by a cape-like overcoat, similar to those worn by pirate and Marine captains.

Post-timeskip, he has grown a goatee, and parts of his uniform now bear the letters "GG" (presumably standing for "God Guardians").

He appears to be very devoted to Enel, until it is revealed that Enel planned to destroy Skypiea with his Devil Fruit powers.
enrichments.short_description: McKinley is a member of God Guardians (previously known as the White Berets), Skypiea's police force. He initially serves as a minor antagonist in the Skypiea Arc, but later becomes an (indirect) ally to the Straw Hat…

enrichments.description:
Meadows is a gladiator who competed in the Corrida Colosseum for the Mera Mera no Mi.

Meadows is a broad-faced man with a fu manchu mustache. He is seen wearing a spotted feline skin as a hood.

Meadows is rather greedy, having decided to go after the Straw Hat Pirates' bounties instead of helping them like some of the other gladiators did. He later stated that he had been blinded by the money.

However, he is not averse to being humble when he realizes he is wrong, as shown when he apologized to Luffy and promised to defend the Straw Hat from Doflamingo, showing a selfless side.
enrichments.short_description: Meadows is a gladiator who competed in the Corrida Colosseum for the Mera Mera no Mi.

enrichments.description:
The Medaka Mermaid Quintuplets are five young mermaids who are friends with Camie. Their names are , , , , and .

The Medaka Mermaid Quintuplets are five small, identical-looking mermaid children. They all have curly, shoulder-length hair and tails with alternating white and colored stripes. They also all wear cowboy hats, crop tops, and bubble rings, which allow them to float in the air. They are all physically identical except for their color schemes and the designs of their hats.

Ichika has red hair, a green-striped tail, and light green fins. Her top is white, and her hat is green with white polka dots.

Nika has blonde hair, a red-striped tail, and pink fins. Her top is red, and her hat matches the red-striped pattern of her tail.
enrichments.short_description: The Medaka Mermaid Quintuplets are five young mermaids who are friends with Camie. Their names are , , , , and .

enrichments.description:
Megalo is a shark that lives on Fish-Man Island. He is the beloved pet of princess Shirahoshi and former pet of the Neptune Army.

Megalo is a black shark with a white underbelly. He wears a shirt from the Criminal fashion line.

He is several times larger than an average shark, approximately the same size as the Thousand Sunny, though he is still smaller than Neptune. His mouth is also large enough to cram Shirahoshi into it, but apparently causes him great stress.

Despite being a shark, Megalo is very friendly and very loyal since he willingly went through with Luffy's idea of stuffing Shirahoshi in his mouth to sneak her out of Hard-Shell Tower. He also is somewhat protective of Shirahoshi as he was angry at Luffy when he made her sad. He appears to be very secretive since he only told Shirahoshi about Otohime's true killer and not to anyone else.
enrichments.short_description: Megalo is a shark that lives on Fish-Man Island. He is the beloved pet of princess Shirahoshi and former pet of the Neptune Army.

enrichments.description:
Melias is an anime-only town located in the Sandora Desert. Like Erumalu, it has become a ruin. Luffy, Vivi, Rasa, and Zaba went there to search for wood to repair the Barbar Pirates's ship. Rasa used to live there before the town went to ruin.

enrichments.description:
The Memo Memo no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to turn people's memories into strips of film and manipulate them. It was eaten by Charlotte Pudding.

By reaching into their target's head, the user can extract their memories in the form of film strips, which they can then manipulate using scissors and paste. By cutting out frames, they can remove that part of the target's memory, and by pasting in other people's frames, they can add new memories to the target. The removed frames can seemingly be kept for long periods of time, as Pudding had a soldier's memory stored away. This memory alteration can be a powerful tool to alter the target's mind. The memory extraction can be painful for the target and can cause them to faint afterwards, allowing the user to place them in a different area in order to complete the illusion.

Unlike another memory altering Devil Fruit, if the user is unaware of being eavesdropped or spied on, they are unable to modify the third party memory of an event. If the third party is able to inform the victim of what really happened, then this fruit's power is useless. Additionally, despite the switching of memory, the victim might still suspect their new memories are false if there are other memories that can contradict it. To edit a memory, the user seemingly must have a pair of scissors. Other than that, this fruit is susceptible to the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.

Pudding uses this power to modify the memories of her victims to prevent them from implicating her plans. After she shot and captured Vinsmoke Reiju and gloated to her about the truth of a plotted betrayal during the wedding ceremony, Pudding used this power to remove Reiju's memories of their encounter, replacing it with a memory of being shot by a stray bullet. She also seems to collect other people's memories in order to use them for memory alterations.
enrichments.short_description: The Memo Memo no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to turn people's memories into strips of film and manipulate them. It was eaten by Charlotte Pudding.

enrichments.description:
The Mera Mera no Mi is a Logia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to create, control, and transform into fire at will. It was eaten by Portgas D. Ace, and two years after its reincarnation was eaten by Sabo.

The Mera Mera no Mi is a round orange fruit, composed of many flame-shaped components with swirl patterns on each one, and has a swirled stem on the top.

The fruit's major strength, like other Logia types, is that it allows the user to produce as well as become the element they control. In this case, the user is able to create, control, and become fire. With this in mind, the user can create devastating fire-based attacks and gain a high resistance towards most heat-based attacks. The flames can also be used to increase the force of physical attacks. By turning into fire, the user is capable of letting enemy attacks harmlessly pass through their fiery body or move around quickly in a stream of flames. Igniting oneself similarly has the added effect of burning an opponent if they had tried to physically harm the user.

When this power clashes against certain other Logia on equal grounds, this seems to come to a stalemate: neither smoke nor ice was able to overcome nor succumb to the flames, instead cancelling each other out when the two elements collided.
enrichments.short_description: The Mera Mera no Mi is a Logia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to create, control, and transform into fire at will. It was eaten by Portgas D. Ace, and two years after its reincarnation was eaten by Sabo.

enrichments.description:
Mero is a mermaid and one of the top five Mermaid Cafe Dancers.

Mero is a young mermaid with long, flowing blue hair, with a yellow flower attached to the right side and blue eyes. She wears a revealing purple flower pattern bikini. Her fishtail has the color of pearl blue.

Like all other mermaids, Mero is kind and caring, and is apparently fun loving. She even seems to like Sanji like the rest of her friends.

As a mermaid, Mero can breathe underwater, speak to fish via sonar waves, and they are generally considered the fastest swimmers in the world. She also appears to be a skilled dancer.
enrichments.short_description: Mero is a mermaid and one of the top five Mermaid Cafe Dancers.

enrichments.description:
The Mero Mero no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows a range of attacks which use emotions of love, lust or adoration to transform opponents into stone. It was eaten by the former Warlord Boa Hancock, who was force-fed it by a World Noble.

This fruit's abilities were duplicated in the Seraph S-Snake, via a transfusion of Green Blood.

The Mero Mero no Mi is a pair of rounded heart-shaped fruits with connected stems, resembling a pair of cherries. The fruits are red and purple with pink heart patterns, which have swirls in them. The top of the stem also forms a heart with swirls.

The major strength of the fruit, as demonstrated by Boa Hancock, is that the user is able to transform those who find them pretty (lust, love) and/or cute into stone in varying degrees. Victims that have been completely turned to stone are incapable of consciousness and susceptible to physical damage unless the user de-petrifies them. Petrification can also be achieved through physically striking an opponent, although the only area that is turned to stone is the contacted area, as opposed to the entire body. The power also extends to nonliving objects, including weapons and Pacifistas. Its power and potential are high enough for Blackbeard to personally invade Amazon Lily to kill Hancock for the Devil Fruit.
enrichments.short_description: The Mero Mero no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows a range of attacks which use emotions of love, lust or adoration to transform opponents into stone. It was eaten by the former Warlord Boa Hancock, who was…

enrichments.description:
Merry is Kaya's butler, and the original designer of the Going Merry.

He is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Syrup Village Arc.

Merry is a tall, formally dressed butler whose most distinguishing feature is his lamb-themed appearance. His hair is curly like a lamb's fleece and has two lamb horns sticking out of it; these have been seen shorter 20 years before the start of the series. His lips also resemble those of a lamb's. Even his collar has a fleece around it.

After the timeskip, Merry has grown his hair out somewhat longer and has also grown a light mustache and goatee. His horns are also bigger.
enrichments.short_description: Merry is Kaya's butler, and the original designer of the Going Merry.

enrichments.description:
Merveille, also known as the and the , is a hidden archipelago of floating isles in the sky above Paradise that served as the base of operations for the Golden Lion Pirates. It is where Shiki and his scientist, Indigo, created many mutated animals in the hopes of having an army to overthrow the world. Of these animals shown 22 years ago is a land-walking squid, giraffes as tall as skyscrapers, and a giant turtle-like creature.

Non-canonically, it also contains people who have feathers on their arms that enable flight. The island is also home to the rare IQ plant, in which Indigo used as a basis for his SIQ drugs for creating the mutant army, as well as the Daft Green.

In canon, Merveille was shown to include a lush forest, with numerous mountains and ruins. The mountain peaks are extremely high, reaching up into the clouds. In Film: Strong World, it was shown that Merveille is a collection of small islands, each with their own flora and ecosystem, as well as several bodies of water. Using the Fuwa Fuwa no Mi, Shiki caused these islands to float, causing them to appear suspended in the air. The island with the tallest peak, which reached into the clouds from the surface, became the primary island in the archipelago.

Non-canonically, many of Merveille's human citizens have been mutated to a small degree, likely due to exposure to SIQ. As a result of the mutation, they have grown feathers underneath their arms and given them the ability to fly.

enrichments.description:
Meshi is a restaurant located in Syrup Village.

From the outside, Meshi appears to be an ordinary restaurant. It is just so in its interior, whose space is rather limited, making it a modest eatery where only a small number of guests can dine at any given time.

As soon as they reached Syrup Village, Luffy, Zoro, and Nami, led by Usopp, headed to Meshi in order to find something to eat. There, the Straw Hat Pirates got to know Usopp better, and the latter spoke to them about Kaya. Then, once Usopp left, the remaining members of the self-styled Usopp Pirates entered the restaurant and met the Straw Hats.

enrichments.description:
The Meta Meta no Mi is a non-canon unknown-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to control liquid metal, making them a . It was eaten by Graydle.

The main strength of this Devil Fruit is that it allows the user to generate and manipulate liquid metal.

Graydle is able to split himself into many communicating parts, which can take the form of himself or others. As such, he is able to impersonate groups of humans, such as Marine soldiers and dogs. To search large areas in urban environments, Graydle also uses the fruit to make a prosthetic arm for himself, which he can make bigger or turn into a blade.

Aside from the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses, there seem to be no known weaknesses to this power.
enrichments.short_description: The Meta Meta no Mi is a non-canon unknown-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to control liquid metal, making them a . It was eaten by Graydle.

enrichments.description:
Mezasuzowan Pisuo is a member of the Germ Pirates.

Pisuo is a very large man, with a stocky build and a height many times that of an average human. He has thick lips, a large round nose, and short dark blue hair with dark purple spikes protruding from it. He wears a light green suit, a yellow collared shirt, and a red tie.

Not much is known about Pisuo's personality, as he has only been seen following his captain while keeping a blank expression.

Pisuo possesses great physical strength, being able to hold an adult man with one hand. However, he was defeated by Vito.
enrichments.short_description: Mezasuzowan Pisuo is a member of the Germ Pirates.

enrichments.description:
Michael and Hoichael are two troublemaker children in the backstreets of Water 7. They idolize Franky, and even dress like him and use his motto as their own: "Mm, super!!", and similarly idolize Paulie. However, their backstreet delinquency has earned them ire from at least Tilestone and Peepley Lulu. Before the timeskip, they were part of class 6-5 of the backstreet elementary school.

Michael has short spiky hair. He wears a red vest with a green pattern that looks like grass. He also wears a yellow shirt underneath that has his name and a white circle. The middle of the circle has red and white character .

Hoichael has short brown hair which seems to be growing only on the top spot of his head. He is missing teeth. He wears a blue vest with pink flowers pattern, and underneath he wears a brown shirt with his name. In the middle of the shirt is a white circle that surrounds a red circle with a white katakana character .

Since they idolize Franky, they tend to imitate him, going as far as using his motto.

Micqueot, also known as , is a location mentioned once by Fullbody.

Micqueot is renowned for its vineyards and the production of the Ithürzburger Stein wine.

When Fullbody visited the Baratie, he claimed he and Moodie were served the Ithürzburger Stein during their meal, explaining its origins and qualities. However, Sanji interrupted him and told him that he was wrong, causing other guests to laugh at the lieutenant.

Midway Forest is a forested area located between Mt. Colubo and the Gray Terminal. It is known for being a dangerous place to any human.

Portgas D. Ace and Sabo used this place as a sort of hideout in their youth, hiding the loot they obtained from stealing within a hidden storage in a large tree. A young Luffy was able to locate them and their treasure stash after following Ace through Mt. Colubo.

After defeating Bluejam in the burning Gray Terminal, Ace and Curly Dadan took refuge next to a river in the forest in order to avoid the spreading fire.
