enrichments.description:
Pucci is one of the island cities in Paradise connected to Water 7 by the Sea Train. It is known as the .

Fourteen years ago, Pucci was connected to Water 7 to help with trade, as an attempted countermeasure against repeated pirate attacks on merchant ships damaging Water 7's economy.

Bimine, Pucci's mayor, and Iceburg, Water 7's mayor, scheduled a meeting, which Iceburg cancelled.

Two years later, Bimine ordered two ships and cola from Zambai's Company Union of the Galley-La Company while Marumieta peered at the catalog through her binoculars with Yamenahare over her.
enrichments.short_description: Pucci is one of the island cities in Paradise connected to Water 7 by the Sea Train. It is known as the .
enrichments.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.

enrichments.description:
Pudding Pudding was a Marine commodore in the 77th Branch of the Marines.

Pudding Pudding was a man of average height with light purple hair that he wears in multiple ponytails. He also had a long goatee and an average build. He wore a standard Marine uniform with a Marine coat and a green scarf.

He appeared to have full confidence in the abilities of his unit, warning the Arlong Pirates that the 77th Branch is known for its valor. Unfortunately for him and his men, however, the commodore underestimated the pirate's abilities, possibly out of overconfidence in the Marines. He was shown to practice a somewhat refined version of justice, caring for not only the evacuation of the survivors from Arlong's reign, but also destroying the Arlong pirates altogether for their crimes. Unlike Nezumi, he appeared not in the least bit willing to negotiate with Arlong.

He seemed to care for his subordinates. He had a casual conversation about Arlong Park with one of his subordinates. Before emerging into battle with the Arlong Pirates, Pudding Pudding encouraged his men to fight. His subordinates cared about him, as they were very angry at Chew when the fish-man attacked their commodore.
enrichments.short_description: Pudding Pudding was a Marine commodore in the 77th Branch of the Marines.

enrichments.description:
Pudos is a Waiter in the Beasts Pirates who worked as a guard in the Prisoner Mine. He was injured by Kawamatsu after trying to attack Monkey D. Luffy.

Pudos is a tall man, being fairly larger than Luffy. He has long bushy blonde hair gathered into a ponytail in the back. He wears an open blue shirt that leaves his chest exposed along with a set of spiked gray pauldrons on his shoulders with gold edges and fur lining, as well as a pair of black pants.

Pudos enjoys the power he has over the prisoners in Udon, gleefully expressing to Luffy how he looked forward to breaking the pirate's spirit. He is easy to set off, being willing to attack Luffy just for glaring at him. Around his comrades, he demonstrates a generally jovial attitude and likes to talk and answer questions.

Pudos is not very tough, as his neck was easily penetrated by a fishbone spat at him by Kawamatsu.
enrichments.short_description: Pudos is a Waiter in the Beasts Pirates who worked as a guard in the Prisoner Mine. He was injured by Kawamatsu after trying to attack Monkey D. Luffy.

enrichments.description:
The Pumpkin Cafe is a new restaurant that opened in Skypiea during the two year timeskip.

Sometime after the defeat of Enel, the Pumpkin Cafe was opened for business. It is unknown who the founder is, but both Raki and Conis are working here as waitresses and cooks. Known customers include McKinley and Pagaya.

Pumpkins, being a popular fruit in Skypiea since its introduction, is the main ingredient of the food served in this cafe, hence the establishment's name. It is famous for its pumpkin noodles.

In keeping with the pumpkin theme, the bowls and cups are in the shape of pumpkins. Small tables, enough for two seats, are the standard seating arrangements for the restaurant.
enrichments.short_description: The Pumpkin Cafe is a new restaurant that opened in Skypiea during the two year timeskip.

enrichments.description:
Punk Hazard is a World Government owned island located in the New World and is the first island the Straw Hat Pirates disembark on after arriving in the New World due to a distress call they received.

A poisonous gas leak occurred on the island, causing the World Government to close off the island. During the two year timeskip, former Admiral Kuzan and current Fleet Admiral Sakazuki fought for the position of Fleet Admiral, causing each half of the island to be contaminated because of Kuzan's Hie Hie no Mi and Sakazuki's Magu Magu no Mi.

It is the main setting of the Punk Hazard Arc.

The island is surrounded by a sea of fire on one side and icebergs on the other. In the center, there is a hole where seawater flows into it, which separates both halves of the island and has sharks living within. This lake was originally a crater formed at the epicenter of Akainu and Aokiji's death match and then later filled with seawater, though the aftermath of the duel did leave behind patches of burning and frozen waters in the lake. This hole has fierce wind and currents running across it. As touched upon by Robin, the extreme temperature differences between the ice and magma lead to an equally extreme difference in air pressure, forming massive gale-force winds.
enrichments.short_description: Punk Hazard is a World Government owned island located in the New World and is the first island the Straw Hat Pirates disembark on after arriving in the New World due to a distress call they received.

enrichments.description:
Punk Records was an area in the Labophase of Egghead which stores the brain of Dr. Vegapunk. It acts as a "library" which Vegapunk and his six satellites can remotely connect to, allowing them to share the same brain.

Following the conclusion of the Egghead Incident, it became disconnected from the island and floated away into the sky. This was done by Edison to prevent York from being able to physically activate it and handing it over to the World Government.

The exterior of Punk Records resembles a broken egg half facing downwards. Inside the egg is a flat black surface with a light grid pattern and the text "PUNK RECORDS" written on it. A ring composed of blocks is floating around the structure. There is a trapdoor access to the interior one tile below the space between the R and E.

The interior of Punk Records contains Vegapunk's oversized and perpetually growing brain, still within his scalp that he cut off years ago, stored inside a liquid tank supported by various machinery.
enrichments.short_description: Punk Records was an area in the Labophase of Egghead which stores the brain of Dr. Vegapunk. It acts as a "library" which Vegapunk and his six satellites can remotely connect to, allowing them to share the same brain.

enrichments.description:
Puppu is the captain of a pirate crew who attempted to pillage Nanohana in Arabasta.

Puppu is an obese and round man, with a very round face, bulbous nose, a row of rounded teeth, and gray hair sticking unkempt on the sides and on top of his head. His arms and legs are very thin in proportion to his wide frame, and his fingers are very thick and short. All this made Puppu resemble a pig.

He wears a simple white shirt that was untucked from his red pirate sash, blue pants, and simple shoes. Like most pirate captains, he wears a pirate's coat, but he wore the sleeves instead of letting the coat drape over his shoulders like a cape. His coat is brown in color and has five large buttons that resemble pig snouts. He also wears a tricorn with his Jolly Roger on it: a square pig's skull with a snout, rounded teeth, and a leaf on top of its head.

Puppu is prideful man, believing the Seven Warlords of the Sea to be pirates who sold their souls to the World Government, and are no more than their dogs. This made him believe that he and his crew were above Crocodile, a mistake that made him foolishly challenge the Warlord, which led to Puppu and his crew's defeat.
enrichments.short_description: Puppu is the captain of a pirate crew who attempted to pillage Nanohana in Arabasta.

enrichments.description:
"Trembling" Pururu is the "princess" of the Bourgeois Pirates, a pirate crew subordinate to the Red Hair Pirates.

Pururu is a short woman with a pointy nose, similar to those of the Tontatta Tribe's women, and turquoise curly hair. She has make-up consisting of mascara, lipstick and blush. She wears a dark dress that exposes her shoulders and a bicorne with hearts lining the rim and her Jolly Roger on the center.

Pururu is a panicky individual but puts up a brave front. She is very loyal to Shanks and willing to fight strong enemies for his sake despite her own weakness.

As the "princess" of the Bourgeois Pirates, Pururu has authority over her crew. However, she and her crew are famous for being weak, like other subordinates of the Red Hair Pirates.
enrichments.short_description: "Trembling" Pururu is the "princess" of the Bourgeois Pirates, a pirate crew subordinate to the Red Hair Pirates.

enrichments.description:
Queen the Plague is an All-Star of the Beasts Pirates as one of Kaidou's three closest confidants. He was formerly the ruler of the Udon region in Wano Country. Born as Scien, he previously was also part of the rogue scientific research team MADS before joining Kaidou. Queen is also the absentee father of Franky of the Straw Hat Pirates, whom he abandoned 26 years ago during his time at MADS.

Due to his actions and role, he is a major antagonist in the Wano Country Arc.

Queen is a massive, round-figured man (evidently obese but claiming otherwise) with light skin. At a towering 612cm tall, he is a mere centimeter shorter than his fellow All-Star King. Similar to Jack, Queen is built top-heavy, with thick, tapering arms yet, compared to his upper self, smallish legs. After being drained of his fluids by Ryokugyu, he became much skinnier.

His head is hunched, undistinguished from his neck due to its plumpness, with a small face. His eyes are hidden by sunglasses with blue lenses and gray, oval rims, which instead of having temples are strapped on by black tapes that go around his head in such a way as to form an X both on his forehead and occiput. Queen has no visible eyebrows, a small hook nose, and his small mouth, sporting navy lipstick, always smokes a big cigar. His hair is blond: a thick, -like braid through eight ties, with a stinger-shaped ending tuft, comes out the back of his head, which is otherwise bald. Additionally, he dons a whose tendrils widen as they droop to his chest. A stitched scar runs curvilinear from his right chest up to the shoulder. On Queen's upper right arm is a black (dark blue in the anime) tattoo consisting of his crew's Jolly Roger above his name in block capitals. Queen's left arm, up to the shoulder, is cybernetic in gray and golden color, composed of metallic rings, bolted plating, wiring, and even a small pressure gauge, with the corresponding hand covered in an orange glove, but was later destroyed by Sanji during the Raid on Onigashima.
enrichments.short_description: Queen the Plague is an All-Star of the Beasts Pirates as one of Kaidou's three closest confidants. He was formerly the ruler of the Udon region in Wano Country. Born as Scien, he previously was also part of the rogue…

enrichments.description:
Quincy is a slender woman with curly hair and wearing an elaborate outfit consisting of a round, crown-like hat, a checkered jacket, a giant ribbon around her waist and a light-colored skirt.

Not much is known about Quincy's personality yet.

Quincy was one of the Kid Pirates witnessing her captain fight Big Mom on Onigashima's Live Floor. When Kid managed to significantly injure Big Mom with Punk Corna Dio, Quincy cheered him on.

ca:Quincy fr:Quincy it:Quincy pl:Quincy Category:Humans Category:Female Characters Category:Kid Pirates
enrichments.short_description: Quincy is a slender woman with curly hair and wearing an elaborate outfit consisting of a round, crown-like hat, a checkered jacket, a giant ribbon around her waist and a light-colored skirt.

enrichments.description:
Rabbitman is a Gifter in the Beasts Pirates.

Rabbitman is a large man. Due to him eating a SMILE, he grew a rabbit face on his chin, with the rabbit's head doubling as his beard, rabbit ears framing his face from both sides, and a large rabbit tail on his back. His hair is shaped like horns worn by most Gifters. He wears a light green shirt, green pants, a brown and orange vest, and brown boots.

Rabbitman is very loyal to his crew. He is also dedicated to maintaining the social order of Wano, as he tried to prevent the residents of Okobore Town from eating clean food.

Not much is known about Rabbitman's abilities, but he has enough authority in Kuri to demand the retrieval of the food supply from Okobore Town.
enrichments.short_description: Rabbitman is a Gifter in the Beasts Pirates.

enrichments.description:
"Pretended Sleep" Raccoon is a Pirate Captain previously active in the West Blue, until he was defeated by the Whitebeard Pirates.

Raccoon and his crew are greedy, as they tried to eat food in Whitebeard's territory without paying for it. Raccoon is also persistent, as he shot Marshall D. Teach after having been defeated and captured.

Being a captain he is in command of his crew and his bounty of 75,000,000 is an indication of his dangerousness. But he and his crew were easily defeated by the Whitebeard Pirates and Raccoon himself was defeated by Marshall D. Teach very easily.

Raccoon wields a pistol, and he is skilled enough to shoot Teach with it after being defeated.
enrichments.short_description: "Pretended Sleep" Raccoon is a Pirate Captain previously active in the West Blue, until he was defeated by the Whitebeard Pirates.
enrichments.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.

enrichments.description:
Raideen is a former member of the Giant Warrior Pirates. Following the crew's disbandment, he returned to Elbaph, where he trained Hajrudin and remains to this day.

Raideen is a giant with light hair sticking out from the sides of his helmet, which is a warrior's helmet with eyepieces obscuring his eyes.

He wears a striped button-down shirt with much of the top unbuttoned, as well as a dark coat lined with light fur.

Raideen's hair and mustache are now longer and apparently gray. His shirt retains its original design, but it's now completely light-colored, not striped, and his helmet is darker.
enrichments.short_description: Raideen is a former member of the Giant Warrior Pirates. Following the crew's disbandment, he returned to Elbaph, where he trained Hajrudin and remains to this day.

enrichments.description:
Raijin is a ninja and a member of the Beasts Pirates. He previously was a member of the Orochi Oniwabanshu which served the shogun of Wano Country, Kurozumi Orochi.

Due to his actions and role, he is a minor antagonist in the Wano Country Arc.

Raijin is an average-sized man with long white spiky hair. He wears a goggled mask over his face, one side of which is blue and the other yellow. He also wears an orange kimono, white gloves, and a large ring on his back holding four fireballs.

He has been seen riding on the back of his large catfish Warazane, that can move on land.
enrichments.short_description: Raijin is a ninja and a member of the Beasts Pirates. He previously was a member of the Orochi Oniwabanshu which served the shogun of Wano Country, Kurozumi Orochi.

enrichments.description:
Raijin Island is one of the three islands in the New World which someone has to travel to if they are following their Log Pose after passing through the Red Line via Fish-Man Island.

The only known resident is Kasa, though in the anime she was accompanied by some other people in cloaks.

When the Roger Pirates went to the New World after visiting Fish-Man Island, their first stop was on Raijin Island. Kouzuki Oden and an unnamed member of the crew were seen getting electrocuted by the lightning of the Island.

Raijin Island was first seen as a stop for the Fallen Monk Pirates in the New World. Intimidated by the island's endless lightnings, Urouge was approached by Kasa, who offered to sell him an umbrella.
enrichments.short_description: Raijin Island is one of the three islands in the New World which someone has to travel to if they are following their Log Pose after passing through the Red Line via Fish-Man Island.

enrichments.description:
Rainbase is one of the few cities within the country that continued thriving even during the drought orchestrated by Crocodile, mostly due to its gambling industry. Because of this, it has been referred to as the "City of Dreams".

Rainbase is located to the northwest of Arabasta, with Yuba to the south and Alubarna and the Sandora River to the east. It takes one day to reach Rainbase from Yuba on feet.

Rainbase is a luxurious, booming city with many casinos and restaurants. Some of those include the Golden Slots, the Loose Slots, the Royale, the Fantasia and the Coin Banditts, among several others. There are also stables where steeds like horses and camels can rest.

The Rainbase Lake is a very large oasis, outright resembling a lake, located in the middle of Rainbase. It is where the Rain Dinners building, the city's biggest casino, is situated.
enrichments.short_description: Rainbase is one of the few cities within the country that continued thriving even during the drought orchestrated by Crocodile, mostly due to its gambling industry. Because of this, it has been referred to as the "City…

enrichments.description:
The Rainbow Tower is a device made possible by Henzo thanks to the taxes gained by Wetton. It took 50 years to build. It is an enormous tunnel device with the sole purpose to link Ruluka with the Rainbow Mist. With it, Wetton hopes to take all the treasures in Ape's Concert. When Luffy arrives to stop him, he decides to destroy Rainbow Tower by making it explode, leaving his family, the Straw Hat Pirates, and the Pumpkin Pirates in the Rainbow Mist.

enrichments.description:
Raizo of the Mist is a ninja from Wano Country and one of the Nine Red Scabbards who served as Kouzuki Oden's retainers. He was born 55 years ago, but traveled 20 years forward in time at the age of 35. Following Kouzuki Momonosuke's ascent to shogun, he serves as the daimyo of Udon.

He acts as a major ally to the Straw Hat Pirates during the Zou and Wano Country Arcs.

Raizo is a very large man, standing at 311 cm (10 ft). He is also quite disproportionately wide, with his head being nearly the same width as the rest of his body. He has exceptionally pronounced cheekbones and a long, square jaw with rounded teeth. He also has thick and lightning-shaped black eyebrows as well as a crescent moon-shaped scar on his forehead that was given to him by King. He has been noted to look rather older and ugly, with no woman being attracted to him, and the prisoners in Udon were not sure he had time traveled as they could easily believe he had aged 20 years since the last time they saw him. Raizo possesses short black hair that includes a small spike at the top of his head; the hair is also partitioned into six tendrils on the sides shaped like antennae. He bears the Kouzuki Family crest somewhere on his body.

For clothing, Raizo wears a light blue kimono whose inner edges are lined by orange stripes dotted with dark blue polka dots. He also wears a green obi tied in a bowtie around his waist, a dark yellow-scaled undershirt and pants under his kimono, a purple nio-dasuki on his back, and a pair of sandals on his feet. He also wears two diamond-shaped appendages on his back whose colors alternate between light and dark blue; this apparatus appears to function as a kite.

enrichments.description:
Rakesh is a port town within the North Blue region. It was only named in the anime.

Rakesh was once allied with the Donquixote Pirates, but started allying with other groups, which caused Doflamingo to target it.

Doflamingo sent Gladius, Senor Pink, Giolla, Machvise, and Baby 5 to attack it. The five succeeded in pillaging and plundering the city and shooting many people there.

enrichments.description:
Raki is one of the Shandia warriors who fought to take back Upper Yard from Enel.

Raki is a tall, black-haired woman, with two large bangs parted to either side of her face on the front, and a long and elaborate ponytail on the back. She has dark green eyes, and her lips are apparently covered with pink lipstick. Like all Shandia, she has two small wings on her back. Raki's outfit consists of a light purple cleavage revealing tunic with a darker pattern that exposes her stomach, and light-red pants, reminiscent of the ones worn by Native Americans, that are open on the inside of her legs. She also has matching colored Skate-type Wavers she wears into battle. After the end of the Skypiea Arc, she wears a more casual version of her outfit.

Since her childhood, Raki, like many Shandia, has usually stayed barefoot instead of wearing shoes; however, Raki does use them sometimes, such as having on a pair of black flats six years prior to her first appearance. Following the events of the Skypiea Arc, Raki starts wearing shoes on a common basis, using a pair with the outfit she had on at the end of the Skypiea Arc when on a walk with her close friends.

After two years, she has two pieces of hair tied on the top of her head instead of one. She also wears the same sleeveless shirt as Conis with a face with wings on it.
enrichments.short_description: Raki is one of the Shandia warriors who fought to take back Upper Yard from Enel.

enrichments.description:
The Raki Raki no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to steal another person's luck by touching them, making the user extremely lucky and the victim extremely unlucky. It was eaten by Baccarat.

By simply touching another person, the user will steal that person's luck to the point where they will become extremely unlucky, as multiple unfortunate occurrences will immediately happen to them. The touch appears completely normal, allowing the user to make their actions inconspicuous. Once the user has absorbed enough luck from other people, they become so lucky that they are almost invincible, as any attempt to hurt them will no doubt end up in failure and they can even use simple objects such as coins that will play out in their favor, like causing accidents that will hurt their foes.

One downside to this power is that its effect seems to be only temporary, as Luffy and Sanji stopped being affected by it after some time. Due to this, the luck that the user has stolen from other people can become depleted, either because enough time has passed for the absorbed luck to "return" to the user's victims, or because the user got lucky enough for all of their luck to get "spent". The user has no control on what the luck is spent on and it can accidentally be spent on something they did not mean to happen. If that happens, the user is unaware of it. Otherwise, the user is affected by the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.

Baccarat uses her fruit's abilities to bring down the luck of casino players, as their losses put them in debt and force them to work for Gild Tesoro.
enrichments.short_description: The Raki Raki no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to steal another person's luck by touching them, making the user extremely lucky and the victim extremely unlucky. It was eaten by Baccarat.

enrichments.description:
The Rako Rako no Mi is a Zoan-type Devil Fruit that allows its user to transform into a sea otter hybrid and a full sea otter at will, making the user a . It was eaten by Pomsky.

Like most Zoans, this fruit grants its user enhanced physical capabilities and at least two different transformations: a full sea otter form and a sea otter-human hybrid one. In hybrid form, the user can wield weapons and swing them around with great force.

Despite the fact that the sea otter is a semi-aquatic animal, the user is presumably still vulnerable to sinking, as well as the other main weaknesses common to Devil Fruit users.

The fruit's bestowed powers, as used by Pomsky, have been used primarily for combat.
enrichments.short_description: The Rako Rako no Mi is a Zoan-type Devil Fruit that allows its user to transform into a sea otter hybrid and a full sea otter at will, making the user a . It was eaten by Pomsky.

enrichments.description:
Rakuda is a resident of the Flower Capital in Wano Country. He once possessed the blueprints of Kaidou's fortress on Onigashima.

Rakuda is a large and muscular man with long and bushy brown hair gathered into a topknot. He wears a yellow kimono with a dark-grey flame-shaped designs on the bottom and has a light-blue, cloud-like tattoo on his upper right arms. He has two scars, one on the right side of his head and the other on his right forearm.

Rakuda appears to be a blunt man who got angry when recalling how the blueprints of Kaidou's fortress were stolen from him. However, he appears to be a greedy thief himself, as he took the blueprints from Tokijiro after realizing their value.

At some point in the past, Rakuda saw that Tokijiro had the blueprints of Kaidou's fortress on Onigashima. Realizing they could sell for a lot of money, he took the blueprints. However, the blueprints were later robbed from him by a masked man who claimed to be from Kuri.
enrichments.short_description: Rakuda is a resident of the Flower Capital in Wano Country. He once possessed the blueprints of Kaidou's fortress on Onigashima.

enrichments.description:
Dr. Rakushitemo Terusubehainaika is a scientist and a member of the Germ Pirates.

Terusubehainaika is an average-sized man with blond hair and a short blond beard. He wears a dark green coat with yellow straps, light brown pants, and dark brown boots.

Terusubehainaika has no interest in piracy, and only joined the Germ Pirates in order to put his research to the test.

Terusubehainaika is a mad scientist who developed the Kiss-Kiss Germ, indicating that he has significant medical expertise.
enrichments.short_description: Dr. Rakushitemo Terusubehainaika is a scientist and a member of the Germ Pirates.

enrichments.description:
Rakuyo is the former 7th division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates.

Rakuyo is a tall man with dark blonde dreadlocks. He has a mustache that consists of two straight points angled diagonally. He wears a typical outfit consisting of a yellow coat with green linings, a green vest under an unbuttoned shirt, a standard light green pirate sash, square-patterned pants, and standard boots. His outfit most notably includes a yellow and purple bandanna bearing Whitebeard's mark. He is often seen wielding a unique spiked ball and chain that has a face at the end.

Thirty-years before the start of the series, Rakuyo had a thinner mustache.

Rakuyo is very loyal to the Whitebeard Pirates and Whitebeard, as he was willing to risk his own life in order to save Ace from execution during the war at Marineford.
enrichments.short_description: Rakuyo is the former 7th division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates.

enrichments.description:
Ramba is an infamous New World pirate captain who allied with Whitebeard.

Ramba is a very tall man, towering over most of his fellow allies, with a slim build. He wears a long, white robe reaching down to his feet, with loose, ruffled-edged sleeves under a dark blue vest and a blue cape with a high collar. He also sports some particular pieces of armor in his attire, these being a pair of golden shoulder pads and his golden yellow, black and white signature crested helm, which has what looks like a Jolly Roger represented on the red part on the front of it and covers the upper part of Ramba's head. He carries around a long sword, fitting his height.

Not much is known about Ramba's personality, other than that he has great respect and loyalty towards Whitebeard, as he is willing to put his own life on the line to rescue Ace from execution. He also appears to be a completely calm and collected man, advising Luffy to take advantage of the distraction of the Marines attacking Whitebeard so that he could rescue his brother Ace. He never panicked even in the worst situation, as seen when Ace was fatally injured by Sakazuki. He has always been seen with the same dour look on his face.

Ramba is a fearsome pirate who has managed to make himself an infamous reputation in the New World, and to become a subordinate of Whitebeard.
enrichments.short_description: Ramba is an infamous New World pirate captain who allied with Whitebeard.

enrichments.description:
Ramen is the king of the Kano Country and one of fifty monarchs who took part in the Levely.

Ramen is a man with a tall bald head that has a Chinese dragon tattooed on the left side. He also has a square jaw and black Fu Manchu mustache.

He wears a green Yuanlingshan with white collar and cuffs. He wears a thick metal chain as a necklace and his eyes are covered by small circular sunglasses. He also wears a small Qing Guanmao atop his head.

Ramen is interested in the well-being of his nation and global matters, as he had many topics he wanted to discuss at the Levely. He seems to be tactical as he sent the Chinjao Family on a secret mission to stop the trade of weapons that was helping enemy nations of the Kano Country.
enrichments.short_description: Ramen is the king of the Kano Country and one of fifty monarchs who took part in the Levely.

enrichments.description:
Rampo is a dwarf from Tontatta Kingdom who first appeared on Green Bit. He is one of the two vice-chiefs of the Tonta Corps along with Bomba, under Gancho and Leo.

Rampo, like all of the other dwarves, is very small. He has a long, pointed nose and a wide mouth with a predominant lower lip. He wears a dark colored jacket that has buttons, a light colored scarf, dark boots, and dark pants that have a hole for his tail. He also wears a large hat, similar to Absalom's, that has a dark colored v-shaped design on it.

In all of his appearances so far he has been frowning, suggesting that he has a stern personality.

He possesses the speed and power characteristic of dwarves, as seen when he and Leo quickly stole the clothes and defeated two of Doflamingo's underlings.
enrichments.short_description: Rampo is a dwarf from Tontatta Kingdom who first appeared on Green Bit. He is one of the two vice-chiefs of the Tonta Corps along with Bomba, under Gancho and Leo.

enrichments.description:
Ran is an average-sized lady who has jet black hair parted on one side with an earring on each ear. She wears long black stockings with straps that reach her matching color panties. Around her waist is a decorative belt of rings that is attached to a small flap of blue cloth to cover her rear. Her top is a small orange flowered tank top with a window hole in the middle that seems almost too small for her size. She carries a quiver of arrows slung around her back with a snake that is usually accompanying her. She wears a overcoat, similar to a Marine, like a cape like many of her fellow crewmates.

Ran is a perceptive woman, knowing that Luffy defeated Bacura with brute force. She also seems to be one of the more knowledgeable and prominent Kuja in the pirate crew, telling a little girl about the Gorgon Sisters and their cursed backs (though unknown to Ran, it was in truth a mark of slavery that the three sisters hide in shame).

As a member of the Kuja Pirates, it can be implied that she is very strong as only the strongest warriors are allowed on the Kuja ship. As with most of the other Kuja warriors, Ran uses a snake that can morph into a bow to launch arrows. She is very skilled with her bow, and is considered a master archer.

In the Calm Belt near Amazon Lily, Ran spoke with Vice Admiral Momonga on the Kuja Pirates ship. Ran noticed that Momonga had killed a Sea King. Momonga then handed over a newspaper to Ran while requesting a meeting with Boa Hancock. After Hancock turned Momonga's crew into stone, the Kuja Pirates sailed for Amazon Lily. After returning to the island, Ran gave the newspaper to Elder Nyon. When the Gorgon Sisters were having their bath time, all Kujas left the castle. When a child asked why the sisters are left alone when they bathe, Ran revealed the story behind the Gorgon Sisters' supposed powers. Ran explained that Boa Hancock and her sisters were inflicted with a curse after slaying a gorgon. The three sisters supposedly have cursed eyes on their backs which turn anyone who sees them into stone and that was why no one was allowed into the castle during her their bath time.
enrichments.short_description: Ran is an average-sized lady who has jet black hair parted on one side with an earring on each ear. She wears long black stockings with straps that reach her matching color panties. Around her waist is a decorative belt…

enrichments.description:
"Crane Rider" Randolph is a rabbit homie and a member of the Big Mom Pirates.

Randolph is an average-sized humanoid rabbit, though his limbs are unusually long. He wears a frilly shirt, a dark cape, and a cavalier hat.

Randolph is very loyal to the Big Mom Pirates, executing his missions and guarding the Seducing Woods. He has no qualms with killing opponents and intruders.

Randolph seems to be cowardly towards his superiors, as he would blame his crane in order to avoid Cracker's wrath. Like other homies, he seems to fear the power of a Vivre Card containing Big Mom's soul.
enrichments.short_description: "Crane Rider" Randolph is a rabbit homie and a member of the Big Mom Pirates.

enrichments.description:
Randolph Theater is a theater troupe that debuted in Episode Special 3. The troupe was owned by Randolph before his retirement.

Randolph's troupe were about to have their final performance as Randolph was going to reitre. However, three of the troupe's actors, including Lola decided to leave right before the final performance. With the loss of three actors, Luffy and his crew became actors to help the play go on.

However, during the intermission, the Marines led by Governor fired a cannonball at the ship and soon arrested Randolph. Lola, who resented the Randolph Theater for its marginal profits, planted weapons in the troupe's ship, and gave a false testimony that she and her fellow actors were forced by Randolph to smuggle illegal weapons or risk losing their jobs. The Straw Hat Pirates assisted in letting the play go on by fighting off the Marines. In the end the play is completed with Randolph acknowledging the pirates, with him even changing the ending as a newfound respect for the Straw Hat Pirates.

enrichments.description:
Rangram is a member of the former Roger Pirates.

Rangram is a tall, fit man with long, light-colored hair that he ties into a tight ponytail. He has sharp features and pointed ears. He wears a dark-colored vest, dark-colored pants, a light-colored wrap around his waist, a necklace, and light-colored shoes.

Rangram cares about his captain, asking him about an unnerved feeling he got on Zou.

In his concept art, Rangram wields an axe. However, he has not been seen using it.
enrichments.short_description: Rangram is a member of the former Roger Pirates.

enrichments.description:
Ratel is a Marine captain who led an invasion of Sphinx during Marco's absence.

Ratel is an average-sized man with dark circles under his eyes, prominent lips and nose, and three whiskers on each side of his face. He wears a light-colored suit, a standard marine coat, and a marine cap with round animal ears on it.

Ratel is a ruthless, greedy and corrupt individual who is willing to terrorize and steal from civilians, including children and the elderly, in countries not affiliated with the World Government. He believes that the law does not apply in non-affiliated countries.

As a Marine Captain, Ratel has authority over lower-ranking Marines.
enrichments.short_description: Ratel is a Marine captain who led an invasion of Sphinx during Marco's absence.

enrichments.description:
Rebecca is the daughter of Scarlett and Kyros, the niece of Viola and the granddaughter of Riku Doldo III. She is the former crown princess of Dressrosa, who forfeited her title to live with her father and currently serves as a to her aunt, Viola.

While living under Donquixote Doflamingo's regime, she was imprisoned and forced to fight as a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum. She joined a tournament to compete for the Mera Mera no Mi, winning the D Block and battling in the finals before Sabo claimed the Devil Fruit.

She is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Dressrosa Arc.

Rebecca is a fair-skinned and tall girl, but slightly shorter than Luffy. She has long, light pink hair, which she wears in a braid. She holds a strong resemblance to her mother.
enrichments.short_description: Rebecca is the daughter of Scarlett and Kyros, the niece of Viola and the granddaughter of Riku Doldo III. She is the former crown princess of Dressrosa, who forfeited her title to live with her father and currently…

enrichments.description:
Reck is a slim man with curly, parted hair and sporting eyeliner. He wears a leather jacket and knee-length pants.

Not much is known about Reck's personality yet. He is, however, loyal to his captain and attempted to protect him from Big Mom.

Reck wields a pair of flintlock pistols.

Reck witnessed his captain fight Big Mom on the Live Floor. When it looked like Kid was done for, Reck was one of the crewmembers who attempted to defend his captain from Big Mom, but he only managed to get hit by Hera's lightning technique in the process. Later, he, alongside other of his crewmembers, attempted to convince Kid to retreat when Big Mom was able to resist his Damned Punk technique at first, but Kid promptly ignored him.
enrichments.short_description: Reck is a slim man with curly, parted hair and sporting eyeliner. He wears a leather jacket and knee-length pants.

enrichments.description:
Red King is a Marine Vice Admiral and one of the nine that took part in the Egghead Incident.

He serves as a minor antagonist in the Egghead Arc.

Red King is a large, tan skinned bald man. He has a large mouth and a long neck with six chins and the word "MARINE" tattooed on the side. He wears a purple pinstripe suit with a pink shirt and red tie underneath, and the Justice coat draped over his shoulders with faded purple cuffs. He also wears a giant gauntlet on his right arm with the word "RED" written on it.

In his initial appearance, Red King's suit and tie were dark, with his suit having a solid color as opposed to the pinstripe one he later donned. The anime had a similar issue, with an early appearance depicting him with a blue pinstripe suit, as opposed to his later purple one.
enrichments.short_description: Red King is a Marine Vice Admiral and one of the nine that took part in the Egghead Incident.

enrichments.description:
The Red Port is one of the two ways to cross the Red Line when traveling on the Grand Line. It was first alluded to by Pappag.

The Red Port is the official, legal way to cross the Red Line. However, it is conditioned by the approval of the World Government. There seems to be a fee for traveling through the port. Those who are granted approval are required to leave their vessel and acquire a new one on the other side.

There are two ports, one on each side of the Red Line. The ports are stationed behind Marine strongholds. The Paradise station is located behind the G-1 Marine base (formerly Marineford) and the New World port is behind New Marineford.

So far, only the Paradise port was clearly seen. It is seemingly built on two Yarukiman Mangrove, which allow the land to have the same properties as Sabaody Archipelago, consisting of occasional bubbles floating in the area. It has several low buildings with cylindrical roofs, at least one of which is a restaurant with Chinese decor. On its shore, there is a large ship's bow structure with the World Government symbol under its bowsprit, surrounded with smaller ports for ships.
enrichments.short_description: The Red Port is one of the two ways to cross the Red Line when traveling on the Grand Line. It was first alluded to by Pappag.

enrichments.description:
Redwolf is a Gifter in the Beasts Pirates.

Redwolf is a fair-skinned man with blonde hair, a square jaw and a cleft mouth. He wears frilled shoulder pads with a furred cape, a leather vest, a pair of dark brown gloves, gray pants with a belt, and boots. Due to eating a Wolf SMILE, he has a red-furred wolf protruding out of his belly. As a Gifter, he wears a pair of black horns.

Redwolf appears to be quite ambitious, wanting to be elevated to the position of Tobiroppo, and was willing to throw himself into battle to achieve his goals. This is more explicit in the anime, where he yells that he intends to claim the position himself.

As a Gifter, Redwolf has consumed a |Ōkami no Sumairu}}, giving him a wolf protruding out of his torso.
enrichments.short_description: Redwolf is a Gifter in the Beasts Pirates.

enrichments.description:
Reforte is an infamous New World pirate captain who allied with Whitebeard.

Reforte is a man with long yellow-blonde hair and a small stubble on his chin. He wears a white shirt that shows most of his chest in a V shape and also wears a black cape over it that is draped across his shoulders. He also wears a sash and a pair of pants with some sort of design on the sides. Furthermore, he wears a black pork pie hat and a pair of black sunglasses or goggles.

In the anime, he has brown hair and a fuller beard.

It can be deduced from his willingness to put his life on the line to save Ace that Reforte is a person that values loyalty and friendship. Furthermore, since he was willing to take up arms against Marine Headquarters, it can be concluded that Reforte is a brave and bold pirate captain.
enrichments.short_description: Reforte is an infamous New World pirate captain who allied with Whitebeard.

enrichments.description:
Renaisse is an island somewhere in Paradise. Smoker and Tashigi captured Mr. 11 here.

While on Renaisse, Smoker and Tashigi arrested Baroque Works agent Mr. 11, though they were unaware of his allegiance at the time. Miss Thursday, Mr. 11's partner, abandoned him, and ran from the two Marines.

In the live-action series, Smoker and Tashigi's journey to Renaisse is shown, rather than simply mentioned. The island is home to a Marine communications outpost, which Smoker and Tashigi arrived at in the middle of a raid by Miss Thursday and Mr. 11.

enrichments.short_description: Renaisse is an island somewhere in Paradise. Smoker and Tashigi captured Mr. 11 here.

enrichments.description:
Renona Topakka was a mermaid and the mother of Kawamatsu.

Topakka was a mermaid with pale greenish skin, blue eyes, and long bright red hair. She wore a short pink kimono with red ring patterns. Due to reaching the age of 30, her tailfin had split into legs.

Topakka cared for her son and feared he would face discrimination for his race, believing it was best for Kawamatsu to lie that he was a kappa.

As a mermaid, Topakka possessed the typical abilities of her race, such as the ability to breathe underwater and the fastest swimming speed among all sea creaures.
enrichments.short_description: Renona Topakka was a mermaid and the mother of Kawamatsu.

enrichments.description:
Reuven was the king of Esperia seventy years ago. He was the husband of Queen Candelle and the adoptive father of Princess Shuri, who killed him 62 years ago after both were turned into demons.

At age 30, Reuven was a larger man with an overall stern, scruffy appearance. He had a frazzled haircut, a pronounced jaw with a stubble, and large lips. He wore a simple tank top alongside striped pants, held up by a large belt, with a pearl necklace, a royal coat with a chain wrapped around it, and a small crown. By age 38, he appeared more dirtied as a result of Esperia's hardships.

At age 21, Reuven already had an old-looking face, but was much slimmer and lacked facial hair. He had no crown and typically wore a dark military uniform-like attire. When hiding his royal status, he wore much plainer clothes.

Befitting his stern appearance, Reuven was a serious individual, to a comical degree. For example, he took Brook's feelings toward his wife Candelle as intentions of an assassination plot, and tried to attack the former when he rejected marrying his young daughter instead. However, he was willing to put this part of himself aside out of concern for his family. He was willing to tolerate Brook's casual attitude due to his role as a powerful royal guard, relying on him when he believed his wife to be in danger.
enrichments.short_description: Reuven was the king of Esperia seventy years ago. He was the husband of Queen Candelle and the adoptive father of Princess Shuri, who killed him 62 years ago after both were turned into demons.

enrichments.description:
The Riba Riba no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to reverse time around them, making the user a . It was eaten by Snitcher.

The Riba Riba no Mi grants the user the ability to reverse the movements of others or the flow of energy, including physical force. They have the ability to selectively enforce this reversal, applying only to specific targets, or to apply it over all eligible targets in a given area. The reversal of a person's movements additionally leaves them disoriented for a few seconds, and the reversal of energy allows the user to functionally reflect attacks based onto their user.

For the reversal ability to function, it must be manually activated by the user; it cannot be set to work automatically. This means that the user can only reflect attacks they are able to react to, and leaves them vulnerable if they are distracted. No other weaknesses are known outside the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.

Snitcher uses the Riba Riba no Mi to reverse the movements and energy of those around him, typically for combat or capture purposes. In combat, he frequently reverses the attacks of his opponents, leaving him nigh-untouchable in single combat. Additionally, he uses movement reversal to leave targets disoriented, allowing them to be easily captured, even by his weaker subordinates.
enrichments.short_description: The Riba Riba no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to reverse time around them, making the user a . It was eaten by Snitcher.

enrichments.description:
Richie is Mohji's pet lion, and a recurring member of the Buggy Pirates in all their various incarnations. He is classified as a Type C creature, "Big Savage".

He serves as a supporting antagonist during the Orange Town Arc.

Richie is a large lion that shows a fierce expression during fights and confrontations. However, he can also show a goofy face when he is not doing anything.

In the anime, his eye colors can sometimes change from white sclerae to scarlet red sclerae, or vice versa, depending on the animators. His eyes are usually white when he is in a comical or friendly mood, but red when he is in a vicious or enraged mood.
enrichments.short_description: Richie is Mohji's pet lion, and a recurring member of the Buggy Pirates in all their various incarnations. He is classified as a Type C creature, "Big Savage".

enrichments.description:
Rika is a young girl from Shells Town, and the daughter of Ririka. She currently serves as a waitress at the 153rd Marine Branch.

Rika is a young girl with black eyes, and dark hair done in pigtails. When she first met the Straw Hat Pirates, she wore a striped one-piece dress with what appeared to be a drawstring hood.

After two years, she has become taller and grown her hair out (though she continues to wear pigtails). Her Marine waitress uniform consists of an apron embroidered with a Marine emblem, a cook's bandana, and simple black shoes.

Rika is remarkably compassionate and brave for her age, enough to risk her life for people who have helped her (e.g. Zoro), and even extend friendship to former enemies (e.g., Helmeppo). At the same time, she can easily fall into tears or tantrums when frustrated.
enrichments.short_description: Rika is a young girl from Shells Town, and the daughter of Ririka. She currently serves as a waitress at the 153rd Marine Branch.

enrichments.description:
The Riki Riki no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that grants its user incredible strength. It was eaten by Jesus Burgess.

The Riki Riki no Mi bestows onto the user abnormal physical strength, such as the ability to lift up and throw gigantic objects. Whether there is an exact limit to the strength increase is currently unknown.

No particular weaknesses are known for this ability apart from the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.

Burgess uses this fruit's power to bolster his already impressive physical strength to even further heights, to the point of being able to casually rip a mountain out of the ground, lift it over his head, and then hurl it away with his bare hands.
enrichments.short_description: The Riki Riki no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that grants its user incredible strength. It was eaten by Jesus Burgess.

enrichments.description:
Riku Doldo III is the recrowned king of Dressrosa after the defeat of Donquixote Doflamingo, who dethroned him a decade ago. The current patriarch of the Riku Family, Doldo is the father of the late Scarlett and Viola and the grandfather of Rebecca. During the latest Levely, he was one of the leading figures in the vote for the abolishment of the Seven Warlords of the Sea.

Doldo entered the Corrida Colosseum to compete for the Mera Mera no Mi under the alias of "Ricky".

He is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Dressrosa Arc.

Doldo is an elderly, yet well-built and extremely muscular man. In his disguise as Ricky, he wears a dark purple (blue in the anime) cape with a skull and crossbones on the back, a black pair of briefs covered by a leather pteruges skirt, a leather chest harness, and a gold (silver in the anime) masked helmet which covers his entire face save for his eyes and features a prominent nose-guard; it also features a flame-like design on it. A crack in this helmet received during his fights in the B Block battle royale revealed that he has a thick brown mustache and beard.
enrichments.short_description: Riku Doldo III is the recrowned king of Dressrosa after the defeat of Donquixote Doflamingo, who dethroned him a decade ago. The current patriarch of the Riku Family, Doldo is the father of the late Scarlett and Viola…

enrichments.description:
Saint Rimoshifu Killingham is a World Noble and a member of the Knights of God.

Due to his actions and role, he is a major antagonist in the Elbaph Arc.

Saint Killingham is a younger-looking man who possesses a lanky physique and, at least in his partial qilin form, is tall enough to tower over some of his fellow Knights of God, being at least twice the height of Figarland Shamrock. Killingham's Human-Beast Form reveals him to have a dark, messy shock of hair at roughly neck length, slanted eyes with prominent lashes, a well-defined nose, and (at least in his Human-Beast Form) sharp fangs for teeth; if the latter are natural or a trait acquired through his qilin powers is as yet unknown.

As with most Knights of God, Killingham dons an ornate military uniform. It consists of an orange, high-collared, double-breasted tunic with two vertical rows of gold buttons, which extends halfway down his thighs and is matched with a white cravat, beige gloves that reach below his elbows, as well as black pants and orange knee-high, high-heeled boots for lower wear. Over the tunic, Killingham wears a trench coat that is also orange, with epaulets and an armband featuring the Knights of God's emblem on his left upper arm, pockets at waist level, and a black holding it close. Unlike the other Knights of God seen so far, Killingham has the resin bubble common among lower-rank World Nobles around his head; his is even more unique than the ones worn by common Celestial Dragons as it fitted with a orange-colored respirator in the front featuring two disk filters, which sticks to his qilin head when transformed. His bubble helmet was later destroyed by Sanji, but then regenerated on its own.
enrichments.short_description: Saint Rimoshifu Killingham is a World Noble and a member of the Knights of God.

enrichments.description:
Rindo is an average-height woman with skin bearing a slightly darker tan than the rest of the Kuja. Her black hair is cut short and tied back into a bun on top of her head. She also always has a cigarette dangling off the side of her mouth.

She wears a fancy orange frilled black jacket with purple spiral snake patterns on it. She lets it hang open, revealing her bosom and midriff. She also wears a loose fitting orange belt which has a yellow and black patterned cloth in front of her waist. Like the other Kuja, her footwear consists of long black stockings with straps attached.

Rindo has often shown to be very respectful and punctual towards her duties and Hancock but is often very aloof, showing no real surprise over the presence of Luffy on the island or the events that took place.

Rindo is the best sniper of the Kuja tribe, and an elite member, strong enough to join the Kuja Pirates.
enrichments.short_description: Rindo is an average-height woman with skin bearing a slightly darker tan than the rest of the Kuja. Her black hair is cut short and tied back into a bun on top of her head. She also always has a cigarette dangling off…

enrichments.description:
Rint was one of the archaeologists of Ohara.

Rint was a middle aged, overweight woman with long shaggy purple hair. She had a reddish-purple hat with a horizontal pink stripe around it. She also wore a shirt with hearts on it, and the sleeves rolled up. Her pants were yellow-green with vertical lines.

Rint was a very devoted scholar that stayed behind to help ditch books into a lake in an effort to protect them. She, along with the other scholars, were friendly towards Nico Robin.

She was a skilled archaeologist and had a good knowledge of history. She specialized in the history of culinary science, and was a skilled cook, commonly making the meals for the other archaeologists.
enrichments.short_description: Rint was one of the archaeologists of Ohara.

enrichments.description:
Ripley is a giant from the last generation of Elbaph's warriors and a biology teacher at the Walrus School. She is also the mother of Colon and common-law wife of Scopper Gaban.

Ripley is a giant woman of slender figure. Her most noticeable trait is a streamlined and violet tattoo that runs down the whole left side of her body, from her left temple to her left foot. She has long, pink hair arranged in braids at the front, with bangs partially covering the right side of her face and pink eyes.

Ripley wears a green, midriff-baring tank top with a horned Jolly Roger design imprinted on it, a green fur cape, a green short skirt held up by leather belts, and green fuzzy boots wrapped in bands.

Ripley is a laid-back woman who does not care about personal manners and freely uses rude language, in spite of hypocritically reprimanding bad behavior among her students. Nevertheless, Ripley is a follower of the late King Harald's teachings, which prioritize peace and trading among countries instead of war and conquest. However, she does still value some of Elbaph's old traditions, as she has been shown to encourage her son's desire to become a warrior and has shown interest in Nika, like many other giants.
enrichments.short_description: Ripley is a giant from the last generation of Elbaph's warriors and a biology teacher at the Walrus School. She is also the mother of Colon and common-law wife of Scopper Gaban.

enrichments.description:
Ripper is a Marine Commander who heads the 153rd Branch. Formerly a subordinate of Captain Morgan, he assumed control after Morgan was defeated by the Straw Hat Pirates.

Ripper is an average man who wears the normal marine hat, shirt, and pants. However, his ascot is a light green instead of dark blue. He has tanned skin, brown hair, a pronounced jawline, and a brown mustache and beard.

After the timeskip, he now wears the Marine officer coat.

When he was still a young Marine, he did not have a beard.
enrichments.short_description: Ripper is a Marine Commander who heads the 153rd Branch. Formerly a subordinate of Captain Morgan, he assumed control after Morgan was defeated by the Straw Hat Pirates.

enrichments.description:
Ririka is a bartender who runs a local bar in Shells Town. She is Rika's mother.

Ririka is a woman of average height and weight. She has brown hair that is usually tied back. She wears a light green dress over a dark green shirt and brown sandals.

She is very protective of her daughter, as she made her stay away from Luffy after he punched Helmeppo, fearing for her safety if she was associated with him.

After Monkey D. Luffy punched Helmeppo, Ririka ordered her daughter to get inside and get away from Luffy. She then asked Rika if she had gone to the execution grounds again, which her daughter denied.
enrichments.short_description: Ririka is a bartender who runs a local bar in Shells Town. She is Rika's mother.

enrichments.description:
The Risky Brothers are two male pirates working as members of the Rolling Pirates under their captain, Lola. They were members of the Thriller Bark Victim's Association, a group of Gecko Moria's victims who banded together. During the time their shadows were stolen from them, they were placed in two squirrel zombies who were also named the Risky Brothers.

The Risky Brothers are a short rotund man, and a tall skinny man.

The rotund one wears a black mask, similar to his zombie counterpart. He has curly black hair and a bandage over the mask. He has tanned skin and large lips, and a bit of stubble on his chin. He also wears a torn up white shirt and torn up black tie. He has brown pants, and bandages around his wrist. He also has a large sword on his back, with a brown strap holding it across his chest.

The other brother is rather tall and skinny, the opposite of the first. He has curly light brown hair with a few strands hanging down. He has thick black circles around his eyes and a bit of stubble on his chin. He sports a torn up long sleeved striped dark blue and light green shirt, and light grey pants.
enrichments.short_description: The Risky Brothers are two male pirates working as members of the Rolling Pirates under their captain, Lola. They were members of the Thriller Bark Victim's Association, a group of Gecko Moria's victims who banded…

enrichments.description:
The Risky Brothers were a duo of Wild Zombie squirrels that served under Perona. They were animated from the shadows of two pirates by the same name.

The Risky Brothers are two tiny squirrels.

One is a lighter brown than the other, and wears a black mask similar to its shadows original owner, one of the real Risky Brothers. He wears a purple vest with light blue stripes on it. He also has a bandage on his right arm, and left leg. He seems to have red buttons sewed into his chest and stomach.

The other is a darker brown, with a bandage on the top left side of his head. He wears a yellow vest with blue dots, under another bandage around his chest. He also has bandages wrapped around the upper parts of both his arms, the lower part of his tail, and left leg.
enrichments.short_description: The Risky Brothers were a duo of Wild Zombie squirrels that served under Perona. They were animated from the shadows of two pirates by the same name.

enrichments.description:
The Risky Red Island is one of the three islands to which one of the needles on the New World Log Pose points after coming from Fish-Man Island, making it one of the first islands in the New World. It was first mentioned by Vice Admiral Smoker.

enrichments.description:
The Risu Risu no Mi, Model: Ratatoskr is a Mythical Zoan-type Devil Fruit that grants the power to transform into a hybrid or full version of Ratatoskr, a legendary ice squirrel of ancient times. The fruit was "eaten" by the giant warhammer Ragnir.

The user is capable of producing ice and freezing mists that can flash-freeze targets. According to Loki, anyone frozen by Ragnir cannot thaw until Ragnir wills it; even an Omen blast from Nerona Imu was unable to break it. However, when Ragnir accidentally collided with the ice, it instantly started to thaw. By having the ice crystals collide with each other, the user can generate and amplify lightning, thus making it a good partner for Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Nidhöggr which produces lightning. The user is capable of unleashing ice attacks even when not transformed, making Ragnir doubly effective in its original hammer form. No weaknesses are currently known aside from the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.

As a hammer, the transmutation of the fruit's abilities has given Ragnir sentience, allowing it to use its tremendous power entirely of its own accord and select a worthy wielder. In conjunction with its current wielder Loki, Ragnir frequently generates either lightning or ice when Loki swings it to attack.

Elbaph legend holds that Ratatoskr was once the companion of the Warrior God many centuries ago, with the Warrior God also wielding Ragnir. When the Warrior God died, it is believed that the spirit of Ratatoskr inhabited Ragnir. The accuracy of this account is currently uncertain, but by gaining the powers of this fruit, Ragnir did receive Ratatoskr's goal of protecting the Warrior God's Devil Fruit, the Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Nidhöggr, which it did for centuries until being bested by Loki, who gained Ragnir as his weapon.
enrichments.short_description: The Risu Risu no Mi, Model: Ratatoskr is a Mythical Zoan-type Devil Fruit that grants the power to transform into a hybrid or full version of Ratatoskr, a legendary ice squirrel of ancient times. The fruit was "eaten"…

enrichments.description:
Rivers is the gunner of the former Bellamy Pirates.

Rivers is a tall man with a good physique. He wears a white hat with long ear-flaps, a dark-red V-neck shirt with grey trousers and brown boots.

When he was younger he wore a white cap very similar to the one he would have as an adult and a blue shirt with green spots and white pants.

He feels that Bellamy shouldn't get his hands dirty like people like Luffy, Zoro, and Nami, whom he doesn't consider to be on his level. After Bellamy's defeat, Rivers showed his cowardice, to the point of preventing Sarquiss from facing Luffy and, like the rest, doing nothing when Luffy took all of his captain's gold.
enrichments.short_description: Rivers is the gunner of the former Bellamy Pirates.

enrichments.description:
Road is a giant from Elbaph who is the navigator of the New Giant Warrior Pirates and was formerly an S-Class ranked mercenary for Buggy's Delivery. In addition, he rules over a personal diorama full of entrapped humans and giant animals as its "Sun God". He is the older brother of Bjorn.

He served as a minor antagonist in the beginning of the Elbaph Arc, but later became an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates.

Road is a tall and slender giant with long dark blue hair which covers the entire right side of his face. He wears a dark gray buttoned coat lined with fur, dark gray pants lined with fur at the bottom, a wide brown belt with a big yellow skull buckle, light grey-blue shoulder plates covered with bumps, and a large yellow cape with lighter yellow vertical stripes. He also wears a very long yellow striped scarf around his neck which covers it and his mouth and has brown gloves on his hands.

As a newborn in the anime, he had olive skin, shorter and dark brown hair, and was wrapped in a pink cloth.
enrichments.short_description: Road is a giant from Elbaph who is the navigator of the New Giant Warrior Pirates and was formerly an S-Class ranked mercenary for Buggy's Delivery. In addition, he rules over a personal diorama full of entrapped humans…

enrichments.description:
Rob Lucci, also known as "Massacre Weapon", is a masked agent of CP0.

Originally, he was introduced as part of CP9, reputed as the assassin unit's strongest member in history. Operating undercover to obtain the Pluton blueprints from Iceburg, he worked as a sawyer, treenail, and bolt specialist for the Galley-La Company's Dock 1 in Water 7.

After his defeat by Monkey D. Luffy at Enies Lobby, Lucci was dismissed from CP9 by Spandam, who declared him and the other assassins responsible for the Straw Hats' havoc on Enies Lobby. However, within the next two years, he managed to be reinstated into Cipher Pol as part of CP0, this time as Spandam's superior.

Lucci is the secondary antagonist of the Water 7 Saga, appearing as the main antagonist of the Water 7 Arc and the secondary antagonist of the Enies Lobby Arc. He later appears as a major antagonist in the Egghead Arc (and briefly a reluctant ally). He is also one of the central characters from CP9's Independent Report Cover Page Serial, along with the rest of the CP9 agents.
enrichments.short_description: Rob Lucci, also known as "Massacre Weapon", is a masked agent of CP0.

enrichments.description:
Robelle is a town located in Drum Island.

This is where Portgas D. Ace asked some of the villagers to tell Luffy that he was going to wait for him at Arabasta only for ten days.

Compared to the rest of Drum, Robelle is a rather flat town with condensed wooden buildings. It has a bridge that leads into it.

The town has at least one restaurant, where Ace ate without paying.
enrichments.short_description: Robelle is a town located in Drum Island.

enrichments.description:
Robson is Wapol's pet, and personal transport. He is a White Walkie, also known as "Wooly Hippo".

Robson is a large White Walkie, with long white fur, and an appearance similar to a hippo. He has long legs, and Wapol has placed a saddle on his back for him to ride on.

Even though Wapol killed his brothers, he still seems to be loyal to him. This loyalty is attributed to the fact that Wapol often offers Robson rewards for following orders.

As a White Walkie, he has extendable legs grant him incredible climbing abilities, and was able to climb the Drum Rockies with Wapol on his back.
enrichments.short_description: Robson is Wapol's pet, and personal transport. He is a White Walkie, also known as "Wooly Hippo".

enrichments.description:
Roche was one of the archaeologists of Ohara.

Roche was an average sized man, with brown hair, similar to Thatch. He also had glasses, and wore a white coat with the sleeves partially rolled up. Under his coat he had a red shirt, with a grey color and two yellow buttons.

Roche was a very devoted scholar that stayed behind to help ditch books into a lake in an effort to protect them. He, along with the other scholars, were friendly towards Nico Robin.

As an archeologist of Ohara, it can be assumed that Roche knew how to read poneglyphs.
enrichments.short_description: Roche was one of the archaeologists of Ohara.

enrichments.description:
Rockstar is a member of the Red Hair Pirates, being relatively new in the crew two years ago.

Rockstar is a fairly tall and burly man with dark skin and a red liberty-spikes-like hairstyle. He wears a colorful attire composed of a dark-purple, double-breasted coat (with buttons similar to Magellan's), left open on his chest to reveal a light-orange, wide-collared shirt, and a red foulard around his neck. He has a yellow sash tied around his waist, that instead of hanging only on one side, like seen on most of the other pirates, hangs down on both sides. He wears light-blue pants and brown boots and carries around a green-hilted saber, hanging on his left hip from a belt he has over the right shoulder.

A confident man, Rockstar demonstrates a great sense of pride. When he was insulted by Whitebeard's men, he wanted to fight them because they had damaged his honor. He also tried to use the strength of his captain to back up the importance of the letter he delivered to Whitebeard. He seems very loyal to his captain, sticking up for him in front of Whitebeard.

Rockstar has a strong sense of justice and wants others to always follow rules.
enrichments.short_description: Rockstar is a member of the Red Hair Pirates, being relatively new in the crew two years ago.

enrichments.description:
The Rocky Port is a large passenger ship formerly of a certain country that was involved in the Rocky Port Incident.

The ship was mistakenly hijacked by Trafalgar Law, who had learned of a Poneglyph on Hachinosu. He rode the ship to the island, getting into conflict with pirates on the way and prompting Blackbeard and Koby to intervene, triggering the Rocky Port Incident.

During the battle, the Rocky Port sustained significant damages.

Since the Rocky Port Incident, the Blackbeard Pirates appear to have claimed the Rocky Port for themselves. They repaired it from the damages it sustained, have only recently finished, and the ship remains on Hachinosu.
enrichments.short_description: The Rocky Port is a large passenger ship formerly of a certain country that was involved in the Rocky Port Incident.
enrichments.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.

enrichments.description:
Roddy is a mink and a Guardian of the Whale Forest.

Roddy is a large, orange-skinned unspecified bull mink with two large horns, a small nose, and long, messy, light orange, bison-like hair flowing down his back. He wears dark clothing with a light-colored cape draped above his shoulders.

Roddy takes his duty of not letting any intruders into the Whale Forest very seriously, as demonstrated when he attacked Monkey D. Luffy for entering the Whale Forest without permission despite the fact that Luffy was an acquaintance of Bepo.

Similar to a bull, he can easily be distracted and enraged by fluttering objects, such as cloth. He also has the tendency to say "moo" while speaking.
enrichments.short_description: Roddy is a mink and a Guardian of the Whale Forest.

enrichments.description:
Roji was the wife of Oran, the mother of Mizuira, the sister-in-law of Nico Olvia, and the maternal aunt of Nico Robin.

Roji was a large, widely obese woman with thin limbs, wide and thick lips, small sad beady eyes, and curly red hair. She wore a simple short-sleeved orange shirt and black pants.

Roji was extremely rude, abusive, and uncaring towards her niece Robin. She threatened Robin for crying and even treated her like a slave. Roji only cared about herself, her husband, and their only daughter.

When Nico Olvia left Ohara to research Poneglyphs, Roji and her husband, Oran, took in Olvia's two-year-old daughter, Robin, since Oran was Olvia's younger brother. Roji never liked Robin and would threaten to hit Robin if she did not stop crying. She would always make Robin do all the housework and have her eat stale bread. Roji would not allow Robin to join any family celebrations. Roji also scolded Robin for trying out Mizuira's clothes. In essence, Roji treated her niece as a slave. However, Roji's husband would always defend Robin; since he is Robin's maternal uncle, he was the only person in the household to show care for her and would deal with Roji's temper.
enrichments.short_description: Roji was the wife of Oran, the mother of Mizuira, the sister-in-law of Nico Olvia, and the maternal aunt of Nico Robin.

enrichments.description:
Lieutenant Junior Grade Rokkaku was one of Axe-Hand Morgan's officers at the 153rd Marine Branch. He currently serves under Commander Ripper.

Rokakku has tanned skin, with prominent cheekbones and a black (light colored in the manga) goatee. He has a scar above his right eye. He also wears a modified marine uniform with a green tie instead of the standard blue. After the Timeskip, he appears to no longer have his scar.

Although everyone was scared of Morgan's wrath, he was willing to stand up against him when he ordered him to kill Rika, showing that he is brave enough to stand up for what he believes in. Also, in contrast to Morgan, he is not a heartless person as he refused to kill a little girl.

As a Marine, he most likely had to go through training and so may have some combat skills.
enrichments.short_description: Lieutenant Junior Grade Rokkaku was one of Axe-Hand Morgan's officers at the 153rd Marine Branch. He currently serves under Commander Ripper.

enrichments.description:
Rokki is a member of the Numbers in the Beasts Pirates, representing the number "six".

Like the other Numbers, Rokki is massive in size, being comparable to an ancient giant. He is bald but has a noticeable amount of body hair on his chest, arms, and legs, as well as stubble on his upper lip. His body is covered in tattoos, including a swirl-shaped design around his head, the 陸 ("six") on his forehead, and a crown-like design on both of his arms. He possesses two dark-colored horns which point straight up. The only clothes he wears are a pair of dark-colored overalls which cover his abdomen but leave much of his upper chest exposed.

In the anime, Rokki is missing the tattoos on his shoulders.

Rokki guards the gate to the armory on Onigashima, and seems to be diligent in this, as Yamato stated that he would likely have to fight him to get past him. However, Rokki was also shown to be asleep at the door, even as a war had broken out above him.
enrichments.short_description: Rokki is a member of the Numbers in the Beasts Pirates, representing the number "six".

enrichments.description:
Rolling Logan is an army commander of the Majiatsuka Kingdom. He joined as a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum to compete for the Mera Mera no Mi.

Rolling Logan is a big, muscular man with tanned skin, large thick lips, and curly dark-colored hair that reaches to his shoulders. He wears a long yellow cape with purple lining held with a brooch, a black pair of briefs, leather boots, and a pair of red gloves.

He has a torso and arms that appear to be rather disproportionate compared to his legs.

He is a brutal man as he enjoyed crushing his opponents. In the anime, he is sadistic and hungry for positive attention, bragging about how he was going to crush Rebecca just to receive cheers from the audience who despised her.
enrichments.short_description: Rolling Logan is an army commander of the Majiatsuka Kingdom. He joined as a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum to compete for the Mera Mera no Mi.

enrichments.description:
Ronja is a student at the Walrus School on Elbaph. She is a .

Ronja is a young giant girl with brown eyes and blonde hair tied in a three-segmented bubble ponytail which curls forwards, resembling the tail of a scorpion. She lacks any upper teeth apart from prominent square-shaped canine teeth. She wears a short fur cape and a patterned dress with light squares formed by dark vertical and horizontal lines.

Ronja has an upbeat personality and remains optimistic even in the face of danger. Like other Walrus School students, Ronja is against violence and fighting. She is also fond of humans. Ronja is very brave, as despite being terrified for her life when Gunko was about to drop her to her death, she tried to reassure the adults and other children that she would be fine and they should not risk Elbaph's history for her sake.

Ronja's father is shown to be concerned for her well-being, and personally rushed to save her when he heard about her kidnapping. Upon seeing her again, he was quick to praise her bravery.
enrichments.short_description: Ronja is a student at the Walrus School on Elbaph. She is a .

enrichments.description:
Roronoa Arashi was the son of Shimotsuki Furiko and Roronoa Pinzoro making him a member of the Shimotsuki Family. He is the father of Roronoa Zoro and the husband of Tera.

Based on his silhouette, Arashi had spiky hair.

Arashi's overall abilities are unknown, it is known that he was defeated and killed in a battle with pirates.

Arashi was born in the Shimotsuki Village to a local swordsman named Pinzoro and a Wano Country emigrant named Furiko. At some point, he married the daughter of a bandit, named Tera. Twenty-one years ago they had a son named Roronoa Zoro, sometime after, Arashi later died in a battle with pirates.
enrichments.short_description: Roronoa Arashi was the son of Shimotsuki Furiko and Roronoa Pinzoro making him a member of the Shimotsuki Family. He is the father of Roronoa Zoro and the husband of Tera.

enrichments.description:
Roronoa Pinzoro is a swordsman from a village in the East Blue. He is also the husband of Shimotsuki Furiko, the father of Roronoa Arashi, and the grandfather of Roronoa Zoro.

Based on his silhouette, Pinzoro had short hair that was spiky in the back.

Pinzoro is a swordsman, but the extent of his swordsmanship skills are unknown.

52 years ago, Pinzoro's village was attacked by mountain bandits. However, the villagers were saved by a group of migrants from Wano Country. Ten of the migrants chose to settle on the island and established Shimotsuki Village. Pinzoro married one of the settlers, Shimotsuki Furiko, and they had a son named Roronoa Arashi.
enrichments.short_description: Roronoa Pinzoro is a swordsman from a village in the East Blue. He is also the husband of Shimotsuki Furiko, the father of Roronoa Arashi, and the grandfather of Roronoa Zoro.

enrichments.description:
"Executioner" Roshio is a pirate captain who has a bounty of 42,000,000.

Roshio is a tall and muscular man with long white dreadlocks and a wide face. His left arm is also intricately tattooed with skulls and a red pattern.

He wears an indigo a-shirt with black pants and a headband with his jolly roger (a hung man on a red background) on it in a repeating pattern.

Roshio is described as a crazy man by the citizens of Mock Town. He murdered a person on the spot when that person won against him in a game of cards. Ironically enough, Roshio himself got brutally attacked by Bellamy when he won against him in another game of cards. Roshio shouted angrily when he was accused of cheating.
enrichments.short_description: "Executioner" Roshio is a pirate captain who has a bounty of 42,000,000.
