enrichments.short_description: Tomato Gang is a debt collector who is after Pandaman. The two often show up in panels together, as Pandaman is constantly on the run from him. He later hires Pandaman's rival, Unforgivable Mask to help track him down.…

enrichments.description:
The Tomb of the Kings is an ancient crypt located beneath Arabasta Kingdom's capital Alubarna, wherein lie the tombs and graves of the past kings of Arabasta. It is also the location of the Arabastan Poneglyph.

The Tomb of the Kings is a structure located to the west of Alubarna's royal palace. The path to the tomb is made up of bricks and lined with a grassy garden and palm trees. There is also a large gate held up by columns with ancient inscriptions on them.

Beneath the tomb exists a large underground chamber, accessed via a hidden staircase. The entry hall of the chamber contains several large columns, a sarcophagus, and two statues depicting sea cats, a sacred animal of Arabasta. It also contains stone carvings depicting the guardian deities of Arabasta, the jackal and the falcon, as well as some kind of serpentine creature.

The Arabasta Poneglyph Chamber is located deeper into the chamber, behind the last door. This is where the poneglyph that contains information on Pluton is located and has been protected by the royal family for generations, although they do not know much else about the poneglyph. Inside, there is a hidden panel that can be activated to make the room collapse.
enrichments.short_description: The Tomb of the Kings is an ancient crypt located beneath Arabasta Kingdom's capital Alubarna, wherein lie the tombs and graves of the past kings of Arabasta. It is also the location of the Arabastan Poneglyph.

enrichments.description:
Tomozo is a shopkeeper in the Wano Country's Flower Capital who operated 41 years ago.

Tomozo is a man of average height with a square jaw and a thin mustache. He wears a black hat, glasses on his forehead, and a dark coat with a gem pattern.

Little is known of Tomozo's personality, but he seems kind, willing to accommodate his customer Denjiro's requests. However, he is not very smart, easily falling for Denjiro's tricks.

As the owner of a general store, Tomozo has authority over the sales of the store.
enrichments.short_description: Tomozo is a shopkeeper in the Wano Country's Flower Capital who operated 41 years ago.

enrichments.description:
The Ton Ton no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit which allows the user to increase their weight, making them a 人間|Sūpā Weito Ningen|English: Super-Weight Man}}. It was eaten by the former Donquixote Family combatant Machvise.

The fruit's power was shown during the conflict of Dressrosa, but was not named until it was revealed in SBS Volume 79.

The fruit allows the user to increase their body weight by incredible amounts, measured in metric tonnes (not to be confused with the imperial tons). This allows them to land crushing attacks that can easily crack the ground and even break the bones of giants.

The fruit is superior to the Kiro Kiro no Mi, since while both fruits revolve around the manipulation of body weight, the user of the Ton Ton no Mi can become much heavier than the Kiro Kiro no Mi's maximum of 10,000 kilograms. The lowest weight shown is ten tonnes (equivalent to ten thousand kilograms) and the highest weight shown is 10,000 tonnes (equivalent to ten million kilograms). The user's weight can also be supplemented by holding other heavy objects, as Machvise sometimes crushes his opponents while holding a large shield.
enrichments.short_description: The Ton Ton no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit which allows the user to increase their weight, making them a 人間|Sūpā Weito Ningen|English: Super-Weight Man}}. It was eaten by the former Donquixote Family combatant…

enrichments.description:
Tongari Island is a non-canon island located in the New World. It is the setting for Tokyo One Piece Tower, and by extension all of its live attractions and related animations. It is considered territory of the Straw Hat Pirates.

Tongari Island is a small, rocky island with a flattened central section where the main tower is located. The island's secret power is channeled through the central tower, as seen when it came to the aid of Luffy and Trafalgar Law.

Underneath the island's surface are a series of caves that hold some of the island's secrets.

Tongari Island has a number of shops, restaurants, and a casino on the island.
enrichments.short_description: Tongari Island is a non-canon island located in the New World. It is the setting for Tokyo One Piece Tower, and by extension all of its live attractions and related animations. It is considered territory of the Straw…

enrichments.description:
Tonjil is Tonjit's grandson and Tonsfer's brother.

Tonjil is a young boy with short black hair. He wears a striped tunic held by a sash and a white bandanna that covers his forehead.

Tonjil is cheerful and likes to play with Shelly. He has recently gotten interested in stilts, causing his parents to worry that he may end up like his grandfather.

Finally meeting his grandfather after his years on stilts, Tonjil hugged Shelly.
enrichments.short_description: Tonjil is Tonjit's grandson and Tonsfer's brother.

enrichments.description:
Tonjit is an elderly nomad belonging to a tribe that lives on Long Ring Long Land.

Tonjit is an elderly man, with wrinkles and a round white beard. He has small round eyes, a round nose, and is missing one tooth. He has a purple-brown hat, with brown fur lining, and brown cloth on the sides. He wears a yellow tunic, with green lining with a circle design on the end of the sleeves, and side of the chest. He has a purple sash, with a red string hanging down. He wears purple shoes, held on by white strings, and grey on the toe area. He also wears vertical zigzag striped purple and tan pants.

Twenty two years ago, he wore the same clothes, but had a less wrinkled face, and a shorter beard, which was black. He also had not lost his tooth yet.

Tonjit is a kind-hearted and hospitable, yet incredibly eccentric and absent-minded old man, as when he and Luffy first met, he acted as if he had known Luffy and Chopper his entire life and greeted them as such, only to quickly accept that they were complete strangers, and calmly remarked that explained why he didn't recognize them.
enrichments.short_description: Tonjit is an elderly nomad belonging to a tribe that lives on Long Ring Long Land.

enrichments.description:
Tonsfer is Tonjit's granddaughter and Tonjil's sister.

Tonsfer is a young girl with shoulder-length black hair tied in a ponytail. She wears a a light tunic with dark blotch patterns at the end of her sleeves.

Tonsfer is cheerful and enjoys her grandfather's company, though she dislikes his cheese.

Finally meeting her grandfather, Tonsfer hugged his arm while he read about the Straw Hat Pirates.
enrichments.short_description: Tonsfer is Tonjit's granddaughter and Tonjil's sister.

enrichments.description:
The Tontatta Kingdom is a kingdom underneath Green Bit, and home to the , a tribe of dwarves ruled by king Gancho.

The Tontatta kingdom is a kingdom that is located just below Green Bit, inside there is as much vegetation as in the forest itself, even having a waterfall, the flowers are normal size, but compared to the houses of the dwarves they seem to be huge. Dwarf houses are oval, as culturally depicted in folklore. The kingdom has a stone roof, and is large enough for a normal-sized human to stand upright.

The Tontatta Kingdom had an army comprised of at least two squads, the Pink Bee Squad led by Bian, and the Yellow Kabu Squad led by Kabu, before it was disbanded following the events of the Dressrosa Arc. Tontatta Kingdom also has an airline, Tontatta Airline (TAL) that is comprised of insects.

In addition to that, they have Linear Foxes known as the that can hold twenty dwarves. They have been said to be extremely fast. The word "Corn" is a play on kon, a Japanese onomatopoeia for foxes.
enrichments.short_description: The Tontatta Kingdom is a kingdom underneath Green Bit, and home to the , a tribe of dwarves ruled by king Gancho.

enrichments.description:
Tony-Tony Island is a non-canon island in the East Blue. It is the home island of Chopperman in the Chopperman manga.

The island is also home to the Cross Power.

Chopperman's hideout is located on Tony-Tony Island, and is where Chopperman and Namifia live and work. It's exact location is unclear.

After Spanda attempted to kidnap Giant Luffy Bomber and left money on the island, Namifia upgraded the hideout.
enrichments.short_description: Tony-Tony Island is a non-canon island in the East Blue. It is the home island of Chopperman in the Chopperman manga.

enrichments.description:
Saint Topman Warcury is a World Noble and one of the Five Elders who publicly head the World Government, holding the title of Warrior God of Justice.

Due to his actions and role, he is one of the secondary antagonists of the Egghead Arc. Along with the other Elders, he is one of the main antagonists of the Final Saga and one of the overarching antagonists of the One Piece series.

Warcury is a bald elderly round man who has a very large white mustache as well as birthmark spots on his forehead and right cheek. He wears a black suit over a black tie and a white buttoned shirt, as well as black pants. In the anime, he initially had a short white beard, but lost it after the timeskip.

Like the other Elders, Warcury cares about the balance in the world maintained by the Three Great Powers and wishes to maintain it. He appears to be patient, as he was content to observe Shanks' potentially threatening actions and not rush to intervene. However, he cursed Crocodile and Monkey D. Luffy for threatening the balance when the latter removed the former from the Seven Warlords of the Sea, saying that Luffy could not be forgiven. He also wishes to preserve the image of the World Government by keeping the events of the Void Century a secret, and he and the other Elders will immediately have anyone destroyed who is found to be studying it.
enrichments.short_description: Saint Topman Warcury is a World Noble and one of the Five Elders who publicly head the World Government, holding the title of Warrior God of Justice.

enrichments.description:
Tori is a member of the Blackbeard Pirates.

Tori is a young woman with long blond hair. She wears a white dress and a red knit cap with sunglasses on it.

Tori seems to enjoy drinking as she is seen holding bottles of alcohol in both hands. She has a habit of emptying bottles quickly but has a strong enough tolerance that it doesn't cause her to change complexion.

Tori sat on a couch with Blackbeard, Maki, and Kikipatsu when Blackbeard conversed with Gecko Moria.
enrichments.short_description: Tori is a member of the Blackbeard Pirates.

enrichments.description:
The Tori Tori no Mi, Model: Albatross is a Zoan-type Devil Fruit that allows its user to transform into an albatross hybrid and a full albatross at will. It was eaten by Morgans.

Although albatrosses are normally flying birds, the current user of this fruit, Morgans, is unable to fly. Other than that, the fruit is susceptible to the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.

Morgans maintains his hybrid form at all times. Despite this, his ability does not permit him to fly.

Morgans ate this fruit at least 38 years ago, as he is seen with his albatross form at 15-year-old.
enrichments.short_description: The Tori Tori no Mi, Model: Albatross is a Zoan-type Devil Fruit that allows its user to transform into an albatross hybrid and a full albatross at will. It was eaten by Morgans.

enrichments.description:
The Tori Tori no Mi, Model: Eagle is an anime-only Zoan-type Devil Fruit that allows its user to transform into an eagle hybrid and a full eagle at will. It was eaten by Buzz.

The first and foremost strength of this Devil Fruit power is that it allows the user to transform into an eagle and, in Buzz's case, an eagle-bulldog hybrid.

Being a predatory bird, this fruit also grants the user the rare ability of flight and increased combat capabilities that surpasses that of a normal Zoan.

This fruit does not seem to have any weaknesses outside of the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.
enrichments.short_description: The Tori Tori no Mi, Model: Eagle is an anime-only Zoan-type Devil Fruit that allows its user to transform into an eagle hybrid and a full eagle at will. It was eaten by Buzz.

enrichments.description:
The Tori Tori no Mi, Model: Falcon is a Zoan-type Devil Fruit that allows its user to transform into a falcon hybrid and a full falcon at will. It was eaten by Pell.

This fruit enables a person to become a large falcon and a falcon-human hybrid at will, granting him the enhanced senses of a falcon, along with the advantage of having one of the only few Devil Fruits that allow flight. In his full falcon form, he can carry other people on his back while flying. Also in this form, weight does not seem to be much of an issue, as he carried a massive bomb high into the air without showing any strain.

This fruit does not seem to have any specific weaknesses, aside from the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.

As shown by Pell, this Devil Fruit grants him increased speed and strength, as well as the ability to use his talons to slash through his opponents. Being a predatory bird, Pell is better suited for physical combat than standard Zoan users. It also allows him to fly. This is useful in both traveling and attacking. He is seen attacking with a pair of Gatling guns, making him resemble a fighter plane. He also gave other people rides on his back in his full falcon form.
enrichments.short_description: The Tori Tori no Mi, Model: Falcon is a Zoan-type Devil Fruit that allows its user to transform into a falcon hybrid and a full falcon at will. It was eaten by Pell.

enrichments.description:
The Tori Tori no Mi, Model: Nue is a non-canon Mythical Zoan-type Devil Fruit that allows its user to transform into a Nue hybrid and a full Nue at will. It was eaten by Toratsugu.

The fruit is biggest at the top and decreases in size as it goes down. It has a flat bottom. Like all devil fruits, it has a stem and is covered in spiral patterns.

The biggest known strength of the fruit is giving the user the ability to fly. As a nue, the user seems to be capable of fighting and causing destruction, as shown when Toratsugu attacked Lark and Kikuhime's wedding ceremony. The nue form is large enough to carry people on its back. No weaknesses are known aside from the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.

Toratsugu uses his fruit in combat, as shown when he fought against Lark and later Luffy, and also uses its ability to fly in order to travel to places quickly and make escapes. When he lived alone as an outlaw, he seemed to be in his nue form most if not all of the time.
enrichments.short_description: The Tori Tori no Mi, Model: Nue is a non-canon Mythical Zoan-type Devil Fruit that allows its user to transform into a Nue hybrid and a full Nue at will. It was eaten by Toratsugu.

enrichments.description:
The Tori Tori no Mi, Model: Phoenix is a Mythical Zoan-type Devil Fruit that grants the power to transform into a and half-phoenix hybrid at will, as well as self-regenerate (and heal others) using blue phoenix flames. The fruit was eaten by Polo Marco.

The Tori Tori no Mi, Model: Phoenix resembles a : an oval fruit with green skin segmented into round fruitlets, which each feature a signature Devil Fruit swirl in the middle and come to a prickly point on top. Instead of the T-shaped stem typically seen with Devil Fruits, this fruit possesses a crown of long, blade-shaped leaves that stiffly point up, form the occasional Devil Fruit swirl, and overall resemble the blue-yellow phoenix flames that this fruit grants access to.

The ability user can transform into a mythical phoenix: a large, vaguely -shaped bird that is completely shrouded in blue (partially yellow) flames. This firebird form comes with two sizeable wings featuring eyespot feathers, a long and slender neck, a yellow-flamed head crest, legs with sharp talons, and a trio of long, yellow tail feathers made of closed, bound-together circles. Notably through Marco's use, no full-bodied Human-Beast Form has been seen (that evenly spreads over his entire body), only partial morphing of his arms and legs into wings and bird legs respectively; whether or not this partial transformation is in fact this Zoan's default Human-Beast Form remains unconfirmed.

As with all Zoans, the ability user's transformations greatly bolster their physical abilities, granting (in Marco's case) strength high enough to hold back two powerful Ancient Zoan users simultaneously. As a bird-type Zoan, it bestows the power of flight in both the Human-Beast and Beast Form, allowing the user to excel in matters of combat mobility and travel. Either one of the user's phoenix forms also comes with sharp sets of talons on the feet that can deliver slashing damage via kicks.

enrichments.description:
At first glance, the island seems savage, and its inhabitants seem primitive. In reality however, the locals have an extensive library and the great tree in the middle of the island is covered in plants that are excellent for making various medicines.

Tony Tony Chopper was sent here by Bartholomew Kuma during the events in the Sabaody Archipelago Arc. He spent two years here in order to train.

The human inhabitants of the Torino Kingdom have so far been shown as overweight people dressed only in grass skirts with knotted black hair, seemingly having the stereotypical caveman intelligence. Some bear an eye tattoo symbol on either of their upper arms and all adults seem wear a simple necklace. Despite this, it has been revealed that they have a vast library of books about different herbs and their medicinal purposes as well as weapons that suggest a mechanical nature. This implies that they have an advanced culture and perhaps a higher intelligence than what was initially presumed. All of them are extremely short, only being about twice as tall as Tony Tony Chopper's hybrid form. The only named inhabitant of the island is Shanba.

The natives of the island were ruled by the gigantic birds known as |Masukeredomo Goayū Bādo}} that live in the tree above.

enrichments.description:
The Toro Toro no Mi is a non-canon Logia-type Devil Fruit from the second movie that allows the user to create, control, and transform into a at will. It was eaten by Honey Queen.

The Toro Toro no Mi allows its user to transform into an unidentified lilac-colored liquid, enabling its user to flow through small spaces and attack with liquid blasts. The user is also immune to physical attacks, which simply pass through their liquid body.

However, the user has no effective physical strength when in liquid form, and cannot transform back into their normal form if they are in a space that their normal body cannot fit in. Because of these flaws, Nami easily captured and sealed Honey Queen in a jar while she was in her liquid form, and preventing her from escaping. Also, even though most Devil Fruit powers transform the user's clothes along with their body, Honey Queen always leaves her clothes behind while transforming into liquid, requiring Boo Jack to bring her clothes back to her. She also is weak to cold, as she ended up frozen when she turned into liquid form when climbing the cold mountain of Mt. Mitsukado. Other than that, the user is also affected by the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.

Honey Queen uses her ability to attack very quickly and for surprise attacks, as seen when she kidnapped Sanji. She launched a large wave of her liquid against the Straw Hat Pirates, with enough force to cause Sanji to fall off the air balloon. She also transforms into the liquid for quick movements and evasive maneuvers, and to move through pipes for faster transportation.
enrichments.short_description: The Toro Toro no Mi is a non-canon Logia-type Devil Fruit from the second movie that allows the user to create, control, and transform into a at will. It was eaten by Honey Queen.

enrichments.description:
Tosa is a Marine Vice Admiral and one of the nine that took part in the Egghead Incident.

He serves as a minor antagonist in the Egghead Arc.

Tosa is a big burly dark skinned man with a big roundish black beard. He has huge hairy muscular arms and big hands. He wears a cap with the word "MARINES" on, as well an orange t-shirt, dark green pants, dark boots. As a high-ranking officer, he wears a Justice coat draped over his shoulders with golden cuffs.

Tosa takes missions seriously. He was confident that with his abilities he could take down Jewelry Bonney. He also showed concern for Jaygarcia Saturn when Bonney stabbed the Elder.
enrichments.short_description: Tosa is a Marine Vice Admiral and one of the nine that took part in the Egghead Incident.

enrichments.description:
The Toshi Toshi no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to manipulate the ages of people or objects, making them an . As part of an experiment, Jaygarcia Saturn administered an extract of the fruit to Jewelry Bonney when she was an infant.

The main strength of the fruit is that it allows the user to freely manipulate the aging process of anything, including themselves, other people, animals and objects. A unique effect of this ability is that the years the user steals from people are manifested in the form of sparkling jewelry and shapes.

The user can employ this power to disguise themselves, as well as cripple opponents by rapidly aging their intended targets into their senior years or regressing them into small, weak children. As such, this ability is noted to be extremely powerful because it merely needs an instance of physical contact (directly or through an user-wielded object) for its effects to apply. The user can also force a target's body to age into a skeleton, but only for a short time, thus traumatizing them with a near-death experience. Even people with knowledge of Haki, such as Marine Vice Admirals, will become helpless if they end up falling to an age regression. Meanwhile, objects can corrode and eventually disintegrate into dust following a rapid progression of their time, giving the fruit further utility as a way to easily break into sealed off locations.

Any target whose bodily age has been altered by this power still retains all of their memories and cognitive abilities, as shown by the Marines and Bonney herself acting the same as normal, regardless of the age their body is showing them to be (though targets that have been reduced to toddlers have a tendency to cry as such). However, it has been non-canonically shown that a target that had been aged from an infant state to an adult state can gain knowledge based on whatever the target is, such as when Bonney aged a clutch of eggs into a flock of full-grown birds to instantly knew how to fly. In addition, any markings or bodily modifications the target may have will not be affected by this power, as Jinbe still retained his scar around his left eye after being turned into a child by this ability, and Vegapunk retained his sliced-off upper head and attached structure. Similarly, the progress of any disease the target has will not change if they are turned into an older version of their present self, even if they were likely to die long before reaching that age.

enrichments.description:
Toto is Koza's father and Goro's older brother, who lives in Yuba.

Originally, Toto was a relatively fat but healthy looking old man. However due to the three year drought brought about by Crocodile's scheme, Toto's body had completely shriveled up from thirst and starvation to a point that he no longer resembled his former self. He has an elderly looking face, and a thick fuzzy mustache. He wears a white wrap around his head, and another grey wrap around his forehead. He wears black robes, that are torn in some places, and a green robe underneath with a dark red lining. Under that, he wears a vertically striped black and white shirt. He also has a turquoise sash, with blue dots.

After the timeskip, Toto is seen wearing a light colored wrap around his head, and a dark colored robe, with a light colored striped robe with buttons underneath. He seems to recovered from his shriveled self and looks normal, though not quite to the level of fat he had in his youth. He has also grown a small goatee, and is wearing a light colored sash.

Toto is a rather kindhearted man and generous man, willing to help travelers to Yuba without a second thought, in spite of the city's massive shortage of water. He also possesses a remarkable stubbornness and willingness to stand by his beliefs, staying in Yuba as all its other residents left, refusing to accept that the city was doomed.
enrichments.short_description: Toto is Koza's father and Goro's older brother, who lives in Yuba.

enrichments.description:
Totto Land is an archipelago in the New World consisting of 35 islands in total. It constitutes the main territory of one of the former Emperors, Big Mom, and her crew, the Big Mom Pirates, which extends around Whole Cake Island. It is navigable with a New World Log Pose.

According to Pekoms, it is considered one large, powerful nation, and Big Mom as its queen wants it to become a utopia that unifies all races of the world.

Totto Land is the general setting for the Whole Cake Island Arc.

Totto Land is a massive archipelago with Whole Cake Island, the nations Capital and Big Mom's base of operation, in its center, and 34 subsidiary islands, arranged roughly in concentric circles. Each subsidiary island is ruled by a member of the Charlotte Family as its minister. Most islands are themed after food.

enrichments.description:
Totts is a member of the Bonney Pirates. He was once a resident of the Sorbet Kingdom, having been a friend of Bartholomew Kuma and Ginny since childhood.

After the Summit War of Marineford, he was arrested by Admiral Akainu following his crew's defeat against the Blackbeard Pirates.

Totts is a plump man with lanky legs and sports a mohawk. He wears a plain tank top and suspenders.

As a young adult 7 years ago, he wore a leather jacket.
enrichments.short_description: Totts is a member of the Bonney Pirates. He was once a resident of the Sorbet Kingdom, having been a friend of Bartholomew Kuma and Ginny since childhood.

enrichments.description:
Tou-Chuka Island is a non-canon island known for its Chinese food ingredients, including many healthy foods and natural cures.

It acts as the setting of the Toriko x One Piece Collab Special 2 episode.

Tou-Chuka Island is entirely covered in dense forest, with a single mountain covering the center of the island. The base of the mountain is surrounded by large stone walls, and an ancient floodgate encircles the top of the mountain, with a seawater reservoir and a smaller island inside. A giant rests on one of the island's beaches, and giant bamboo shoots protrude from the opposite side of the island.

A monument outside an abandoned temple has the inscription "on the island, where the sea overflows, the fruit grows", hinting at the location of the Seafood Fruit.
enrichments.short_description: Tou-Chuka Island is a non-canon island known for its Chinese food ingredients, including many healthy foods and natural cures.

enrichments.description:
Toyama Tsujigiro is a Wano Country government official who lives in the Flower Capital. He is also a serial killer who attacked strangers at night.

Tsujigiro is an average-sized man with thick eyebrows and black hair tied in a topknot. He wears a dark blue kimono, light blue hakama and a light blue vest.

Tsujigiro is a cruel individual who murdered random people to sate his bloodlust. He is cunning and remorseless enough to frame an innocent man as the perpetrator and sentence him to seppuku. He seems to hold an interest in high-quality swords like the Famous Blade Shusui, as he was even drooling slightly while holding the sword in his possession. Tsujigiro was perceptive enough to acknowledge that Zoro could not be the thief of Shusui due to his young age, and instead believing him to have taken it from the real thief.

As a Magistrate, he commands a large number of samurai and has jurisdiction over the Flower Capital.
enrichments.short_description: Toyama Tsujigiro is a Wano Country government official who lives in the Flower Capital. He is also a serial killer who attacked strangers at night.

enrichments.description:
Trafalgar Lami was Trafalgar D. Water Law's younger sister from the town of Flevance.

Lami was a young girl with brunette hair in pigtails, with a cheerful and wide smile. When she became sick with amber lead syndrome, she had white spots all over her body.

Lami was a very cheerful girl, and particularly close to her brother, Law. She liked festivals.

Trafalgar Law was Lami's older brother, and they were very close to each other. Law took care of her when she became sick with amber lead syndrome, saying that their father, the best doctor on the island, will save her. When she died, Law was devastated by her death. Along with family and classmates, Lami's death led to Law becoming the nihilistic and homicidal child he was before meeting Donquixote Rosinante.
enrichments.short_description: Trafalgar Lami was Trafalgar D. Water Law's younger sister from the town of Flevance.

enrichments.description:
Trap Tower is a Marine tower run and operated by Captain Trap. It was destroyed by the Straw Hat Pirates and, accidentally, by the Giant Nine.

Trap Tower is a tall structure with numerous floors and features. A Kung-Fu Dugong statue sits at the top of the tower, and its arm can move and mouth can open when a lever is pulled. Inside the tower, winding tubes with water flowing through them guide captors to various traps. On the outside of the tower, an intricate blue slide can carry ships away at fast speeds. After all of the tubes, traps, and floors, a Seastone prison rests at the bottom of the prison to hold captors.

Because the Straw Hat Pirates escaped partway down the tower's ride, the layout of the lower floors and traps in the tower is unknown.

The tower contains different traps meant to hurt or kill its captors. The first trap, Cutting Hell, is a spinning fan of blades created to chop up ships. The second, Hammer Hell, is an animatronic gorilla with large fists that smash together repeatedly to crush captors. No other traps are named, but they include golden harpoon launchers, a room full of dugong-operated cannons, and a dark pit full of obstructive, jagged pillars.
enrichments.short_description: Trap Tower is a Marine tower run and operated by Captain Trap. It was destroyed by the Straw Hat Pirates and, accidentally, by the Giant Nine.

enrichments.description:
Trebol is one of the top three officers of the Donquixote Pirates, acting as a Staff Officer. He occupies the Club seat of the Donquixote Family and is the leader of the crew's Trebol Army subdivision.

He is also personally responsible for fostering Donquixote Doflamingo's cruelty from a young age, making him the indirect cause of an inhumanly large amount of evil and suffering brought about by Doflamingo's wrath. Because of this, he can be considered a major antagonist in the Dressrosa Arc with a greater influence and impact than what is first suggested in his initial appearances.

Trebol is a toweringly tall hunchback who, despite his impairment, looms over his captain, Doflamingo, at a similar height to Diamante and Pica. His appearance is disheveled and unkempt. His attire consists of a long, ragged blue coat (initially dark grey, then cyan in the anime) made of his Devil Fruit mucus with a navy (dark in the anime) blue ring pattern. Mucus and sticky slime constantly trail from the coat's hem. The front of the coat is cleverly designed to resemble the front of a barrel chest, making Trebol appear to be a thickset man wearing a loose cloak over his shoulders. In truth, he is extremely skinny to the point of being emaciated, and everything under the hollow of his stooped chest is a decoy made of mucus. His posture and attire make him look like a giant snail.

Trebol is barefoot but wears a mid-length chained shackle on each of his ankles, which are not linked together. He usually wears a pair of sunglasses covering his small slanted eyes and has a broad flat nose, commonly seen with snot hanging out of it. He wears his dark hair in a bowl-cut, complete with a long, thick beard and stubble on his upper lip. His lips are a bit thicker than normal, and his teeth are round and have some space between them. He also has a small scar just above his right eyebrow. He holds a scepter with a club suit design on the top. This scepter also has a lighter built into it, which he can use to ignite his mucus.
enrichments.short_description: Trebol is one of the top three officers of the Donquixote Pirates, acting as a Staff Officer. He occupies the Club seat of the Donquixote Family and is the leader of the crew's Trebol Army subdivision.

enrichments.description:
The Tree of Knowledge was a gigantic 5,000-year-old tree located on the island of Ohara which served as a library and a hub for archaeologists from around the world. It was destroyed by the World Government via a Buster Call twenty-two years before the present.

The tree was used by archaeologists who were able to decipher the Poneglyphs. As research of the Poneglyphs is forbidden by the World Government, they sent CP9 to attack the archaeologists and called forth a Buster Call. When Spandine, the chief of CP9 back then, activated the Buster Call to destroy Ohara, the tree fell and crushed almost everything. It is here where Nico Robin learned to read this language, that still remained unbeknownst to the other archaeologists. Its library was the oldest known structure in the world.

Aside from the archaeologists research of the poneglyph located there, the Tree of Knowledge contained thousands of historic resources that were gathered from all across the globe over hundreds of years. After the Tree of Knowledge caught fire during the Buster Call, the archaeologists desperately threw books into a nearby lake and their efforts saved enough books to fill up the entire lake.

The Tree of Knowledge once contained a geocentric model of the Blue Planet. The Ohara model showed the Blue Planet to have six s, which presumably includes the world's moon, one of which had a second body orbiting it. The Blue Planet as shown in the model sits at a rough angle of about 24 to 25 degrees.
enrichments.short_description: The Tree of Knowledge was a gigantic 5,000-year-old tree located on the island of Ohara which served as a library and a hub for archaeologists from around the world. It was destroyed by the World Government via a Buster…

enrichments.description:
Tristan is a mink and one of Inuarashi's subjects, until Carrot took the throne of Mokomo Dukedom.

Tristan is a light blue-haired squirrel mink with tan fur, a dark patch on her forehead down to her nose, and a large bushy brown tail with two dark stripes down the center.

She wears a frilly yellow blouse with short puffy sleeves, a pink skirt with two layers, and red pumps.

Her nurse's uniform is a light-pink minidress and a light-pink cap with a cross on it (a red horizontal stripe in the anime).
enrichments.short_description: Tristan is a mink and one of Inuarashi's subjects, until Carrot took the throne of Mokomo Dukedom.

enrichments.description:
Tritobu is the prince of the Nagagutsu Kingdom. He accompanied his father Furrari to the Levely.

Tritobu is a stocky man with a double chin, stubble around his mouth and short blond hair.

He wears a dark blue coat, a white, frilled dress shirt and a dark blue fedora-like hat.

Tritobu seems to become flustered in the presence of beautiful women such as Shirahoshi and expressed his fondness of her to his father. He was highly offended when she unwittingly insulted him by claiming he was not her type, due to her social inexperience.
enrichments.short_description: Tritobu is the prince of the Nagagutsu Kingdom. He accompanied his father Furrari to the Levely.

enrichments.description:
Tritoma is a former empress of the Kuja tribe, succeeding Shakuyaku and preceding Boa Hancock. She died years ago, as a victim of Love Sickness.

Like the other known empresses of the Kuja, Tritoma was a young-looking woman of slim stature. She had shoulder-length straight dark hair (curly at the ends), lipstick, and wore a similar outfit to what her successor, Hancock, currently does, including a V-neck blouse and snake-shaped hoop earrings.

44 years ago, she appeared younger, with shorter hair and no lipstick. She wore a long cape, a leopard-print short top and skirt, simple pearl earrings, and sandals.

She was described by Boa Hancock as benevolent as she pardoned former Empress Gloriosa for the crime of abandoning the nation.
enrichments.short_description: Tritoma is a former empress of the Kuja tribe, succeeding Shakuyaku and preceding Boa Hancock. She died years ago, as a victim of Love Sickness.

enrichments.description:
Trump Castle is a tower located in Clockwork Island. It is where the Trump Siblings and their forces used to live, before the tower's destruction during the events of the second One Piece movie.

thumb|left|210px|The Diamond Clock. The castle is set on a mountaintop, and is filled with numerous traps, such as a falling ceiling and sliding stairs, and the castle is also the location of the "key". At the top is a pool used to hold captured ships, and on the castle is the , the world's most valuable clock.

At some point prior to the current storyline, Bear King and his crew invaded the Clockwork Island and had the villagers build Trump Castle. The crew made the Trump Castle their temporary home, until the King Cannon was created, in order to rule the seas using it.

After Honey Queen and Boo Jack captured Nami, they brought her to the Trump Castle in order to meet Bear King. After meeting her, Bear King ordered his crew to bring the rest of the Straw Hat Pirates there as well. When they were brought to the castle due to Bear King's desire to marry Nami, the other members were crucified on the top in an attempt to coerce Nami. Eventually, Monkey D. Luffy came to rescue his crew, and in the ensuing battle, Luffy destroyed a big part of the tower. When Bear King fired a bullet of the King Cannon at Luffy, he deflected it back at Bear King, causing the glass floor to shatter and the "key" to be destroyed, which resulted in the entire castle collapsing.
enrichments.short_description: Trump Castle is a tower located in Clockwork Island. It is where the Trump Siblings and their forces used to live, before the tower's destruction during the events of the second One Piece movie.

enrichments.description:
Tsugaru Umi is a woman who trained Nico Robin to perform as a geisha. She lives in the Flower Capital of the Wano Country.

Umi is a very short elderly woman with blonde hair tied up in a shimada with a hairpin. She wears a red kimono with pink lines forming a grid pattern.

Umi is strict but supportive teacher towards her students, helping Robin achieve her goal of performing at the Shogun's banquet. Like the majority of Wano Country citizens, Umi admired the oiran Komurasaki for her beauty and elegance.

Umi is knowledgeable about the artforms practiced by geisha and was able to teach Robin to perform well enough to be summoned by the Shogun in a rather short period of time.
enrichments.short_description: Tsugaru Umi is a woman who trained Nico Robin to perform as a geisha. She lives in the Flower Capital of the Wano Country.

enrichments.description:
Dr. Tsukimi was an old man who appeared in Enel's cover story.

Tsukimi was an old man, with a wrinkled face and long ovular head. He had white eyebrows, and was bald. He had a thick neck, but relatively thin limbs. His eyes were seen to be always closed, as in content and calm.

He wore a light-gray colored robe, with a hood and buttoned collar, and dark colored sandals.

He was very kind, as his automata loved him dearly to the point of traveling to the moon to avenge his death and give him a decent burial. He had a passion for moon watching, as his name implies.
enrichments.short_description: Dr. Tsukimi was an old man who appeared in Enel's cover story.

enrichments.description:
The Tsumegeri Guards were four of the most powerful soldiers in the Arabasta Kingdom Guard Squad. They drank the Hero Water and attempted to take down Crocodile, but failed and died from the water's side effects shortly after Crocodile refused to even fight them to give them an honorable death.

The Tsumegeri Guards wore the armor similar to the regular Arabasta Kingdom Guard Squad soldiers but with the addition of a turban with a duck headband and wings on each sides. They wear what appears to be war paint, with one line that goes down to the nose as their common mark.

The Tsumegeri Guards were fiercely loyal for their country and ruler, as they were willing to drink the Hero Water in an attempt to even the odds against Crocodile, knowing full well of the lethal side-effects.

enrichments.description:
Tsumonsieur Kamaya is a former CP9 agent.

Kamaya is a tall man with long, curly hair of a coral pink color. He has high cheek bones, a square jaw and prominent lips.

He wears a full dark suit ensemble coupled with a yellow tie, light gloves and a black cowboy hat. He also sports round sunglasses.

Kamaya seemed to be loyal to the World Government, as he helped Spandine at Ohara. He is not above doing odd jobs to advance his career, and frequently performed tasks that Spandine was not skilled at.
enrichments.short_description: Tsumonsieur Kamaya is a former CP9 agent.

enrichments.description:
"Broken Hat" Tsunagoro is a yakuza boss who was in charge of the Hakumai region in Wano Country. He was imprisoned in Udon by the Beasts Pirates, but was freed when Luffy took over the prison.

Tsunagoro is a thin man with a long face and light colored hair. He has a signature double chonmage, while the rest of his hair falls down his face, covering his right eye. He is constantly seen with a sinister grin and twig in his mouth.

Being a yakuza boss, he had the respect of his followers from Hakumai, as well as the other yakuza bosses of his time, being able to work alongside them. He seems to highly respect Hyougoro and would threaten those who offend the elder as well as obey his commands.

Tsunagoro seems to have enough strength to hold down a struggling Luffy while the latter is being punished for his rudeness.
enrichments.short_description: "Broken Hat" Tsunagoro is a yakuza boss who was in charge of the Hakumai region in Wano Country. He was imprisoned in Udon by the Beasts Pirates, but was freed when Luffy took over the prison.

enrichments.description:
Tsuru, known as the "Great Staff Officer", is a renowned Marine Vice Admiral, as well as the grandmother of Kujaku.

Tsuru is a tall, thin, and elderly woman with silver hair tied in a small ponytail. Her attire appears to be less formal than the other high-ranking officers', consisting of an untucked shirt, with the sleeves rolled up and a tie around her neck, and calves-long pants, which makes her somewhat resemble the animal of her name, the . She sports earrings made of beads, and wears two bracelets on her right wrist. The epaulets on her Marine coat are golden for the outer epaulets and purple with two white dots for the inner epaulets. During the time of the Battle of Edd War, they were the standard blue.

At age 34, she was wearing a dress shirt and had her hair in a loose ponytail.

Twenty-seven years ago, at age 49, her skin was already wrinkled despite only being middle-aged.
enrichments.short_description: Tsuru, known as the "Great Staff Officer", is a renowned Marine Vice Admiral, as well as the grandmother of Kujaku.

enrichments.description:
"Careless" Tsurube was a retainer of the Kurozumi Family who burned to death after accidentally falling into the boiling oil prepared for Kouzuki Oden's execution.

Tsurube was an average-sized man with semi-long dark brown hair tied in a topknot. He wore a light gray kimono, a dark gray , a black with white Kurozumi Family crests on both sides, white socks and sandals.

Tsurube did not have any respect or patience for Kouzuki Oden, ignoring his requests and mockingly hurrying him into the boiling oil. However, true to his nickname, he was rather careless which ended up costing his life.

Tsurube was not particularly powerful as he died nigh-instantly after falling into boiling oil, which Kouzuki Oden managed to withstand for over an hour.
enrichments.short_description: "Careless" Tsurube was a retainer of the Kurozumi Family who burned to death after accidentally falling into the boiling oil prepared for Kouzuki Oden's execution.

enrichments.description:
Tsurue Monnosuke is the machi-bugyō of the Flower Capital.

Monnosuke is an average-sized man with brown hair that is shaven to buzzcut at the top, but styled into a topknot at the back and forms wing-like curls on the sides. He wears a light blue kimono, light blue hakama and a dark blue vest.

Monnosuke is dedicated to his duties and was prepared to deal with the chaotic incident unfolding in the banquet hall.

As the machi-bugyō, Monnosuke holds some political power and commands a group of samurai.
enrichments.short_description: Tsurue Monnosuke is the machi-bugyō of the Flower Capital.

enrichments.description:
Tsurujo, commonly known as , is a tea house owner from the Wano Country, as well as the wife of Kin'emon.

Tsuru has a youthful appearance for a lady of her age. She has light brown eyes and black hair in a style with a gold crane-shaped hairpin. She has a prominent nose and wears lipstick. She wears a blue kimono with light blue clouds and white crane patterns. She also has large pale blue obi with teal polka dots. After the Okobore Town incident, Tsuru has two burn scars on her forehead and the left side of her face.

Tsuru is a very kind and compassionate woman. Upon seeing Kurozumi Tama being badly poisoned, Tsuru offered to help her. She can be very forceful when helping people as shown when she angrily scolded Tama for refusing to eat the dish she prepared for her. Kiku also stated Tsuru would never accept people refusing her help. Tsuru has an extremely refined and sophisticated personality as she always speaks to people in a courteous manner and is always ready to repay other people for helping her. After Zoro rescued her from some of Kaidou's thugs, she quickly offered to repay him, and that she sneaked aboard Komachiyo's tail when Zoro and Luffy retreated in order to not lose sight of them as she wished to express her gratitude.

She is quite perceptive, as she saw through Kikunojo's disguise and realized her husband was still alive. She is also brave, preparing to risk her own life to protect her husband.
enrichments.short_description: Tsurujo, commonly known as , is a tea house owner from the Wano Country, as well as the wife of Kin'emon.

enrichments.description:
The Tsutsu Tsutsu no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to transform their head into a cannon, turning them into a . It was eaten by Urban.

This fruit grants the user the ability to manifest cannons from their head, using them to fire explosive projectiles at targets.

Urban carries around a , implying that he needs to maintain his cannon parts and clean them after use. Other than that, the user is also affected by the same main weaknesses as other Devil Fruit users.

Urban primarily utilizes his fruit's ability to fire cannon shots from the top of his head, with his hat serving as the discharging barrel. This makes it suitable for combat and executions.
enrichments.short_description: The Tsutsu Tsutsu no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to transform their head into a cannon, turning them into a . It was eaten by Urban.

enrichments.description:
Tumi is a country located in the South Blue. It was conquered by the Revolutionary Army around twelve years ago.

Tumi appears to feature at least one town, with a large tower in the center. Said tower was destroyed by Bartholomew Kuma, implying it was a stronghold of sorts for the local rulers.

Fifteen years ago, Tumi fell into an uprising by its local population, which was supported by the Revolutionary Army. However, after three years of civil war, the rebels started getting outmatched by the local military force.

Kuma, who at the time was in the East Blue helping refugees from the Gray Terminal, listened to an aid request coming from Tumi and teleported himself to the island as quickly as possible. Kuma's arrival was enough to tilt the war in favor of the rebels, with its population celebrating their victory the following day and the Marines taking notice of another fallen country.
enrichments.short_description: Tumi is a country located in the South Blue. It was conquered by the Revolutionary Army around twelve years ago.

enrichments.description:
Turco is a member of the Fake Straw Hat Crew and masqueraded as Franky. When the crew switched to posing as the Kid Pirates, Turco impersonated Wire.

Turco is a tall, skinny man with a long neck, thick lips and no visible chin. He wears a flowered shirt and a blue haircut similar to the real Franky of two years before the present, but has no resemblance to the pirate after he remodeled himself. He wears sunglasses similar to Franky's, and is seen smoking a cigarette. While the real Franky always wears swim briefs and keeps his shirt open, Turco is seen wearing regular pants and has his shirt buttoned up and brown shoes.

When impersonating Wire, Turco wears a similar headdress and shirt.

Turco, as a member of the Fake Straw Hats, uses the reputation of the real crew to intimidate others. He was oddly dismissive of Usopp despite being hit by one of his attacks at the time. Upon the truth coming out, he was discovered to be very cowardly, begging Caribou for mercy.
enrichments.short_description: Turco is a member of the Fake Straw Hat Crew and masqueraded as Franky. When the crew switched to posing as the Kid Pirates, Turco impersonated Wire.

enrichments.description:
Twin Cape, sometimes called the , is located at the bottom of Reverse Mountain, at the exit that leads into Paradise. The area is located precisely where the Red Line and the Grand Line meet. From here, sailors can choose one of the seven routes of the Grand Line by waiting for the Log Pose to set on the desired one.

As the base of Reverse Mountain, Twin Cape's northern lighthouse acts as the setting of the Reverse Mountain Arc.

The two lighthouses are located at the exit of Reverse Mountain, on either side of the river down the mountain. Crocus has been the caretaker of the northern lighthouse for at least 52 years, taking care of Laboon as well, minus the three years he spent as the doctor of the Roger Pirates.

enrichments.short_description: Twin Cape, sometimes called the , is located at the bottom of Reverse Mountain, at the exit that leads into Paradise. The area is located precisely where the Red Line and the Grand Line meet. From here, sailors can…

enrichments.description:
Ubau was the God of Skypiea roughly 400 years ago. His desire to live on the Vearth the Shandia had called home initiated a war between the Skypieans and Shandia that would last over 400 years.

Ubau was a massive, heavyset man who was over twice the height of a normal person. He had puffy black hair, a goatee with a large nose, prominent cheekbones, thick lips, and a very thick neck. Ubau wore white robes and smoked cigars.

Ubau believed in his own absolute power as God and was willing to initiate conflict and kill others for his own desires. He also claimed to hear the sound of Vearth, but it is unknown if this was Mantra or his own self-absorbed elitism.

As God, Ubau had command over the Divine Squad and his other subjects on Skypiea.
enrichments.short_description: Ubau was the God of Skypiea roughly 400 years ago. His desire to live on the Vearth the Shandia had called home initiated a war between the Skypieans and Shandia that would last over 400 years.

enrichments.description:
"Brutal Bull" Ucy is a that regularly competed as a gladiator in Dressrosa's Corrida Colosseum, where he was befriended (and named) by Monkey D. Luffy.

He serves as an ally to Luffy during the Dressrosa Arc.

Ucy is a large bull with dark fur, long horns (the left eventually broken by Hajrudin) and a bulky body. He also has small eyes, bearing three eyelashes on each.

He is described by Gatz as the "Colosseum's Grim Reaper", and his fighting style has led him to become known as the "Brutal Bull". Despite this, Luffy was still able to tame and befriend him using his Supreme King Haki.
enrichments.short_description: "Brutal Bull" Ucy is a that regularly competed as a gladiator in Dressrosa's Corrida Colosseum, where he was befriended (and named) by Monkey D. Luffy.

enrichments.description:
Uholisia is the daughter of Chichilisia, the leader of the Niho Navy. She is the wife of 25 men and Sai's former fiancée.

Uholisia is a very muscular and masculine woman with blonde hair who is about as tall as Sai. She has red patches on her cheeks and very pronounced lips. Her facial features are very similar to those of Okama. She wears a blue dress with pink and yellow flowers on it.

She agreed to an arranged marriage with Sai for political reasons, showing her value in foreign affairs as well as the well-being of her own nation. She can be vicious, as she furiously gave Sai a beating when he broke off his engagement to her.

Fitting her muscular frame, Uholisia seems to be very strong, as she viciously beat up the powerful warrior Sai, although Sai did not seem to fight back.
enrichments.short_description: Uholisia is the daughter of Chichilisia, the leader of the Niho Navy. She is the wife of 25 men and Sai's former fiancée.

enrichments.description:
Seaman Recruit Ukkari is a Marine who serves at the Shells Town Marine base.

Ukkari is a short man. He wears the standard Marine uniform: a white sleeveless shirt and hat.

Like all other Marines in Shells Town, Ukkari hated and feared Captain Morgan.

He lightly scratched Morgan's statue as he was raising it up. Morgan decided to kill him for the scratch, but before Morgan was able to do so, Luffy showed up on the roof and accidentally destroyed the statue.
enrichments.short_description: Seaman Recruit Ukkari is a Marine who serves at the Shells Town Marine base.

enrichments.description:
Ukkari Hot-Spring Island is a Paradise island, located somewhere in the proximity of the Arabasta Kingdom. It is where Gedatsu landed and resettled after being defeated in Skypiea.

Ukkari Hot-Spring Island is full of holes created by Goro, so he could build his hot spring resort. It has a forest with three odd-shaped trees and is connected to Arabasta via tunnels.

Dreaming of running a hot spring resort, Goro began digging holes around the island in order to find a hot spring. After Gedatsu landed on the island, he joined Goro in digging. They ended up finding the Dirt Boss, whom Gedatsu beat up and then got to dig the island for them. With the Dirt Boss's help, they finally reached hot water for the resort. They were then approached by the Forest Boss, whom Gedatsu also beat up. While the others left to continue digging a tunnel, the Forest Boss and his workers built the resort's structure.

This island was later linked to Yuba of Arabasta via a tunnel, and now both are connected because of the Hot Spring Resort that they run.
enrichments.short_description: Ukkari Hot-Spring Island is a Paradise island, located somewhere in the proximity of the Arabasta Kingdom. It is where Gedatsu landed and resettled after being defeated in Skypiea.

enrichments.description:
Ukon is a samurai who allied with the Kouzuki Family. After waiting 20 years for the return of the Nine Red Scabbards, he affiliated with the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance to raid Onigashima.

Ukon is a tall, fair-skinned man who is almost twice Usopp's height. He has blonde puffy hair tie up in a chonmage, sideburns that extend down to his jawline, a pointed nose, slim eyes, and black eyebrows. He wears a grey kimono with a slate-colored square pattern on it, and a light green cloak with a darker green, blotchy patterns on the sleeves and bottom of the cape. He also wears geta with a dark-colored strap and has a reverse crescent moon tattoo on his ankle.

Ukon was caught off guard when a slip of paper appeared in his cloak and was surprised further by the message on it. He is loyal to the Kouzuki Family, and he was delighted with the opportunity to fight alongside his comrades again. He was terrified of Big Mom's power, with his jaw dropped and eyes bulging out in disbelief, but due to his isolation on Wano Country, he did not know who she was.

Ukon is strong enough to fend for himself against the Beasts Pirates on Onigashima and has a formidable will, continuing to fight them after being bloody and battered.
enrichments.short_description: Ukon is a samurai who allied with the Kouzuki Family. After waiting 20 years for the return of the Nine Red Scabbards, he affiliated with the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance to raid Onigashima.

enrichments.description:
Ulti is a former member of the Tobiroppo, the six strongest Shinuchi of the Beasts Pirates. She is the elder sister of fellow former Tobiroppo Page One, and the daughter of a former Warlord of the Sea, Hanafuda.

Due to her actions and role, she is a supporting antagonist in the Wano Country Arc. Following the downfall of the Beasts Pirates however, Ulti swore loyalty to Yamato for saving her and Page One from Who's-Who and became one of his allies in the Oni Child Yamato's Golden Harvest Surrogate Pilgrimage Cover Page Serial.

Ulti is a young woman of relatively tall height, with a light complexion. Her hair reaches near her mid-back and forms rounded locks mainly blue in coloration, but with thin, pink-colored streaks running through (plus a single white one over her left eye). Blunt bangs fall on her forehead, split near the left, and an ahoge stands up on her head. Characteristically (as with many of her crewmates), Ulti has horns: a sharp, upward-curving pair emerging from the sides of her head, white in color, that resemble a bull's. Ulti's eyes are large, round, and fringed by long lashes and encompass pinkish-violet irises. Her lower face up to the nose is covered by a pink mask with a scalloped edge, trimmed with a white stripe; Ulti keeps this mask even when she assumes her pachycephalosaurus form. When in her Human-Beast Form, Ulti's bangs are pushed back, exposing her forehead.

Otherwise, Ulti takes to wearing a long-sleeved minidress that is white and pleated above the waist, with a blue bow below a point collar. The dress's lower, light-blue, and non-pleated section, with a button placket in the middle, ends in a short skirt part that has a slightly ruffled hem, leaving most of Ulti's legs visible. Fastened on her shoulders is a darker-blue cape trimmed with light-blue fur on its edges (the inside is also blue), which goes near the ground, and her footwear is red high heels.
enrichments.short_description: Ulti is a former member of the Tobiroppo, the six strongest Shinuchi of the Beasts Pirates. She is the elder sister of fellow former Tobiroppo Page One, and the daughter of a former Warlord of the Sea, Hanafuda.

enrichments.description:
Ultraking was the assistant-manager of Rain Dinners in Rainbase during the Arabasta Arc.

Ultraking is an average sized man, with wild white hair that resembles a crown. He has a tiny bit of hair on his upper lip and sports a black suit over a purple shirt and red bowtie.

Ultraking seems to be a relatively calm person, since he didn't freak out when the Straw Hat Pirates entered his casino and simply called for security. He does, however, get quite apologetic to Miss All Sunday, who is the manager of the casino, when Luffy defeats the Koala Mercenaries.

He was able to run a successful casino for a long while and had the authority to call on the Koala Mercenaries for help until it was shut down due to the Baroque Works incident.
enrichments.short_description: Ultraking was the assistant-manager of Rain Dinners in Rainbase during the Arabasta Arc.

enrichments.description:
The Uma Uma no Mi is a Zoan-type Devil Fruit that allows its user to transform into a horse hybrid and a full horse at will. It was eaten by Gan Fall's bird, Pierre.

This fruit allows the eater to transform into a horse or horse hybrid at will.

This fruit does not seem to have any specific weaknesses, aside from the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.

The main usage of the Devil Fruit is merely allowing Gan Fall to claim that he rides a Pegasus, as Pierre's original bird form is big enough already to serve as a mount. However, as a horse or in its hybrid form, Pierre can also bite anyone who disrespects his master.
enrichments.short_description: The Uma Uma no Mi is a Zoan-type Devil Fruit that allows its user to transform into a horse hybrid and a full horse at will. It was eaten by Gan Fall's bird, Pierre.

enrichments.description:
The Uma Uma no Mi, Model: Pegasus is a Mythical Zoan-type Devil Fruit that allows its user to transform into a Pegasus hybrid and a full Pegasus at will. It was eaten by Stronger.

This fruit allows the eater to transform into a Pegasus or Pegasus hybrid at will. This grants them the power of flight.

This fruit does not seem to have any specific weaknesses, aside from the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.

Due to being a horse to begin with, Stronger does not appear to transform significantly apart from gaining wings. It is unknown whether this is his hybrid form or his full Pegasus form. He uses this power to carry Doc Q and other members of the Blackbeard Pirates while flying in the air.
enrichments.short_description: The Uma Uma no Mi, Model: Pegasus is a Mythical Zoan-type Devil Fruit that allows its user to transform into a Pegasus hybrid and a full Pegasus at will. It was eaten by Stronger.

enrichments.description:
The Umibozu is a submarine belonging to the Laotour Bandits.

The Umibozu is a relatively small submarine with a white and orange frame. It has several circular windows and three barrels on each on side of it. There is a periscope at the top of it and a propeller at the back. The bow has a large spiked decoration.

The Umibozu was first introduced to the Straw Hat Pirates by Otsu for their mission to invade the Fortress of Zilpah on Hi Island. Later, the Straw Hats use the Umibozu to dive through an underwater cavern connecting the sea to Muika Lake on Mu Island.
enrichments.short_description: The Umibozu is a submarine belonging to the Laotour Bandits.

enrichments.description:
"Deep-Sea Currents" Umit is a magnate who presides Umit Shipping and one of the emperors of the Underworld.

Umit is an older man with bags and age spots under his eyes. He has long black hair, a beard, and curled mustache, and he wears a large bicorne with anchor on the front and three feathers sticking out of the left side. He wears a brown coat over a ruffled white shirt, a yellow scarf, and wrinkled pants.

Umit appears to always be serious, in contrast to the joy and amusement his fellow emperors show.

As an emperor of the Underworld, Umit possesses some amount of power within it. He is important enough to be invited to the Emperor Big Mom's tea parties. Being the president of Umit Shipping, he has full control over the company and its workers.
enrichments.short_description: "Deep-Sea Currents" Umit is a magnate who presides Umit Shipping and one of the emperors of the Underworld.

enrichments.description:
The is a deep sea area where light does not penetrate, where normal creatures are not allowed to exist. The creatures here have either had to acquire better eyesight, or, in some cases, bio-luminescence.

The Straw Hat Pirates were carried by the sea currents to this place when Luffy knocked out the kraken that was blocking the way.

Franky stated that this area is approximately 7,000 meters below the surface.

ca:Inframón del Mar es:Submundo del Mar fr:Monde Souterrain de la Mer ru:Морские глубины Category:Sea Floor Locations
enrichments.short_description: The is a deep sea area where light does not penetrate, where normal creatures are not allowed to exist. The creatures here have either had to acquire better eyesight, or, in some cases, bio-luminescence.

enrichments.description:
Unforgivable Mask is a hidden One Piece character, much like Pandaman. He is, in fact, Pandaman's rival.

Unforgivable Mask's appearance is that of a muscle-bound figure with a panda face as a mask. He wears black swim briefs and boots. Unlike Pandaman (and others with a similar style), who appears to have an authentic panda's head, Unforgivable Mask actually appears to be wearing a mask.

Unforgivable Mask was hired by Tomato Gang to track down Pandaman.
