enrichments.description:
Wakasa is a resident of Bakura Town in Wano Country who runs a restaurant alongside Hiroshi; the two of them own a tanuki named Saikoro which the sumo wrestler Urashima forced to be cooked and served to him.

Wakasa is an older woman with wrinkly skin and gray hair tied in a bun. She wears a maroon kimono with dark gold polka dots, as well as a gray obi.

Wakasa cares about her customers' satisfaction and will be attentive to them if they express displeasure. While she expressed considerable shock at Urashima's request to cook and serve him the tanuki that she and Hiroshi had owned for many years, Wakasa was not shown trying to resist the command of the high-status samurai.

As the proprietor of a restaurant, Wakasa likely possesses skill in cooking.
enrichments.short_description: Wakasa is a resident of Bakura Town in Wano Country who runs a restaurant alongside Hiroshi; the two of them own a tanuki named Saikoro which the sumo wrestler Urashima forced to be cooked and served to him.

enrichments.description:
Wallace is a fish-man and a member of the Spade Pirates.

Wallace is a fish-man with a stocky neck, light-colored hair that is slicked back and a light-colored mustache. He wears a light-colored, v-neck shirt, dark-colored shorts, and light-colored shoes. He has a tattoo on his left arm.

Wallace cares greatly about his captain, Portgas D. Ace, since he was willing to defend him from Edward Newgate. Wallace can also be somewhat disrespectful, laughing at Deuce's adventure diary despite the fact that it is his main aspiration of their travels.

When Wallace had no where else to go, Ace took him in and did not judge him based on his race but instead on his character.
enrichments.short_description: Wallace is a fish-man and a member of the Spade Pirates.

enrichments.description:
Wallem is an infamous New World pirate captain who allied with Whitebeard.

Wallem is a man with a hat and a red pirate captain coat. He has long dark hair and a mustache with a goatee. He is seen wielding a sword.

No much is know about Wallem's personality but he put his own life on the line to rescue Ace from execution and was concerned when the Marines tried to execute him ahead of schedule. He was overjoyed when Luffy saved Ace, cheering with his fellow allies.

Wallem is a fearsome pirate who has managed to achieve an infamous reputation in the New World, and to make an alliance with the Whitebeard Pirates.
enrichments.short_description: Wallem is an infamous New World pirate captain who allied with Whitebeard.

enrichments.description:
The Walrus School is an elementary school and the main educational institution of Elbaph, hosted in the Warrior's Spring alongside the neighboring Owl Library and southwest of Western Village. Giant children between the ages of 18–36 (6–12 in human years) attend the school in order to learn about different subjects and socialize with other children.

It was founded 20 years ago by Jaguar D. Saul under the request of the late King of Elbaph, Harald.

The Walrus School is an immense structure built on Branch Route 8, which rises from the Warrior's Spring coast and has boardwalk stairs built along its body so people can access the main building. The Owl Library is located just next to it, on an adjacent branch.

The school overall resembles an open treehouse, with two large central platforms (where most of the school's facilities are located) surrounded by several smaller structures, which are held aloft by hanging ropes tied to other parts of the branch. Some of those structures resemble playground swings while others spherical huts.
enrichments.short_description: The Walrus School is an elementary school and the main educational institution of Elbaph, hosted in the Warrior's Spring alongside the neighboring Owl Library and southwest of Western Village. Giant children between the…

enrichments.description:
Wanda is a canine mink of the Inuarashi Musketeer Squad, previously also acting as a Kingsbird to both Inuarashi and Nekomamushi.

She is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Zou and Wano Country Arcs.

Wanda is a tan-furred, orange-haired, curvaceous and well-endowed canine mink with a large bushy tail.

When first meeting Luffy's group, Wanda wore Nami's blue jeans, black high-heeled boots, and green-white striped bikini top after Nami lent them to her. Wanda also wears the Musketeer's blue cape and another blue cloth tied around her jeans.
enrichments.short_description: Wanda is a canine mink of the Inuarashi Musketeer Squad, previously also acting as a Kingsbird to both Inuarashi and Nekomamushi.

enrichments.description:
Wanyudo is a Gifter in the Beasts Pirates, serving as Black Maria's weapon.

Wanyudo has a large face with flame-shaped beard and sideburns, bushy eyebrows and a bulbous nose. Due to the effects of SMILE, the rest of his body has become that of a small pug dog.

Wanyudo is almost always seen laughing, seemingly enjoying the destruction his master Black Maria employs him for, although he appears to suffer from shortness of breath due to his constant running effort.

Wanyudo ate a |Pagu no Sumairu}} that has transformed his entire body (sans head) into that of a pug, a small dog breed.
enrichments.short_description: Wanyudo is a Gifter in the Beasts Pirates, serving as Black Maria's weapon.

enrichments.description:
Wanze is an agent of CP7 and a cook, specializing in making ramen noodles.

He was one of the antagonists during the Sea Train voyage in the Water 7 Arc.

Wanze has an almost permanent smile on his face, even when he is afraid or mad. He has white fluffy hair, goggles, buck teeth, spiral-designs on his cheek, and his eyes seem to extend off of his face with his skin and eyelids as well. Wanze wears a black shirt unbuttoned, revealing his chest, a yellow scarf, black pants with a red belt, and roller skates. The back of his jacket reads "MAD". On both his forearms, Wanze has tattooed the kanji . He also wears a white chef's jacket with the World Government's symbol on its back, to which he removes prior to battle.

After getting hit by Sanji's Parage Shot, Wanze's face is molded into something that resembles a stereotypical ; ironically, he finds this form to be rather ugly. His face changes back to its former appearance after a kick to his torso from Sanji.
enrichments.short_description: Wanze is an agent of CP7 and a cook, specializing in making ramen noodles.

enrichments.description:
"Tin-Plate" Wapol is the king of the South Blue's Evil Black Drum Kingdom and president of , an international toy conglomerate and .

Originally king of the Grand Line's Drum Island, Wapol fled when the Blackbeard Pirates attacked (spending some time as the "captain" of his own, improvised pirate crew) and was permanently deposed by the Straw Hat Pirates soon after. However, his chance creation of a unique "miracle" alloy allowed him to rebuild as a toy manufacturer, winning wealth and power anew and eventually securing his current kingdom with the world-famous Kinderella as consort. After accidentally witnessing the Five Elders and Imu assassinating King Nefertari Cobra at the latest Levely, he went into hiding aboard "Big News" Morgans' airship alongside Nefertari Vivi.

He is the main antagonist of the Drum Island Arc (and by extension the ninth movie). He is also the protagonist of the Wapol's Omnivorous Hurrah cover arc.

Wapol is an overweight man with an unusual appearance. He has dark violet hair and a cylinder-shaped jaw made up of tin plates, hence his epithet. When Wapol uses his Slim-Up technique, he "eats" his body and becomes slim. During the Drum Island Arc, he used to dress in tin-plate armor and a hooded cape made from White Walkie skin. He was also wearing brown thick gloves. He spotted a pair of purple and orange woolen shorts and a brown belt around his waist and a pair of thick short boots. When he was the ruler of the Drum Peak, he was wearing the same attire but the tin-plate armor. Instead, he was wearing a grey shirt, and his gloves had no fur on their upper edge.
enrichments.short_description: "Tin-Plate" Wapol is the king of the South Blue's Evil Black Drum Kingdom and president of , an international toy conglomerate and .

enrichments.description:
The Wapu Wapu no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to teleport themselves and others from place to place. It was eaten by Van Augur.

The Wapu Wapu no Mi grants the power of |瞬間移動|shunkan idō}}: the user can warp from place to place instantaneously, as well as teleport other people after touching them.

In battle, Van Augur primarily uses this power to avoid direct combat by repositioning himself. As a sniper, this allows Van to ambush from unexpected directions and maintain a long-range advantage against his opponents.

Without mastery of the ability, the range for warping is relatively limited. The user can warp greater distances with training, though it is unknown whether they can ever overcome the range limitation entirely. As seen with his battle against Bepo, the user must be able to react to incoming attacks to dodge them, meaning that surprises or faster opponents can potentially hit the user before they attempt to teleport away. In general, other weaknesses of the ability, beside the standard ones for Devil Fruits, are unknown.
enrichments.short_description: The Wapu Wapu no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to teleport themselves and others from place to place. It was eaten by Van Augur.

enrichments.description:
The Wara Wara no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to create and manipulate straw at will, with the straw having damage-redirecting properties. It was eaten by Basil Hawkins.

Its powers were first demonstrated during the Sabaody Archipelago Arc, but it was not named until the Wano Country Arc.

The fruit's main ability is the capacity to create and manipulate straw, which seems to have a broad variety of applications. At its most basic, the straw can serve as a holding device as well as act as sharp weapon. By producing a larger amount of straw, the user can cover themselves in it to enhance their fighting capabilities or create a large straw monster with which to attack their foes. When using these techniques, the user is also seemingly able to manifest nails and use them as accompanying weapons.

As a more advanced technique, the user is also capable of creating small straw dolls and storing them inside their body. Each doll, through unknown means, can be linked to and represents another person akin to a voodoo doll. Consequently, if the user is injured in any way, the damage is instead transferred to a given doll and in turn whichever person it represents. This allows the user to easily survive and recover from multiple life-threatening injuries if they have enough dolls in store, making them difficult to defeat. It was also shown that effects that do not directly hurt or injure the user, such as the effects of the Ope Ope no Mi, can be transferred to other people as well. While the exact process is unclear, the user is capable of specifically choosing which person a straw doll is tied to. Thus, the user is capable of gaining a massive advantage in battle if they manage to connect their dolls to their opponents' allies, rendering the opponent unable to harm them without first killing one or more comrades. The user can further take advantage of tying an enemy's body to a doll by inflicting harm on themselves.
enrichments.short_description: The Wara Wara no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to create and manipulate straw at will, with the straw having damage-redirecting properties. It was eaten by Basil Hawkins.

enrichments.description:
Warashi is one of the Shandia warriors who fought against Enel.

Warashi is a tall, broad, and pale man with unkempt blond hair that goes till his shoulders. He wears a white pointed cap, with red stripes, and white feathers with black tips on the top. He wears two thin dark red necklaces, and one necklace with a golden medallion with a star on it, and a white string hanging down. He wears a white, open, sleeveless coat that goes down to his thighs, and is torn at the bottom. He has two red arm bands on his upper arms, that have white circles with a white square in it as the design. He also has a plate around his stomach, and a dark brown grass skirt, with grey-brown pants. He has white wings on his back and carries a large broadaxe.

As a Shandia warrior, Warashi feels great pride and loyalty towards his people. He is also level-headed, as he remained calm in the face of his comrades' injury and defeat.

Warashi is strong enough among the Shandia Warriors to be one of the few to reach Upper Yard. However, he was no match for Ohm.
enrichments.short_description: Warashi is one of the Shandia warriors who fought against Enel.

enrichments.description:
The Warrior God is a legendary giant of Elbaph who wielded the hammer Ragnir and fought against the Sun God. His loyal companion was the ice squirrel Ratatoskr.

The Warrior God was a large bearded giant, possibly an ancient giant based on his size. He went shirtless and wore a helmet with horns. He also wore a black fur cape, a loincloth, boots, and a large belt that covered his stomach.

The Warrior God had eaten a Mythical Zoan-type Devil Fruit, the Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Nidhöggr, which allowed him to transform into an enormous black dragon.

The Warrior God wielded Ragnir. He also carried a comparatively smaller sword or knife.
enrichments.short_description: The Warrior God is a legendary giant of Elbaph who wielded the hammer Ragnir and fought against the Sun God. His loyal companion was the ice squirrel Ratatoskr.

enrichments.description:
Warship Island, also known as "Battleship Island", is one of the anime-only places visited in the Warship Island Arc. The island, which is in the shape of a battleship, is where the Sennenryu, a thought-to-be extinct race of dragons that live for 1000 years, come to die and be reborn.

The Dragon's Nest is an area found underneath Warship Island. It rises from the ocean every 1000 years, during which time the Sennenryu gather to give birth and die.

es:Isla Buque de Guerra fr:Île du Vaisseau de Guerre ru:Остров-линкор Category:Non-Canon East Blue Islands
enrichments.short_description: Warship Island, also known as "Battleship Island", is one of the anime-only places visited in the Warship Island Arc. The island, which is in the shape of a battleship, is where the Sennenryu, a thought-to-be extinct…

enrichments.description:
Waruno Furishiro is a man who manages weapon production orders on behalf of Kurozumi Orochi in the Flower Capital of Wano Country.

Furishiro is an elderly man with a bald head, a long gray beard and a short mustache. He wears a red kimono, a golden decorated stole and beads around his neck.

Furishiro acts as an intermediary for weapon production, but is self-conscious about being called "evil". He is secretly frustrated with the current state of Wano Country and shed tears while expressing his true feelings at the Fire Festival.

Furishiro is somewhat perceptive as he noticed when he was being spied on.
enrichments.short_description: Waruno Furishiro is a man who manages weapon production orders on behalf of Kurozumi Orochi in the Flower Capital of Wano Country.

enrichments.description:
Wavers are small vehicles created in Skypiea.

The typical Waver bears a resemblance to a water scooter, in both appearance and functional design. They are made from a small boat with a Breath Dial installed within, and a set of handlebars that are connected to the front wheel.

Wavers are extremely hard to control and it usually takes ten years to master riding the vehicle. Nami, however, managed to master riding one shortly after seeing its operation, due to her exceptional natural ability and delicate touch.

The one Nami owns has been modified by Franky in both design and functionality, and has been rechristened as "Shiro Mokuba I." It is faster than other Wavers, as it is very light in weight and uses a Jet Dial for propulsion instead of the standard Breath Dial.
enrichments.short_description: Wavers are small vehicles created in Skypiea.

enrichments.description:
Weatheria is an artificial sky island. Nami was sent here by Bartholomew Kuma during the events of Sabaody Archipelago, and spent two years on the island honing her skills.

It appears to be floating on top of a large bubble and it is notable for the study of weather conditions as well as tools that can create various conditions, such as the Wind Knot. The island is constantly drifting with the wind. It was last seen over the Sabaody Archipelago, causing rainfall above the fourth back-up platoon, ruining their gunpowder in order to assist Nami.

The citizens of this country mainly seem to be tall, old men, with long beards who are dressed up as stereotypical wizards. The country seems to lack any law enforcement personnel, with the citizens themselves having to take actions in the event of a crime. However, they all seem to be quite weak and naïve, and are unsure of how to handle crime and violence, though they do have a prison for criminals. This is demonstrated when Nami attempted to steal their technology. They apparently make their living by temporarily landing on islands they pass by and offering to briefly alter their weather for the citizens, for example, bringing rain to a drought-ridden country.

The Wind Knot is a tied rope created on Weatheria. Untying the rope's knots releases gusts of wind.
enrichments.short_description: Weatheria is an artificial sky island. Nami was sent here by Bartholomew Kuma during the events of Sabaody Archipelago, and spent two years on the island honing her skills.

enrichments.description:
Welbems Island is a non-canon island in the North Blue where Hakugan lived prior to joining the Heart Pirates.

After being conquered by the Nagels Pirates, the North side of the island is ruled by Nagels' self-named kingdom.

Welbems Island is split into two halves, the North and South. After the Nagels Pirates attacked and conquered the North side, Nagels established a kingdom there, which he ruled with an iron fist; despite attempts to similarly conquer the South, he was unable to do so.

The island has a warm climate, with long springs and summers, and is known as one of the most comfortable places to live in the North Blue.
enrichments.short_description: Welbems Island is a non-canon island in the North Blue where Hakugan lived prior to joining the Heart Pirates.

enrichments.description:
Wellington is a North Blue pirate from around fourteen to sixteen years ago.

Wellington is a large, burly man with a short, shaggy beard. He wears a captain's coat and shorts. His hair is unkempt with a noticeable widow's peak. He has a scar above his right eye that runs diagonally down his face.

Wellington is very brutal and ruthless. He has no qualms with attacking and killing children, even trying to stab a young Trafalgar Law.

Wellington seems to be quite strong and durable, as he did not seem fazed by the bullets that Baby 5 shot at him from her leg. In spite of his resistance to Baby 5's attack, he was effortlessly defeated by Doflamingo's strings.
enrichments.short_description: Wellington is a North Blue pirate from around fourteen to sixteen years ago.

enrichments.description:
The West Blue is the ocean which makes up the west part of the Blue Sea split by the Red Line and the Grand Line. It is separated from the South Blue by the Red Line and the North Blue by the New World half of the Grand Line.

It is known to be the birthplace of the Straw Hat Pirates' archaeologist, Nico Robin, and musician Brook; the captain of the Rocks Pirates, Rocks D. Xebec; the Emperor Red-Haired Shanks; the Knights of God Figarland Shamrock and Manmayer Gunko; former Warlord of the Sea, Gecko Moria; and one of the members of the Worst Generation, Capone Bege. Other notable pirate crews from this sea include the Rumbar Pirates and the Happo Navy.

The West Blue is also known for having a strong Underworld scene due to the presence of five influential mafia organizations known collectively as the Five Families of the West. Another family with major ties to the Underworld, the Davy Family, was known to secretly live in this sea as well.

Over 60 years ago, a country in the West Blue unaffiliated itself with the World Government. It was reportedly wiped off the map after this, which the people of the Esperia Kingdom believed to be directly related.
enrichments.short_description: The West Blue is the ocean which makes up the west part of the Blue Sea split by the Red Line and the Grand Line. It is separated from the South Blue by the Red Line and the North Blue by the New World half of the Grand…

enrichments.description:
Wheel is the prince of the South Fire Kingdom. He accompanied his father Jeep to the Levely.

Wheel is a slightly stock young man with high cheekbones, small ears, small eyes, and a high forehead with hair pulled up into a pompadour style. Overall, he bears a great physical resemblance to his father Jeep.

He wears a fancy coat decorated with a rose in its left breast. He also sports a sash hanging from his right shoulder across his torso.

Wheel holds the mermaid princess in high regard because of her beauty and tried to get acquainted with her through his father. He was highly offended when she unwittingly insulted him by claiming he was not her type, due to her social inexperience.
enrichments.short_description: Wheel is the prince of the South Fire Kingdom. He accompanied his father Jeep to the Levely.

enrichments.description:
Whisky Peak is the only city located on Cactus Island.

This city is inhabited entirely by bounty hunters working for Baroque Works, who capture any bounty heads that land here to help fund the missions of their organization. As such, the city does not have much supplies, as noted by Miss Monday. The citizens here fool pirates into thinking that they are kind and hospitable and proceed to throw a party for them, only to turn them in and steal everything from their ship when the pirates pass out. Whisky Peak is apparently famous for its liquor, but whether that is the truth or an excuse to have many barrels of alcoholic beverages to better subdue pirates without suspicion is unknown. Roronoa Zoro defeated 100 bounty hunters here, including Mr. 9, Miss Monday, Igaram, and Miss Wednesday.

After the timeskip, Mr. 9 and Miss Monday are revealed to be living there and raising a family.

The town itself looks like a northwestern town with pueblo houses.
enrichments.short_description: Whisky Peak is the only city located on Cactus Island.

enrichments.description:
"Ice Witch" Whitey Bay is an infamous New World pirate captain who was once a member of the Whitebeard Pirates before forming her own crew subordinate to Whitebeard.

Whitey Bay has long, flowing blue hair, full lips and always has a confident expression on her face. She sports a short striped dress closed by laces that have flower-shaped buttons, with loose sleeves, and a scarf. She also wears a polka-dotted bandanna, and over it a light blue and purple pirate hat with her Jolly Roger in the center, a skull with a snowflake design. She also sports a cape, hanging from her back.

During her youth thirty years ago, she wore a striped long-sleeved shirt that exposed her midriff and a short striped skirt.

Having only appeared on a small number of occasions, there is little of her personality that can be ascertained as of late, aside from a confident stance and a somewhat laid-back demeanor. She also seems very loyal to Whitebeard, as she answered his call to arms to save Ace. She took pride in the talent of her ship stating that it can go where it is needed.
enrichments.short_description: "Ice Witch" Whitey Bay is an infamous New World pirate captain who was once a member of the Whitebeard Pirates before forming her own crew subordinate to Whitebeard.

enrichments.description:
Who's-Who, also known as Who of the Droplets, is a pirate who acted as one of the Tobiroppo, the strongest six Shinuchi of the Beasts Pirates, prior to Kaidou's fall from power after the Raid on Onigashima.

Over a decade ago, he served as an agent of CP9 before his failure to guard the Gomu Gomu no Mi led to his dismissal from service and imprisonment. Upon escaping, Who's-Who turned to piracy, becoming captain of the Who's-Who Pirates before eventually joining the Beasts Pirates.

Due to his actions and role, Who's-Who is a supporting antagonist in the Wano Country Arc and the Oni Child Yamato's Golden Harvest Surrogate Pilgrimage cover story.

Who's-Who is a very tall man at over 3.3 meters, lean yet well-toned with particularly long legs and a light complexion. A mane of wavy, pink-colored hair goes down his back a little past his waist, and a pair of long, upward-curving horns jut out of his head. A chain smoker, Who's-Who is always seen with a cigarette in his mouth.
enrichments.short_description: Who's-Who, also known as Who of the Droplets, is a pirate who acted as one of the Tobiroppo, the strongest six Shinuchi of the Beasts Pirates, prior to Kaidou's fall from power after the Raid on Onigashima.

enrichments.description:
The Whole Cake Chateau was the four-layered massive castle of Big Mom, located at the center of Whole Cake Island. Following the detonation of the bomb inside the Tamatebako, extensive damage was caused to the Chateau's base, resulting in the collapse of most of the castle. Streusen transformed a large portion of the building into sponge cake in order to dampen the impact, thus causing the resultant product to cover Sweet City.

Whole Cake Chateau was the largest cake building found in Sweet City. The Chateau's exterior resembled a four layered cake, with the three top layers in different sizes, and each layer had a different style (horizontal, vertical, slash with horizontal base, and backslash), although internally it had a total of ten floors. The second layer had thin, red leafed trees on it edges, which gave the cake shape structure the resemblance of a birthday cake with lit candles. Another tree was occasionally seen on the top layer as well. The third layer had the kitchen's chimney on top of it across the fourth one. As the Chateau collapsed, it was transformed into a sponge cake, and the fourth layer was cut vertically.

The Chateau dwarfed essentially all the other buildings and landmarks of the island (actually being larger than Sweet City as a whole). It was situated roughly centrally on the island, being surrounded by Sweet City and Lake Aprico.

The is the name of the hallways in the Chateau. Luffy ran through one on the third floor, while he looked for Sanji. Another one on the second floor was partly destroyed when the chateau collapsed. Baum is German for "Tree", and considering the overall food theme, might come from Baumkuchen or Baumstriezel, which are types of Spit Cake, a kind of European cake made from rolled dough.
enrichments.short_description: The Whole Cake Chateau was the four-layered massive castle of Big Mom, located at the center of Whole Cake Island. Following the detonation of the bomb inside the Tamatebako, extensive damage was caused to the Chateau's…

enrichments.description:
Wicca is a female dwarf from Tontatta Kingdom beneath Green Bit. She, along with other members of her kind often pose as Dressrosa's fairies and take their "offerings". She is a member of the Tontatta Pirates, the 5th Division of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet.

Wicca, like all the other dwarves, is small in stature and has a large fluffy tail and a pointy nose. She has light blue hair, and also wears a large blue hat, with a red stripe around it. She also wears a blue dress with a white scarf.

She is quite emotional and worries about her comrades, and will throw destructive tantrums when her worry gets the best of her. She is not afraid to speak her mind as shown when she insulted Zoro for his stupidity. Wicca is also older than she looks, as when Zoro asked what her age was, he was surprised to hear she was 27.

As a Dwarf, Wicca is quite powerful despite her small size, capable of smashing the stone ground beneath her with ease, using nothing but her bare hands during her tantrum. She is also a member of the scouting unit on Dressrosa, which may further attest to her strength.
enrichments.short_description: Wicca is a female dwarf from Tontatta Kingdom beneath Green Bit. She, along with other members of her kind often pose as Dressrosa's fairies and take their "offerings". She is a member of the Tontatta Pirates, the 5th…

enrichments.description:
Wind Granma is a ship used by Monkey D. Dragon, leader of the Revolutionary Army.

Wind Granma is a large ship that has a figurehead and theme of an actual dragon, complete with a small dragon tail.

This ship was kept around for at least ten years, as seen when Dragon used it to rescue the citizens from the Gray Terminal, and when they landed at another island to get supplies.

After the Summit War of Marineford, it was seen moored outside of the Revolutionary Army headquarters at Baltigo.
enrichments.short_description: Wind Granma is a ship used by Monkey D. Dragon, leader of the Revolutionary Army.

enrichments.description:
Winner Island is a New World island northeast of Wano Country.

Winner Island is a rocky island with large geological formations that have rounded protrusions and sparsely placed trees. The sea level portion of the island looks to be densely forested, with a barren coast.

Winner Island is one of three islands that follow Wano Country in the New World, alongside Egghead and Elbaph.

Trafalgar D. Water Law selected the Northeastern route from Wano Country using a Log Pose, and his crew departed on course for Winner Island.
enrichments.short_description: Winner Island is a New World island northeast of Wano Country.

enrichments.description:
Wire is among the tallest members of the crew, standing about one meter taller than Kid and Killer. He wears a dark brown cloak, a wire shirt, black shorts, and black fishnet stockings. The looped, golden belt on his shorts matches Heat's. He has the crew's secondary Jolly Roger over his chest and a necklace with small axe blades on it. He has droopy eyes, regardless of his expression.

From the Wano Country Arc onward, Wire started wearing five spikes atop his hood.

Wire is taciturn and usually, he does not show any type of emotion, as he is often seen standing in the background with a mopish expression in his face. He did, however, express shock when Kid was attacked by a Pacifista and after hearing about Big Mom and Kaidou's alliance. He is sympathetic to Killer for what happened to him.

Wire is strong enough to withstand the blast of Haki that Silvers Rayleigh used at the Human Auctioning House on Sabaody Archipelago.
enrichments.short_description: Wire is among the tallest members of the crew, standing about one meter taller than Kid and Killer. He wears a dark brown cloak, a wire shirt, black shorts, and black fishnet stockings. The looped, golden belt on his…

enrichments.description:
Wolf is a giant from Elbaph who works as the gym teacher at the Walrus School.

As a giant, Wolf appears to be very large. He has short black hair and a beard tied into three ponytails. Wolf wears a yellow shirt with a belt and a green feathered coat.

Wolf seems to care for his students' well-being as he prioritized their safety over his own injuries.

As a giant, Wolf has immense physical strength. As a gym teacher, he is likely athletic and knowledgeable of physical fitness. He is quite brave and seems to be confident in his abilities, as he went up against a giant snake with only a stick in his hand in an attempt to protect the children.
enrichments.short_description: Wolf is a giant from Elbaph who works as the gym teacher at the Walrus School.

enrichments.description:
Woop Slap is the mayor of Monkey D. Luffy's hometown, Foosha Village.

Woop Slap is a short, wiry, bespectacled man with something of a cleft chin. He generally wears lightweight "tropical" clothing, along with a selection of striped hats.

As a younger man, he once wore his facial hair as stubble, but has since grown them into a full mustache and goatee. His age has also caused him to take up a walking cane.

For the most part, Woop Slap is a typical village elder: practical, humorless, and disdainful of pirates (with the semi-exception of Shanks). As such, he is Foosha Village's loudest—if not only—critic against Luffy's dreams of piracy, and has remained so long after Luffy's crew attained worldwide notoriety.
enrichments.short_description: Woop Slap is the mayor of Monkey D. Luffy's hometown, Foosha Village.

enrichments.description:
The Woshu Woshu no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to literally "wash and hang out to dry" people and objects as if they were clothes, making the user a . It was eaten by Tsuru.

The main strength of this Devil Fruit is that it allows Tsuru to "wash and hang out to dry" people and objects as if they were clothes. This seems to render her victims unable to fight back or move. According to Oda, "villains who have been dried get their hearts a little bit cleaner as well; their evil hearts become fainter, so that's a dangerous ability against pirates".

This power has no known weaknesses aside from the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.

Tsuru has so far been seen disabling pirates with this power. She can also "clean" a limited amount of evil out of her opponents' hearts, rendering them slightly less evil. It is unknown how she activates her powers.
enrichments.short_description: The Woshu Woshu no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to literally "wash and hang out to dry" people and objects as if they were clothes, making the user a . It was eaten by Tsuru.

enrichments.description:
"Berserker" Wyper is the former leader of the Shandia warriors that fought to take Upper Yard back from Enel. He is the direct descendant of Kalgara. After the timeskip, he joined the God's Guards and became their leader.

He is an antagonist later turned ally during the Skypiea Arc. After the timeskip, he is one of God's Guards.

Wyper is a tall, muscular Shandia, and as such, sports a pair of little wings on his back. He's covered by various tribal tattoos across his left shoulder and the left side of his face. He has very long dark brown hair is arranged in a mohawk that follows into a segmented braid that goes slightly past his waist, resembling those worn by real life Native Americans, and he has little spherical earrings. Wyper always goes shirtless, and is also shoeless beyond using Skate-type Wavers in battle. He generally wears a grass skirt, with a rope belt decorated by three small ornaments that look like fangs or claws around his waist. He is usually seen smoking a cigarillo, chomping down on it during battle, and as a child he chewed on a grass stalk before he moved up to tobacco, showing it is a definite habit of his. He also wore an intimidating tribal mask in his first appearance, but soon discarded it.

After the timeskip he now wears his hair unbraided, appearing to have a full head of long hair past his shoulders. He also has the coat his fellow guards wear tied around his waist instead of actually wearing it. He also has a more muscular build.
enrichments.short_description: "Berserker" Wyper is the former leader of the Shandia warriors that fought to take Upper Yard back from Enel. He is the direct descendant of Kalgara. After the timeskip, he joined the God's Guards and became their…

enrichments.description:
"Red Flag" X Drake (pronounced as "Diez Drake") is the captain of the Marine Secret Special Unit SWORD. In order to go undercover as a pirate, he publicly defected from his position as rear admiral and founded the Drake Pirates. He is one of twelve pirates referred to as the "Worst Generation", and before the two-year timeskip had a bounty of 222,000,000.

Drake is the son of the Marine-turned-pirate Diez Barrels and was affiliated with the Barrels Pirates until he defected to the Marines. As a young adult, he was called Dory.

In Drake's endeavor as an undercover spy, he and his crew became subordinate to the Beasts Pirates, led by Kaidou of the Four Emperors, over the two-year timeskip. Drake served as one of the crew's Shinuchi, specifically one of strongest six called Tobiroppo. His treachery was eventually uncovered, however, leading him to ally himself with the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance.

Drake is a tall, lean, and muscular man who wears what appears to be a combination of a white-plumed with his crew's Jolly Roger on the side and a domino mask over his eyes. Underneath this headgear, Drake's hair is reddish brown, with brush-like sideburns. On his broad chin, he has an "X"-shaped scar, and on his chest and upper body, he also has another large "X." The "X's," as well as that in his name, represent the Roman numeral X for 10, not the English letter.
enrichments.short_description: "Red Flag" X Drake (pronounced as "Diez Drake") is the captain of the Marine Secret Special Unit SWORD. In order to go undercover as a pirate, he publicly defected from his position as rear admiral and founded the Drake…

enrichments.description:
Yama is a Birkan and the commander of the Divine Soldiers under Enel. He is a supporting antagonist during the Skypiea Arc.

Yama is an obese man with a triple chin. He has a round body shape with long wavy black hair and tanned skin. He has bags under his eyes and thick lips. He wears a white toga with black vertical stripes, three on each side. Over his toga he has an orange sash, connected by strings, and has red lining and dark orange vertical stripes on it. Yama wears gold bracelets on both his wrist, and has wings on his back, like other Birkans.

Yama is fanatically loyal to Enel, going so far as to reprimand Shura, Ohm, and Gedatsu for fighting in his presence. He displays quite an amount of brutality in battle. His ruthless fighting style gives him little respect for the world around him, as seen when he destroyed the ruins of Shandora during his fight with Robin.

He has a habit of often exclaiming "Baa!" and "Meriya!"
enrichments.short_description: Yama is a Birkan and the commander of the Divine Soldiers under Enel. He is a supporting antagonist during the Skypiea Arc.

enrichments.description:
Vice Admiral Yamakaji is a Marine officer, and one of the five vice admirals who led the Buster Call on Enies Lobby.

Yamakaji is a tall and broad-chested man. He has a slightly wrinkled face, a round nose with prominent nostrils, thick lips, and a wide, round chin. He has brown buzz cut-styled hair which connects to a thick beard that covers his entire chin. He is always seen with his eyes closed and with a cigar in his mouth. He is also often seen with a cheerful smile. He wears a dark brown double-breasted suit with a black tie underneath, all over a yellow dress shirt with a red polka dot pattern. He also wears brown pants and brown shoes. Like most high-ranking Marine officers, he drapes his standard Marine coat over his shoulders like a cape. He also wears a standard Marine cap.

Twenty-seven years ago, his appearance was very similar. He lacked his beard, instead just having some stubble on his chin, as well as sideburns. He wore an orange suit and a red tie over a white dress shirt, and already had his Marine coat and cap at that time.

Yamakaji generally acts very nonchalant, such as when he was seen peacefully grinning while the Marines destroyed Enies Lobby. However, during the Summit War of Marineford, this demeanor slipped, and he was seen anxiously observing the war. Yamakaji appears to admire his senior officers. This is demonstrated when he was seen acting excited when he saw Garp and Sengoku working together, as well as when he acted protective of Tsuru during the Summit War of Marineford. Yamakaji likes to smoke so much that he even smokes during battle. As a Marine, Yamakaji presumably has a strong sense of justice. He appears to be very obedient, to the point of not wanting to attack Blackbeard without receiving direct orders.
enrichments.short_description: Vice Admiral Yamakaji is a Marine officer, and one of the five vice admirals who led the Buster Call on Enies Lobby.

enrichments.description:
Yamanba is a Gifter of the Beasts Pirates who works under Black Maria.

Yamanba is a woman of above-average height. She has a long face and chin with a large mouth, and is frequently seen with her tongue hanging out. She has long, purple hair, which she adorns with a flower. She wears a purple with a pink sash, and has two small horns protruding from beneath her hair.

Yamanba is a very cruel person, and is known to go out of her way to slit the throats of her enemies with her beloved . Despite this, she appears to be somewhat sympathetic to those she views as below her, showing pity for Sanji when he was being beat by Black Maria.

Yamanba has eaten a SMILE|アオダイショウの|Aodaishō no Sumairu}}. What abilities it gives her, however, are unclear.
enrichments.short_description: Yamanba is a Gifter of the Beasts Pirates who works under Black Maria.

enrichments.description:
Yamato is the son of Kaidou. Born as Kaidou's daughter and groomed from a young age to be his heir, Yamato instead developed a profound admiration for the legendary samurai Kouzuki Oden. After Oden's death, Yamato decided to become like him, impersonating him and adopting his mannerisms. As a result of this desire to emulate Oden, Yamato decided to become a man and identify as Kaidou's son, with his father and the Beasts Pirates referring to him as such as well.

This path has put Yamato at odds with Kaidou, with much of his life being spent imprisoned on Onigashima. Yamato befriended Portgas D. Ace during his visit to Wano Country, and after learning of Ace's death waited for the arrival of his sworn brother, Monkey D. Luffy. Yamato eventually met Luffy during the Raid on Onigashima, during which he took a rebellious stance against his father and fought as a valuable ally to the samurai against the Beasts Pirates. Initially desiring to join Luffy's crew, Yamato ultimately decided to remain behind in Wano to help protect it from outside forces, though he still intends to join them in the future.

Yamato is a major ally of the Straw Hats during the Wano Country Arc. He also is the central character from the Oni Child Yamato's Golden Harvest Surrogate Pilgrimage Cover Page serial.

Being assigned female at birth and not usually choosing to explicitly present as male, Yamato has typically been referred to as a woman by people when they first encounter him. Yamato is taller than an average human, standing at 263 cm (8'8"). He has long, white hair that is bound between orange rods into a ponytail at the back, which fades into aqua green and then blue the further down it goes, and ends in rectangular locks similar to Kaidou. Yamato also has large, orange eyes with prominent eyelashes, wears gold hoop earrings on both ears, and has horns on the top of his head which are mostly red, but gradually become more flesh-colored toward the base.
enrichments.short_description: Yamato is the son of Kaidou. Born as Kaidou's daughter and groomed from a young age to be his heir, Yamato instead developed a profound admiration for the legendary samurai Kouzuki Oden. After Oden's death, Yamato…

enrichments.description:
The Yamato Maru is Yamato's personal ship in One Piece School. It is one of .

The Yamato Maru is a small wooden boat with a hut in the center. It has the text written on the roof of the hut, and "Yamato Maru" written on the side of the ship.

At some point in the past, the Yamato Maru washed up on the shore of Onigashima Middle School. Yamato recovered the boat, disguising it as a cargo ship and naming it.

With the ship disguised, Yamato began using the Yamato Maru to sneak out of the school.
enrichments.short_description: The Yamato Maru is Yamato's personal ship in One Piece School. It is one of .

enrichments.description:
O-Yame is a woman who lives in Okobore Town of Kuri with her two sons, Kinbo and an unnamed infant.

Yame is an average-sized woman with a round nose and brown hair tied in a bun. She wears a light blue kimono with light green cloud patterns and pink patches, as well as a purple obi with white dots and a red string. She carries her infant son on her back.

Yame believes that Wano Country boys should not cry or complain no matter the circumstances.

Yame tried to calm down her son Kinbo who was crying from hunger by telling him that Wano Country boys do not whine. When Zoro, Kiku and Law arrived with the Treasure Ship of Provisions, Yame and her family were able to eat as much as they wanted.
enrichments.short_description: O-Yame is a woman who lives in Okobore Town of Kuri with her two sons, Kinbo and an unnamed infant.

enrichments.description:
Yamenahare is a citizen of Pucci and the manservant to Marumieta, the daughter of Pucci's mayor, Bimine.

Yamenahare is a middle aged man, with glasses, a large mustache and beard. He wears a standard suit.

Yamenahare shows great concern over Marumieta.

Yamenahare accompanied Marumieta to Water 7 in order to deliver emergency supplies after the Aqua Laguna. While there, they witnessed Franky's naked run through Water 7, and Yamenahare was shocked at Marumieta spying on Franky with binoculars.
enrichments.short_description: Yamenahare is a citizen of Pucci and the manservant to Marumieta, the daughter of Pucci's mayor, Bimine.

enrichments.description:
The Yami Yami no Mi is a Logia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to create, control, and transform into darkness at will, making the user a . It was eaten by Marshall D. Teach, also known as "Blackbeard", who stole it from Commander Thatch of the Whitebeard Pirates' 4th division after murdering him.

This fruit is considered unique even for a Logia, and the ability it grants is said to be the "most evil" of all Devil Fruits.

The Yami Yami no Mi is a large, round, light purple fruit made up of many small teardrop-shaped components with swirl patterns, and green leaves sprouting from the top. Its overall shape and appearance closely resembles a pineapple or a bunch of oversized and teardrop-shaped grapes.

The first and foremost strength, as demonstrated by Blackbeard, is that it allows the user to control darkness and its unique property of . The darkness is visually demonstrated by a black smoke-like substance spreading out from the user's body. The darkness is a void that devours and crushes everything. Due to this, the user can absorb physical matter and attacks of any type by sucking them into the darkness. The user can also use this ability to irresistibly pull the opponent to them, regardless of their current state.
enrichments.short_description: The Yami Yami no Mi is a Logia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to create, control, and transform into darkness at will, making the user a . It was eaten by Marshall D. Teach, also known as "Blackbeard", who stole…

enrichments.description:
The only known citizen of Yano Country was Shiki, who was born there.

Little is known about Yano Country, but it is described as a "rougher version of Wano Country".

73 years ago, Shiki was born in the Yano Country. At least 48 years ago, he left the country to become a pirate, developing a reputation as a pirate-yakuza.

pl:Kraj Yano ru:Страна Яно Category:Mentioned Only Regimes
enrichments.short_description: The only known citizen of Yano Country was Shiki, who was born there.

enrichments.description:
Yarisugi is a Marine Commodore of G-5 Unit 06.

Yarisugi is a tall and muscular man who wears a round hat with a short dark brim and a "5" at the front. He also has brown colored hair sticking out from the sides of his head to form a circle and a small black beard with a mustache of the same color, and a scar on his left cheek.

Under a light fur-lined coat, he wears a bow-tie and a dark-colored leotard with the Marine symbol and "G 5" on it that goes from the middle of his chest to the middle of his thighs. He has three circular badges with dark-colored stars on them, two on the right of his coat, one on the left. He also has a belt strapped diagonally across his chest where he carries a sword. He wears metal greaves on his legs.

Yarisugi is a harsh and violent Marine, fitting the image of the G-5 branch where he works. Uncompassionate and unsympathetic, he kicked one of the citizens who was begging him to help find their children and even went as far as threatening the depressed citizens outright. He also tends to exaggerate things, saying, "too" in almost every sentence.
enrichments.short_description: Yarisugi is a Marine Commodore of G-5 Unit 06.

enrichments.description:
Yasopp, known as "Chaser", is one of the Senior Officers and the sniper of the Red Hair Pirates. He is also the father of Usopp and the widower of Banchina.

His appearance is very similar to his son, Usopp. However, his shorter nose and blond hair do not match Usopp's longer nose and darker hair, both of which are hereditary traits of Usopp's mother. Twenty years ago, Yasopp had the same tight curls and black hair as Usopp, and in Romance Dawn, his hair was styled in loose waves, but later appearances show him with it in dreadlocks. In addition to that, his body was slimmer while in his latest appearance, it seems to have become more muscular.

His name was written on his headband, while in his latest appearance, he has no headband, and his name is written on his upper right arm. During his time in Foosha Village, he wore a dark-blue shirt, dark-green pants reaching down to his calves, and blue shoes with buckles on them. He donned his headband at this time. At Marineford, he sports a dark A-shirt, short pants, standard boots, and a large belt with a bag attached to it. There is also a little necklace around his neck. He retains his trademark star-patterned cape, and he has his rifle attached to his back via a band.

He shares many personality traits with his son, including being able to encourage the rest of his crew to join in with his fun. He is very proud of his son, Usopp, to the point where he would often talk about his son over and over again to Luffy, which led Luffy to recognize Usopp on sight from Yasopp's stories alone. During his time in Luffy's village, Yasopp felt close to Luffy because he is the same age as his son whom he left at home.
enrichments.short_description: Yasopp, known as "Chaser", is one of the Senior Officers and the sniper of the Red Hair Pirates. He is also the father of Usopp and the widower of Banchina.

enrichments.description:
"Snake-Eyes" Yatappe is a yakuza boss who was in charge of the Kibi region in Wano Country. He was imprisoned in Udon by the Beasts Pirates, but was freed when Luffy took over the prison.

Yatappe is an average size man, with long dark purple wavy hair and thick sideburns. His mustache and beard form a circle around his mouth. He has thick lips, a thin nose, and a circular scar over his right eye.

Being a yakuza boss, he had the respect of his followers from Kibi, as well as the other yakuza bosses of his time, being able to work alongside them. He seems to highly respect Hyougoro, and would threaten those who offend the elder as well as obey his commands. However, Yatappe expressed his misgivigns when Hyougoro ordered him and the other yakuza bosses to end his life should he fully succumb to the Ice Oni virus.

Yatappe seems to have enough strength to hold down a struggling Luffy while the latter is being punished for his rudeness.
enrichments.short_description: "Snake-Eyes" Yatappe is a yakuza boss who was in charge of the Kibi region in Wano Country. He was imprisoned in Udon by the Beasts Pirates, but was freed when Luffy took over the prison.

enrichments.description:
Yazaemon is a ninja and a member of the Beasts Pirates. He previously was a member of the Orochi Oniwabanshu which served the shogun of Wano Country, Kurozumi Orochi.

Due to his actions and role, he is a minor antagonist in the Wano Country Arc.

Yazaemon is a man of relatively average height, though he is perpetually hunched over with his hands resting on the ground. His face is completely covered by bandages, leaving only his red eyes exposed. He wears a straw snow cape with a tube at the top. He wears a blue kimono with hash patterns on it; the kimono has rather puffy sleeves.

As a member of the Oniwabanshu, Yazaemon appeared to be loyal to Kurozumi Orochi until the latter's death.
enrichments.short_description: Yazaemon is a ninja and a member of the Beasts Pirates. He previously was a member of the Orochi Oniwabanshu which served the shogun of Wano Country, Kurozumi Orochi.

enrichments.description:
The Yeti Cool Brothers are and , a pair of giant assassins who were employed by Caesar Clown. They are members of a mysterious type of giant.

They serve as supporting antagonists of the Punk Hazard Arc.

The brothers are a pair of furry giants, having long limbs and being covered in white fur all over their bodies except their fingers. It is unknown if they are actual yetis, although several characters believe them to be due to the strong parallels.

Their height dwarfs that of many giants. One of the brother's footprints is larger than Brook, who stands at 277 cm (9'1"). When the pair captured Franky under Caesar Clown's orders, Scotch held his entire 240 cm (7'10½") frame in just one hand.
enrichments.short_description: The Yeti Cool Brothers are and , a pair of giant assassins who were employed by Caesar Clown. They are members of a mysterious type of giant.

enrichments.description:
Yggdrasil, literally translated as the World Tree, is a giant tree located in the Land of Gods.

From the view of its human inhabitants, Yggdrasil is a tree of large proportions, being extremely wide and tall.

Yggdrasil appears to be of major importance to the local culture, as if a disaster were to befall it, the Land of Gods would perish.

When a fire (caused by the Straw Hat Pirates) started in a forest near Yggdrasil, it caused a panic among the other humans who lived nearby, as they feared for the tree's safety.
enrichments.short_description: Yggdrasil, literally translated as the World Tree, is a giant tree located in the Land of Gods.

enrichments.description:
Ylva is a student at the Walrus School on Elbaph. She is the great-great-granddaughter of Jarul.

Ylva is a young giant girl with blue eyes, short blonde hair, and blush marks on her cheeks. She wears a pink tunic with a white collar and a belt and black stripes along its bottom, as well as a large, pink nearly oversized horned helmet with a wide brim. Her helmet has two straps, though she leaves them open, and it has a design from her face to the back of her head.

Like other Walrus School students, Ylva is against violence and fighting. She is very sensitive and fears legendary monsters like the ones in Elbaph's myths.

Ylva's great-great-grandfather Jarul seems to treasure her, as he immediately thought of her when the Walrus School was attacked. Jarul seemed to support Harald's efforts towards a peaceful Elbaph in part due to seeing Ylva grow up without being taught to fight.
enrichments.short_description: Ylva is a student at the Walrus School on Elbaph. She is the great-great-granddaughter of Jarul.

enrichments.description:
Yokan is a doctor assigned to treat the injured at sumo matches in Bakura Town.

Yokan is an elderly man with a very long face. He has gray hair tied in a topknot, but the top of his head is balding. He has a thick gray mustache and a short beard. He wears glasses on top of his head and a rose-colored kimono with the kanji printed all over it.

Yokan is a stoic individual as he remained calm while counting the number of injuries at the sumo tournament.

Yokan appears to be a skilled doctor as he was able to accurately determine the injuries of the sumo fighters and count the number of broken bones.
enrichments.short_description: Yokan is a doctor assigned to treat the injured at sumo matches in Bakura Town.

enrichments.description:
Yokozuna is a Sumo Frog that Tom's Workers kept as a pet, friend and mascot up until Tom's execution.

He is a supporting character throughout the Water 7 Saga.

Yokozuna is a giant frog with yellow-brown skin and black hair worn in a . He has numerous scars on his belly (from testing his strength against the Sea Train, a task inspired by his comrade Franky's death-defying act). He also has sharp, jagged teeth and is seemingly a facultative biped, used mostly for his sumo stance.

Yokozuna cares very much for his friends and loved ones. He is exceptionally loyal to Franky who taught him the frontcrawl-stroke when they were younger.
enrichments.short_description: Yokozuna is a Sumo Frog that Tom's Workers kept as a pet, friend and mascot up until Tom's execution.

enrichments.description:
The Yomi Yomi no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit which strengthens the user's soul to the point where they resurrect after their first death, allowing them to live a second time and to use several other soul-based abilities, making the user a . It was eaten by Brook.

The Yomi Yomi no Mi is a spherical-shaped golden fruit with a green stem. On its bottom, it has four stubby growths, making the shape resemble a skull. As with most Devil Fruits, it has swirl patterns allover.

The major strength of the fruit, as demonstrated by Brook, is that it gives its user another chance at life after dying once before and thereby a literal second chance at living. After death, the user continues to exist in whatever state they were revived as and can even go as far as to grant a form of "immortality" that lasts until the user suffers a second death. However, since the main attribute of the fruit is resurrection, the Yomi Yomi no Mi's power will remain dormant until the time when the consumer suffers his or her first death. As a result, until such time, the only aspects the fruit bestows upon its eater are the typical Devil Fruit weaknesses.

While the Fruit allows the user's soul to return from the , it does not automatically return them to the physical body that it once resided in during its mortal life. Thus, it is then up to the disembodied soul to search for the corporeal body in order to once again reunite with it. Though the user gains another life, their body, however, will continue being a lifeless corpse and will continue rotting away until the user's soul can find its way back to the body. When the user's soul returns to their body, the powers of the Devil Fruit will fortunately support the user's well-being in the case that their body may be in a condition unable to support life.
enrichments.short_description: The Yomi Yomi no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit which strengthens the user's soul to the point where they resurrect after their first death, allowing them to live a second time and to use several other soul-based…

enrichments.description:
Pastor Yomo is a mink and one of Inuarashi's Musketeers.

Yomo is a large male sheep mink with fluffy, light-colored fur. He has narrow eyes, thick lips, and black skin. He has sheep hooves, horns, and a tail, and wears a pair of dark-colored pants.

Yomo did not mind it when Nami slept on him and seems to like it, as he attempted to accompany her to Whole Cake Island with the reasoning that Nami likes sleeping on him.

As a mink, Yomo is a natural-born warrior and can use Electro. Furthermore, as a member of the Inuarashi Musketeer Squad, he is highly formidable in combat. During the full moon, Yomo can activate a Sulong transformation.
enrichments.short_description: Pastor Yomo is a mink and one of Inuarashi's Musketeers.

enrichments.description:
"Calico" Yorki was the captain of the Rumbar Pirates.

52 years ago, he and the rest of his crew traveled from the West Blue to Reverse Mountain, bringing along Laboon and leaving him at Twin Cape in Crocus' care.

Yorki was a blond haired pirate with two tattoos on his face, one under his right eye and one under his lower lip. His tattoos resembled the katakana character, ヨ (yo).

He typically wore a white cowboy hat and a green captain's coat with gold epaulettes. He also wore a gold and red pendant.
enrichments.short_description: "Calico" Yorki was the captain of the Rumbar Pirates.

enrichments.description:
Yosaku along with Johnny are old friends and former bounty hunting partners of Roronoa Zoro.

He is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Baratie Arc and the Arlong Park Arc.

Yosaku has a black shirt with a green coat and red headgear. He has plaid yellow boxer shorts over unshaven legs and dark shoes and, like his partner, carries a sword. He is also sometimes seen with a cigarette.

After the timeskip, Yosaku is no longer wearing the coat and is seen shirtless, showing he has a kanji tattoo that reads on his back. His arms have become very muscular.
enrichments.short_description: Yosaku along with Johnny are old friends and former bounty hunting partners of Roronoa Zoro.

enrichments.description:
Mr. Yoshimoto is the owner of the restaurant Spice Bean.

Yoshimoto is a tall, middle-aged man. He is bald and wears a chef's hat. He wears a blue robe, with a purple lining that has yellow circles on it. Under his robes, he has a yellow shirt with orange lining and a large star on it.

Yoshimoto cares deeply for his restaurant, since he was struggling to smile at Luffy, who was eating all of the restaurant’s food. He, like most civilians, is also scared of well-known pirates, telling Luffy to run away from Portgas D. Ace.

He was always trying his best to smile while Luffy was consuming almost his entire food supply. After Luffy blasted away Ace and Smoker, he was seen telling Luffy to run, thinking Ace was going to kill him, not knowing that they were brothers.
enrichments.short_description: Mr. Yoshimoto is the owner of the restaurant Spice Bean.

enrichments.description:
Yotsubane is one of the Shandia warriors who fought against Enel.

Yotsubane is a lean man with wings, like other Shandia. He wears a red cap that resembles a chullo, with two white stripes on it, with four white feathers with black tips on the top. The hat also has a white cloth hanging down on the sides. He wears a dark yellow robe, that shows half his chest, has white frills at the bottom, purple triangle shapes with white triangles inside on the hip area. He also wears a brown belt across his torso, which he carries the holder for his arrows and his bow.

As a Shandia warrior, Yotsubane has great pride and loyalty to his people. He was horrified when Wyper was attacked by Holy. He is also quite aggressive, calling for Enel's head and retaliating at Ohm after Wyper was injured.

Yotsubane, being one of the few Shandia warriors to reach Upper Yard, is quite powerful. However, he was easily defeated when Holy knocked him into Ohm's White-Barbed Iron Deathmatch.
enrichments.short_description: Yotsubane is one of the Shandia warriors who fought against Enel.

enrichments.description:
Yuba is a small oasis town in Arabasta where Toto lives.

Originally built with the purpose of acting as an intersection for the towns and villages of western Arabasta, Yuba was endlessly struck with sandstorms summoned by the leader of Baroque Works, Mr. 0, a.k.a Crocodile, as part of his plan to agitate the country's rebellion forces.

It once served as the headquarters of the Arabastan rebel army until they moved to Katorea. Unaware of that, Nefertari Vivi and the Straw Hat Pirates came to this town thinking they could meet with the rebels and stop the civil war.

Yuba is a recent town, no older than 8–10 years old. Its location, at the very middle of the western portion of the Sandora Desert, was strategically decided in order to provide Arabasta with a hub that could act as a rest stop for merchants traveling through the desert. Rainbase is located to its north, the Spiders Cafe to its southwest and Erumalu to its southeast.
enrichments.short_description: Yuba is a small oasis town in Arabasta where Toto lives.

enrichments.description:
Yuba Oasis is a non-canon oasis town in Mr. Kuromaku's version of Arabasta, run by ック・ワークス|Furokku Wākusu}}.

Unlike in the One Piece world, the oasis located here did not dry up, and the location was transformed into a resort by "Furo"que Works. It has a heavy gambling industry, centered around pulling gamblers into debt and forcing them to work it off.

Yuba Oasis is split up into three main sections, being a water park, casino, and underground factory.

The water park contains multiple slides and pools despite the surrounding desert, a testament to the present oasis. It also contains street stalls selling food. This region is used as a draw to customers, with nearly free access; "Furo"que Works intends for visitors to begin here and funnel over to the casino.
enrichments.short_description: Yuba Oasis is a non-canon oasis town in Mr. Kuromaku's version of Arabasta, run by ック・ワークス|Furokku Wākusu}}.

enrichments.description:
Yui is a member of the former Roger Pirates.

Yui is a short man with wavy, red hair that sticks straight up. He wears a light-colored cloak with a collar that is high enough to cover the lower portion of his face. His hair color was later changed to brown.

Nothing is known about Yui's personality, but he always appears extremely calm. He also set off for the God Valley with his team without hesitation.

Thirty-eight years ago Yui was seen along with the Roger Pirates arriving at God Valley preparing to engage the Rocks Pirates in what would later be labeled as the God Valley Incident.
enrichments.short_description: Yui is a member of the former Roger Pirates.

enrichments.description:
Yukari was an ancient civilization that existed some time in the past few centuries. It was a small, independent city-state, surrounded by larger nations that it was constantly fighting off. It was eventually absorbed by one of its neighbors, and due to the active warzone surrounding its former location, much of the information about it has been lost.

Not much is known about Yukari's geography, but it was surrounded by enemy nations. The country contained a palace built out of stone, though it was destroyed; the kitchen, specifically, was destroyed in a fire. The ground was made of limestone, and as such trees did not naturally grow.

While Yukari functioned largely independently, it did trade with World Government-affiliated countries.

Yukari had its own language and writing system, which was written using a alphabet. The language was discovered to be similar to another language from the same time period called , allowing it to be translated by Nico Robin and Koala. The oral language, meanwhile, is very similar to the language used by the World Government, allowing it to be translated by ear.
enrichments.short_description: Yukari was an ancient civilization that existed some time in the past few centuries. It was a small, independent city-state, surrounded by larger nations that it was constantly fighting off. It was eventually absorbed…
