entities.short_description: Gyogyo is a member of the Bonney Pirates. He was once a resident of the Sorbet Kingdom, having been a friend of Bartholomew Kuma and Ginny since childhood.

entities.name: Gyoro, Nin, and Bao
entities.description:
Gyoro, Nin, and Bao were a trio of oddly shaped Soldier Zombies that were first seen reporting to Moria about the Straw Hats' arrival.

They are relatively small Soldier Zombies and they are all roughly the same size as Chopper when he is when using his Brain Point. Gyoro is the zombie that looks like a one-eyed samurai with an ovular head. Nin is the pinkish-red zombie archer with a triangular head. Bao is the yellow zombie that looks like some sort of super hero with a bucket shaped head.

They all seem to be very scared of Gecko Moria, but are still loyal to him, as they notified him when the Straw Hat Pirates came to the island because they thought it would be useful to him. They also respect the Mysterious Four.

Gyoro, Nin, and Bao's physical abilities are unknown, as they have not been shown fighting.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.image_alt: Identification thumbnail for Gyoro, Nin, and Bao
entities.short_description: Gyoro, Nin, and Bao were a trio of oddly shaped Soldier Zombies that were first seen reporting to Moria about the Straw Hats' arrival.

entities.name: Gyoru
entities.description:
Gyoru is a fishmonger in Foosha Village and the husband of Chicken. Luffy bought fish from him when he was a kid.

Gyoru is an average sized middle aged man with black hair, a widow's peak, and a spiky tuft of hair on the top of his head. He has small round eyes, thick eyebrows, and stubble on his chin. He has always been seen sporting a large smile. He wears a yellow shirt with a black apron over it and a pink rope tied around his head. 12 years ago, he lacked stubble.

Gyoru has had multiple color schemes in the anime. In all of his appearances in the anime he has brown hair instead of black. In his first appearance in Episode 45, his shirt was beige, his apron was green, and the rope around his head was pink. In Episode 504, his shirt was white with gray cuffs, his apron was brown, and the rope around his head was white. In Episode of East Blue, his shirt was gray, his apron was black, the rope around his head was white, and he also lacked the tuft of hair on his head.

Gyoru is kind, as he was nice to Luffy and supported him in his dream of becoming a pirate.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Gyoru is a fishmonger in Foosha Village and the husband of Chicken. Luffy bought fish from him when he was a kid.

entities.name: Gyro
entities.description:
Crab-Hand Gyro is the captain of the Gyro Pirates from South Blue that was on its way to the New World before an unfortunate meeting with the New Fish-Man Pirates.

Gyro is a skinny man of average height with a child-like, oval face, and a square nose. He has two red distinctive spots on his cheeks, dark hair, beard and mustache, he's missing a tooth and has what appears to be a massive on top of his head. He also has well-developed pectorals and abdominal muscles.

He sports a bicorne adorned with his Jolly Roger, tied around his neck with a string, much like Luffy with his straw hat. He wears a partially unbuttoned black vest underneath a light blue captain's coat worn with the arms in the sleeves, with the left sleeve being cut right below his elbow, and has a large buckled belt hanging on his chest from his right shoulder. He wears striped pants reaching down to his calves, with many purple and white stripes at the ends, and sandals. He carries around a katana with him.

His most distinctive feature, as well as the source of his epithet, is the giant crab claw where his left hand should be. It is orange and made of metal with spikes coming out of the arm. This is a weapon attachment, as his human arm is seen bitten off and floating next to him after being defeated by Hody Jones.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Crab-Hand Gyro is the captain of the Gyro Pirates from South Blue that was on its way to the New World before an unfortunate meeting with the New Fish-Man Pirates.

entities.name: Hack
entities.description:
"Hundredth Dan" Hack is a fish-man and a member of the Revolutionary Army, which he serves as combat instructor. He went to Dressrosa to investigate the arms trafficking there and competed at the Corrida Colosseum for the Mera Mera no Mi.

Hack is a fish-man with yellow skin that has brown spots on the upper part of his head, along with scales under his eyelids, sharp teeth, and gills on the sides of his neck. The fish-man has a muscular stature, with long light blue flowing hair and a thick blue mustache. Similar to Kuroobi, he wears an open gi with a black belt.

When he was transformed into a toy, he appeared to be shaped like a dog while maintaining the same color scheme.

Hack is a calm and proud person, and follows a dream where a path of friendship may be formed by fighting. For that reason, he will continue fighting. He finds fighting battles to be honorable and thus, dislikes those who show a lack of respect toward a fight such as Bartolomeo. He is very honorable and dislikes attacking an opponent from the back, but he will do it if said opponent is not worthy of his respect, as he did to Bartolomeo, who was urinating on the side of the fighting ring and was, in Hack's opinion, not taking the battle seriously.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: "Hundredth Dan" Hack is a fish-man and a member of the Revolutionary Army, which he serves as combat instructor. He went to Dressrosa to investigate the arms trafficking there and competed at the Corrida Colosseum for…

entities.name: Hack
entities.description:
Hack was one of the archaeologists of Ohara.

Hack was an average sized man, with small eyes and a round nose. He had curly hair, and wore a striped short sleeved shirt, with light colored pants.

Not much is known of Hack's personality, but he did seem to care for knowledge, as he tried to save the library of Ohara.

As an archaeologist of Ohara, it can be assumed that Hack was able to decipher the poneglyphs.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hack was one of the archaeologists of Ohara.

entities.name: Hajrudin
entities.description:
Hajrudin is a giant warrior described as being from the "new generation" of Elbaph. He is the illegitimate son of the late King Harald and his original lover Ida, as well as the older half-brother of Prince Loki.

A century after the Giant Warrior Pirates' disbandment, Hajrudin formed the New Giant Warrior Pirates in an attempt to revive the legendary crew; they formerly served as S-class pirate mercenaries for Buggy's Pirate Dispatch Organization. Hajrudin competed in the Corrida Colosseum on Dressrosa, where he would team up with Monkey D. Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates to overthrow Donquixote Doflamingo's regime. Following this, Hajrudin swore his crew's allegiance to Luffy and became the captain of the sixth ship of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet.

He is a major ally during the Dressrosa and Elbaph Arcs, and one of the central characters of The Stories of the Self-Proclaimed Straw Hat Grand Fleet Cover Page Serial.

Hajrudin is a muscular giant, well proportioned, and has long dark brown hair, mustache, and beard. He wears a metal helmet (gold in the manga) with protector shades over his eyes. He sports large metal (gold in the manga) with shields on each one. He also wears a pair of black underwear covered by a skirt of brown leather strips. He also has a gold belt buckle, and sports big black boots. After leaving Buggy's Delivery, Hajrudin wears armor plates over his belt and below his chest, a thick fur cape, and bigger vambraces.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hajrudin is a giant warrior described as being from the "new generation" of Elbaph. He is the illegitimate son of the late King Harald and his original lover Ida, as well as the older half-brother of Prince Loki.

entities.name: Hakowan
entities.description:
Hakowan is Wapol's pet dog, acquired after Wapol was permanently deposed from Drum Island.

Hakowan used to be a regular dog with small beady eyes and a tongue sticking out, similar to Chouchou, but smaller in size and without a frown.

After Wapol altered him with his Baku Baku no Mi abilities, he now has a box for a head and lenses for eyes.

Hakowan is somewhat disrespectful of others, since he urinated on Wapol when he first met him and kept doing so occasionally. Despite this, he is loyal to the former king, as he stood by his side through the entire cover story and beyond.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hakowan is Wapol's pet dog, acquired after Wapol was permanently deposed from Drum Island.

entities.name: Hakugan
entities.description:
Hakugan is the helmsman of the Heart Pirates.

Hakugan is an average-sized man with light brown hair. He covers his face with a white mask featuring a smile design, and like most members of the Heart Pirates, he wears a white boiler suit with the crew's jolly roger on the left breast.

In One Piece novel Law: The Hour of Kikoku, it is revealed that he wears his mask to hide severe burn scars.

Hakugan is loyal to his crew and captain, listening to his orders to the letter.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hakugan is the helmsman of the Heart Pirates.

entities.name: Ham Burger
entities.description:
Ham Burger is the king of the Ballywood Kingdom, acting as chairman of the most recent Levely.

Ham Burger is a stern-looking older man with prominent cheekbones, a pointy pink nose, and a square jaw. He has bushy black hair and beard.

He wears a black suit with a white frilly shirt and a dark blue bow tie. He also has white gloves and a blue top hat with red stars.

Ham Burger appears to be a man of conviction, as even though he walks slowly, he has stated that he has never turned around.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Ham Burger is the king of the Ballywood Kingdom, acting as chairman of the most recent Levely.

entities.name: Hamburg
entities.description:
Hamburg is a combatant of the Foxy Pirates and the leader of the Groggy Monsters. Alongside Porche, he is one of Foxy's last remaining crewmates.

Due to his actions, he is a major antagonist during the Long Ring Long Land Arc.

Hamburg is a huge gorilla-like human who is almost always seen laughing. He wears the typical clothing of a Foxy Pirate from the mask to the long-sleeved gloves. He is the smallest member of the Groggy Monsters. He also wears a leopard patterned scarf. In the 4kids version of the game One Piece: Pirates Carnival, Hamburg has very dark skin and wears red instead of blue.

Hamburg is very unintelligent, similar to his fellow Groggy Monsters. He laughs at anything, whether it is his crew cheating or his depressed captain. He also laughs when he is nervous, as seen when the Straw Hats are deciding who to pick for their crew after the last round of the Davy Back Fight. Like the rest of the Foxy Pirates, he is quite dishonest and cheats whenever the opportunity presents itself.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hamburg is a combatant of the Foxy Pirates and the leader of the Groggy Monsters. Alongside Porche, he is one of Foxy's last remaining crewmates.

entities.name: Hamlet
entities.description:
Hamlet is a Shinuchi in the Beasts Pirates. After being tamed by Tama, he became an ally of the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance.

Due to the nature of his SMILE transformation, Hamlet has an entire giraffe's body growing from his backside starting from the neck, thus leaving his main body hanging several meters in the air. He has long, shaggy bright green hair and possesses the ears and ossicones of a giraffe. He wears a regal-looking cloak that leaves his chest exposed and has pronounced shoulder pads, dark gloves, and also wears giraffe-printed pants and boots with spurs.

Hamlet is very cocky, speaking in a condescending tone to his underlings and being confident that he would easily deal with the threats they were afraid of.

As a Shinuchi, Hamlet has authority over the lower-ranking members of the Beasts Pirates.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hamlet is a Shinuchi in the Beasts Pirates. After being tamed by Tama, he became an ally of the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance.

entities.name: Hammond
entities.description:
Hammond is a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Daggertooth_pike_conger Daggertooth pike conger] fish-Man and a member of the now disbanded New Fish-Man Pirates.

He serves as a supporting antagonist in the Fish-Man Island Arc.

Hammond is a slim-looking bright yellow skinned Fish-Man with medium-length, puffy orange hair and a long and squarish neck with a small beard. His facial features are quite sinister: they include a long and sharp beak-like muzzle, razor-like teeth, and dark, glaring eyes. On his neck he has the tattoo of the Arlong Pirates symbol near his left shoulder, in honor of Arlong and his ideals. He also wears the New Fish-Man Pirates tattoo on the right side of his abdominals.

Hammond wears a long-sleeved black coat with a striped undershirt, both of which he keeps open to display his tattoos. Hammond wears shin-high, frayed white pants with a mint-green sash and black sandals. On his head he has a black fedora and earrings on both ears.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hammond is a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Daggertooth_pike_conger Daggertooth pike conger] fish-Man and a member of the now disbanded New Fish-Man Pirates.

entities.name: Hanafuda
entities.description:
Hanafuda, also known as the "King of Lizards", was a former Warlord of the Sea and affiliate of the Beasts Pirates who was defeated by Portgas D. Ace four years ago. Following his expulsion and eventual death at the hands of rival pirates, his Warlord position was given to Bartholomew Kuma. He was also the father of Ulti and Page One.

Hanafuda was an extremely tall and muscular man with sharp teeth. He had thick light-colored hair, partly coming out from under a dark, pointed hat that covered most of his face.

Hanafuda wore a long, knee-length, dark jacket that he kept unbuttoned and prominent, curved shoulder pads. He wore metal gloves on both hands, a belt that crossed his chest diagonally, light-colored trousers with irregular rectangular patterns with a wide metal belt over another fur-lined one, and tall dark boots.

Hanafuda had an interest in collecting Ancient Zoan Devil Fruits. He was a man captivated by strong individuals as he formed a partnership with Kaidou after clashing with him and for their shared goal, believing that the Emperor would be the next Pirate King. This admiration for Kaidou was strong enough for him to entrust the Emperor with his own children, who he apparently loved.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hanafuda, also known as the "King of Lizards", was a former Warlord of the Sea and affiliate of the Beasts Pirates who was defeated by Portgas D. Ace four years ago. Following his expulsion and eventual death at the…

entities.name: Hangan
entities.description:
Hangan is an infamous New World pirate captain who allied with Whitebeard.

Hangan is a man with an abnormally long neck, and blue-grey hair. His cheekbones are square, along with parts of his forehead. He sports a dark coat with a white fur lined hood. He also has a black cowboy hat, and a spotted shirt under his coat.

His personality is not known, but he seems to care about Ace as he was willing to risk his life to save him from execution instead of fleeing through the path he had cleared that Whitebeard with his power.

Hangan is a fearsome pirate who has managed to achieve an infamous reputation in the New World, and to make an alliance with Whitebeard. It is still unknown what abilities and weapons he possesses.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hangan is an infamous New World pirate captain who allied with Whitebeard.

entities.name: Hanger
entities.description:
Hanger is an employee at Robecca Hanberg, a clothing store in Loguetown. Nami tried on all of his best clothes, but did not buy any.

Hanger is a normal-sized man, with black hair, with part that resembles a clothes hanger. He has a large forehead, and thick black eyebrows. He has a round, long nose that goes down, and a black mustache that curls up. He wears a purple vest with vertical lines on it, with a pink long-sleeved shirt underneath, and a light green tie. He also has black pants.

He was an enthusiastic man that enjoyed customers visiting his shop. He has displayed patience towards customers, as shown when he was later upset at Nami for walking out of the shop after trying on all of his clothes, but still bid her farewell in a nice manner.

While Nami was trying on the clothes in his store, Hanger kept complimenting her on how good she looked. After letting Nami try on all of the clothes in his store, Hanger prepared to checkout and asked if she was going to buy it all. However, she simply declared that she was not interested in anything and wanted something more casual to travel in. Upset by her decision, Hanger was seen crying, but he still asked for her to please come again.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hanger is an employee at Robecca Hanberg, a clothing store in Loguetown. Nami tried on all of his best clothes, but did not buy any.

entities.name: Hanji
entities.description:
Hanji is a resident of Wano Country who has been running a pawn shop for over 10 years.

Hanji is a portly man with a thick neck, drooping eyes, a large mouth, and a thin mustache. He has chin-length brown hair that curls outward on the sides, and he has a topknot. Hanji wears a teal kimono with green rippled patterning, and a burgundy coat.

Little is known about Hanji's personality. He initially had trouble recalling who purchased the blueprints to Kaidou's fortress from him.

Ten years ago, Hanji purchased the blueprints to Kaidou's fortress from Minatomo.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hanji is a resident of Wano Country who has been running a pawn shop for over 10 years.

entities.name: Hanji
entities.description:
Hanji is a former prisoner of Udon's Prisoner Mine.

Hanji is a middle-aged man with tanned skin and a scar over his left eye. He has lavender-colored hair and is mostly bold at the top apart from a orange flame-like mohawk. At Udon, he wears the standard prisoner outfit.

In the anime, he wears a red kimono after discarding the prison uniform.

Hanji believes that there is no freedom in Wano Country and is willing to obey the Beasts Pirates rather than rebel. He does not want to be given "unnecessary" hope and cries tears of anguish while restraining Luffy. In the anime, he also showed himself to be a rather restless person, which forced Hyougoro to calm him down.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hanji is a former prisoner of Udon's Prisoner Mine.

entities.name: Hannyabal
entities.description:
Hannyabal is the warden of Impel Down. Formerly the Vice Warden, he was promoted to Magellan's position following the mass breakout.

Due to his actions and role, he is a major antagonist in the Impel Down Arc.

Hannyabal is a large pot-bellied man that resembles a cross between a demon and an Egyptian pharaoh. On the one hand, his face is reminding of a mask, with the brow ridge shaped like horns and large jawline; on the other hand, he has a long chin much like a pharaoh's false beard and wears a with yellow and green stripes. Like all Impel Down personnel, he wears small bat-like wings on his back and carries a pitchfork around, in addition to his personal weapon Kessui.

Twenty-two years before the main events, when Shiki escaped the prison, Hannyabal wore the standard militaristic white uniform like other normal guards. He already wore the nemes. As Vice Warden, he used to go bare-chested.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hannyabal is the warden of Impel Down. Formerly the Vice Warden, he was promoted to Magellan's position following the mass breakout.

entities.name: Hanzo
entities.description:
Hanzo is a ninja and a member of the Beasts Pirates. He previously was a member of the Orochi Oniwabanshu which served the shogun of Wano Country, Kurozumi Orochi.

Due to his actions and role, he is a minor antagonist in the Wano Country Arc.

Hanzo is a very large and thickset man. He wears a yellow mask over his face that only exposes his eyes, and has a skull design on the forehead. He also wears a yellow kimono with shuriken designs on it and a light green scarf around his neck, and his entire body below his head appears to be covered in dark green netting.

Like the other members of the Orochi Oniwabanshu, Hanzo is loyal to the shogun Orochi and is dedicated to his job. While appearing calm most of the time he is on the job, he became gripped by fear when he encountered the renowned kunoichi Shinobu.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hanzo is a ninja and a member of the Beasts Pirates. He previously was a member of the Orochi Oniwabanshu which served the shogun of Wano Country, Kurozumi Orochi.

entities.name: Happa Yamao
entities.description:
Happa Yamao is a civilian of Water 7 whom Usopp bought wood and supplies from in order to repair the Going Merry. He is an old bandit turned carpenter who moved to Water 7 from the "Gourmet City", Pucci.

Happa is a tall fat man, easily towering over Usopp, with spiky dark hair and a beard of the same shape. He has a scar under his right eye. He also wears an unbuttoned blue collared shirt with a brown leaf design on it, with a white shirt beneath it.

He appears to be a kind man, as he gave Usopp some rice balls when he realized that Usopp was hungry and he was willing to take what little money Usopp had for him despite it not being enough to pay for what he bought.

As a carpenter, he has at least some skill in carpentry.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Happa Yamao is a civilian of Water 7 whom Usopp bought wood and supplies from in order to repair the Going Merry. He is an old bandit turned carpenter who moved to Water 7 from the "Gourmet City", Pucci.

entities.name: Happygun
entities.description:
Happygun is an infamous New World pirate captain who allied with Whitebeard.

Happygun is a tall man with long black hair, a long pointed nose, and a triple pointed chin. He wears a purple coat with pink inner edges that exposes his chest.

In his original concept art, he wore a light colored coat with light colored buttons and lines at the end of the sleeves over a light colored vest underneath. Under the vest, he wore a button up white shirt. He also has a light colored sash and dark colored pants with long boots that go to his thighs.

Since Happygun was willing to put his life on the line to save Ace from execution, it can be deduced that Happygun is a person that values loyalty and friendship. Furthermore, since he was willing to brave the fight against Marine Headquarters, it can be concluded that Happygun is a daring and fearless pirate captain.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Happygun is an infamous New World pirate captain who allied with Whitebeard.

entities.name: Hara
entities.description:
Hara is a resident who lives in the Flower Capital of Wano Country.

Hara is a stocky man with a double chin and lumps under and above his eyes. He has long, curly brown hair which is tied in a topknot but loose on the sides. He wears light green kimono with yellow dots and light blue line patterns, as well as a gray cape with green leaf patterns.

Hara is a timid man who is visibly afraid of the consequences of talking negatively about Shogun Orochi. He is also easily scared by stories such as Kyoshiro's retelling of the "vengeful ghosts" interpretation of Toki's prophecy. However, he seems somewhat curious as he woke Kyoshiro up to finish his story.

Hara was present at Kyoshiro's residence when the latter started criticizing Shogun Kurozumi Orochi for fearing vengeance by "ghosts" of the Kouzuki Family. Hara attempted to stop Kyoshiro from speaking loudly but was rebuffed. When Kyoshiro fell asleep in the middle of his story, Hara woke him up to finish it.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hara is a resident who lives in the Flower Capital of Wano Country.

entities.name: Harald
entities.description:
Harald was the most recent king of Elbaph and a member of the Knights of God. He is the father of Hajrudin and Loki, born respectively from Ida, his original lover, and Estrid, his official spouse.

Celebrated as Elbaph's greatest king, Harald spent most of his reign campaigning to undo his homeland's reputation as a warmongering nation and affiliate it with the World Government. Among his local accomplishments were the construction of the Walrus School and the several branch routes that connect Elbaph's villages together. However, 14 years ago Harald was betrayed by the World Government, which corrupted him in an attempt to enslave his subjects. Despite this, Harald foiled their plot by having his son Loki kill him, though the true reason for his death would not become known by the rest of Elbaph until the present day.

Harald's life and death make him a major figure in the events of the Elbaph Arc.

Harald was a broad-shouldered muscular giant who sported jagged eyebrows and a curved double-line tattoo framing his left temple and going through his left eye. Due to his lineage as a descendant of ancient giants, Harald was larger than most modern giants and was born with a pair of horns poking from his head.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Harald was the most recent king of Elbaph and a member of the Knights of God. He is the father of Hajrudin and Loki, born respectively from Ida, his original lover, and Estrid, his official spouse.

entities.name: Haredas
entities.description:
Haredas is an old man who lives in Weatheria. He was Nami's tutor in weather-manipulation during the timeskip.

Haredas is an old man who has a long, white beard and long, straight hair of the same color, that fall on his back. He wears a blue pointed hat that matches his wizard-like robe, which stretches down to his feet. In the manga, he is fairly tall, whereas in the anime, he is rather short. Sometimes, Haredas' eyes are shown large and shining, much like Nyon's when she admires Hancock's cuteness.

Haredas has shown to have a rather carefree upbeat personality, smiling and seemingly enjoying himself mostly. He is also slightly absent-minded and bumbling and tends to repeat certain many things he already said and introduced before. Also, he is shown to be very patient and even after Nami kept (inappropriately) hitting him, and still maintained his friendly attitude with her. He has a habit to address to people repeatedly "oi, oi, oi, oi, oi, oi, oi, oi, oi, oi" ("hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey") instead of only one time.

Haredas is very patient with Nami, despite her ungrateful and, at times, physically abusive attitude toward him. He was shocked by her idea of using the Weather Ball as a weapon, but he gladly mentored her in the science of Weatheria regardless. When Nami returned to her crew on Sabaody Archipelago, Haredas commented that Weatheria would be lonelier without her. He and the other scientists want to impress her, as seen from their choice to dress better after she left.

entities.short_description: Haredas is an old man who lives in Weatheria. He was Nami's tutor in weather-manipulation during the timeskip.

entities.name: Hareji
entities.description:
Hareji is a former prisoner of Udon's prisoner mines. In the past, he was a resident of the Flower Capital. In the anime credits and closed captions, he was named .

Hareji is a man of average height with a crescent-shaped scar on the left side of his face. He has turquoise hair formed in a pompadour at the front and a topknot at the back. At Udon, he wore a standard prisoner outfit.

In the anime, he wears a black and yellow striped kimono with a white after discarding the prison uniform.

41 years ago, in the anime, Hareji wore a lilac kimono. In the manga, he was dressed in a light-colored kimono with a pattern of four squares that form a larger square. In those days, he also did not have a scar on his face.

entities.short_description: Hareji is a former prisoner of Udon's prisoner mines. In the past, he was a resident of the Flower Capital. In the anime credits and closed captions, he was named .

entities.name: Haritsu Kendiyo
entities.description:
Haritsu Kendiyo is a pirate captain whose crew was captured by the Kid Pirates as they tried to escape back to Paradise from the New World.

Kendiyo is a large man, bigger than Kid, and slightly fat as well. He has bushy brown hair and a scraggly beard, and wore a red captain's coat over a white shirt and brown pants. He has a sword over his back.

Kendiyo is shown to be a weak-hearted pirate. After his defeat and capture by the Kid Pirates, he wanted to run away and return to Paradise with his crew.

He seems to be very caring toward his crew as he begged Kid to let him and his crew escape alive from the New World and return to Paradise.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Haritsu Kendiyo is a pirate captain whose crew was captured by the Kid Pirates as they tried to escape back to Paradise from the New World.

entities.name: Haruta
entities.description:
Haruta is the former 12th division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates.

Haruta has a crop of short brown hair, blue eyes, and is fairly short. He wears a green and white 16th century-style ruffed outfit with white tights and carries a saber whose hand guard resembles the ruffles of his shirt.

Haruta was loyal to Whitebeard, and wanted to save Portgas D. Ace at Marineford. Haruta cried when Ace died, showing that he cared for him.

As the commander of the 12th division of the Whitebeard Pirates, Haruta has authority over the lower-ranking subordinates. He is presumably very strong: this statement was bolstered when Jinbe remarked that all of the Whitebeard commanders have great strength.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Haruta is the former 12th division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates.

entities.name: Hasami
entities.description:
Hasami is a giant desert crab from Sandy Island, and a friend of Matsuge the camel. Originally an inhabitant of the deserts near Rainbase, he currently works as an employee of Ukkari Hot-Spring Island.

He serves as an ally to the Straw Hat Pirates during the Arabasta Arc.

Hasami is a red-shelled crab the size of a small house, with a human-like mouth in a perpetual leer. His claws are sharply asymmetric, with the right being much larger than the left. While he aided the Straw Hats, he wore a pair of reins hooked to the corners of his mouth, and bore a thick green matting atop his shell; it remains unknown whether the latter was some sort of tarp, or naturally-growing plant life.

Under the employment of Ukkari Hot-Spring Island, he now wears a howdah-esque carriage (large enough to hold dozens of average-sized humans) shaped after a bus driver's cap; its "hatband" is decorated with a scissors emblem, and equipped with a massive flashlight. His face also bears the resort's logo—UKKARI bisected by an old-fashioned rendering of the kanji for .
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hasami is a giant desert crab from Sandy Island, and a friend of Matsuge the camel. Originally an inhabitant of the deserts near Rainbase, he currently works as an employee of Ukkari Hot-Spring Island.

entities.name: Hatcha
entities.description:
Hatcha is a member of the Numbers in the Beasts Pirates, representing the number "eight".

Due to his actions and role, he is a minor antagonist in the Wano Country Arc.

Like the other Numbers, Hatcha is an enormous humanoid larger than a typical giant, standing at a height of 36.7 meters. Like his fellow Numbers and most of the Beasts Pirates in general, Hatcha has a pair of horns atop his head. While some of the other Numbers have more animal-like features, Hatcha looks very humanoid, having peach skin, a set of rounded teeth and indigo hair arranged in a bowl cut. On the left side of his abdomen is a tattoo of the daiji "捌", which means eight.

He wears a yellow track-jacket that remains unzipped, leaving his bare chest exposed, dark pants and light shoes with laces. He also possesses a pair of oval sunglasses.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hatcha is a member of the Numbers in the Beasts Pirates, representing the number "eight".

entities.name: Hatchan
entities.description:
Hatchan, nicknamed , is an fish-man who was an officer of the Arlong Pirates before their defeat, and a member of the Sun Pirates before that.

After the rest of the Arlong Pirates were arrested, Hatchan was the sole member to escape, and went on many adventures which ended in him opening a floating takoyaki restaurant and meeting up again with the Straw Hat Pirates.

He was one of the major antagonists of the Arlong Park Arc. He is also the central character of the Hatchan's Sea-Floor Stroll Cover Page Serial. Later, along with Camie, he is one of the main supporting characters of both the Sabaody Archipelago and Fish-Man Island Arcs as an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates.

Hatchan, being an octopus fish-man, has eight appendages (six arms and two legs) and an octopus-like face. He has pink skin and grey hair styled into five spikes. By the time he had become a takoyaki salesman, he had a second row of spikes. He has a muscular build and suction cups on his six arms, which he can use to cling on to walls. Hatchan has a tattoo in the shape of a sun on his forehead, as a result of being in the Sun Pirates.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hatchan, nicknamed , is an fish-man who was an officer of the Arlong Pirates before their defeat, and a member of the Sun Pirates before that.

entities.name: Hattori
entities.description:
Hattori is Rob Lucci's pet pigeon, and initially acted as the target of his ventriloquism.

Hattori is a white pigeon and is always seen wearing a light red tie while Lucci was undercover as a shipwright and a black one afterwards. He wore a light green coat identical to his master's while Lucci wore his during the Sea Train ride to Enies Lobby and the meeting at the Tower of Justice.

After the timeskip, Hattori wears a white coat and hat resembling those worn by Lucci, though with the addition of a white necktie.

Why Hattori is with Lucci is unknown considering the man's reputation as a heartless mass-murderer, though Lucci has had him since he was a child. He apparently is not afraid of Lucci and is very loyal to him, as he stays close to his master even in dangerous situations like the Buster Call. He even attempted to bandage him after his fight with Luffy and was happy when Lucci finally woke up in the hospital in St. Poplar. When Lucci is not fighting, Hattori is usually perched on his master's right shoulder.

entities.short_description: Hattori is Rob Lucci's pet pigeon, and initially acted as the target of his ventriloquism.

entities.name: Hawkman
entities.description:
Hawkman is a man of average size. Due to the SMILE that he consumed, a large green hawk is present on the back of his body, acting as a sort of hood over his head, and possessing large wings. Unlike other Gifters, he does not possess a pair of horns. He wears a blue-green fur coat over his shoulders, red pants, brown boots, and a belt bearing the symbol of the Beasts Pirates.

Like most pirates, Hawkman seems to revel in causing violence and chaos. He had little issue with blowing up various ships and infrastructure on Orochi's orders, and didn't hesitate to gloat about it when given the chance. He also showed great confidence in Kaidou's abilities, going as far as to completely disregard the Straw Hats and their allies' attempts to overthrow him.

Hawkman seems quite capable of fighting, given his status as a Gifter, as well as his confidence in his own strength. However, when confronted by three members of the worst generation, he was unable to harm any of them.

As a Gifter, Hawkman has consumed a SMILE fruit, giving him the power of flight through the hawk on his back.

entities.name: Headband Catfish Village Elder
entities.description:
The Headband Catfish Village Elder is the chief of the Headband Catfish Village.

The Elder is an old catfish with a droopy face, long beard, and thick eyebrows. Like all other villagers, he wears a carpenter's coat and a rope headband.

The Elder cares deeply about his village and was sad about its destruction by a sunken ship. He was a kind person who encouraged his hungry villagers, and even when Hatchan treated him to takoyaki, he prioritized others getting food first.

Like the rest of his village, the Elder is a skilled carpenter. Alongside his villagers, they were able to build Takoyaki 8 overnight.

entities.short_description: The Headband Catfish Village Elder is the chief of the Headband Catfish Village.

entities.name: Heat
entities.description:
Heat has long light blue, shaggy hair. His mouth stretches to the sides of his face like a Glasgow smile. He has black sunken eyes and visible bone ridges on his forehead. There are stitched scars at his chin, mouth-line, and the high point of his cheeks. Tattoos resembling barbed wire run along his shoulders, arms, and neck.

He wears a dark blue corset laced with red string, red pants with an armored pad over his right leg, and long brown boots. The looped, golden belt on his pants matches Wire's.

Heat holds high respect for his captain, Eustass Kid. This is seen when he exclaimed "Master Kid!" out of shock, when his captain was shot in the leg by a Pacifista. Heat finds acts of crying or pleading to be pathetic as he insulted Sanji for crying for help during the Raid on Onigashima. Despite this, Heat proved to be a hypocrite as seen when he pleaded to Shanks for his captain and crew to be spared after the latter was defeated by him.

Heat has the ability to breathe fire; how he does it has yet to be explained. Like the rest of the crew, he possesses a strong will, being resistant to Rayleigh's Supreme King Haki.

entities.name: Helmeppo
entities.description:
Lieutenant Commander Helmeppo is a Marine officer and the son of ex-Marine Captain "Axe-Hand" Morgan. Once a civilian who shamelessly exploited his father's status, he (together with Koby) underwent extensive training under Vice Admiral Garp to become a full-fledged serviceman, currently holding the rank of lieutenant commander. He is also a member of the secret group known as SWORD.

Due to his actions during his initial appearance, he can be considered a supporting antagonist of the Romance Dawn Arc. He and Koby are also the protagonists of Diary of Koby-Meppo Cover Page Serial.

Helmeppo is a lanky, average-sized young man with a distinctive cleft chin and light blonde hair.

Originally, he wore his hair in a bizarre mushroom-shaped style, coupled with flashy leisure suits (and what appeared to be a rubber-band ring on his left hand). After his father was ousted from power, he was "demoted" to a standard Marine chore-boy uniform.

entities.name: Heppoko
entities.description:
Heppoko is a member of the Alvida Pirates and the triplet brother of Peppoko and Poppoko.

Heppoko is a tanned skinned man, with a large forehead and short black hair. He also has a black mustache and goatee. He wears a green short sleeved shirt.

Typical of his thuggish appearance, Heppoko likes to intimidate Koby due to his low status and timid personality. He fears Alvida, and tried to deny slacking off (which she hates) when she found him doing so. He, like the rest of the crew, calls her beautiful simply to avoid her iron mace.

Heppoko wielded a sword against Luffy, though he broke it.

entities.name: Hera
entities.description:
Hera is a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum that competed for the Mera Mera no Mi.

Hera is a tall man with thick muscles. He is bare-chested and barefoot. He wears a spiked ridge helmet, studded wristbands, and a dark paludamentum. The back of his paludamentum bears his name and participant number. He also carries a longsword.

He is seen wielding a sword in the gladiator waiting room, but it is unknown how well he wields it.

Hera was in the waiting room when Luffy arrived, waiting for his turn to fight.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hera is a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum that competed for the Mera Mera no Mi.

entities.name: Heracles
entities.description:
Heracles is a strange warrior that used to reside in the Greenstone forest in the Boin Archipelago. He trained Usopp in the use of Pop Greens for two years.

Heracles is dressed in a beetle-stylized armor that looks like a hero costume with a mask that covers his face, a mantle, and a purple cape. He has a round-shaped body with relatively thin arms and legs.

He has an odd habit of adding "n" to people's names (a Japanese quirk often done to show friendship), as well as at the end of sentences (in Japanese). For example, he called , and he himself is . He also has a habit of repeatedly introducing himself. Heracles has a usual laid-back attitude, but is quick to react when he senses dangers. He also seems to be an easy target for flattery and compliments.

The two share a very positive relationship as Heracles is very friendly towards Usopp and was quick to help him when he first arrived on Boin Archipelago.

entities.short_description: Heracles is a strange warrior that used to reside in the Greenstone forest in the Boin Archipelago. He trained Usopp in the use of Pop Greens for two years.

entities.name: Hewitt
entities.description:
Hewitt is the cook of the former Bellamy Pirates.

He wears a blue coat and has tan skin. His hair is black and has an angry expression. He also has the number "21" tattooed on the right side of his forehead.

He seems to be loyal to the Bellamy Pirates, and if so, Doflamingo as well.

Hewitt is seen using a sword during him and his crew's fight with the Saruyama Alliance. As a Cook, he must have some form of culinary skill.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hewitt is the cook of the former Bellamy Pirates.

entities.name: Hidayu
entities.description:
Hidayu is a samurai who allied with the Kouzuki Family. After waiting 20 years for the return of the Nine Red Scabbards, he affiliated with the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance to raid Onigashima.

Hidayu is a stocky, tan-skinned man with navy blue hair that is shaved, a slight widow's peak, and think eyebrows, a mustache and goatee that look like kumadori makeup. He wears a brown kimono with an orange circular pattern on it. He sometimes wears a white scarf over his head or a light-colored cloak with a zig-zag pattern on the sleeves. He has a reverse crescent moon tattoo on his ankle.

Hidayu is loyal to the Kouzuki Family and often maintains a stern, stoic expression. He was hesitant to believe the Kouzuki Family had returned to usurp Orochi, but was faithful after being imprisoned. He broke his normal expression when he joined the Onigashima raid after Denjiro freed him, smiling and cheering, and again after Big Mom attacked his comrades, gritting his teeth and showing concern.

As a samurai, Hidayu is likely proficient at combat. However, he has not been seen carrying a weapon.

entities.short_description: Hidayu is a samurai who allied with the Kouzuki Family. After waiting 20 years for the return of the Nine Red Scabbards, he affiliated with the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance to raid Onigashima.

entities.name: Higuma
entities.description:
Higuma was a bandit and the leader of the , active in the mountains of Dawn Island. He was the first antagonist to be introduced in the series, and the first of three in the Romance Dawn Arc (third of three in the anime).

Higuma was a tall, well-tanned man with black hair, a black goatee, and an X-shaped scar above his right eye. He wore a long red coat over a white shirt, black trousers, and a golden necklace.

Higuma was an arrogant, brutish man, always ready to boast about himself and brutalize the weak, including children. Having lived inland for all his life, he developed a particularly low opinion of pirates upon meeting the Red Hair Pirates, deeming them all "cowards" when their captain refused to be baited into a fight.

Like most brutes, he had little courage of his own, and reacted poorly to genuine danger. When the Red Hair Pirates seriously fought—and effortlessly crushed—his henchmen, and again when the Lord of the Coast attacked him, he could only panic and scramble for his own life.

entities.name: Hikkomitsukumai
entities.description:
Hikkomitsukumai is a retainer of the Kurozumi Family and a prison guard who lives in the Flower Capital of Wano Country.

Hikkomitsukumai is an averaged sized man. He has a somewhat flat face, with long, blond hair, tied up in a topknot. He wears a light blue kimono with a patterned cloak over his shoulders.

Hikkomitsukumai doesn't seem to take the Shogun very seriously, scoffing at the idea that he would ever admit to making a mistake.

As a prison guard, Hikkomitsukumai must have some fighting ability to keep the prisoners in check.

entities.short_description: Hikkomitsukumai is a retainer of the Kurozumi Family and a prison guard who lives in the Flower Capital of Wano Country.

entities.name: Hikoichi
entities.description:
Hikoichi is a member of the Arabasta Kingdom's Super Spot-Billed Duck Troops.

Hikoichi is a pale yellow Super Spot-Billed Duck. He is slightly shorter than average, and wears a kasa, a straw pelt, and a green tie.

Like every member of the Duck Troops, Hikoichi is loyal to Karoo.

Hikoichi is one of the fastest runners in the Arabasta Kingdom, owing to his being a Super-Spot Billed Duck and his position in the Duck Troops. Like the other members, he is well-trained in carrying riders, and is well acclimated to Arabasta's desert environment.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hikoichi is a member of the Arabasta Kingdom's Super Spot-Billed Duck Troops.

entities.name: Hildon
entities.description:
Hildon was a Wild Zombie that resembled a stitched-up vampire. He appeared to act as a messenger in-between the members of Thriller Bark's Mysterious Four, reporting to them noteworthy events that were happening throughout the island ship before it fell.

Hildon had a bat-like body covered in bandages. He wore a dark purple cape that doubled as his wings and enabled him to fly. He had talons capable of suspending him upside down. He had sharp teeth with vampiric fangs, red claws, a long and stitched nose, pointed ears, and his eyes, if not sunken, seemed to have strange tattoos encircling them. Above his right eye was the number 21, and above his left was a stitch trailing from his eye to his hairline.

When he first appeared, he carried a very large long-necked bottle of what appeared to be liquor on his back. He somewhat resembled a vampire.

For the most part, Hildon was amiable and polite when interacting with others casually.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.

entities.name: Himuro
entities.description:
Himuro is a samurai and a member of the Beasts Pirates. He was previously a member of the Mimawarigumi, which served as the police force of the shogun of Wano Country, Kurozumi Orochi.

Due to his actions and role, he is a minor antagonist in the Wano Country Arc.

Himuro is a very tall and rotund man with gray skin covered in small dots, making him resemble a statue. His bald head is abnormally large and ovoid, and his earlobes are wider than average. He has a lumpy nose, droopy eyes, and is always seen with a frown.

Himuro wears a solid beige kimono, dark green with a light green sash, a large kasa, and dark purple sandals. As part of his Mimawarigumi uniform, he also wears a white cloak over his shoulders which has a jagged black design at the end of the sleeves and bottom, as well as a thin purple rope tied around his shoulders and torso.

entities.short_description: Himuro is a samurai and a member of the Beasts Pirates. He was previously a member of the Mimawarigumi, which served as the police force of the shogun of Wano Country, Kurozumi Orochi.

entities.name: Hinokizu
entities.description:
Hinokizu is the name given to a mysterious man possessing a burn scar. He is rumored to possess the Road Poneglyph that was once on Fish-Man Island and whose location is now unknown. He is said to sail on an all-black ship.

Hinokizu has yet to make a confirmed appearance. It is only known that he bears a burn scar or scars somewhere on his body, injuries from which his epithet was derived.

Nothing is known of Hinokizu's personality, beyond the claim that he uses his ability to destroy any ship that comes near his own. His motives for doing so are unknown.

Due to being rumored to possess one of the Road Poneglyphs, Hinokizu is a very influential figure as pirates, particularly the Four Emperors themselves, are seeking to find him in order to obtain the information which will allow them to reach Laugh Tale. Eustass Kid even went as far as to claim that he "could be the key to the war for One Piece", suggesting that without knowing who he is or his whereabouts, no one would be able to find the One Piece, making him invaluable to anyone aiming at claiming it.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hinokizu is the name given to a mysterious man possessing a burn scar. He is rumored to possess the Road Poneglyph that was once on Fish-Man Island and whose location is now unknown. He is said to sail on an all-black…

entities.name: Hippan Natte
entities.description:
Hippan Natte is a Waiter of the Beasts Pirates who serves as a guard in the Prisoner Mine of the Udon region.

Natte is a shorter man, with an average build. He has dark hair fashioned like the horns of a bull, and goggles that he wears on his forehead. He wears an open purple shirt that leaves his chest exposed along with a set of gray pauldrons on his shoulders, as well as a pair of blue pants.

Like his fellow Waiters, Natte is without honor, and has no qualms about attacking someone unable to defend himself if it means he can gain glory from it.

Natte was fairly weak, as he was defeated without trouble by Kawamatsu.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hippan Natte is a Waiter of the Beasts Pirates who serves as a guard in the Prisoner Mine of the Udon region.

entities.name: Hippie
entities.description:
Hippie the Skull Curry is the captain of the Endurance Curry Pirates.

Hippie is a man with a light hair and a full beard connected to his sideburns. He wears a top hat with a skull attached to the front and a scarf wrapped around the crown. He also wears striped pants, a belt, a sailor tie and a captain's coat with no shirt.

Hippie dislikes spicy curry and prefers sweet-tasting curry. He is aiming to find the One Piece.

According to his description, Hippie is very powerful.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hippie the Skull Curry is the captain of the Endurance Curry Pirates.

entities.name: Hippo Gentleman
entities.description:
Hippo Gentleman was a Wild Zombie who was the vice commander of the Wild Zombies.

Hippo Gentleman is a large zombie with a hippo head and a human-like body. He has long, thin limbs, a hunched back, and a stocky abdomen. He also has a mustache and the number 28 printed on the right side of his neck. In relation to his name, "Hippo Gentleman", he wears a full suit with a red bowtie. Additionally, his hands are the same color as his head, suggesting that they are covered in hippo skin.

Hippo Gentleman had a brutal personality, as he was willing to attack Nami with intent to kill. He also cared about his fellow zombies, as he tried to strike down Usopp for exorcising Kumashi.

Hippo Gentleman swore allegiance to Gecko Moria as a zombie and to Perona as a Wild Zombie in her garden. Unlike his relationship with them, the Hippo Gentleman fears Absalom's power and, despite not being Absalom's subordinate, listens to him because of it.

entities.short_description: Hippo Gentleman was a Wild Zombie who was the vice commander of the Wild Zombies.

entities.name: Hiriluk
entities.description:
Dr. Hiriluk was a quack doctor from Drum Island, as well as Tony Tony Chopper's father figure. He was also a former thief.

He died seven years ago by drinking an explosive formula—a form of preemptive suicide, as his life was already curtailed by both disease and external threats.

Hiriluk wore mottled pink pants and a black coat over a green shirt. Over his bizarre white hair resembling a cross, he wore a black hat that matched his coat. He had long gray hair arranged in three standing outs, one to each side and one at the top, the latter of which is covered by his hat. He also had a black goatee and mustache.

Hiriluk was a very eccentric man, who would test his experimental medication on unsuspecting patients only for it to backfire, causing the quack doctor to flee. However, he was very caring towards others, as he honestly tried his best to cure them of their afflictions, and never desired any rewards. This also extended to animals, as upon meeting the heavily wounded Chopper, his first instinct was to help the injured soul. Even when Chopper retaliated with violence, Hiriluk did not back down and ended up taking on a fatherly role to the abandoned reindeer. The quack doctor's compassion showed itself when he chose to sacrifice himself rather than let Wapol have his way, as he knew that the country he lived in would eventually recover, with his actions having a lasting effect on many people who knew of his true caring intentions.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Dr. Hiriluk was a quack doctor from Drum Island, as well as Tony Tony Chopper's father figure. He was also a former thief.

entities.name: Hiro Gomon
entities.description:
Hiro Gomon is a member of the Endurance Curry Pirates.

Gomon is a man with a thin dark mustache and round eyeglasses. He wears dark baggy pants, an iron helmet and iron cape, bracelets, and shoes made from iron strips.

Gomon is a sadomasochist who loves torture, mainly inflicting it but also receiving it. He is excited at the prospect of finding the One Piece.

Gomon is heavily armored with an iron cape and helmet.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hiro Gomon is a member of the Endurance Curry Pirates.

entities.name: Hiroshi
entities.description:
Hiroshi is a resident of Bakura Town in Wano Country who runs a restaurant alongside Wakasa; the two of them own a tanuki named Saikoro which the sumo wrestler Urashima forced to be cooked and served to him.

Hiroshi is an older man with dark gray hair that is gathered into a topknot. He wears a vertically-striped gray and dark green kimono.

Hiroshi cares about his customers' satisfaction and will be attentive to them if they express displeasure. While he expressed considerable shock at Urashima's request to cook and serve him the tanuki that he and Wakasa had owned for many years, he was not shown trying to resist the command of the high-status samurai.

As the proprietor of a restaurant, Hiroshi likely possesses skill in cooking.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hiroshi is a resident of Bakura Town in Wano Country who runs a restaurant alongside Wakasa; the two of them own a tanuki named Saikoro which the sumo wrestler Urashima forced to be cooked and served to him.

entities.name: Hitsugisukan
entities.description:
Duke Hitsugisukan is a sheep mink and the former ruler of the Mokomo Dukedom before Inuarashi and Nekomamushi.

Hitsugisukan is a large sheep mink with white wool and black skin. He has curved horns, a walrus mustache, and fluffy beard. He wears a dark colored king's robe and a crown.

Hitsugisukan is very knowledgeable and respectful of traditions of the Mokomo Dukedom.

He also seemed to be very caring for his subjects, as he cried upon learning that Inuarashi and Nekomamushi were alive and safe.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Duke Hitsugisukan is a sheep mink and the former ruler of the Mokomo Dukedom before Inuarashi and Nekomamushi.

entities.description: Ho is a One Piece subject documented on the One Piece Fandom Wiki.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.

entities.name: Hocha
entities.description:
Hocha was one of the archaeologists of Ohara.

Hocha was a tall man, with small eyes and a large nose. He had long black hair, and wore a blue jacket with a black shirt underneath.

He was very loyal to the Ohara archaeologist, and enjoyed studying history. He wanted to find out about the Void History, as he studied the Poneglyph.

As he was an archeologist, it can be assumed he had skill in studying and reading the Poneglyph.
