entities.short_description: Matsuge is a yasa camel who accompanied the Straw Hat Pirates during the Arabasta Arc. He is classified as a Type-A creature, "Big Friendly" and currently works as a member of the Super Spot-Billed Duck Troops.

entities.name: Maujii
entities.description:
Maujii is a dwarf from Tontatta Kingdom and the aide of Princess Mansherry.

Maujii, like all other dwarves, is quite short. He has a white beard and mustache and wears a helmet with a pompom that has goggles on it. He also wears an orange coat, purple gloves, blue pants, and purple boots.

Not much is known about his personality, but he seems to have great care and concern for Princess Mansherry.

Maujii has yet to be seen fighting, but it is likely that he has the strength and speed similar to other dwarves. Sure enough, he ran with such speed that he failed to stop in time, resulting in him ramming open the storage door via sheer force despite his small stature.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Maujii is a dwarf from Tontatta Kingdom and the aide of Princess Mansherry.

entities.name: MAX Marx
entities.description:
MAX Marx is the cook of the former Roger Pirates.

Marx is a tall, muscular man with broad shoulders, large arms, and slim legs. He has medium-length, dark-colored hair, a mustache, a beard, a widow's peak, and prominent lips. He also has a tattoo on his neck and a tattoo that stretches down his left arm.

Marx was shocked at seeing the Sky Island of Skypiea.

As the Roger Pirates' ship cook, he had the responsibility of feeding his captain and the crew.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: MAX Marx is the cook of the former Roger Pirates.

entities.name: Maynard
entities.description:
Maynard the Pursuer is a vice admiral who appears in the Dressrosa Arc. He was registered as a gladiator to compete at the Corrida Colosseum for the Mera Mera no Mi, but was defeated before he could participate.

Maynard is a muscular, broad-chested man with dark hair tied up in a wild ponytail that sticks out to one side. He also has a dark beard and a mustache.

His outfit as a gladiator consists of a dark red cap, studded belt, briefs, a studded band on his left thigh which holds a knife, and sandals that reach just below his knees and are studded down the front. Under his cap he wears sunglasses.

After leaving the colosseum, he wears the typical Marine coat with on the back. His cap is also different, with the word MARINE across the front, though it is still dark-colored unlike the white caps worn by most the Marines. In the anime, it is white.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Maynard the Pursuer is a vice admiral who appears in the Dressrosa Arc. He was registered as a gladiator to compete at the Corrida Colosseum for the Mera Mera no Mi, but was defeated before he could participate.

entities.name: Mayushika
entities.description:
Mayushika is one of the Shandia warriors who fought against Enel.

Mayushika is a bald, tanned man, with dark, red tattoos on his face, upper arms, chest, and knees. He has white wings on his back, like other Shandia, and wears a dirty, white cloth around his waist held up by a grey rope, and it hangs down to his feet. Under the cloth he wears a dark, brown, grass skirt. He also wears the same dial skates worn by Wyper. He carries a polearm that is attached to what appears to be massive, white, animal antlers.

As a Shandia warrior, Mayushika is brave and is proud of his people. He was startled when Nola began to laugh uncontrollably. He was also surprised at Holy's strength, warning his allies that the dog might be trouble.

It is assumed that Mayushika has an inordinate amount of strength, since he is able to handle wielding his heavy weapon fairly easily during his clash against the enforcers. Despite this, he was still easily defeated by Holy.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mayushika is one of the Shandia warriors who fought against Enel.

entities.name: McGuy
entities.description:
"Thunder Lord" McGuy is an infamous New World pirate captain who allied with Whitebeard.

McGuy has a long face with a big nose and prominent chin, along with a defined jawline and wavy blonde hair reaching to his waist, and a black mustache shaped like a lightning bolt. He sports a blue shirt with loose sleeves and ruffled edges under a black vest. Due to his legs not being visible enough in the manga, in the anime he was given dark bermuda shorts and an orange sash decorated by a silver colored ornament with a red jewel in it.

Though little can be said regarding McGuy's personality in the manga, he is shown having huge respect towards Whitebeard instead of fleeing through the path he had cleared with his power. He also seems to be very loyal with high levels of courtesy. In the anime, he was shown to be perceptive enough to see through Sengoku's tactic to lure the pirates in for the Pacifista to attack. McGuy cried tragically after the death of Whitebeard.

McGuy has managed to make himself an infamous reputation in the New World, becoming a subordinate of Whitebeard. Also, he was very observant, as he managed to understand why Whitebeard ordered his subordinates to split up in order to avoid being trapped by the Pacifista. He also avoided injuries from the war.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: "Thunder Lord" McGuy is an infamous New World pirate captain who allied with Whitebeard.

entities.name: McKinley
entities.description:
McKinley is a member of God Guardians (previously known as the White Berets), Skypiea's police force. He initially serves as a minor antagonist in the Skypiea Arc, but later becomes an (indirect) ally to the Straw Hat Pirates.

McKinley is a tall, well-built Skypiean man who bears the typical wings, as well as a small scar under his left eye. He wears the standard White Beret uniform, consisting of the namesake , a short-sleeved shirt, cloud-patterned , and black boots; his rank is distinguished by a cape-like overcoat, similar to those worn by pirate and Marine captains.

Post-timeskip, he has grown a goatee, and parts of his uniform now bear the letters "GG" (presumably standing for "God Guardians").

He appears to be very devoted to Enel, until it is revealed that Enel planned to destroy Skypiea with his Devil Fruit powers.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: McKinley is a member of God Guardians (previously known as the White Berets), Skypiea's police force. He initially serves as a minor antagonist in the Skypiea Arc, but later becomes an (indirect) ally to the Straw Hat…

entities.name: Meadows
entities.description:
Meadows is a gladiator who competed in the Corrida Colosseum for the Mera Mera no Mi.

Meadows is a broad-faced man with a fu manchu mustache. He is seen wearing a spotted feline skin as a hood.

Meadows is rather greedy, having decided to go after the Straw Hat Pirates' bounties instead of helping them like some of the other gladiators did. He later stated that he had been blinded by the money.

However, he is not averse to being humble when he realizes he is wrong, as shown when he apologized to Luffy and promised to defend the Straw Hat from Doflamingo, showing a selfless side.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Meadows is a gladiator who competed in the Corrida Colosseum for the Mera Mera no Mi.

entities.name: Megalo
entities.description:
Megalo is a shark that lives on Fish-Man Island. He is the beloved pet of princess Shirahoshi and former pet of the Neptune Army.

Megalo is a black shark with a white underbelly. He wears a shirt from the Criminal fashion line.

He is several times larger than an average shark, approximately the same size as the Thousand Sunny, though he is still smaller than Neptune. His mouth is also large enough to cram Shirahoshi into it, but apparently causes him great stress.

Despite being a shark, Megalo is very friendly and very loyal since he willingly went through with Luffy's idea of stuffing Shirahoshi in his mouth to sneak her out of Hard-Shell Tower. He also is somewhat protective of Shirahoshi as he was angry at Luffy when he made her sad. He appears to be very secretive since he only told Shirahoshi about Otohime's true killer and not to anyone else.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Megalo is a shark that lives on Fish-Man Island. He is the beloved pet of princess Shirahoshi and former pet of the Neptune Army.

entities.name: Merry
entities.description:
Merry is Kaya's butler, and the original designer of the Going Merry.

He is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Syrup Village Arc.

Merry is a tall, formally dressed butler whose most distinguishing feature is his lamb-themed appearance. His hair is curly like a lamb's fleece and has two lamb horns sticking out of it; these have been seen shorter 20 years before the start of the series. His lips also resemble those of a lamb's. Even his collar has a fleece around it.

After the timeskip, Merry has grown his hair out somewhat longer and has also grown a light mustache and goatee. His horns are also bigger.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Merry is Kaya's butler, and the original designer of the Going Merry.

entities.name: Mezasuzowan Pisuo
entities.description:
Mezasuzowan Pisuo is a member of the Germ Pirates.

Pisuo is a very large man, with a stocky build and a height many times that of an average human. He has thick lips, a large round nose, and short dark blue hair with dark purple spikes protruding from it. He wears a light green suit, a yellow collared shirt, and a red tie.

Not much is known about Pisuo's personality, as he has only been seen following his captain while keeping a blank expression.

Pisuo possesses great physical strength, being able to hold an adult man with one hand. However, he was defeated by Vito.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mezasuzowan Pisuo is a member of the Germ Pirates.

entities.name: Michael and Hoichael
entities.description:
Michael and Hoichael are two troublemaker children in the backstreets of Water 7. They idolize Franky, and even dress like him and use his motto as their own: "Mm, super!!", and similarly idolize Paulie. However, their backstreet delinquency has earned them ire from at least Tilestone and Peepley Lulu. Before the timeskip, they were part of class 6-5 of the backstreet elementary school.

Michael has short spiky hair. He wears a red vest with a green pattern that looks like grass. He also wears a yellow shirt underneath that has his name and a white circle. The middle of the circle has red and white character .

Hoichael has short brown hair which seems to be growing only on the top spot of his head. He is missing teeth. He wears a blue vest with pink flowers pattern, and underneath he wears a brown shirt with his name. In the middle of the shirt is a white circle that surrounds a red circle with a white katakana character .

Since they idolize Franky, they tend to imitate him, going as far as using his motto.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.image_alt: Identification thumbnail for Michael and Hoichael
entities.short_description: Michael and Hoichael are two troublemaker children in the backstreets of Water 7. They idolize Franky, and even dress like him and use his motto as their own: "Mm, super!!", and similarly idolize Paulie. However, their…

entities.name: Mihar
entities.description:
"Indoor" Mihar is a member of the Spade Pirates and, subsequently, the Whitebeard Pirates.

Mihar is a tall man with tan skin, light blonde hair, thin limbs and slight shoulders. He has a tattoo on his left cheek. He wears a wide-brimmed, reddish-brown hat with a yellow band around the base of the crown, glasses, and a bright yellow, open jacket with a brown collar and cuffs. The sleeves of his jacket appear to be rolled up to his forearms. Underneath the jacket, he wears a white, low-cut shirt. His hands are covered in yellow gloves, and he wears pink shorts with a dark belt and dark boots. Over the belt, he has a blue sash with a swirling pattern in orange and white.

In the anime, he was initially depicted with light brown hair, a black top hat, an open black jacket, and simple pants with a large belt buckle. He was later incorrectly depicted with brown medium length hair and a brown beard.

All three of his anime designs lack his tattoo.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: "Indoor" Mihar is a member of the Spade Pirates and, subsequently, the Whitebeard Pirates.

entities.name: Mikazuki
entities.description:
Mikazuki is the captain and only named member of the Big Helmet Pirates.

He wears a large spherical helmet similar to Kokoro's, apart from the fact that it has a crescent moon on it. He also has large canine teeth resembling a demon. His facial appearance is that of a middle aged man and his hair color is white.

He was shown to be arrogant, demanding and ungrateful when he refused to pay for his ship repairs, because of the length of time it took to repair it. He tried to threaten the shipwrights with brute force when they tried to make him pay.

With a bounty of 36,000,000 and having made it through the Grand Line to Water 7, Mikazuki is a considerable pirate by the first half of the Grand Line's standards. However, he stood no chance whatsoever against the workers of Galley-La.

entities.name: Mikio Itoo
entities.description:
Mikio Itoo is a background joke character created by Eiichiro Oda, and arguably the first Easter Egg featured in One Piece.

He is a caricature of , a -born manga creator whom Oda knew as a fellow assistant to . Like Oda, Ito went on to publish his own series in Weekly Shonen Jump, such as and .

Within One Piece, Itoo is a wanted gunman with a bounty of ¥1 million (unknown how much this is in belly).

Thus far, Itoo has "appeared" mostly on wanted posters scattered throughout areas of the East Blue. These tend to vary greatly in detail; the most detailed depicts him as a man with an untidy mop of brown hair and matching beard.

entities.name: Miles
entities.description:
Miles is a merman and a trumpeter in a orchestra from Fish-Man Island.

Miles is a merman of peach complexion and a black-yellow stripped tail. He has long, wavy orange-brown hair.

He wears a suit, round sunglasses, an earring on his left ear and a fedora hat.

From his demeanor, Miles appears to enjoy his profession of playing the trumpet, readily participating in a show to celebrate the Straw Hats' success.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Miles is a merman and a trumpeter in a orchestra from Fish-Man Island.

entities.name: Millet Pine
entities.description:
Millet Pine is the torturer of the former Roger Pirates.

Pine is a short rotund man with dark curly hair and a large black beard. He wears an orange helmet with black horns, the right of which is broken off, gold armor, and brown trousers with a large brown fury belt with a logo in the middle. He fits the stereotypical appearance of a Viking.

Like many of his crewmates, he was initially cold towards Kouzuki Oden when Roger brought him aboard, but quickly warmed up to him. He, like the rest of the crew, seemed to admire Shakuyaku and was very angry when they had to give her up to Silvers Rayleigh, protecting them both during their escape from the Marines and other pirates. Like other pirates, he loves treasure, jealously protecting his loot from other pirates in the God Valley.

He is loyal to his crew and respects the captain, sharing joy with them during long voyages and mourning the loss of crew members. However, for his own sake, he may ignore the captain's orders or try to circumvent them whenever possible.

entities.short_description: Millet Pine is the torturer of the former Roger Pirates.

entities.name: Milo
entities.description:
Milo is a citizen of Dressrosa. While he was a toy, he was known as "Onepoco".

Milo is a chubby man with light-colored hair and beard (dark brown in the anime). He wears a light-colored shirt (light blue with white sleeves in the anime) with dark rims and collar. The front of his shirt has his name, while the back has "★NOT★ ONEPOCO". He also wears dark gray shorts.

As Onepoco, he was a metallic toy dog with a pale gray body, floppy dark brown ears, and a light blue hat with the word "ONE" written in white on it. His right eye had a red X mark on it. His neck and tail were springs and his legs were made out of balls.

Milo is generally happy and playful around his family but during his time as a toy, he was secretly frustrated that his wife and son did not remember him at all.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Milo is a citizen of Dressrosa. While he was a toy, he was known as "Onepoco".

entities.name: Minatomo
entities.description:
Minatomo-san is a traveling carpenter (in)famously obsessed with repairing any broken door he sees. A native of Wano Country, he left with Shimotsuki Kouzaburou and Furiko 55 years ago and resettled in the East Blue. One of his relatives, also known as Minatomo, remains in Wano.

He originated in the SBS as a joke used by Eiichiro Oda to "explain" an art oversight in Chapter 1 (namely, a door at Partys Bar reappearing intact minutes after Higuma kicked off its hinges). Since then, the anime has periodically used him as an Easter Egg (not unlike Pandaman) in crowd shots and the like. Interestingly, he has never appeared in the manga proper, with even an identical carpenter in the Wano Country Arc identified as a separate person.

Minatomo is a short, elderly man with tanned skin, dark gray hair, and a stern look on his face. He also has a scar on his left cheek. He wears working clothes in varying shades of blue and has a rope tied around his forehead.

Not much is known about his personality except that he is apparently short-tempered and cannot stand broken doors, immediately repairing them when he sees one.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.

entities.name: Minatomo
entities.description:
Minatomo is a legendary carpenter in Wano Country and the leader of a guild that Franky joined to get access to the blueprints of Kaidou's fortress. He is related to another person, whose name is also Minatomo, who is a descendant of someone who traveled from Wano to East Blue.

Minatomo is a short, elderly man with tanned skin, dark gray hair, and a stern look on his face. He also has a scar on his left cheek. He wears working clothes in varying shades of blue and has a rope tied around his forehead (a nejiri-hachimaki).

He appreciates talented carpenters as he praised Franky for his superior craftsmanship, albeit in a rude and grumpy manner, much to the latter's annoyance.

Minatomo is an extremely skilled carpenter, having been the one who built Kaidou's residence on Onigashima. Furthermore, he owns his own carpenter guild, of which Franky was temporarily a member, and as such, has an entire guild of carpenters that follow his orders.

entities.name: Minister of the Left
entities.description:
The Minister of the Left is a merman in service of King Neptune. While it is not clear what his job entails, it appears to involve some sort of administrative and military duties. His actual name is currently unknown.

The Minister of the Left is a short, rather rotund merman with light blond waist-length hair. He has a long beard and, like a catfish, two large whiskers for a mustache.

In the past, his beard was dark and scruffier.

He wears a monocle on his left eye and an over-sized top hat. He uses a wooden cane that has horned design on the top to get around.

entities.name: Minister of the Right
entities.description:
The Minister of the Right is a merman in service to King Neptune. While it is not clear exactly what his job entails, he appears to have some administrative and military duties. He also appears to be a guard or commander as he and the other guards hurried to the princess when she needed help. His actual name is unknown.

He is a seahorse merman, having ridges along his back and the sides of his face, as well as a curly orange tail like a seahorse rather than a standard merman's fishtail. His mouth also protrudes forwards like a seahorse's.

He wears a jacket with two circles and a band on each sleeve. His jacket's sleeves are very large on the end. He carries a katana on his left hip and a -like trident.

In the past, his hair was shorter, scruffier, and darker and he did not have a beard.

entities.name: Minochihuahua
entities.description:
Minochihuahua is the newest Jailer Beast in Impel Down. He is an Awakened Zoan Devil Fruit user who ate a fruit that allows him to turn into a chihuahua.

In his Zoan form, Minochihuahua is a giant bipedal chihuahua with small eyes, a runny nose, and wears shorts. Unlike the other guards, he is clothed on his upper-body and wears a . He also wears a chain wrapped around the left hip of his shorts, headphones around his neck, and spiked bracelets.

Like the other Jailer Beasts, Minochihuahua is incredibly violent, and the prisoners fear him. Also like the other Jailer Beasts, he most likely acknowledges Sadi's superiority.

As one of the Jailer Beasts of Impel Down under Sadi, Minochihuahua is in charge of torturing and maintaining various prisoners.

entities.name: Minokoala
entities.description:
Minokoala is one of the five Jailer Beasts of Impel Down. He is an Awakened Zoan Devil Fruit user that ate a fruit that allows him to turn into a koala.

Due to his actions, he can be considered a supporting antagonist of the Impel Down Arc.

In his Zoan form, Minokoala is a large yellow koala in pants. He has cutesy eyes, large lips, and a runny nose like every other Jailer Beast. He wields three spiked knuckles in his hands. Carried alongside his side, is a bag full of eucalyptus leaves that he eats. The Minokoala wears pants having the former Japanese Imperial Navy flag represented on them.

Minokoala is described as being hawkish. He apparently enjoys eating Eucalyptus and bullying Minorhinoceros. Aside from this, he is also violent and bloodthirsty like the other Jailer Beasts. He acknowledges Sadi's superiority in battle, even fearing her when she got angry over his failure. Since Minokoala is a koala, he likes to eat eucalyptus leaves, which is why he always has a bag with them on his waist.

entities.name: Minorhinoceros
entities.description:
Minorhinoceros is one of the five Jailer Beasts of Impel Down. He is an Awakened Zoan Devil Fruit user, having eaten a Devil Fruit that allows him to turn into a blue rhinoceros.

Due to his actions, he can be considered a supporting antagonist of the Impel Down Arc.

In his Zoan form, Minorhinoceros is a large bipedal blue rhinoceros in overalls. He has cutesy eyes, large lips, and a runny nose like the other Jailer Beasts. He wields two spiked clubs.

Minorhinoceros is described as being bashful. Despite this and his ridiculous appearance, he is incredibly bloodthirsty like the other Jailer Beasts and the prisoners fear him. However, he acknowledges Sadi's superiority in battle, even fearing her when she got angry over his failure.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Minorhinoceros is one of the five Jailer Beasts of Impel Down. He is an Awakened Zoan Devil Fruit user, having eaten a Devil Fruit that allows him to turn into a blue rhinoceros.

entities.name: Minoruba
entities.description:
Minoruba is a bounty hunter on Sabaody Archipelago.

Minoruba is a rather pudgy man with brown hair parted to form both a small mohawk and a neck-length hair style, who wears a black coat and plaid pants. He also has notably visible stubble around his chin and lips.

As a bounty hunter, Minoruba is likely quite merciless. He was desperate enough to attack the Straw Hat Pirates but ended up losing miserably to them.

Not much is known about Minoruba's abilities, but as a bounty hunter he likely possesses some combat skill. However, he was easily defeated by the Straw Hat Pirates.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Minoruba is a bounty hunter on Sabaody Archipelago.

entities.name: Minotaurus
entities.description:
Minotaurus is one of Impel Down's Jailer Beasts. He is an awakened Zoan Devil Fruit user who ate a fruit that allows him to turn into a Holstein cow.

Due to his actions, he can be considered a supporting antagonist of the Impel Down Arc.

In his Zoan form, Minotaurus is a minotaur with cutesy eyes, large lips, and a runny nose. His body pattern resembles that of a cow.

He wears striped pants, a leather belt with a bronze hoof shaped belt buckle, but no shirt. He is often seen with a spiked club that he uses.

entities.short_description: Minotaurus is one of Impel Down's Jailer Beasts. He is an awakened Zoan Devil Fruit user who ate a fruit that allows him to turn into a Holstein cow.

entities.name: Minozebra
entities.description:
Minozebra is one of the five Jailer Beasts of Impel Down. He is an Awakened Zoan Devil Fruit user that ate a fruit that allows him to turn into a zebra.

Due to his actions, he can be considered a supporting antagonist of the Impel Down Arc.

Stuck in his Zoan form, Minozebra is a large bipedal zebra with a human abdomen, in pants. He has a runny nose and large lips like every other Jailer Beast. Also he has long elegant hair. Unlike the other Jailer Beasts, Minozebra has bored looking eyes instead of cutesy ones. He wields a long spiked ball mace.

Minozebra is described as very shy, although he is a brutal beast who regularly tortures the prisoners of Impel Down.

entities.name: Mishoin Cashible
entities.description:
Mishoin Cashible is a salesman based in Water 7 who rents bulls to ferry people around the canals.

Cashible is an average-sized, somewhat thickset man. He has a pig-like nose and has long, unkempt black hair, a thin mustache, and a goatee; he wears a small pair of glasses that rest on his nose well below his eyeline. He wears a casual v-neck button down shirt and dark pants.

Cashible is a friendly and helpful salesman who will gladly explain what his bulls do and give tips and directions regarding Water 7 to newcomers. He tended to ignore and laugh off the more outrageous things Luffy said, such as that he had gold treasure in his bag, and was shocked when that statement was proven to be true. He does have a cheeky and greedy side, as he immediately said he would take some treasure when Luffy showed it to him and exponentially raised the rent price of the bulls for the Straw Hats, though he was not truly serious and is an honest businessman.

Monkey D. Luffy, Nami, and Usopp entered Cashible's shop looking to rent bulls; when he learned they were from out of town, he explained to them what the bulls did as he outfitted two yagara bulls for them. When Luffy took his large bag to the bull, Cashible asked what was in it; Luffy responded that it was gold treasure, and Cashible did not believe him until Luffy showed him, leaving him awestruck and causing him to increase the rental price in jest. Nami asked if there was a currency exchange nearby, and Cashible recommended they go to Main Street on Shipbuilding Island. He then bid farewell to the Straw Hat trio and wished them well as they set off.

entities.short_description: Mishoin Cashible is a salesman based in Water 7 who rents bulls to ferry people around the canals.

entities.name: Miyagi
entities.description:
Miyagi is a mink and one of Inuarashi's subjects, until Carrot took the throne of Mokomo Dukedom.

Miyagi is a male goat mink with a thickset body covered in light-colored hair. He has two pointed horns on the top of his head and a long beard, and wears a white doctor's jacket, black pants, and black boots.

He was very eager to help Tony Tony Chopper tend to Duke Inuarashi after the latter awoke from his coma because of the learning experience it would provide, having been impressed by Chopper's mix of the Sakura Kingdom's medical expertise and the Torino Kingdom's medicinal knowledge. He is also curious as to where Zunesha has been heading while it has walked the oceans for the past 1000 years.

As a doctor, Miyagi has some medical expertise, having helped Chopper treat other minks who were poisoned by the Koro gas and later being called to help tend to Inuarashi after the latter woke from his coma. Miyagi has special medicine that can instantly heal someone, even if they are significantly injured over their entire body, however it has the devastating side-effect of doubling the recipients pain once it wears off.

entities.name: Mizuta Madaisuki
entities.description:
Mizuta Madaisuki was the older of the two Mizuta Twins, identical twin brothers of the Rumbar Pirates. He and his brother, Mawaritosuki, were identified by Oda in a SBS question. A fan asked why one of the Rumbar Pirates that died singing had a sword in his skull. Oda explained that this was because they were two identical pirates who died two separate ways.

Madaisuki wears polka-dot shirt with blue dots, blue pants, and sandals. He carries around a sword on his back. He also has brown hair with a front part that is long, goes up, and hangs down. As an identical twin, he and Mawaritosuki share all of the same physical characteristics, except for differences in clothing. Madaisuki has more dots on his shirt than Mawaritosuki.

Like the rest of their crew, Madaisuki was quite fun-loving and jolly. He enjoyed playing music and, in particular, playing for Laboon. He was also quite enthusiastic and willing to learn, since he was a big fan of Brook and his fighting style.

As a member of the Rumbar Pirates, Madaisuki was a skilled musician and fighter. It is unknown what specific musical talent Madaisuki possessed. Both he and his brother were also skilled swordsmen. Madaisuki admired Brook’s fencing style and wished to learn it.

entities.description:
Mizuta Mawaritosuki was the younger of the two Mizuta Twins, identical twin brothers of the Rumbar Pirates. He and his brother, Madaisuki, were identified by Oda in a SBS question. A fan asked why one of the Rumbar Pirates that died singing had a sword in his skull. Oda explained that this was because they were two identical pirates who died two separate ways.

Mawaritosuki wears polka-dot shirt with blue dots. He also has brown hair with a front part that is long, goes up, and hangs down. As an identical twin, he and Madaisuki share all of the same physical characteristics, except for differences in clothing. Mawaritosuki has less dots on his shirt than Madaisuki.

Like the rest of their crew, Mawaritosuki was quite fun-loving and jolly. He enjoyed playing music and, in particular, playing for Laboon.

As a member of the Rumbar Pirates, Mawaritosuki was a skilled musician and fighter. Mawaritosuki was shown to be a skilled singer. He was also a skilled swordsman.

entities.name: Moai
entities.description:
Moai is a large man with light colored hair tied in a ponytail. He wears a tattered light color tank top, a beaded neckless, a dotted bandana, a beaded belt and low hanging pants.

In the Digitally Colored Manga, Moai was given a color scheme matching Compo's anime appearance.

Not much is known about Moai's personality yet, but he is loyal to his captain and worries about his well-being.

Moai was one of the Kid Pirates witnessing her captain fight Big Mom on Onigashima's Live Floor. When Kid's railgun attack proved to be not enough to finish off Big Mom at first, he was one of the members that tried to convince their captain to retreat, however, he was promptly ignored by him.

entities.name: MocDonald
entities.description:
MocDonald was a Wild Zombie who lived on Thriller Bark.

He was a tree who came to life after having a shadow put inside of it. He had what somewhat resembled a human face, with a long nose and a big mouth. He had human hands with a pair of roots acting as legs. He had a tiny shrub near his roots.

MocDonald seemed to be quite laid back, since he was seen drinking with Unigaro. He was also quite terrified of Luffy and his crew, pleading the captain to overlook him.

While riding in the carriage, Nami, Usopp, and Chopper came across MocDonald and a group of creatures singing about "prey".

entities.name: Mochi
entities.description:
Mochi is a Skypiean on Angel Island and Moyle's son.

Apart from an average Skypiean appearance - two antennae and a set of wings - Mochi is a small boy with puffy brown hair. He wears a green tunic with pink hearts down his left side, along with a brown belt.

He is an eager and positive thinker: despite never meeting his father, he couldn't wait to meet him as he knew he was working directly under God.

Mochi was first seen talking with his friends outside Conis's house about how evil she is for rebelling against God, and for helping the pirates of the East Blue. They then talk about their fathers, and how they work for God. Mochi says he can not wait to meet his father, despite never seeing his face, and his friends also say they want to meet him.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mochi is a Skypiean on Angel Island and Moyle's son.

entities.name: Mohji
entities.description:
Mohji the Beast Tamer is a pirate and the first mate of the Buggy Pirates and a member of the Buggy and Alvida Alliance. He is a pet tamer, usually accompanied by his pet lion Richie. He was a member of Buggy's Delivery, and now currently a member of Cross Guild.

Due to his actions, he can be considered the secondary antagonist of the Orange Town Arc, and a minor antagonist in the Loguetown Arc.

Mohji is a man with muscular torso and thick lips. He wears a white fur vest that covers the area of his chest, green pants (blue in the anime) held up by a black sash (yellow in the anime), and shoes in the shape of animal white fur feet.

Every time Mohji appears in the series for an arc, his hairstyle changes. During the Orange Town Arc, his hair was shaped like a teddy bear. In the Loguetown Arc he wears a pink helmet with bunny ears sticking out. When the group makes it into the Grand Line, during the Jaya Arc his hair is shaped like a lion's mane. In the Impel Down Arc, his hairstyle causes him to resemble a ram, somewhat similar to Merry.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mohji the Beast Tamer is a pirate and the first mate of the Buggy Pirates and a member of the Buggy and Alvida Alliance. He is a pet tamer, usually accompanied by his pet lion Richie. He was a member of Buggy's…

entities.name: Momonga
entities.description:
Vice Admiral Momonga is a Marine officer and the Base Commander of the G-1 Marine Base. He was one of the five Vice Admirals who had led the Buster Call on Enies Lobby.

He served as a minor antagonist of the Marineford Arc.

Momonga is a man with a black mohawk and a mustache (dark red in the anime). He wears the standard marine uniform, consisting of a purple and white pinstripe suit with a coat draped over his shoulders, like Kizaru. Underneath his coat lies a dark blue shirt and a light blue tie. He is of relatively tall height and very well-built. He carries around his weapon of choice, a katana, either attached to his right hip or on his shoulder.

In his youth, he wore a marine cap and had not yet grown a mustache.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Vice Admiral Momonga is a Marine officer and the Base Commander of the G-1 Marine Base. He was one of the five Vice Admirals who had led the Buster Call on Enies Lobby.

entities.name: Momoo
entities.description:
Momoo is a giant sea cow from the Grand Line, and the first Sea Beast seen in the series. He is classified as a Type A creature, "Big Friendly".

Originally, he was utilized by the Arlong Pirates as a method of intimidation towards the residents of the Conomi Islands. After Arlong's defeat, he was captured and briefly employed as a draft animal by the Caribou Pirates.

Momoo is a giant sea cow with a seal-like structure, with a height of 36 meters (118'1" feet) and weighing 16 tons (32,000 lbs). Despite having fish-like scales covering his body from his neck to his stomach, Momoo is classified as a mammal Sea Beast. These scales are actually his hardened skin, protecting his vital organs from external attacks as an armor.

He has a big, round nose with a gold nose ring, cow-esque face, horns, and green spots throughout his body. Besides helping him swim, his fins contain retractable bones sharp enough to act as claws.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Momoo is a giant sea cow from the Grand Line, and the first Sea Beast seen in the series. He is classified as a Type A creature, "Big Friendly".

entities.name: Monda
entities.description:
Monda is a Star Shark and a former pet animal of the Foxy Pirates. He left the crew sometime during the Timeskip.

Monda is an orange shark with yellow stars on him in the upper side of his body. It wears a red mask-like hood with black stripes. In the manga his underbelly is dark orange.

It is devious and sneaky. It is also good friends with Capote, and assisted him together with Porche in the first race of the Davy Back Fight, the Donut Race.

It is a powerful swimmer by nature. It is able to "combine" with Capote by putting the Fish-Man's legs in its mouth to swim even faster. This is called the Two-fish Engine.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Monda is a Star Shark and a former pet animal of the Foxy Pirates. He left the crew sometime during the Timeskip.

entities.name: Monjii
entities.description:
Monjii is an elderly monkey mink with long, white eyebrows and a mustache connected to a chest-length beard. He wears a dark cloak, a hat, and baggy striped pants.

Monjii is a mink of enormous calm and composure; when confronted by the fearsome Beasts Pirates and the Calamity Jack, he remained undaunted and insisted on settling the matter peacefully through conversation while trying to reason with Jack, despite the latter's aggression and Monjii's own ability to fight.

As a mink, Monjii is a natural-born warrior and can use Electro. Despite his old age, he has retained his high physical prowess and agility.

When the Beasts Pirates, led by Jack, arrived on Zou in search of Raizo, Monjii tried to reason with them, but Jack angrily rejected his attempt at diplomacy. After the Pleasures attacked and were repelled by the minks, Monjii revealed that all the minks were warriors from birth and tried to convince Jack to talk to Inuarashi in order to avoid a war that would cause both sides to suffer greatly, but Jack refused and ordered the Gifters to attack.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Monjii is an elderly monkey mink with long, white eyebrows and a mustache connected to a chest-length beard. He wears a dark cloak, a hat, and baggy striped pants.

entities.name: Monjiro
entities.description:
Monjiro is a samurai who allied with the Kouzuki Family. After waiting 20 years for the return of the Nine Red Scabbards, he affiliated with the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance to raid Onigashima.

Monjiro is a short man with droopy eyes, a wide nose, and a green mustache that covers his mouth. He also has green hair with long, bushy sideburns and green eyebrows. Monjiro wears a green kimono with blue hakama. He also wears a red beaded necklace and a black sugegasa hat with a white chin strap, and he carries a box on his back. He has a reverse crescent moon tattoo on his ankle.

Monjiro is loyal to the Kouzuki Family, as he waited roughly 20 years for their return. He seemed perplexed by the message he was given about the Kouzuki Family returning to revolt.

Monjiro wields a sword and is proficient at using it, fending off members of the Beasts Pirates during the raid on Onigashima.

entities.short_description: Monjiro is a samurai who allied with the Kouzuki Family. After waiting 20 years for the return of the Nine Red Scabbards, he affiliated with the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance to raid Onigashima.

entities.name: Monster
entities.description:
Monster is one of the Senior Officers and musicians of the Red Hair Pirates. He first appeared playing with his crew at the Partys Bar.

Monster is a relatively large monkey with tiny eyes and head fur tied up into a topknot. Like many monkeys, he has brown fur over most of his body, but has white fur on his stomach, face and hands.

12 years ago, Monster was smaller, with beady eyes and no topknot.

Monster seems to be very jolly and fun-loving, as he was seen partying with Shanks and his crew.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Monster is one of the Senior Officers and musicians of the Red Hair Pirates. He first appeared playing with his crew at the Partys Bar.

entities.name: Mont Blanc Cricket
entities.description:
Mont Blanc Cricket is an inhabitant of Jaya, living in a small home behind the façade of a castle. He is the distant descendant of Mont Blanc Noland and the |Rasuto Bosu}} of the Saruyama Alliance.

He is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Jaya Arc, and led the Saruyama Alliance in helping them reach Skypiea.

Cricket is a muscular, middle aged man with blond hair. He has a large chestnut on his head which he inherited from his ancestor, Noland. He wears dark-purple tracksuit-pants with a white stripe running along each leg, and a rope around his waist. He does not generally wear a shirt, nor shoes, due to his continuous diving explorations. He is usually seen smoking with a cigarette in his mouth. On his left arm, Cricket has a tattoo of a chestnut with the word "Maroon" written across it.

Twenty four years ago, his appearance was the same as it was during the Jaya Arc, except he had a short beard on his chin.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.image_alt: Identification thumbnail for Mont Blanc Cricket
entities.short_description: Mont Blanc Cricket is an inhabitant of Jaya, living in a small home behind the façade of a castle. He is the distant descendant of Mont Blanc Noland and the |Rasuto Bosu}} of the Saruyama Alliance.

entities.name: Mont Blanc Noland
entities.description:
Mont Blanc Noland was an admiral in the Lvneel Kingdom and a famous explorer who made multiple trips into the Grand Line. He discovered a City of Gold on Jaya, but found upon returning there with Lvneel's king that it had disappeared, causing him to be executed. He was then memorialized in a fairy tale as a liar and trickster.

Noland was a chestnut-haired man whose most distinct feature was a large chestnut on his head. This feature was passed down to his descendants. He was a well-built man who often wore a high-collared black coat, closed by a belt, and an orange scarf. Noland had tan skin and a round nose.

His legs were covered by striped blue and white pants, and his feet by standard shoes. Hidden under his coat, he had an orange sash adorned with medal-like pendants. He carried around his sword on his left hip. On the left side of his chest is a large cross-shaped scar.

After his execution, Noland's image was distorted over the centuries due to the shame that was brought to his name. Since then, whenever someone refers to Noland, the image of an ever smiling idiot is the one that commonly comes into mind. This defacing image is the one often drawn by artists in children's books. His nose is shaped like a spork.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.image_alt: Identification thumbnail for Mont Blanc Noland
entities.short_description: Mont Blanc Noland was an admiral in the Lvneel Kingdom and a famous explorer who made multiple trips into the Grand Line. He discovered a City of Gold on Jaya, but found upon returning there with Lvneel's king that it…

entities.name: Moon Isaac Jr.
entities.description:
Moon Isaac Jr. is a member of the former Roger Pirates and their until the crew's dissolution. His current whereabouts and status are unknown.

Isaac has a long, beak-like nose, slicked back short brown hair, and a dark moustache. He has a rotund body shape and wears a tan shirt, a golden cape, striped trousers, and long black boots, while holding a rapier.

He seems to be weak to compliments as he became flustered when Roger spoke highly of the crew.

Isaac held the status of tactical staff officer within the Roger Pirates, implying a higher rank among the crew. As a tactician, he likely had expertise in devising battle strategies.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.image_alt: Identification thumbnail for Moon Isaac Jr.
entities.short_description: Moon Isaac Jr. is a member of the former Roger Pirates and their until the crew's dissolution. His current whereabouts and status are unknown.

entities.name: Moqueca
entities.description:
Moqueca is the king of the in the South Blue and one of fifty monarchs who took part in the Levely.

Moqueca is a short, rotund middle-aged man with a thin mustache. He wears a frilly shirt, a bead necklace, robes and a colorful, feathered hat resembling a palm tree.

Moqueca is a cheerful, jovial man who enjoys samba.

Moqueca is the king of a nation affiliated with the World Government and one of the few allowed to attend the Levely, which grants him some authority over matters concerning the world.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Moqueca is the king of the in the South Blue and one of fifty monarchs who took part in the Levely.

entities.name: Morgan
entities.description:
"Axe-Hand" Morgan is a former Marine captain, the father of Helmeppo and the first significant Marine officer to appear in the storyline. After his defeat by Monkey D. Luffy and Roronoa Zoro, he was stripped of his rank for his many abuses of power.

He is the third antagonist of the Romance Dawn Arc, serving as the main antagonist of the Shells Town subsection. He is also the main antagonist of the Diary of Koby-Meppo cover-page serial.

Morgan is a notably towering, muscular man with tanned skin, blonde hair, a well-defined face, and a steel jaw etched with the word Möwe (German for "seagull"). As his epithet suggests, his right hand has been replaced with a huge steel axe, the handle of which is not only bolted through the bones of his forearm, but sticks out where his elbow should be.

Like most Marine officers, he wears a large, ornate overcoat. However, this coat notably lacks the usual insignia, and is completely sleeveless; it is also worn conventionally, instead of being draped over the shoulders like a cape. His trousers bear a striped pattern reminiscent of Marine Bases and battleships.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: "Axe-Hand" Morgan is a former Marine captain, the father of Helmeppo and the first significant Marine officer to appear in the storyline. After his defeat by Monkey D. Luffy and Roronoa Zoro, he was stripped of his rank…

entities.name: Morgans
entities.description:
"Big News" Morgans is the president of the World Economy News Paper and one of the emperors of the Underworld.

His first appearance was during the Whole Cake Island Arc, as one of the more high-profile guests in Big Mom's Tea Party. Since then, Morgans has been a frequent figure in the world's ongoings, usually by being the first to report on them to the general public.

In his Human-Beast form courtesy of his Devil Fruit, Morgans has the form of a very tall human albatross hybrid with small eyes and a large beak. His body is covered in white feathers, and he has a large tail and wings that resemble human arms. He wears a blue top hat with a large striped feather in it, a light blue button-down shirt with a yellow bow on the top, red and white checkered pants, a dark cape, and shoes that fit his bird-like feet.

As of yet, his Human and Beast forms have not been shown.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: "Big News" Morgans is the president of the World Economy News Paper and one of the emperors of the Underworld.

entities.name: Mornin
entities.description:
Mornin is the mayor of Syrup Village, and one of several villagers who used Usopp's antics as a makeshift alarm clock.

Mornin is an old man who is bald on the top with gray hair on the sides and back of his head. He has a curved pointed nose and a gray mustache. He also wears a collared shirt and round-shaped glasses.

Unlike many of his fellow villagers, he was not very annoyed by Usopp's lies. In fact, he used it as a sign to get ready for the day.

As a mayor, it can be assumed that Mornin has some influence over village matters and is proficient at running a town.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mornin is the mayor of Syrup Village, and one of several villagers who used Usopp's antics as a makeshift alarm clock.

entities.name: Mosh
entities.description:
Mosh is a very large man, comparable to Jean Bart in size. His hair is light-colored and arranged in a ponytail, with a prominent bang covering the left side of his face. He wears a feathered coat adorned with spikes at the shoulders (similar to Kid's own captain coat before the timeskip) and a shirt with the picture of a guitar printed on it.

Not much is known about Mosh's personality yet. He is, however, loyal to his captain and attempted to protect him from Big Mom.

Mosh wields a katana with a long handle.

Mosh witnessed his captain fight Big Mom on the Live Floor. When it looked like Kid was done for, Mosh was one of the crewmembers who attempted to defend his captain from Big Mom, but he only managed to get hit by Hera's lightning technique in the process. He later cheered on for Kid after the latter got up and was able to significantly injure Big Mom.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mosh is a very large man, comparable to Jean Bart in size. His hair is light-colored and arranged in a ponytail, with a prominent bang covering the left side of his face. He wears a feathered coat adorned with spikes at…

entities.name: Motobaro
entities.description:
Motobaro is the pet bison of Duval. He is used by Duval as a steed, and can also swim on water.

Motobaro is a very large bison, with relatively small limbs and short horns in contrast with his big head and body. Typically, Motobaro is ridden by Duval with a special saddle. Aside from the side pockets where Duval's harpoon cartridges can be stored on it, there are motorcycle handle bars similar to those worn by the flying fish of Duval's men. With these, Duval rides Motobaro as if he's riding a large motorcycle. When traversing across water, Motobaro is fitted with a special breathing apparatus that resembles the front of truck with two exhaust pipes at the side.

In the anime, to increase his speed, Franky built and put on Motobaro a sort of engine.

Because of his strength, Motobaro is called a brutal beast who is capable of tearing holes even in village dams with his horns, which people call them the . They were the reason that Duval was able to escape the Marines. He is so strong that he is still capable of breaking straight out of a cage and crushing an opponent even if his horns do not reach them.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Motobaro is the pet bison of Duval. He is used by Duval as a steed, and can also swim on water.

entities.name: Motzel
entities.description:
Mr. Motzel is a gourmand and one of the known customers of the Baratie.

Motzel is an overweight man, with large lips and brown hair (grey in the anime) that is curled up. He has a flat nose, round eyes, and thick eyebrows. He wears a purple shirt, with either a swirl or floral design.

Motzel is a fan of gourmet cooking, but he has a nasty habit of stealing other people's food.

Motzel visited the Baratie with his daughter at the same time as Fullbody. While his daughter was looking at the Marine Lieutenant, Motzel stole some food from her plate. The two fought about it afterward.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mr. Motzel is a gourmand and one of the known customers of the Baratie.

entities.name: Moulon
entities.description:
Don Moulon was the boss of the Moulon Family.

Although not personally seen, Moulon can be described as an obsessive individual. According to Reuven and Moulon's own subordinates, he has tried numerous times to kidnap Candelle, the queen of Esperia. He eventually became fed up with his failures, to the point he considered it fine to kill her should she refuse again.

As the boss of the Moulon Family, Moulon has at least 17 well-armed subordinates willing to do his bidding.

Since at least 70 years ago, Moulon made many attempts to kidnap Candelle in order to force her to be his lover. However, his family suffered failure after failure in that regard, causing him great frustration. 70 years ago, Moulon had his subordinates attack the Opera House on Esperia for one final showdown, allowing them to even kill her should she refuse again. However, his lackeys happened to run into Brook earlier that day, leading to their swift defeat as his attack finally struck them.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Don Moulon was the boss of the Moulon Family.

entities.name: Mounblutain
entities.description:
Mounblutain was a member of the Fake Straw Hat Crew who masqueraded as Sogeking.

Mounblutain is a very large man, much taller and rounder than the real Sogeking. He wears a mask which resembles that of the real Sogeking but larger and more exaggerated, and does not completely cover his face, as the real one should. The long nose is also part of the mask and the horns are straighter and rounder than the original mask (which was wavy and flat).

He wears striped pants and a dark red cape, similar to Sogeking's, and a plain shirt. He also wears brown boots and a yellow sash for a belt. He has large, curly hair similar to Sogeking's, as well as a thick beard. Underneath the mask reveals his real face to be wide, with thick lips, a relatively flat nose, and round teeth.

Mounblutain is almost always laughing or smiling. Like the other members of the Fake Straw Hats, he uses the name of the real Straw Hats to instill fear in those around him. Upon the truth coming out, he was discovered to be very cowardly, begging Caribou for mercy. He is surprisingly noble, as he was the only one who attacked Caribou in order to save Drip (Fake Sanji), even with the knowledge that he was a Super Rookie with a 210,000,000 bounty on his head.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mounblutain was a member of the Fake Straw Hat Crew who masqueraded as Sogeking.

entities.name: Mountain Ricky
entities.description:
Mountain Ricky is a former member of the Foxy Pirates. He fought George Mach before the third round of the Davy Back Fight.

Ricky is a short, fat man with a stubby nose, missing teeth and curly dark hair. He wears boxing gloves, shorts, elbow sweat bands, and the typical Foxy Pirate mask.

Little is known about Ricky's personality, but he is likely very deceptive, similar to the rest of his crew. He seems very engaged when fighting.

It is unknown exactly what kind of abilities Ricky possesses, but he seems to be fairly weak, as he and George Mach were battling evenly before they were both knocked out of the ring when the third round of the Davy Back Fight started.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mountain Ricky is a former member of the Foxy Pirates. He fought George Mach before the third round of the Davy Back Fight.

entities.name: Mouseman
entities.description:
Mouseman is a Gifter in the Beasts Pirates. He resides in Bakura Town.

Mouseman is an average-sized man with a long face. He has bushy light hair and a thin beard and mustache. He wears a dark vest and a pair of aviator goggles on his forehead, and due to his Devil Fruit, he has two large mouse ears.

Mouseman is a staunch supporter of Wano Country's social hierarchy, and so convinced the yokozuna Urashima to use his high status to ensure that the commoner woman Kiku would marry him no matter what, even suggesting that he kill and destroy everything close to her so he would be the only one who could support her.

While he does support Urashima's high standing and suggesting him to take full advantage of it, Mouseman is not above insulting such people, as he made a passive remark of how Urashima was an idiot for taking too much into consideration of taking Kiku.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mouseman is a Gifter in the Beasts Pirates. He resides in Bakura Town.

entities.name: Mouthto Mouthyan
entities.description:
Mouthto Mouthyan is a citizen of Dressrosa.

Mouthyan is a young, blonde man who wears a blue shirt. Because of Kyuin, he ended with a large lipstick mark over his face.

Not much is known about Mouthyan's personality, although he was kind enough to warn Vito of his "attacker".

Mouthyan was one of the many men who ended up victim to Kyuin's drunken kissing rampage. Thinking Lola could have been responsible for it, Vito was given directions of the attacker by Mouthyan, but ended up finding that the source of the commotion was someone else.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mouthto Mouthyan is a citizen of Dressrosa.

entities.name: Moyle
entities.description:
Moyle is a Skypiean and the father of Mochi. He originally worked for Gan Fall in the Divine Squad, but after Enel took over, he and the other members were forced to work in God's Army until they were betrayed and almost killed.

Moyle is an average-sized man with brown hair, which is styled into a single antenna, and has a pair of wings just like all of the Skypieans. He wears a white robe and sandals.

Moyle has a very kind and friendly nature as he trusted his leader, Gan Fall. After Gan Fall was defeated by Enel, Moyle was forced to work for Enel, who he did not trust but had to follow due to fear of the "God's" wrath. He also seems to get along well with fellow Skypieans.

When defending Gan Fall's title, Moyle was seen carrying a staff. It is unknown how skilled he is in using it.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Moyle is a Skypiean and the father of Mochi. He originally worked for Gan Fall in the Divine Squad, but after Enel took over, he and the other members were forced to work in God's Army until they were betrayed and…

entities.name: Mozambia
entities.description:
Vice Admiral Mozambia is a Marine officer who attended the meeting with the Seven Warlords of the Sea to discuss Crocodile's replacement.

Mozambia is a dark-skinned man with short dark gray hair and a scar on the left side of his face, which he received as a young Marine while protecting civilians. He wears a brown suit with a blue shirt and tie, with the standard Marine coat draped over his shoulders.

When his body was manipulated by Doflamingo of the Seven Warlords, Mozambia panicked because he did not know the cause of the manipulation.

As a Marine vice admiral, Mozambia is capable of commanding a Buster Call alongside other vice admirals. He also has authority over lower-ranking subordinates.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Vice Admiral Mozambia is a Marine officer who attended the meeting with the Seven Warlords of the Sea to discuss Crocodile's replacement.

entities.name: Mr. 10
entities.description:
Mr. 10 is the partner to Miss Tuesday and a Frontier Agent in the Baroque Works rankings.

He was first mentioned by Nefertari Vivi, who explained how Baroque Works was organized to the Straw Hat Pirates. Neither him nor his partner are seen in the series, but concept art of him does exist.

He has long, unkempt hair with a headband. He wears a half-shirt, open to reveal a bare chest. He wears pants with stars on them and a belt.

Nothing is known about Mr. 10's personality, but it can be assumed that he is brutal and willing to kill to complete a mission like other agents.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mr. 10 is the partner to Miss Tuesday and a Frontier Agent in the Baroque Works rankings.

entities.name: Mr. 11
entities.description:
Mr. 11 was a Frontier Agent for Baroque Works and the partner of Miss Thursday.

Mr. 11 was a short man, with long wavy gray hair. He had tattoos of his number on each side of his face, and a large black top hat. He wore a dark blue coat with a gray collar and yellow buttons. Underneath, he sported a purple puffy shirt and black pants.

Mr. 11 was quite easily tricked and unable to hold a poker face, inadvertently giving away his connection to Baroque Works when Smoker pretended to have found a letter with orders in his pocket. He also mistook a group of Billions for Millions, showing he did not know much about the lower members of his organization.

In the live-action series, he was shown to be brash and overconfident, wanting to take Tashigi's sword but knowing nothing about his own sword, Kashu, using it as a normal blade. After being captured by Smoker, Mr. 11 refused to give up any information and chose to die, showing a commitment to his organization.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mr. 11 was a Frontier Agent for Baroque Works and the partner of Miss Thursday.

entities.name: Mr. 12
entities.description:
Mr. 12 is the partner of Miss Saturday and a Frontier Agent in the Baroque Works rankings. He was first mentioned by Nefertari Vivi, who explained how Baroque Works was organized to the Straw Hat Pirates.

Mr. 12's appearance is unknown, as neither him nor his partner are seen in the series. It is assumed that the number 12 plays a major part of his design, similar to the other Frontier Agents designs.

Nothing is known about Mr. 12's personality, but it can be assumed that he is brutal and willing to kill to complete a mission like other agents.

Nothing is known about Mr. 12's abilities, but his number (higher than 10) means he is not much stronger in the Baroque Works number system than the Billions.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mr. 12 is the partner of Miss Saturday and a Frontier Agent in the Baroque Works rankings. He was first mentioned by Nefertari Vivi, who explained how Baroque Works was organized to the Straw Hat Pirates.

entities.name: Mr. 13
entities.description:
Mr. 13 is an otter and a member of the criminal organization Baroque Works, being a part of the |Anrakkīzu}} along with Miss Friday. They were a team that served as messengers for Mr. 0 and were also responsible for executing any Baroque Works agents that fail their missions. He is classified as a Type D creature, "Small Savage".

Mr. 13 is a small, brown-furred otter with white fur around his snout. He wears a long-sleeved, light blue jumpsuit with purple dots, as well as black sunglasses.

Like most of the Baroque Works members, Mr. 13 is quite brutal, having been willing to attack Mr. 9 and Vivi for failing their mission, and the bounty hunters at Whisky Peak simply for running away. He and Miss Friday are not very faithful to their organization and its members, as they betrayed their fellow Baroque Works agents to the Marines in exchange for food.

Mr. 13 display exceptional intelligence among animals, having tracked down other agents, understand human speech (evidenced when he and Miss Friday listened in on Vivi), and easily operated weaponry. He seems to have an excellent memory and is a skilled artist, having drawn detailed sketches of the Straw Hat Pirates after meeting them only once.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mr. 13 is an otter and a member of the criminal organization Baroque Works, being a part of the |Anrakkīzu}} along with Miss Friday. They were a team that served as messengers for Mr. 0 and were also responsible for…

entities.name: Mr. 6
entities.description:
Mr. 6 is the partner of Miss Mother's Day and the top Frontier Agent in the Baroque Works rankings. He was first mentioned by Nefertari Vivi, who explained how Baroque Works was organized to the Straw Hat Pirates.

Mr. 6's appearance is unknown, as neither him nor his partner are seen in the series. It is assumed that the number 6 plays a major part of his design, similar to the other Frontier Agents' designs.

Nothing is known about Mr. 6's personality, but it can be assumed that he is brutal and willing to kill to complete a mission like other agents.

Nothing is known about Mr. 6's abilities, but his ranking suggests that he is considerably stronger than the other Frontier Agents.
