entities.short_description: Mr. 6 is the partner of Miss Mother's Day and the top Frontier Agent in the Baroque Works rankings. He was first mentioned by Nefertari Vivi, who explained how Baroque Works was organized to the Straw Hat Pirates.

entities.name: Mr. 7
entities.description:
Mr. 7 is a former Frontier Agent of Baroque Works, being half of a sniper duo along with his partner, Miss Father's Day. He replaced the previous agent of the same codename when the latter died in the line of duty. He is a minor antagonist in the Arabasta Arc.

Mr. 7's body is covered with sevens, including his eyebrows, shoes, and gun. Many of his body parts, the gestures he makes with his hands, and the way he opens his mouth also resemble the number seven.

He has puffy blueish-white hair, that is styled similar to a helmet. He sports a purple coat that goes down to his ankles, with yellow frills on the shoulders, in of the sleeves, and in the middle part. The coat also has parallel sevens on each side of the chest. Under the coat he wears a dark blue shirt with pink lines on it, and a light blue neckerchief. He wears black trousers with long white socks, and yellow shoes in the shape of sevens. He also has square yellow sunglasses with red lenses.

Mr. 7 seems to have a laid back, though slightly more serious, attitude than his partner. However, underneath his laid-back personality, he is ruthless and delights in killing others.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mr. 7 is a former Frontier Agent of Baroque Works, being half of a sniper duo along with his partner, Miss Father's Day. He replaced the previous agent of the same codename when the latter died in the line of duty. He…

entities.name: Mr. 7
entities.description:
Mr. 7 was a frontier agent of Baroque Works. He died on duty when he attempted to forcefully recruit Roronoa Zoro to the organization. His position was filled by the next Mr. 7.

The first known Mr. 7 was a round headed man with a number seven tattoo on his left cheek.

The official sketch by Eiichiro Oda reveals Mr. 7 as a tall, dark-skinned man with short hair and a multi-spiked Mohawk hairstyle. He wears a long, dark coat with a frill-like collar, as well as a pair of gloves. On his belt there is a sheathed sword.

Virtually nothing is known about the late Mr. 7's personality, but he attempted to kill Zoro for refusing to join Baroque Works, showing a certain level of loyalty for the group.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mr. 7 was a frontier agent of Baroque Works. He died on duty when he attempted to forcefully recruit Roronoa Zoro to the organization. His position was filled by the next Mr. 7.

entities.name: Mr. 9
entities.description:
Mr. 9 is the code name of a former Frontier Agent and bounty hunter of Baroque Works, and Miss Wednesday's former assigned partner during her infiltration. Due to his actions, he is one of the main antagonists of the Reverse Mountain Arc, and a supporting antihero in the Whisky Peak Arc. After the fall of Baroque Works, he stayed at Whisky Peak, and eventually bore a son with Miss Monday.

Mr. 9 is a young man who wears a golden crown on top of his red hair and has his agent number written on his cheeks. He wears a green suit with white lace along with a ruffled red scarf. His attire makes him look like a prince or a king, but he is neither.

After two years, his hair is much longer, and he has grown a bit of a mustache. He wears a different, longer scarf and has erased his agent numbers. His clothes also look different, lacking the lace that trimmed the collar and sleeves. His crown is the same, though.

Mr. 9 is very sure of himself and very loyal to his friends. His favorite phrase is "Bye bye, baby;" these were his last words to Miss Wednesday before he attempted to hold off Mr. 5 so she could escape. Unlike Officer Agents, who seem to believe that friendship is a sign of weakness, Mr. 9 is shown to highly value friendship and loyalty, as shown when he fought for Vivi's sake. Due to this, it is proved that he does indeed have a more heroic side to him, in contrast to his role as a Baroque Works agent.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mr. 9 is the code name of a former Frontier Agent and bounty hunter of Baroque Works, and Miss Wednesday's former assigned partner during her infiltration. Due to his actions, he is one of the main antagonists of the…

entities.name: Mr. Beans
entities.description:
Mr. Beans is a former Baroque Works Millions agent who was stationed at Whisky Peak alongside his partner, Miss Catherina. He worked under the Frontier Agents Mr. 8, Miss Monday, Mr. 9 and Miss Wednesday.

Mr. Beans is a small boy with short blonde hair. He wears light green shorts, brown shoes, and a white short sleeve shirt with a "Wanted" picture of Pandaman.

In the anime, he has dark gray hair and wears a gray-green short sleeve shirt which does not have the Pandaman image.

In his debut appearance in the anime, he had brown hair, wore a blue short sleeve shirt with an image of Pandaman. He also wore beige shorts and a pirate hat.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mr. Beans is a former Baroque Works Millions agent who was stationed at Whisky Peak alongside his partner, Miss Catherina. He worked under the Frontier Agents Mr. 8, Miss Monday, Mr. 9 and Miss Wednesday.

entities.name: Mr. Love
entities.description:
Mr. Love is one of Baroque Works' Billions who posed as a member of the Rebel Army.

Mr. Love is an average-sized man with shaggy brown hair. He wears a pair of tan gloves and a blueish-black coat with a hood. On the back of his coat are the words "Baroque" on the top, followed by "I ❤️ Miss Valentine" below. Most of the words are written in white letters, with "Miss" in purple letters and the heart in red. He also wears light purple shorts with purple-black oval shapes on them. In the anime, he has shaggy blonde hair instead of brown and does not wear gloves.

Mr. Love was an obedient agent, as he followed his orders without question in posing as a member of the Rebel Army. He is also a deceitful person as he tried to lie to the Marines about his true identity as a member of Baroque Works. Furthermore, Mr. Love is also obsessed with Miss Valentine, as he even made a jacket himself to declare his love for her.

At some point in his life, he joined Baroque Works. He then became member No. 31 of Miss Valentine's fan club.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mr. Love is one of Baroque Works' Billions who posed as a member of the Rebel Army.

entities.name: Mr. Mellow
entities.description:
Mr. Mellow is one of the few identified members of Baroque Works' Billions.

He is apparently the leader of at least some of the Billions, as he ordered an unsuccessful attack on Portgas D. Ace and oversaw the murder of Mr. 11.

Mr. Mellow is an average-sized tan man with black hair. He wears a dark red shirt with kanji meaning on it, along with a white fur scarf, a green cap with a melon stem on top, and plain black pants with a brown belt. He also has a dark tattoo on his left arm; Although not clearly visible in the manga, the anime depicts it as a pair of intertwined snakes.

In the flashback of him pulling the cart of Dance Powder, his shirt said and he did not wear the fur scarf. In the manga he also wore different, lighter-colored pants with a grid pattern.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mr. Mellow is one of the few identified members of Baroque Works' Billions.

entities.name: Mr. Momora
entities.description:
Mr. Momora is a member of the former Roger Pirates.

Mr. Momora is a very tall, thin man with long, bushy, light-colored hair. He has a pointed nose, a pointed chin, thin eyebrows, and prominent lower eyelashes. He wears a short-sleeved, dark-colored shirt, light-colored pants, and a belt. He is always seen wearing a large, dark-colored hat with a long bill and a light-colored marking on the front.

Mr. Momora is a kind-hearted person, happily exchanging goods with the Whitebeard Pirates and laughing at his crewmates goofing off at a hot spring. He was sad when the crew dropped Kouzuki Oden off at Wano Country. Feeling a powerful wave of Haki from Imu, Mr. Momora became frightened and believed that the end of the world had begun.

He is loyal to his crew and respects the captain, sharing joy with them during long voyages and mourning the loss of crew members. However, for his own sake, he may ignore the captain's orders or try to circumvent them whenever possible.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mr. Momora is a member of the former Roger Pirates.

entities.name: Mr. Shimizu
entities.description:
Mr. Shimizu was a Baroque Works Millions agent stationed at Whisky Peak. He worked under the Frontier Agents Mr. 8, Miss Monday, Mr. 9 and Miss Wednesday.

Mr. Shimizu a man with short black hair with a stubble on his upper lip and chin. He wears a white shirt and a rope around his forehead.

In the anime, he wears a light blue shirt and his hair leans more towards a brown color.

Mr. Shimizu has no qualms about deceiving those he wishes to capture, as shown when he partied alongside the Straw Hat Pirates to get them to lower their guard.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mr. Shimizu was a Baroque Works Millions agent stationed at Whisky Peak. He worked under the Frontier Agents Mr. 8, Miss Monday, Mr. 9 and Miss Wednesday.

entities.name: Muchana
entities.description:
Muchana is a doctor who currently works in Impel Down's medical room.

Muchana is a man with black hair who wears an Impel Down uniform that consists of a white suit, garnet gloves, a shirt with the Impel Down symbol on the lapels, and a black tie. Being part of the medical team, he wears a doctor's mask that covers part of his face, and a white cap with a small Impel Down symbol on one side.

Little is known about Muchana's personality. He is nervous when talking to Hannyabal, possibly for fear of receiving retaliation from a superior.

Muchana possesses some medical experience and seems to know the poisons that the Doku Doku no Mi produces very well.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Muchana is a doctor who currently works in Impel Down's medical room.

entities.name: Mugren
entities.description:
Colonel Mugren is a member of the former Roger Pirates.

Colonel Mugren is a large man with broad shoulders, a stocky abdomen, and thin legs. He has a large, round chin and a downward pointed nose. He wears a light-colored shirt that buttons in the front and has a frilled collar. He also wears dark-colored pants and dark-colored, pointed boots.

In his concept art, he was seen smoking a cigar.

Mugren was cheerful during Kouzuki Oden's welcome party, and he laughed along with his crew when they saw the treasure Joy Boy had left behind on the final island. Like any pirate, he loves treasure, as he was very happy with the great booty in the God Valley. Having been wounded, he was dissatisfied and did not share Rowing's enthusiasm that the battle was becoming more interesting.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Colonel Mugren is a member of the former Roger Pirates.

entities.name: Mukkashimi Tower
entities.description:
Mukkashimi Tower is a spectator at the Corrida Colosseum.

Tower is a pale, old man with a wrinkled, rectangular face, a predominant chin, and slicked-back, grey hair. He also has a grey mustache. He wears an off-white collared shirt and a polka-dotted tie.

Tower has a very good memory, remembering the fighting style used by Kyros and Ricky from many years ago.

He has been a regular patron of the colosseum for many years, and loves watching the matches so much that his family left him. Despite this, he remains healthy and in good spirits.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mukkashimi Tower is a spectator at the Corrida Colosseum.

entities.name: Mummy
entities.description:
Mummy is a sorcerer who joined as a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum to compete for the Mera Mera no Mi.

Mummy is a wrinkled man, with bandages covering the sides of his face, making an X in the middle. His head is decorated with feathers. His hands are also wrapped in bandages, and he wears a fur covering, most likely made of an animal hide.

When Cavendish fell asleep, Mummy became very scared, since he knew that Hakuba would attack.

Mummy has a sense of honor, as he choose to lay his life on the line to protect Luffy from Doflamingo long enough to buy the pirate enough time to defeat the Warlord.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mummy is a sorcerer who joined as a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum to compete for the Mera Mera no Mi.

entities.name: Nakaiwa
entities.description:
Nakaiwa is a man who lived in the Wano Country 41 years ago.

Nakaiwa is a thin man of average height with a long head, a large chin, and droopy eyes. He wears a top with a tree pattern and a dark vest and scarf, as well as a woven hat.

Nakaiwa is fairly greedy and not very superstitious, being willing to kidnap a white boar for the Kurokoma Family's bounty. He was quite dedicated in this goal, spending an entire year searching for the animal with Oiwa and Koiwa. His greed is strong enough that he is even willing to kidnap bystanders to get paid, but despite the fact that he is secretly in love with the kidnapped woman, Nakaiwa is afraid of losing face in front of his comrades and makes no attempt to dissuade them from taking her hostage.

Nakaiwa was in love with Tsurujo, and frequented the tea house where she worked often. He planned to confess his love for her after receiving the reward money for finding a white boar. However, greed and fear of failing in front of his comrades did not stop him from taking her hostage.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Nakaiwa is a man who lived in the Wano Country 41 years ago.

entities.name: Nako
entities.description:
Dr. Nako is a doctor from Cocoyasi Village. He is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Arlong Park Arc.

Nako is a slight, elderly man with grey hair, including a prominent "Van Dyke" mustache and beard. His usual attire consists of sunglasses, a bandanna, and a white doctor's coat, the latter two bearing red crosses. He wore a striped light green and dark green shirt.

In Episode of Nami, his bandanna instead bears the kanji for .

After the timeskip, he has a flower-patterned shirt and striped shorts, with the same sunglasses, coat, and bandanna.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Dr. Nako is a doctor from Cocoyasi Village. He is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Arlong Park Arc.

entities.name: Namur
entities.description:
Namur is a fish-man and the former 8th division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates.

Namur appears to be a shark fish-man. His shark-like teeth stick out of his mouth from his lower jaw, with three small teeth on each side. He also has three pairs of gills on his neck.

He is somewhat short and rotund in shape, and his hair is arranged in spikes pointing upwards, similar to Gecko Moria. He has the number "8" tattooed to the left side of his neck to represent the division that he leads. He also wears a white t-shirt with sky blue sleeves with the star logo for the Criminal brand (colored orange) on his chest. Due to his legs not being visible in the manga, in the anime he was given standard grey pants held up by a belt. Also in the anime, he is also seen with a gray shark fin protruding from his back, and no shoes.

Namur is very loyal to the Whitebeard Pirates and Whitebeard, as he was willing to risk his own life in order to save Ace from execution during the war at Marineford.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Namur is a fish-man and the former 8th division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates.

entities.name: Nanday
entities.description:
Nanday is the infant son of Mr. 9 and Miss Monday.

Nanday is a small baby with messy black hair. He wears a light blue onesie and a golden crown over his head.

Nanday appears to be a cheerful baby, having no fear while being juggled by his father.

Nanday was born on Cactus Island to Mr. 9 and Miss Monday, sometime during the last two years.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Nanday is the infant son of Mr. 9 and Miss Monday.

entities.name: Nangi
entities.description:
Nangi is a member of the Numbers in the Beasts Pirates, representing the number "seven".

Due to his actions and role, he is a minor antagonist in the Wano Country Arc.

As one of the Numbers, Nangi's size seems to be large even by giant standards; in one instance he was shown to utterly dwarf the likes of Jack, who himself is over eight meters tall.

Nangi greatly resembles depictions of oni in traditional Japanese art. He is broadly built and bears a wide mouth full of sharp teeth, including a particularly big pair of upper canines. Nangi has round eyes, light skin, a wide nose, short, curly, green hair with a matching beard, and a small pair of horns on his head. On his lower body he dons an enormous tiger pelt, which in the anime is depicted as having been fashioned into a pair of shorts.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Nangi is a member of the Numbers in the Beasts Pirates, representing the number "seven".

entities.name: Napoleon
entities.description:
Napoleon the Bicorne is a homie taking the form of a hat that is worn by Big Mom. He can also become a sword homie that Big Mom uses in combat. He is a special kind of homie, as he received a soul fragment from Big Mom herself, and serves as one of her personal weapons alongside Prometheus and Hera, and formerly Zeus.

Napoleon is an extremely large pink bicorne hat with a Jolly Roger on the front; the Jolly Roger consists of a skull with yellow eyes, two crossed knives, and a curled white mustache. He emotes through the skull of the Jolly Roger, seeing with its eyes and talking with its mouth. Napoleon also has a yellow stripe around his top, and a fastener on his left side.

Napoleon also can turn into a form of a giant blade with insane-looking eyes and a wicked sharp-toothed grin on the sharp edge.

20 years before the current timeline, Napoleon had a crack on his right forehead.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description:
Nashi is the king of the and one of fifty monarchs who took part in the Levely.

Nashi is a middle-aged man with puffy cheeks, a hunchback and long, light-colored hair that is pulled up to his crown.

He wears royal robes and a pair of sunglasses.

Nashi appears to be a politically social person, being seen interacting with another king.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Nashi is the king of the and one of fifty monarchs who took part in the Levely.

entities.name: Natto
entities.description:
Natto is a former member of the Sand-Sand Clan and, later, of the Arabasta Rebel Army.

Natto is a man of average height. He wears a wrapped hat, dark sunglasses, and a striped shirt.

As a child, he wore an un-buttoned shirt, with black spots near the bottom, and a black stripe at the end of the short sleeves. He wore a sash, with shorts, and sandals.

Natto believes in the same vision of Arabasta as Koza, strongly enough to join the Rebel Army.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Natto is a former member of the Sand-Sand Clan and, later, of the Arabasta Rebel Army.

entities.name: Nazu Ketagari
entities.description:
Nazu Ketagari is a Vice Admiral and the head of a Marine Headquarters division in charge of assigning epithets to Marines, including the Admiral aliases.

Ketagari has a long, thin face with an angular jaw, hooked nose, and small, round eyes. He has rosy cheeks, small ears, and full lips, and the corners of his mouth are upturned. He has has dark hair that is pulled into pig-tails and a long, thin mustache. Ketagari wears a standard Marine cap and coat.

Little is known about Ketagari's personality. He has a hobby of fortune-telling based off people's names.

Every Vice Admiral has the ability to use Haki, so Ketagari also has this ability.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Nazu Ketagari is a Vice Admiral and the head of a Marine Headquarters division in charge of assigning epithets to Marines, including the Admiral aliases.

entities.name: Nefertari Cobra
entities.description:
Nefertari Cobra was the 12th king of the Arabasta Kingdom, the former patriarch of Nefertari Family, husband of the late Nefertari Titi and father of Nefertari Vivi. He was related to Nefertari D. Lili, one of the First Twenty monarchs who founded the World Government, and secretly bore her initial D. in his name.

He was a major character throughout the Arabasta Arc and a two-time participant of the Levely, having played a key role in the vote that led to the dissolution of the Seven Warlords of the Sea in the latest one. During the latest Levely, Cobra was murdered by Imu and the Five Elders after learning about the former's existence and sacrificing himself so Sabo could escape.

Cobra was a man of average height. He had a wrinkled face, a tied-off beard, and long, curly, black hair. He wore a green robe with yellow edging, an orange and beige sash around his waist, and a purple coat. He also wore black shoes and a necklace.

After the timeskip he grew a mustache, his beard had turned completely gray, and only half of his hair was still dark. His sideburns were gray but the upper half of the back and top were black. He wore a lighter colored robe and coat and no longer wore his necklace.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Nefertari Cobra was the 12th king of the Arabasta Kingdom, the former patriarch of Nefertari Family, husband of the late Nefertari Titi and father of Nefertari Vivi. He was related to Nefertari D. Lili, one of the First…

entities.name: Nekomamushi
entities.description:
Master Nekomamushi is a feline mink and the former guardian of the Whale Forest on Zou. He was one of the two rulers of the Mokomo Dukedom, dubbed the "Ruler of Night", holding the position from 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM. He and Inuarashi serve as retainers for the Kouzuki Family of Wano Country, as members of the Nine Red Scabbards.

Alongside Inuarashi he was once a member of the Whitebeard Pirates and Roger Pirates, serving under Kouzuki Oden. Pedro has claimed that he and Inuarashi must not be allowed to die because "the world is waiting for them". After Kaidou's fall from power, Nekomamushi became a yakuza boss in the Flower Capital.

He is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Whole Cake Island and Wano Country Sagas.

Nekomamushi is a large, yellow feline mink with dark brown stripes, sharp teeth, claws, and a very thick striped tail. He has wild, bushy blonde hair resembling a lion's mane running around his neck and down his back, and there is a scar running from the left side of his forehead down to his cheek. His outfit consists of a large red robe decorated with orange and yellow circles, a pink haramaki around his waist, tan sandals, and a white shirt paired with white pants. In addition, he frequently smokes a . Like all the retainers of the Kouzuki Family, Nekomamushi bears the family crest somewhere on his body.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Master Nekomamushi is a feline mink and the former guardian of the Whale Forest on Zou. He was one of the two rulers of the Mokomo Dukedom, dubbed the "Ruler of Night", holding the position from 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM. He…

entities.name: Neoki
entities.description:
Neoki is a Waiter of the Beasts Pirates who serves as a guard in the Prisoner Mine of the Udon region.

Neoki is a taller man, with a muscular build, and a pronounced jaw. He has puffy purple hair, and a metallic mask he wears over the top half of his face. He wears an open purple shirt that leaves his chest exposed along with a set of gray pauldrons on his shoulders, as well as a pair of blue pants. In addition, he has a tattoo on the lower-right side of his chest reading, "BOUTTO 4TEL".

Like his fellow Waiters, Neoki is without honor, and has no qualms about attacking someone unable to defend himself if it means he can gain glory from it.

Neoki was fairly weak, as he was defeated without trouble by Kawamatsu.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Neoki is a Waiter of the Beasts Pirates who serves as a guard in the Prisoner Mine of the Udon region.

entities.name: Neptune
entities.description:
King Neptune is a merman and the king of the Ryugu Kingdom on Fish-Man Island. He is also the current patriarch of the Neptune Family, father of Fukaboshi, Ryuboshi, Manboshi, and Shirahoshi, and the husband of the late Queen Otohime.

Neptune is a giant-sized and muscular merman. He has a red nose, small eyes, and long, thick, orange, curly hair (despite his age of seventy) and a beard. Both his chest and arms are covered with hair. He is bare-chested and has matching black tattoos on both arms, which look like spirals with wavy protrusion designs around it.

He wears a gold crown that resembles a tulip with jewels embedded and a golden bracelet on each wrist and carries a gold trident with an elaborate design.

At Otohime's funeral, he wore a large suit. When he and his family arrived at the Red Port for the Levely, he wore a dark-colored coat.

entities.short_description: King Neptune is a merman and the king of the Ryugu Kingdom on Fish-Man Island. He is also the current patriarch of the Neptune Family, father of Fukaboshi, Ryuboshi, Manboshi, and Shirahoshi, and the husband of the late…

entities.name: Nero
entities.description:
Nero the Sea Weasel was the newest agent of CP9 and part of the team escorting Nico Robin to Enies Lobby.

He was one of the antagonists during the Puffing Tom's voyage in the Water 7 Arc.

Nero is a pale, slim man, wearing a striking attire consisting of a dark-brown T-shirt, orange pants, decorated shoes and a hat adorned with a red plume. He has two necklaces around his neck, a simple one composed of green beads, and a bigger and more elaborate one, which consists of many red jewels linked together. He wears a glove on his left hand, and bracelets around the wrist. He has an unique hairstyle, with a bald top crossed by three mohawk-like strips.

Having undergone the customary training of CP9 agents, he is a calm and collected individual, seen with the casual way he spoke with Franky when they fought. Nonetheless, he is not above displaying his emotions, such as anger at being tricked, fear in the face of inevitable pain, or exasperation in the face of Franky's antics. Additionally, Nero appears to be less hardened than the other agents, as he easily believed Franky's lie when he asked what was behind him, just so that he could sucker punch him. Beneath his calm exterior, he has a measure of arrogance, thinking that knowing four of the six forms of Six Powers made him a "superhuman" that could be in the same league as the other, full-fledged CP9 agents. When Rob Lucci expelled Nero from the group with a death threat, Nero became horrified and made a failed attempt to run away.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Nero the Sea Weasel was the newest agent of CP9 and part of the team escorting Nico Robin to Enies Lobby.

entities.name: Nezumi
entities.description:
Captain Nezumi is a Marine captain of the 16th Branch in the East Blue. Highly corrupt, he covered up the vast majority of Arlong's actions in the Conomi Islands in exchange for bribe money.

Due to his actions, he can be considered the secondary antagonist of the Arlong Park Arc. He is also the one responsible for officially making Monkey D. Luffy a wanted criminal to the World Government by requesting his first ever bounty.

Nezumi is a slim, dark-haired man with—appropriately for his name—a strongly mouse-like appearance. His eyes are constantly narrowed, while his facial hair consists of a thin goatee and six long, wire-like whiskers on his upper lip. His Marine uniform is heavily customized, with the standard cap converted into a mouse-eared , connected to a buttoned-up that reaches to his feet, accessorized with a belt and blue .

His coat carries a blueish-grey color in the TV anime, which is dulled in the digitally colored manga and Episode of East Blue.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Captain Nezumi is a Marine captain of the 16th Branch in the East Blue. Highly corrupt, he covered up the vast majority of Arlong's actions in the Conomi Islands in exchange for bribe money.

entities.name: Nigeratta
entities.description:
Nigeratta is a man from Nico Robin's past.

Nigeratta is a middle-aged man with shoulder-length black hair parted to the sides, a mustache of matching color, a crooked nose, long chin, and small, slit-like eyes.

Nigeratta is a deceptive and greedy man, as he acted kind enough to adopt Robin in her time of need, only planning to turn her in for the bounty on her head. He is also egocentric and hypocritical, as when Robin overheard his plan and fled, he accused her of betraying their kindness when he is the one who attempted the betrayal.

Nigeratta owns a rifle, which he intended to use while searching for Robin.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Nigeratta is a man from Nico Robin's past.

entities.name: Ninjin
entities.description:
Ninjin is a former member of the Usopp Pirates, along with Piiman and Tamanegi, before Usopp joined the Straw Hat Pirates.

He is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Syrup Village Arc.

Ninjin is a freckled boy with short spiky purple hair (white in the digital colored manga) that covers his eyes, a red hat (orange in the digital colored manga) with a frill at the top and the Usopp Pirates Jolly Roger on the front, and a face that ends in a pointed chin; these three features make his head resemble a carrot. He also wears a black sweater, a reddish-brown sash, light orange pants (yellow in the digital colored manga), and dark brown shoes, with light brown on the bottom.

After two years, he has grown taller and his hair appears to be less spiky than before, and he wears a light-colored hooded jacket with buttons. He also wears black calf-length pants and black laced shoes.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Ninjin is a former member of the Usopp Pirates, along with Piiman and Tamanegi, before Usopp joined the Straw Hat Pirates.

entities.name: Ninth
entities.description:
Ninth is an infamous New World pirate captain who allied with Whitebeard.

Ninth is a tall man with dark hair and a scar on his forehead. He has long sideburns, a pointed nose and a rather long chin. His chest is exposed, and he has ruffles on his wrists.

Not much is known of Ninth's personality, other than that he was willing to fight to save Ace.

Ninth is a fearsome pirate who has managed to achieve an infamous reputation in the New World, and to make an alliance with Whitebeard.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Ninth is an infamous New World pirate captain who allied with Whitebeard.

entities.name: Noble Croc
entities.description:
The Noble Croc is a crocodile homie that lives in the Seducing Woods on Whole Cake Island.

The Noble Croc is a very large light blue crocodile, dwarfing normal humans. He often stands on his hind legs, further increasing his height. He wears a purple bowler hat as well as a pair of pants with suspenders.

The Noble Croc is carnivorous and has no qualms with eating other sentient beings, though with the notable exception of humans, and he is eagerly willing to try other races such as mink.

As a crocodile, the Noble Croc is a good swimmer and is capable of swimming undetected. Due to his large size, he is able to swallow multiple regular-sized humans and minks at once.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: The Noble Croc is a crocodile homie that lives in the Seducing Woods on Whole Cake Island.

entities.name: Nodoi Wakan
entities.description:
Nodoi Wakan is a Waiter of the Beasts Pirates who serves as a guard in the Prisoner Mine of the Udon region.

Wakan is an average-sized man, with a heavier build. He has green hair that he fashions out of the top of his helmet. He wears an open purple shirt that leaves his chest exposed along with a set of gray pauldrons on his shoulders, as well as a pair of dark-green pants.

Like his fellow Waiters, Wakan is without honor, and has no qualms about attacking someone unable to defend himself if it means he can gain glory from it.

Wakan is quite weak, as he faltered from having a fishbone penetrating his neck, and was quickly defeated thereafter.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Nodoi Wakan is a Waiter of the Beasts Pirates who serves as a guard in the Prisoner Mine of the Udon region.

entities.name: Nokokuwa Police
entities.description:
Nokokuwa Police is a Shinuchi of the Beasts Pirates and part of the Armored Division led by Sasaki. After being tamed by Tama, he became an ally of the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance.

Nokokuwa Police is a tall muscular man, approximately twice as tall as Zoro's height, and has tattoos of fish bones on his chest. Due to consuming a Stag Beetle SMILE, he has a pair of stag beetle's mandibles on his shoulders and an extra pair of arms. He wears a police hat with a golden buckle on it, a sleeveless leather jacket, two pairs of black gloves, leather pants with a belt, and boots. As a Gifter, he has black horns on his head.

In his first two appearances, he lacked the tattoos on his upper body and wore suspenders under his vest and shoulder pads with spikes. The pattern on his police hat looked more like three connected circles than what is shown later.

Nokokuwa Police appears to be very loyal to the Beasts Pirates and does not seem to have a problem with firing on Kouzuki Momonosuke, a child. He appears to look down on those who challenge his crew, trying to convince Zoro to give up during the Raid on Onigashima. In the anime, he appears to be cold-hearted, laughing alongside the rest of the Armored Division when Sasaki made fun of the Kouzuki Family.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Nokokuwa Police is a Shinuchi of the Beasts Pirates and part of the Armored Division led by Sasaki. After being tamed by Tama, he became an ally of the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance.

entities.name: Nora Gitsune
entities.description:
Nora Gitsune is a fox who filled the role of the "pet" for the Fake Straw Hat Crew, who did not know that the real Chopper is the crew's doctor and is given human-traits by the Hito Hito no Mi.

Nora Gitsune is a light brown fox with black legs. He has a curled mustache and a chain-leash around his neck. He also wears a hat similar to Chopper's, but without the 'X' mark on the front.

While the real Chopper is sweet and patient, Gitsune seems to be more aggressive when provoked, as shown when he bit Cocoa for kicking him. Otherwise, he's fairly passive.

Gitsune bit Cocoa's head, and was able to hang on with his teeth, so he presumably has a strong bite with the strength of a normal fox.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Nora Gitsune is a fox who filled the role of the "pet" for the Fake Straw Hat Crew, who did not know that the real Chopper is the crew's doctor and is given human-traits by the Hito Hito no Mi.

entities.name: Norinosuke
entities.description:
Norinosuke is a self-proclaimed shaman from the Flower Capital of the Wano Country and the father of Beasts Pirates officer Holed'em.

Norinosuke is a wiry man of average height with long, brown hair. He wears heavy black makeup around his lips and eyes, and dresses in a white with purple pants; around his head, he wears a circlet of lit candles supported by a white band, and he carries an . His face, in particular, resembles that of his son Holed'em.

He is dressed in what appears to be the ceremonial garb of a .

Norinosuke appears to be a particularly religious individual, evident by the religious garb he wears. He is more religiously inclined than the average Wano citizen; while he notes that many people no longer believe in the divinity of white boars, he appears to, and encourages those around him to return Koyama to the mountain. When Kin'emon attempted to battle the Mountain God, Norinosuke urged him to stop, stating that the entire country would fall into ruin if it was harmed.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Norinosuke is a self-proclaimed shaman from the Flower Capital of the Wano Country and the father of Beasts Pirates officer Holed'em.

entities.name: Nosgarl
entities.description:
Nosgarl is an infamous New World pirate captain who allied with Whitebeard.

Nosgarl is an aged man with light hair resembling horns, glasses, and a hooked nose. He wears an old-fashioned pirate dress, with a mantle and heels. As many characters, his legs are disproportionately short and slender compared to his main body.

Not much is known about Nosgarl's personality other than that he is very loyal to Whitebeard as he was willing to risk his own life trying to save Ace from execution.

Nosgarl is a fearsome pirate who has managed to achieve an infamous reputation in the New World, and he made an alliance with Whitebeard.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Nosgarl is an infamous New World pirate captain who allied with Whitebeard.

entities.name: Nubon
entities.description:
Nubon is a dwarf from Tontatta Kingdom who first appeared on Green Bit.

Nubon is a normal sized dwarf with a stubby, round nose, thick lips, and dark lines beneath his eyes. He has bushy, light-colored hair under a large, round hat and a dark-colored mustache. He wears a long sleeved shirt with a tie and overalls.

Nubon is quite gullible, believing Usopp was a descendant of Mont Blanc Noland. He is also quite brave, having sacrificed himself to allow his comrades to continue Operation SOP.

Nubon seems fairly strong, being able to topple Lao G with the assistance of Baxcon and Daikon. He was not, however, strong enough to greatly damage the pirate.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Nubon is a dwarf from Tontatta Kingdom who first appeared on Green Bit.

entities.name: Nugire Yainu
entities.description:
Nugire Yainu was the shipwright of the Black Cat Pirates and the crew member who was killed by the Marines three years prior to Kuro enacting his plan.

Yainu has a square-shaped face with small, round glasses with his black hair combed back neatly. He wears a red shirt with his crew's jolly roger on the front, with regular pants and shoes.

He was given the captain's jacket to wear, which was black with red interior and the crew's symbol on the shoulder pads when he was handed over to the Marines. Overall, Yainu has a passing resemblance to his captain, Kuro, to the point where the Marines were not able to tell the difference.

He was shown to be feeble-minded enough to fall victim to Jango’s hypnotism.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Nugire Yainu was the shipwright of the Black Cat Pirates and the crew member who was killed by the Marines three years prior to Kuro enacting his plan.

entities.name: Nyornyo Nyarmani
entities.description:
Nyornyo Nyarmani is a famous fashion designer from the Nagagutsu Kingdom. He is the creator of a high-end fashion brand which shares his name, "Nyornyo Nyarmani", which is worn by the Five Elders.

Nyarmani is an elderly cat mink with a relatively human-like face filled with wrinkles. Otherwise, he has typical cat features such as a furry body, short overhead fur, a flat snout, whiskers and slitted pupils.

Not much is known about Nyarmani's personality. He appears to believe in a form of , and argues that "being naked is the height of fashion".

Nyarmani is a highly rated fashion designer, responsible for designing the outfits worn by the Five Elders. His work is apparently of such fine quality that the Elders only purchase their clothes from him.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Nyornyo Nyarmani is a famous fashion designer from the Nagagutsu Kingdom. He is the creator of a high-end fashion brand which shares his name, "Nyornyo Nyarmani", which is worn by the Five Elders.

entities.name: Oars
entities.description:
Oars the Continent-Puller, also known as the "Devil", was an infamous ancient giant. Around 500 years ago, he wreaked havoc on the seas by conquering countries and hauling away entire islands, which he used to create a "nation of villains". He eventually died in the Land of Ice.

After he died, his body was unearthed by the Thriller Bark Pirates and was subsequently revived by Gecko Moria as Zombie #900, a Special Zombie. As the member of Moria's army animated using the stolen shadow of Monkey D. Luffy, he was a major obstacle that the Straw Hat Pirates had to overcome during their adventure on Thriller Bark. He is the direct ancestor of Little Oars Jr.

Due to his actions, he is a major antagonist of the Thriller Bark Arc.

Oars is an extremely large, red-skinned, skull-faced zombie who is more than four times the size of an average giant; his sheer size caused Roronoa Zoro and Franky to mistake his body for a large wall upon encountering it up close. Oars has two large horns and long yellow hair that flows from his head to his back. His upper teeth are squared, while his lower teeth are pointed with long canines. He is missing his right eye, and his left arm has "SZ-900" tattooed on it, "SZ" representing "Special Zombie" and "900" being his zombie classification number.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Oars the Continent-Puller, also known as the "Devil", was an infamous ancient giant. Around 500 years ago, he wreaked havoc on the seas by conquering countries and hauling away entire islands, which he used to create a…

entities.name: Ochoku
entities.description:
Ochoku is a former member of the Rocks Pirates. Following his time with the crew he became the ruler of Hachinosu, before being overthrown by Blackbeard during the Rocky Port Incident.

Ochoku is a large man, around the size of Edward Newgate. He has an overall slimy appearance, with light, greasy green hair, a prominent widows peak, a long, forked tongue, and pronounced, darkened lips. In addition, his ears are pointed, giving him a devilish look as well. He wears a light, frilled purple dress shirt, with a red cravat, a yellow great coat over his shoulders, and dark pants with a floral design. Sometime after the God Valley Incident, Ochoku gained a scar on his cheek and forehead.

Ochoku could best be described as a selfish and ruthless opportunist. After losing a Davy Back Fight against Rocks D. Xebec, he followed his new captain solely to advance his own goals, one of which involved conquering Hachinosu. Sure enough, right before the God Valley Incident, he pawned Shakuyaku to the World Government as a prize for their Native Hunting Competition at God Valley. After Rocks died there, Ochoku was quick to take his seat as the ruler of Hachinosu.

As a former member of the Rocks Pirates, Ochoku was presumably similar to the rest in that he did not get along with his crewmates. He followed Rocks only for his own purposes, apparently without any respect for his captain.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Ochoku is a former member of the Rocks Pirates. Following his time with the crew he became the ruler of Hachinosu, before being overthrown by Blackbeard during the Rocky Port Incident.

entities.name: Ohm
entities.description:
"Skybreeder" Ohm is one of four priests of the former God Enel and a high-ranking member of God's Army. Together with his giant dog steed Holy, he subjected God's enemies to the Ordeal of Iron on Upper Yard. Due to his affiliation and actions, he is a major antagonist in the Skypiea Arc.

Ohm is a bald and muscular man of relatively average height with somewhat tanned skin. As a Birkan, he has a pair of small wings sprouting from his back which extend down to near his waist. He has a small mustache and beard around his mouth, and wears a pair of small sunglasses over his eyes. He also wears a green sleeveless shirt, gray pants with several pockets, a long and flowing white sash around his waist similar to the one worn by his master, and dark leather boots with bandages around the soles.

Eight years ago, he looked the same, except that he wore a polka-dotted shirt instead of a plain one.

Ohm is a stoic and serious man who frequently acts philosophical about human nature. He believes that human nature is to constantly fight one another to achieve happiness, even though such happiness is achieved through peace and humans' frail bodies are destroyed by these conflicts. This bitter irony makes Ohm mourn, even to the point of shedding tears. His idea for the "salvation" of the human race is to eradicate it, and as a guardian of Upper Yard he spent a great deal of time working to kill anyone he encountered.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: "Skybreeder" Ohm is one of four priests of the former God Enel and a high-ranking member of God's Army. Together with his giant dog steed Holy, he subjected God's enemies to the Ordeal of Iron on Upper Yard. Due to his…

entities.name: Oimo
entities.description:
Oimo is a giant from Elbaph and a member of the Giant Warrior Pirates under Dorry and Brogy. He has a grandson attending the Walrus School on Elbaph; Olav.

After being captured by the Marines 50 years ago, he and his comrade Kashii were tricked into serving as the guards of Enies Lobby's main gate. During the Enies Lobby Arc, Oimo and Kashii defected against the World Government and allied themselves with the Straw Hat Pirates, Galley-La Company, and Franky Family.

During the Egghead Arc, Oimo and Kashii became major allies of the Straw Hat Pirates as members of the Giant Warrior Pirates.

Oimo is a thickset giant with a flat, pig-like nose and long, flowing orange hair, along with some stubble on his chin. He sports viking attire, with a light green short-sleeved shirt lined in brown-green. He also wears tab suspenders with large gold buttons, and a big pink tunic with brown lace lined on the top with a lighter colored fluff. Under that, he sports green-brown pants with big black boots. He is seen wearing a Roman style helmet, with gold around the edges and red in the middle, with pink frills on the top. He has a big black belt with a gold buckle, and is usually seen with his gargantuan wooden club.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Oimo is a giant from Elbaph and a member of the Giant Warrior Pirates under Dorry and Brogy. He has a grandson attending the Walrus School on Elbaph; Olav.

entities.name: Oiwa
entities.description:
Oiwa is a man who lived in the Wano Country 41 years ago.

Oiwa is a plump man with short, brown hair stuck up to either side of his head, a topknot, thick eyebrows, and a frequently blushing nose. He has a row of large round teeth in his mouth, and a crescent-shaped scar across his eyebrow near his left eye. He wore a kimono with a floral pattern and a white coat before being robbed by Kin'emon, and a striped kimono after. For a short period of time before the striped kimono was found, Oiwa wore a loincloth.

Oiwa is fairly greedy and not very superstitious, being willing to kidnap a white boar for the Kurokoma Family's bounty. He was quite dedicated in this goal, spending an entire year searching for the animal with Koiwa and Nakaiwa. His greed is strong enough that he is even willing to kidnap bystanders to get paid, though it was overriden by fear when he saw the Mountain God.

Oiwa is quite weak, losing against Kin'emon even with Koiwa and Nakaiwa on his side. However, he is quite experienced in searching, having spent a whole year tracking the legendary white boar, and was even able to kidnap it.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Oiwa is a man who lived in the Wano Country 41 years ago.

entities.name: Okome
entities.description:
Okome is the first mate and the only known member of the Hokahoka Pirates.

Okome is a tall, but fat man with wide cheeks compared to a thin forehead, but seemingly no hair. He wears a yellow tricorne with a bowl of rice from Doskoi Panda on top of it, a purple captain's coat over the rest of his unseen attire.

Little is known about Okome's personality, but he was the only person who witnessed Bellamy's attack on Roshio and managed to keep a straight face.

Okome was present as an onlooker when Bellamy injured Roshio in Mock Town.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Okome is the first mate and the only known member of the Hokahoka Pirates.

entities.name: Olav
entities.description:
Olav is a student at the Walrus School on Elbaph. He is the grandson of Oimo.

Olav is a young boy with a large, round face. He wears a fur coat, a belt with a large, round buckle, and black gloves. Additionally, he has a large, uniquely-shaped helmet with two horns and a top piece resembling a Roman pluma.

Like other Walrus School students, Olav is against violence and fighting. Befittingly, he did not care for the Giant Warrior Pirates, considering them to be savages; this extends to even family, as he looked down on his grandfather for being a member. However, upon being rescued from the Knights of God, he was excited to watch the crew fight against the enemies.

Oimo is Olav's grandfather. Although Oimo cares greatly for Olav, his grandson has been shown to have a fairly low opinion of his grandfather and his crewmates. Despite this, he was greatly concerned when Oimo put his life on the line to rescue him.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Olav is a student at the Walrus School on Elbaph. He is the grandson of Oimo.

entities.name: Oliva
entities.description:
Oliva is the former boss of Port Chibaralta Island, which was part of Whitebeard's territory. However, he was deposed by Portgas D. Ace due to partaking in the slave trade.

Oliva wore a flashy striped suit showing his rippling muscles and a gorilla costume mask over his face. He also wore thick rings of pure gold on all fingers.

When the mask was taken off, his features looked more like a gorilla's than a human.

Oliva is an unscrupulous individual, as seen by his participation in the slave trade despite Whitebeard forbidding it.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Oliva is the former boss of Port Chibaralta Island, which was part of Whitebeard's territory. However, he was deposed by Portgas D. Ace due to partaking in the slave trade.

entities.name: Omasa
entities.description:
"Blood-Writing" Omasa is a yakuza boss who was in charge of the Udon region in Wano Country. He was imprisoned in Udon by the Beasts Pirates, but was freed when Luffy took over the prison.

Omasa is a large man with light colored hair, with two braids at the front of his face and bells at the end of them. He has thin whiskers and a large scar over his right eye.

Being a yakuza boss, he had the respect of his followers from Udon, as well as the other yakuza bosses of his time, being able to work alongside them. He seems to highly respect Hyougoro, and would threaten those who offend the elder as well as obey his commands. He is also caring and brave. After he was infected by the Ice Oni virus, he was willing to commit suicide to prevent himself from attacking and infecting his comrades.

Omasa seems to have enough strength to hold down a struggling Luffy while the latter is being punished for his rudeness.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: "Blood-Writing" Omasa is a yakuza boss who was in charge of the Udon region in Wano Country. He was imprisoned in Udon by the Beasts Pirates, but was freed when Luffy took over the prison.

entities.name: Onigumo
entities.description:
Vice Admiral Onigumo is a Marine officer, and one of the five vice admirals who led the Buster Call on Enies Lobby. His name was revealed in the third databook.

Due to his actions, he is a minor antagonist in the Enies Lobby and Marineford Arcs.

Onigumo is a tall man with a cold face and eyes that are always semi-closed. He is usually seen smoking a cigarette, has long brown hair, and wears an ancient war helmet with a small, traditional Japanese dragon on it, and a long red plume hanging from it. Under his Marine coat he wears a double-breasted gray suit over a dark green shirt with a silver tie. He also has a golden loop earring on his left ear.

Onigumo is a firm believer of the Absolute Justice philosophy, and is willing to sacrifice anything to defeat what is defined as "evil". This was shown when a soldier questioned Onigumo's order of destroying a fellow Buster Call ship and one thousand comrades just to kill Monkey D. Luffy, which led Onigumo to shoot him dead in cold blood. In the anime, his dedication to Absolute Justice is further shown at Marineford, when he gave a charismatic speech to other Marines telling them that their victory in the pursuit for justice must be absolute by slaughtering as many pirates as possible.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Vice Admiral Onigumo is a Marine officer, and one of the five vice admirals who led the Buster Call on Enies Lobby. His name was revealed in the third databook.

entities.name: Onimaru
entities.description:
Onimaru is a komagitsune who was once the companion of the late daimyo of Ringo, Shimotsuki Ushimaru.

After the death of his master, he joined forces with Kawamatsu in collecting weapons for the final battle against Kaidou and protecting them from robbers. After Kawamatsu was captured, Onimaru posed as a human known as Gyukimaru on Oihagi Bridge, stealing weapons from people while continuing to guard the graves.

Being a komagitsune, Onimaru heavily resembles a fox, with his fur and tail having a flaming composition, and his pointy ears have a swirly appearance. His fur is light, with his legs being dark below the knees. He is rather large, appearing to be over half the size of the very large kappa Kawamatsu.

As Gyukimaru, he is a very large man with a face resembling a mask. He wears a dark kimono, light pants, and a light cape, and carries many weapons on his back. He also wears a very large bead necklace.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Onimaru is a komagitsune who was once the companion of the late daimyo of Ringo, Shimotsuki Ushimaru.

entities.name: Oran
entities.description:
Oran was the husband of Roji, the father of Mizuira, the younger brother of Nico Olvia, and the maternal uncle and foster parent of Nico Robin.

Oran had black hair in a combover, a thin curled mustache, and slight stubble on his chin. He wore glasses along with a collared shirt, sweater, and bowtie.

Oran was a generally absent father figure for Robin. Although he tried to comfort Robin when her mother sailed and defended her from his wife's abuse, he rarely defied Roji's temper and let her treat Robin as if she were their servant, despite his older sister asked him to take care of her precious daughter.

28 years ago, Oran agreed, against his wife's wishes, to look after his niece Robin. He saw his sister Olvia off at the harbor when she left on her voyage, and tried to comfort Robin. When Roji angrily threatened to hit Robin if she did not cease crying, Oran stopped his wife.

entities.short_description: Oran was the husband of Roji, the father of Mizuira, the younger brother of Nico Olvia, and the maternal uncle and foster parent of Nico Robin.

entities.name: Orlumbus
entities.description:
"Massacre Ruler" Orlumbus is a former adventurer from the Standing Kingdom and the admiral of the Yonta Maria Grand Fleet. He joined as a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum to compete for the Mera Mera no Mi. After the final battle against Donquixote Doflamingo, Orlumbus pledged his loyalty to Monkey D. Luffy and became a pirate and the captain of the seventh ship of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet.

He is an ally of Luffy during the Dressrosa Arc, and one of the central characters from The Stories of the Self-Proclaimed Straw Hat Grand Fleet Cover Page Serial.

Orlumbus is a huge man that resembles a stereotypical pirate captain. He has a deep frown and thick chin with stubble. He wears his long blond hair in braids with four slung over his shoulder. He has a large, masculine upper-body and a small lower-body with small legs.

He wears a bicorn with a small skull on the front over a black bandanna with orange spots. There are four braids coming down from his hat, it is unknown if it is his hat or his hair (like Buggy). He wears a buckled strap over his bare chest under a navy blue (red in the anime) naval long-coat.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: "Massacre Ruler" Orlumbus is a former adventurer from the Standing Kingdom and the admiral of the Yonta Maria Grand Fleet. He joined as a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum to compete for the Mera Mera no Mi. After the…

entities.name: Ossamondo
entities.description:
Ossamondo is a member of the Spade Pirates.

Ossamondo is a large, rotund man with light-colored hair, a light-colored beard, small eyes, prominent lips, and slim legs. He wears a long top that ties at the collar and has a pattern on the bottom left side, a furry cape, pants, and pointed shoes.

Ossamondo cares greatly about his captain, Portgas D. Ace, since he was willing to defend him from Edward Newgate. Ossamondo can also be somewhat disrespectful, laughing at Deuce's adventure diary despite the fact that it is his main aspiration of their travels.

Like the rest of the Spade Pirates, Ossamondo cares greatly for his captain, warning Ace about Jinbe and defending him from an Emperor. However, Ossamondo was not seen during the Summit War of Marineford.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Ossamondo is a member of the Spade Pirates.

entities.name: Ottoland
entities.description:
Ottoland is one of the Franky Family's Kairiki Destroyers.

Ottoland is a large, muscular man with brown, unruly hair and fleshy lips. He wears the Franky Family uniform, consisting of a metal lederhosen with a pink star and a pair of specialized goggles, as well as a bandana with a star, round shoulder pads, and green shorts.

Like the other Kairiki Destroyers, Ottoland is an abnormally large human, reaching up above the legs of regular-sized giants and towering above the other members of the Franky Family.

In his initial appearance in the Digitally Colored Manga, Ottoland's hair was a much lighter shade of brown, and his bandana was gray instead of beige. His later appearances match the anime.
