entities.short_description: Estrid was the mother of Loki, as well as the former arranged wife to king Harald, making her Elbaph's latest queen. She was also the daughter of a pureblooded and ancient influential lineage, akin to nobility. She…

entities.name: Ettara Chaunkai
entities.description:
Ettara Chaunkai is a citizen of Dressrosa.

Chaunkai is a young woman with a hourglass-shaped body figure. She has a round face, eyes, nose and styles her volumous pink hair in braided pigtails similarly to Lola, making her resemble the latter from behind. She wears a lime green dress with an orange coat draped over her shoulders and carries a small purse with her.

Not much is known about Chaunkai's personality. She is hit on often, so she tends to think that strangers speaking to her are doing the same.

While out shopping around Dressrosa with her friend Furika, the two women were approached by Bege, who had mistaken them for his wife and sister-in-law due to their hairstyles. Chaunkai paid no attention to Bege as she thought he was just another man hitting on her.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Ettara Chaunkai is a citizen of Dressrosa.

entities.name: Fillonce
entities.description:
Fillonce is an mermaid and one of the Mermaid Cafe Dancers.

Fillonce is a mermaid with a clear blue almost white tail which has an agglomerations of white dot-like markings. And just like Camie, she has prominent lips. Her pink somewhat frizzly hair opens wide with her bangs curling to the right.

She wears a red bikini top, with the straps crossing over the exact top of her cleavage, through a ring, and around her neck.

Like all other mermaids shown so far, Fillonce is friendly, kind, caring, and is apparently fun loving. She even seems to like Sanji like the rest of her friends. Like Ishilly, Fillonce does have a curious side to her, wanting to see what was inside Caribou's tightly sealed barrel.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Fillonce is an mermaid and one of the Mermaid Cafe Dancers.

entities.name: Flare
entities.description:
Flare was a character from Eiichiro Oda's one-shot Monsters.

Flare was a young girl with shoulder-length dark brown hair and dark green eyes. She wears a white shirt with line patterns and an orange apron over it. She looks very similar to Nami before the timeskip.

In the anime, Flare's hair and eyes are pale orange and pale blue respectively. Her shirt is also yellow with a much simpler stripe pattern, and her apron becomes navy blue. She also wears brown pants with boots.

Flare is a kind girl, giving Ryuma, who had starved for five days, free food. She is also trusting and caring, as she was affectionate towards Cyrano for supposedly saving her life, but turned out to be using her, which led her to cry when she discovered the truth.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Flare was a character from Eiichiro Oda's one-shot Monsters.

entities.name: Fukumi
entities.description:
Fukumi was the younger sister of Fukurokuju.

Fukumi was a young girl with light frizzy hair tied in a low ponytail, with bangs on both sides of her face. She had flower hairpieces at the top of the bangs and at the base of the ponytail, and wore a kimono.

She seems to have been on good terms with her brother, as he ended up bearing a grudge for her sake. However, Fukurokuju misunderstood her feelings towards Raizo.

Fukumi fell in love with Raizo after being rescued by him. Although Raizo reciprocated her feelings, he accidentally hurt her and ended up escaping in shame. Fukumi later called his name on her deathbed.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Fukumi was the younger sister of Fukurokuju.

entities.name: Furika
entities.description:
Furika is a tall, plump woman with shoulder-length hair kept in pigtails. She wears a striped dress, a sunhat with a wide brim, and dark sunglasses, and carries a small black purse.

Her hair and build make her resemble Charlotte Chiffon from behind.

Not much is known about Furika's personality, but she is apparently kind, and did not mind being mistaken for Chiffon by Bege.

While out shopping around Dressrosa with her friend Ettara Chaunkai, the two women were approached by Bege, who had mistaken them for his wife and sister-in-law due to their hairstyles. However, Furika was unbothered by the interruption and did not hold it against Bege.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Furika is a tall, plump woman with shoulder-length hair kept in pigtails. She wears a striped dress, a sunhat with a wide brim, and dark sunglasses, and carries a small black purse.

entities.name: Gatherine
entities.description:
Gatherine is a cafeteria worker at Enies Lobby.

Gatherine is a pale woman, with black hair tied into two pigtails in the back. She has light blue eyes, and red makeup on her cheeks and lips. She has a large chin and large cheeks. She wears a white button up shirt, with a pink skirt.

She only cares about men for their looks.

Over 13 years ago, Gatherine rejected Who's-Who's advances.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Gatherine is a cafeteria worker at Enies Lobby.

entities.name: Gerd
entities.description:
Gerd is a giant from Elbaph and the doctor of the New Giant Warrior Pirates. She was formerly an S-Class ranked mercenary for Buggy's Delivery.

She is a major ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Elbaph Arc.

Gerd is a slender and taller than average giantess with long blonde hair, part of which is kept in two braids on the sides of her head. She has dark brown eyes (blue as a child). She wears a revealing one-piece purple fur garment with a neckline that goes down to her stomach and which leaves the sides of her legs completely exposed. She also wears a very long black and yellow striped stocking on her left leg that nearly goes up to her waist, as well as an eggshell cape with tatters on the bottom and fur boots.

As a child, she had shoulder-length hair and she wore a light blue long-sleeved dress, and has her hair arranged in two braids under a yellow checkered kerchief.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Gerd is a giant from Elbaph and the doctor of the New Giant Warrior Pirates. She was formerly an S-Class ranked mercenary for Buggy's Delivery.

entities.name: Gina
entities.description:
Gina was the female carpenter of the Foxy Pirates. She left the crew sometime during the Timeskip.

Gina is a normal sized, attractive woman with short, wavy red hair reaching down to her neck. She also wears the same mask as other Foxy Pirates and a dark colored shirt with straps over the shoulders and short short with a belt, and long gloves, like some of the other Foxy Pirates. She wears a string abound her forehead with a green jewel on it and two red bands with a heart on her forearms. She has a thigh holster with a hammer in it.

It is unknown how loyal she is to Foxy or the Foxy Pirates, as she was most likely just won in a Davy Back Fight.

In the anime filler, Gina's personality is revealed to be conniving and flirtatious, since she enticed Sanji during the Hit and Deadball game.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Gina was the female carpenter of the Foxy Pirates. She left the crew sometime during the Timeskip.

entities.name: Ginko
entities.description:
Ginko is a little girl who was held captive on Punk Hazard. She was one of the children Momonosuke met when he came to the island. She is only named in the anime.

Ginko is a little girl, with short brown hair, and wears a white shirt. Due to her being a recent arrival to Punk Hazard, she has not had the growth transformation that others have.

Ginko is a very caring little girl, since she asked how Momonosuke was doing and was worried about him. She is also very innocent, as she believed whatever the Punk Hazard personnel told her.

She is quite hopeful, since she told Momonosuke that he was not alone in missing his parents and wanting to leave.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Ginko is a little girl who was held captive on Punk Hazard. She was one of the children Momonosuke met when he came to the island. She is only named in the anime.

entities.name: Ginny
entities.description:
Ginny was the former East Army commander of the Revolutionary Army, having joined the group alongside Bartholomew Kuma 22 years ago, back when they were known as the Freedom Fighters. She was the late mother of Jewelry Bonney.

She was previously a slave from the Porco Kingdom who was forced to take part in the Native Hunting Competition on God Valley 38 years ago. She and Emporio Ivankov were responsible for orchestrating the God Valley Incident as a means of escaping the Native Hunting Competition.

She was captured by the World Government and became the eighth wife to a World Noble. She was also one of Jaygarcia Saturn's test subjects and developed the Sapphire Scales disease after a failed experiment. Ginny was then released from slavery and used the little time remaining to her to return to the Sorbet Kingdom with her child, dying as a result.

38 years ago, Ginny was a young girl with freckles, purple eyes, and a missing tooth. She had short, messy pink hair with prominent bangs around her face. She wore a pink sleeveless shirt, yellow shorts, and brown shoes.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Ginny was the former East Army commander of the Revolutionary Army, having joined the group alongside Bartholomew Kuma 22 years ago, back when they were known as the Freedom Fighters. She was the late mother of Jewelry…

entities.name: Ginrummy
entities.description:
Ginrummy is a Shinuchi of the Beasts Pirates.

Ginrummy is a tall woman of slender build with white skin, pink hair, and light blue eyes. She wears very little clothing, limited up to two pieces of red-violet metal breastplated armor with golden spine-like dots and white fur covering her breasts around them, a red-violet thong, a pair of black gloves, black calf-length high-heel boots, small thin golden earrings on her ears, and an open black cloak with white fur and spine-like dots. She also has a pair of small, black horns on her head.

Ginrummy is a fairly cautious woman, having ordered her crewmates to retreat right after Sanji defeated Sheepshead instead of battling him and the other Straw Hats. Additionally, she did not reveal to Jack that his minions had been forced off Zou, knowing his response to their failure would be harsh. She seems to be less brutal and sadistic than many of her crewmates, having winced when Jack spoke about the various brutal and sadistic things he could do to Zunesha in order to kill it.

Ginrummy reacted to Sanji's perverted nature by attempting to cover herself up, indicating that she is embarrassed by such people.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Ginrummy is a Shinuchi of the Beasts Pirates.

entities.name: Giolla
entities.description:
Giolla is an officer of the Donquixote Pirates' Trebol Army.

Due to her actions and role, she is a supporting antagonist during the Dressrosa Arc.

Giolla is a very large woman, with exaggerated facial features, a plump upper body and very skinny legs. She wears a purple dress, with yellow flowers on it, and has a pink bead necklace. Her orange and blonde hair (right and left side, respectively, and twisted together on top), large cheekbones, heavy make-up, and pink pointed glasses accentuate her face.

As a child, she wore a dark dress and had large buns on each side of her hair. She also carried painting supplies with her. At age 45, she was much slimmer and had a less-wrinkled face and longer neck. She wore a shorter, dark pink dress with no additional design, a set of garters on her left leg, and a had pink and green coat draped in her shoulders. She also smoked from time to time, and her hairstyle was different, with her blonde hair outlined by her orange hair and a large curl of orange hair on top of her blonde head. At age 51, she had noticeably more weight, with her waistline and face noticeably plumper, but not to the same extent as currently.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Giolla is an officer of the Donquixote Pirates' Trebol Army.

entities.name: Gion
entities.description:
Gion, better known by her alias Momousagi, is a Marine vice admiral.

Gion is a tall, slender woman with red lipstick, long curly black hair that is tied back, and a mole on the right side of her face below her mouth. She also possesses a black spider tattoo on her left thigh.

She wears a Marine coat on her shoulders like a cape, and her sleeves have pink cuffs and the epaulettes are pink. Her Marine coat has a hood, though she usually keeps it down. Underneath, she sports a short-sleeved pink shirt, with a frilled collar and an open neckline that exposes her cleavage. She wears dark brown shorts and black heels.

Gion appears to be a determined and temperamental woman who is not afraid to speak her mind, even against a legend like Garp. She may believe in moral justice or follow her own view of justice as she seemed bothered that Garp was not the least bit worried about his grandson being in danger of being hunted down by two Emperors, despite the latter being a pirate of the Worst Generation. Gion uses her seductive hospitality to lure all kinds of pirates into trouble.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Gion, better known by her alias Momousagi, is a Marine vice admiral.

entities.name: Gloriosa
entities.description:
Gloriosa, more commonly known as "Elder Nyon", is an advisor of sorts to the current empress of the Kuja tribe, Boa Hancock. Gloriosa is a former empress and captain of the Kuja Pirates from three generations prior to Hancock. She is also a former member of the legendary Rocks Pirates.

Gloriosa is remarkably diminutive in height, with very thick lips, and is wrinkled from old age. She wears small robe-like, loose Kuja top, and some kind of sea-green pearl belt to hold up the spotted-print short skirt that all Kuja wear. Also, like most Kuja, she wears a cape. Her hair is white, and she wears a pink flower on the left side of her head.

In her prime, Gloriosa was a tall, slender and very beautiful woman with reddish pink hair (strawberry blonde in the manga). She wore a similar outfit to Hancock, a revealing blue V-neck blouse that showed much of her chest and a loose sarong that exposed her long, slender legs with the symbol of the Kuja adorned on it, along with a white cape sporting epaulettes more commonly found on the jackets of high-ranking Marines, and also shown to wear red heels. While described as very beautiful by men and women alike, she was noted to be outshined by her own subordinate, Shakuyaku, in terms of beauty.

In her first colored appearance, in the opening "Share the World", her color scheme is completely different. Namely that the alternate casual top of the Kuja, which appears to be evening wear, that she wears is blue instead of the pink-bordered burgundy seen in the anime. Additionally, her Snake Weapon is colored purple, as opposed to the white color seen in the "Share the World" opening. It acts as her staff and the upper body of the snake is curled up.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Gloriosa, more commonly known as "Elder Nyon", is an advisor of sorts to the current empress of the Kuja tribe, Boa Hancock. Gloriosa is a former empress and captain of the Kuja Pirates from three generations prior to…

entities.name: Goldfish Princess
entities.description:
The Goldfish Princess is a character in the Hatchan's Sea-Floor Stroll cover story.

The Goldfish Princess is a pink goldfish with red heart-shaped scale patterns and green eyes. She wears a gold crown with three green jewels embedded in it, a gold ring with a purple jewel on her left fin, and red lipstick.

She is also seen in the game One Piece: Ocean's Dream!, to date this is her only color appearance.

The Goldfish Princess had an emotional attachment to her ring, and was thankful enough to Hatchan when he returned it. She gave him a golden trident in return for finding her ring.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: The Goldfish Princess is a character in the Hatchan's Sea-Floor Stroll cover story.

entities.name: Grabar
entities.description:
Grabar is a dwarf from Tontatta Kingdom who first appeared on Green Bit. She is Leo's grandmother.

Grabar is an average-sized stout female dwarf with a wrinkled face, raised cheekbones, and a light colored tail. She has light colored hair tied back into two bun-like ponytails. She wears a light colored sleeveless shirt, dark colored pants, a dark colored belt, a dark colored hair band, dark glasses, and has a tattoo on her right arm.

In the anime, she has gray hair and wears a reddish-pink sleeveless shirt, indigo pants, brown belt, blue and black headphones and brown tinted shades.

Grabar cares for Leo's well-being, since she packed him a lunch for his mission.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Grabar is a dwarf from Tontatta Kingdom who first appeared on Green Bit. She is Leo's grandmother.

entities.name: Gram
entities.description:
Gram was one of the archaeologists of Ohara.

Gram was a young average sized girl, with short blond hair under a purple cap. She wore a coat that matched her hat, with a light blue shirt underneath that was darker blue at the collar, and had four white buttons.

Gram was a very devoted scholar who stayed behind to help ditch books into a lake in an effort to protect them. She, along with the other scholars, were friendly towards Nico Robin.

Gram was very close to Nico Olvia, who she considered like an older sister.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Gram was one of the archaeologists of Ohara.

entities.name: Hana
entities.description:
O-Hana is a citizen of Wano Country, residing in the Flower Capital.

Hana is an average size woman with fair skin and blonde hair tied up in a shimada with a hairpin. She wears a blue flower over her right temple, and a light teal kimono with a purple obi.

Not much is known about Hana's personality since she was only shown in dire situations, during which she was timid and frightful.

Twenty-five years ago, Hana was one of the people abducted by Kurozumi Orochi and was meant to be used as a slave until being freed thanks to Kouzuki Oden.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: O-Hana is a citizen of Wano Country, residing in the Flower Capital.

entities.name: Hatsume
entities.description:
Hatsume is a samurai and member of the Beasts Pirates. She was formerly a member of the Mimawarigumi serving Kurozumi Orochi until Orochi's seeming death.

Hatsume is a short woman with long blonde hair kept in two ponytails with red flowers. She wears a red mask over her face, as well as a red kimono with flower and leaf patterns on it and a white cloak.

Little is known about Hatsume's personality. She was presumably loyal to Kurozumi Orochi until the latter's seeming death, but had no issue with defecting to the Beasts Pirates afterward in spite of what the samurai code of honor held. She was shown with a sullen expression following this event.

She is known for never removing her mask, and apparently nobody has ever seen what's under it.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hatsume is a samurai and member of the Beasts Pirates. She was formerly a member of the Mimawarigumi serving Kurozumi Orochi until Orochi's seeming death.

entities.name: Hera
entities.description:
Hera the Thundercloud is a thundercloud homie created by Big Mom at Wano Country as a replacement for Zeus. She is a special kind of homie, having received a soul fragment from Big Mom herself, and serves as one of her personal weapons, alongside Prometheus and Napoleon.

Hera typically takes the form of a small, puffy yellowish cloud. She possesses a notably long and pointy nose, as well as pronounced eyelashes, lips, and blush marks on her cheeks. She possesses long strands on her head resembling hair, and her "hairdo" is parted toward the right side of her face and covers her right eye.

When powered up, she can become completely shrouded in lightning. Whenever she eats something, her mouth opens wide and reveals sharp, pointed teeth.

Hera is almost always in a jovial mood and speaks in a sweet, flirtatious tone denoted by hearts at the end of her sentences. She's also shown to be rather conceited, calling herself glamorous.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hera the Thundercloud is a thundercloud homie created by Big Mom at Wano Country as a replacement for Zeus. She is a special kind of homie, having received a soul fragment from Big Mom herself, and serves as one of her…

entities.name: Herb
entities.description:
Herb was a Shandia from 400 years ago. She was Kalgara's wife and Mousse's mother.

She was an average sized woman, with black hair tied in a bun in the back, with decorative feathers in it and two strands hanging down. She wore a grey shirt, with white frills at the bottom, and a long reddish brown skirt that went to her ankles. Over her shirt she wore a small dark red coat, with no sleeves draped over her shoulders and buttoned with one button, and white fringe on the button.

She seemed to be a very good mother, as she did not want her daughter to be sacrificed to the gods.

At some point, she married Kalgara and they had a daughter, Mousse. Years later, she was dismayed that her daughter had to be sacrificed to appease the gods.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Herb was a Shandia from 400 years ago. She was Kalgara's wife and Mousse's mother.

entities.name: Hibari
entities.description:
Hibari is a Marine Commander and a member of SWORD.

Hibari is a young woman of regular stature. She has blonde hair with bangs worn in a ponytail. Her Marine uniform consists of a white military pocketed shirt that exposes her midriff, green gloves, orange military boots and sea foam green camo pants with a tri-colored cloud pattern of blue, white, and turquoise, with the latter's right side ripped to reveal yellow and orange striped leggings. She also wears pink headphones with blue stripes over her ears, a black belt with pink heart-shaped buckles around her torso, and a brown backpack with a blue hanging teddy bear called .

Hibari is an emotional young woman who is willing to put herself in danger for the sake of an ally. She is kind and considerate towards others, but somewhat bashful and embarrassed over how a boy like Koby may interpret her gestures.

She speaks with a , for example using the particles and .
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hibari is a Marine Commander and a member of SWORD.

entities.name: Hina
entities.description:
"Black Cage" Hina is a Marine Rear Admiral and a former classmate of Vice Admiral Smoker. She currently leads the Black Cage Corps, a unit (containing Jango and Fullbody among others) tasked with patrolling the seas around the Arabasta Kingdom.

Originally introduced as a captain, she was promoted to the rank of rear admiral some time after the Summit War of Marineford.

Due to her actions and role, she is a supporting antagonist in the Arabasta Arc and a minor antagonist in the Marineford Arc.

Hina is a tall, slim woman with dark brown eyes and straight, waist-length pink hair worn in a middle part. She wears dark red lipstick and is sometimes seen smoking a cigarette.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: "Black Cage" Hina is a Marine Rear Admiral and a former classmate of Vice Admiral Smoker. She currently leads the Black Cage Corps, a unit (containing Jango and Fullbody among others) tasked with patrolling the seas…

entities.name: Hip
entities.description:
Hip is a woman with short light colored hair. She wears a short sleeved dark shirt and a light tank top with some writing on it.

Not much is known about Hip's personality yet, but she is loyal to her captain and worries about his well-being.

Hip is shown carrying two swords, but it is unknown how well she uses them.

Hip was one of the Kid Pirates witnessing her captain fight Big Mom on Onigashima's Live Floor, showing worry when Big Mom looked like she had beaten him. Later, when Kid's railgun attack proved to be not enough to finish off Big Mom at first, she was one of the members that tried to convince their captain to retreat, however, she was promptly ignored by him and ran towards him after the victory over Big Mom.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hip is a woman with short light colored hair. She wears a short sleeved dark shirt and a light tank top with some writing on it.

entities.name: Hiramera
entities.description:
Hiramera is an mermaid and one of the top five Mermaid Cafe Dancers.

Hiramera is a mermaid with light pink hair that has been tied into flowing pigtails and a yellow tail with darker yellow spots. She wears a purple shirt with pearls with her cleavage revealed, and lipstick. In the manga, she is shown to have a long fin frill on either side of her tail. This is absent in the anime.

Like all other mermaids, Hiramera is kind and caring, and is apparently fun loving. She even seems to like Sanji like rest of her friends.

When the Straw Hat Pirates were accused of kidnapping mermaids, Hiramera was the one to defend them, saying they seemed like nice people and are Camie's friends after all.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hiramera is an mermaid and one of the top five Mermaid Cafe Dancers.

entities.name: Hop
entities.description:
Hop is a woman with long light colored hair tied in a high ponytail. She wears an open dark jacket and a skirt.

Not much is known about Hop's personality yet, but she is loyal to her captain and worries about his well-being.

Hop is shown carrying a sword, but it unknown how well she uses it.

Hop was one of the Kid Pirates witnessing her captain fight Big Mom on Onigashima's Live Floor. When Kid's railgun attack proved to be not enough to finish off Big Mom at first, she was one of the members that tried to convince their captain to retreat, however, she was promptly ignored by him.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Hop is a woman with long light colored hair tied in a high ponytail. She wears an open dark jacket and a skirt.

entities.name: Hototogisu
entities.description:
Hototogisu is a Marine Vice Admiral and a subordinate of Vice Admiral Tsuru.

Hototogisu is a regular-sized, young woman with light hair. Like many Marines, she wears her high-collared sailing coat draped over her shoulders. She also wears a bucket hat with the Marine logo engraved on it and a loose tie with her spotted shirt.

Hototogisu cares about Marine cadets and was willing to assault Vice Admiral Garp for giving what she saw as bad advice to them. She also denounces the idea of some lives being greater than others, and believes all lives have equal worth and should be respected as such.

As a Vice Admiral, she has authority over lower-ranking Marines.

entities.name: House
entities.description:
House is a woman with wild hair, with some of it arranged in the shape of a small pair of horns above her head. She wears a knee-length dress with an open shirt-collar and which sports a cross design printed on its front with many matching circles near the hem.

Not much is known about House's personality yet, but she is loyal to her captain and worries about his well-being.

House was one of the Kid Pirates witnessing her captain fight Big Mom on Onigashima's Live Floor, showing worry when Big Mom looked like she had beaten him. Later, when Kid's railgun attack proved to be not enough to finish off Big Mom at first, she was one of the members that tried to convince their captain to retreat, however, she was promptly ignored by him.

entities.name: Ida
entities.description:
Ida was a giantess hailing from Samuwanai Island in the South Blue who once worked at a circus in the Bunt Kingdom. She ran a notorious bar alongside Mato in Elbaph.

Ida was the unofficial mentor, advisor and long-time lover of King Harald of Elbaph, and the mother of his firstborn Hajrudin. She was also the foster mother to Hajrudin's half-brother Prince Loki, after Loki's birth mother, Queen Estrid, disowned him and died.

Ida passed away fifteen years ago after being poisoned by Estrid's relatives to prevent her from claiming the fortune they believed was entitled to their family, which sent Loki into a murderous rage of revenge for his foster mother.

Ida was a slender giant woman with average facial features, including freckles, full lips and a well-defined round nose. She had long, light-colored hair with a messy cowlick at the front, curly side locks and tied in a ponytail at the back.

entities.name: Ikkaku
entities.description:
Ikkaku is a member of the Heart Pirates.

Ikkaku is a woman with curly dark brown hair and light brown eyes. She wears a yellow and orange hat. Like all the other members of the Heart Pirates, she also wears a boiler suit with the crew's Jolly Roger imprinted on the left breast.

Along with Uni and Clione, Ikkaku was against the idea of allying with the Straw Hat Pirates, thinking of their assistance as worthless.

A month before Trafalgar Law formed an alliance with the Straw Hat Pirates, Ikkaku and the other Heart Pirates went to Zou and were left under the watch of Nekomamushi. Ikkaku, Uni, and Clione were against forming the alliance, but they were outvoted.

entities.name: Ipponume
entities.description:
Ipponume is a tall, large woman with a pointed nose, low ears, long eyelashes, thin eyebrows, and shoulder-length, curly red hair. She wears a light-colored polo shirt, a light-colored skirt, a dark-colored sweater, and a dark-colored cap with stars on it.

Before the timeskip, she wore a striped yellow polo shirt and a purple cap.

Ipponume is a matter-of-fact woman with an honest personality. She did not want her husband to keep the Sandai Kitetsu and disliked the sword.

Ipponume has a good relationship with her husband. He calls her "honey" and "dear" and cleans the bathtub for her. However, Ipponume thinks that he is a "cheapskate".

entities.name: Isa
entities.description:
Isa is a Shandia woman and Aisa's mother.

Isa is a middle-aged woman with short, brown hair. She wears a long, tan dress with a brown vest and brown shoes. When she was younger, she wore a long brown dress with red dots. Like all Shandia, Isa has the short wings associated with their species.

Isa is a very caring mother as she tried to comfort her crying daughter and was concerned that she had not returned during Enel's attack.

Isa is Aisa's mother and she cares for her as such. Raki may also be her niece, since she calls Isa , although the terms is often used out of respect for elderly. Isa is also close enough to Raki that Raki confided to her about how she feared Wyper and his aggressive nature.

entities.short_description: Isa is a Shandia woman and Aisa's mother.

entities.name: Ishilly
entities.description:
Ishilly is a mermaid and one of the top five Mermaid Cafe Dancers.

Ishilly is a mermaid with freckles and a black and white striped tail. Her black wavy hair is arranged in two pigtails with flowery ribbons, and her bangs are gathered mostly to the left.

She wears a starfish-shaped pendant around her neck and a black-white striped bikini top with a flower in the middle.

Ishilly is friendly and playful, like her fellow mermaids. She welcomes Luffy's group with a warm smile and happily swims with Sanji, enjoying his company. She seems to have taken a liking to the Straw Hat chef, as she shows concern for him after he suffered critical blood loss from a massive nosebleed.

entities.short_description: Ishilly is a mermaid and one of the top five Mermaid Cafe Dancers.

entities.name: Isuka
entities.description:
"Nailing" Isuka is a Marine Ensign that confronted the Spade Pirates during their time of activity.

Isuka is a young woman with short vermilion hair, brown eyes, a bandaid on her left cheek and a burn scar on the back of her hand. She typically wears a Marine uniform with a collared, buttoned shirt, a tie, brown gloves, shorts and heeled boots. On her shoulders she wears the standard Marine coat with on the back.

When she was off-duty at Sabaody Archipelago, she wore more casual tourist clothes.

Isuka is a brave woman with a strong sense of justice, as she was willing to confront the Spade Pirates alone on their ship in order to arrest Portgas D. Ace. She is very tenacious and dedicated, because she kept chasing Ace through the first half of the Grand Line. However, she can also be a little clumsy and naive, as she expected Ace to come out of his ship to confront her, not realizing he snuck away from the other side.

entities.short_description: "Nailing" Isuka is a Marine Ensign that confronted the Spade Pirates during their time of activity.

entities.name: Iyan'eno Chinode
entities.description:
Iyan'eno Chinode is a writer for the fashion column "Streetcorner Collection" in the World Economy News Paper.

Chinode is a young woman of average size with short dark hair. She wears a large newsboy cap, a frilly and puffy shirt with a small cravat around her neck, and dark suspender pants.

Chinode greatly admires princess Nefertari Vivi, having loaned her clothes and declaring to herself that she would never wash the outfit again. She is stated to be a diligent reporter with a fiery personality.

Chinode is a skilled writer, being in charge of the WENP's fashion column, which is stated to be very popular.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Iyan'eno Chinode is a writer for the fashion column "Streetcorner Collection" in the World Economy News Paper.

entities.name: Jigoku Benten
entities.description:
Jigoku Benten is a kunoichi and a member of the Beasts Pirates. She previously was a member of the Orochi Oniwabanshu which served the shogun of Wano Country, Kurozumi Orochi.

Due to her actions and role, she is a minor antagonist in the Wano Country Arc.

Benten is a tall, fair-skinned woman with large green eyes and purple hair. She has long eyelashes and wears pink lipstick and red nail polish. Her hair is tied up in a bow-like fashion and is adorned with three white skulls, a white heart and two yellow combs. She wears a green and light blue kimono with yellow and blue patterns on it, a white sash that floats behind her, a pink obi tied into a bow around her waist, and silver dangling earrings. She is often seen carrying a .

Benten usually seems calm and stoic, but she showed signs of concern when Nico Robin used a clone to escape the Orochi Oniwabanshu's attack.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Jigoku Benten is a kunoichi and a member of the Beasts Pirates. She previously was a member of the Orochi Oniwabanshu which served the shogun of Wano Country, Kurozumi Orochi.

entities.name: Johanna
entities.description:
Johanna is a student at the Walrus School on Elbaph.

Johanna is a young girl with light, shoulder-length hair. She displays a pair of pink horns, as evidence of her ancient giant heritage.

Like other Walrus School students, Johanna is against violence and fighting. She expresses a little envy for the children, as apparently she has no parents while the others do. She attempts to hide this with a strong front, at one point rejecting her teacher Ange's attempt to reach out.

Ange is one of Johanna's teachers. The two are apparently close enough to the point that Ange offered to serve as a surrogate mother, although Johanna rejected her. However, when Ange appeared to comfort Johanna in a hopeless situation, her true feelings won out, and she accepted the affection.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Johanna is a student at the Walrus School on Elbaph.

entities.name: Jugemu Jugemuko
entities.description:
Jugemu Jugemuko is a young girl from the Hakumai region of the Wano Country. She is the sister of Chokyumei-no Chosuke.

Jugemuko is a young girl with dirty blonde hair, which she keeps in pigtails. She wears an old pink outfit, with visible patches and a floral design. She carries her baby sibling on her back in a knapsack.

As a young child, Jugemuko is afraid of pirates, and is especially afraid of the Numbers, with their monstrous forms; upon seeing them, she trembled with fear. Despite her fears, however, she is responsible enough to care for her younger siblings in place of her busy parents.

Chokyumei-no Chosuke is Jugemuko's younger brother. She cares for him in their parents absence.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Jugemu Jugemuko is a young girl from the Hakumai region of the Wano Country. She is the sister of Chokyumei-no Chosuke.

entities.name: Kairen
entities.description:
Kairen is a mermaid and one of the top five Mermaid Cafe Dancers.

Kairen is a mermaid with a somewhat wide face, red lipstick, and long, flowing blonde hair. She wears a white, revealing bikini, with a purple stripe-like pattern on it, that looks similar to the marine's "MÖWE" logo.

Like all other mermaids, Kairen is kind and caring, and is apparently fun loving. She even seems to like Sanji like the rest of her friends.

Being a mermaid, Kairen has several abilities unique to her race. It is not yet shown but she may have the ability to talk to fish and call out to them using sonar waves, which is one of the basic abilities found in all mermaids and some Fish-Men. Apart from the ability to breathe underwater, as a mermaid she also has the ability to swim very quickly at speeds much faster than the flying fish used by the Flying Fish Riders. However, like any mermaid, she is vulnerable on land.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Kairen is a mermaid and one of the top five Mermaid Cafe Dancers.

entities.name: Kalifa
entities.description:
Kalifa is an agent of CP0. Before the timeskip, she was an agent of CP9, operating undercover as Iceburg's secretary at the Galley-La Company. She is also Laskey's daughter and the older sister of Alpha.

She was one of the major antagonists during the Water 7 and Enies Lobby Arcs.

Kalifa is a tall, slim, and curvaceous young woman with blue eyes and glasses. Like Kuro, she often pushes up her glasses. Her strawberry-blonde hair was about shoulder-length when she first infiltrated Water 7, and she grew it out over the years she spent undercover there. She kept it tied up in a bun as a secretary, but let it fall freely when she was revealed to be an assassin.

Her height is 185 cm (6'1"), and her are B93-W61-H92 (36.61"-24.02"-36.22"), making her breasts a G-cup in Japan.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Kalifa is an agent of CP0. Before the timeskip, she was an agent of CP9, operating undercover as Iceburg's secretary at the Galley-La Company. She is also Laskey's daughter and the older sister of Alpha.

entities.name: Kamakirigirl
entities.description:
Kamakirigirl is a Gifter in the Beasts Pirates. After being tamed by Tama, she became an ally of the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance.

Kamakirigirl is a tall, slender woman. Her clothing is relatively limited, only wearing up two pieces of purple metal breastplated armor with shoulder guards, a purple thong, purple boots, and kneepads. Her hair is pink, and like most other Gifters, she has a pair of small, black horns on her head. On her arms are multiple circular tattoos. Due to her SMILE, her hands are replaced with massive, curved blades, similar to a praying mantis.

Kamakirigirl is quite ambitious, and is willing to act on her ambitions, even setting out to sea in an attempt to become Pirate King. Despite her ambitions, however, she appears to be a realist, recognizing that she could not defeat Kaidou.

She either has a tendency to "take the easy way out", even using that line of reasoning to attempt and convince Roronoa Zoro to follow in her footsteps and submit to Kaidou, or she has thoroughly accepted her submission, and fully given up on her ambitions. Either way, since she joined the Beasts Pirates, she has adopted the belief that everybody should follow Kaidou's rule.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Kamakirigirl is a Gifter in the Beasts Pirates. After being tamed by Tama, she became an ally of the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance.

entities.name: Kanezenny
entities.description:
Kanezenny is an elderly farm woman from Nico Robin's past.

Kanezenny is an elderly woman with large eyes, small ears, a crooked nose, wide chin, lumpy cheeks, and a wide smile. She tied her long hair into a ponytail, and wore a light purple dress with dark purple spots and a brown jacket over it.

Kanezenny is a deceptive and cruel old woman, appearing to be kind and understanding towards Robin at first, only to sell her out to the World Government for the bounty on her head. She is also very short-tempered and argumentative, as when Robin escaped, Kanezenny demanded her reward for simply giving information on Robin's whereabouts, and even reacted violently toward the agents who refused to pay her.

When an 8-year-old Robin was looking for refuge from the World Government after escaping from the Ohara Incident, Kanezenny took the child in. Robin worked hard for the elderly woman, with Kanezenny acting kind and loving in return. Robin thought she had found her place to stay. However, one evening, when Robin entered the house for dinner, she saw that Kanezenny had led World Government agents into the house to ambush Robin. Robin managed to escape, and this was the first betrayal she ever suffered. Regardless, Kanezenny demanded that the agents pay the bounty for providing information on Robin's whereabouts, and was last seen angrily grabbing the collar of one of the agents she had brought in, screaming at them.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Kanezenny is an elderly farm woman from Nico Robin's past.

entities.name: Karin
entities.description:
Karin is a student at the Walrus School on Elbaph.

Karin is a young girl with long light hair arranged in a ponytail. She has a long, protruding nose and wears a pair of headphones.

Karin is a reserved girl who is usually frowning. She considers herself unlucky and remains unflappable even when she is kidnapped. According to her mother, she has a tendency to lie.

Karin's mother has shown great concern over her, but is annoyed by her deceitful nature. She was one of the many parents who rushed to save their children from the Knights of God.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Karin is a student at the Walrus School on Elbaph.

entities.name: Kasa
entities.description:
Kasa is an elderly woman from Raijin Island.

She is a short, wrinkled, elderly woman in a cloak.

She seemed to be quite hospitable, even to strangers, as she offered umbrellas to Urouge and his crew for their safety.

Being an inhabitant of Raijin Island, she has a lot of knowledge about her island and can protect tourists from the great electrical storm.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Kasa is an elderly woman from Raijin Island.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description:
Kaya is a young woman who lives in the largest mansion in Syrup Village on the Gecko Islands. She is a close friend of Usopp and is currently studying to become a doctor.

She is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Syrup Village Arc.

Kaya is a slim and pale-skinned girl with pale blonde hair long to the shoulders. She has wide brown eyes, that are of a sort of lighter shade.

Despite her fortune, she is rarely seen in anything but simple neat clothing, be it a plain long dress or "common" clothing such as a skirt and jacket.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Kaya is a young woman who lives in the largest mansion in Syrup Village on the Gecko Islands. She is a close friend of Usopp and is currently studying to become a doctor.

entities.name: Kiku
entities.description:
Kiku is a member of the Kuja. She is never seen but her name appears on the match-ups of the arena battle board.

Little is known about Kiku's abilities, but, since her odds of winning were 5:1, it can be presumed that she is weaker than her opponent, Shion.

Kiku's name was seen on the list of match-ups in the arena battles. She was listed against Shion.

entities.name: Kikunojo
entities.description:
Kikunojo of the Lingering Snow, more commonly referred to as Kiku, is a samurai from Wano Country and a retainer for the Kouzuki Family, serving as one of Kouzuki Oden's Nine Red Scabbards. She is also the younger sister of Izou and the daughter of the dancing school head of the in Ringo.

After traveling forward in time, she worked as a tea house poster girl in Okobore Town while gathering information for the planned rebellion. She participated in the Raid on Onigashima where she battled Kaidou alongside the other Scabbards, losing her left arm to one of Kaidou's attacks. Following Kouzuki Momonosuke's ascent to shogun, she serves as the daimyo of Ringo.

She is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Wano Country Arc.

Kikunojo has a feminine appearance and she is noted for her beauty given her past reputation as the . She has long dark-violet (dark-blue in the anime) hair that falls onto her back with square bangs hanging above her eyebrows while she has shoulder-length hair strands hanging on either side, indigo eyes and she is very tall, easily towering over the likes of Monkey D. Luffy and Roronoa Zoro as well as her older brother at 287 cm.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.

entities.name: Kikyo
entities.description:
Kikyo is a Kuja warrior from Amazon Lily.

Kikyo is a slim normal-sized Kuja woman with tan skin and long black hair arranged in a ponytail.

Like all Kuja, she wears revealing clothes and carries a snake weapon. Kikyo’s attire is composed of black one piece swimsuit. The top straps being decorated with studs attached to a ring link connecting the bottom straps to form a cross, exposing a plunge neck. She also wears a white cape.

She seems to be one of the toughest and most mature of the Kuja. Kikyo discouraged Luffy's presence on the island, especially after seeing the return of Boa Hancock. Of the Kuja at the party after the arena fight, she is the only one not amused at Luffy's antics. She also shouts at the Kuja who put sticks in their mouths and noses during Luffy's departure from the island with Hancock.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Kikyo is a Kuja warrior from Amazon Lily.

entities.name: Kinderella
entities.description:
Kinderella, also known as Miss Universe, is a woman who married Wapol after he became the head of his own corporation. Two years after that, she became the queen of the Evil Black Drum Kingdom when Wapol became its king.

Kinderella is a tall, slender woman with purple hair whose mouth is often seen open. She wore long purple dresses, and was seen by others as beautiful. After becoming the queen, she added a dark cape with bat wings on the shoulders, a hood with a crow design, long light-colored gloves, and an eye-mask.

Kinderella enjoys listening to her husband insulting other people and laughs profusely when he does so, indicating that she is as rude as he is. She sometimes adds "-universe" as a suffix at the end of her sentences.

Kinderella is a rather shallow person, as she only "loves" Wapol for his money.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Kinderella, also known as Miss Universe, is a woman who married Wapol after he became the head of his own corporation. Two years after that, she became the queen of the Evil Black Drum Kingdom when Wapol became its king.

entities.name: Kisegawa
entities.description:
Kisegawa is a geisha from the Flower Capital of Wano Country. She once possessed the blueprints of Kaidou's fortress on Onigashima.

Kisegawa is a youthful-looking woman with large dark-brown eyes, Indian red lipstick and golden blonde hair that is gathered at the back with four, pastel flowers. She had light-red fingernails and wears an kimono with white and light-purple vertical stripes.

Kisegawa had a lack of understanding of what the Onigashima blueprints were about, leading her to use them as coasters.

At some point in the past, Kisegawa received the blueprints for Kaidou's lair on Onigashima from an old man named Kobe. Not knowing what the blueprints were for, she used them as a coaster for a pot until a man named Tokijiro eventually acquired them from her.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Kisegawa is a geisha from the Flower Capital of Wano Country. She once possessed the blueprints of Kaidou's fortress on Onigashima.

entities.name: Koala
entities.description:
Koala is a high ranking officer of the Revolutionary Army, serving as the Fish-Man Karate assistant instructor. She started as a slave on Mary Geoise, but was then set free by Fisher Tiger's rampage. She sailed along with the Sun Pirates to reach her home town. Approximately two years later, she left her family to join the Revolutionary Army, where she often works alongside both Sabo and Hack.

She first debuted as a child during a flashback in the Fish-Man Island Arc. She made her reappearance during the Dressrosa Arc.

When she appeared twelve years ago, Koala was a skinny girl with long, unkempt brown hair. She also had distinctively large and round purple eyes, similar to that of a koala, and was always smiling. She had on a dirty, short-sleeved collared shirt, which she wore under dark-brown overalls and a smudge on her right cheek. As a slave of the World Nobles, she had the mark of the Celestial Dragons on her back, which was replaced by the mark of the Sun Pirates by Fisher Tiger.

After a few weeks she had neat, shoulder-length hair, a yellow dress with an orange diamond pattern on the bottom of the dress that went around it, and a pair of orange loafers.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Koala is a high ranking officer of the Revolutionary Army, serving as the Fish-Man Karate assistant instructor. She started as a slave on Mary Geoise, but was then set free by Fisher Tiger's rampage. She sailed along…

entities.name: Koda
entities.description:
Koda is a Marine Chef, Kyuji's wife and mother of Moda.

Koda is a short, relatively pudgy woman who wears a marine apron and a dotted shirt.

Koda is a very loving mother who cares deeply for her daughter, as she was overjoyed when she met Moda after coming back from the Marine Base.

As she is a Marine chef, her cooking skills are assumed to be good enough for the Marines.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Koda is a Marine Chef, Kyuji's wife and mother of Moda.

entities.name: Koito
entities.description:
Koito is a young girl residing in Ebisu Town of the Wano Country.

Koito has a rather wide mouth with large teeth, and is missing a tooth in the right side. She has brown hair done in a bun.

Due to consuming a failed SMILE, Koito is always happy, sporting a big smile. She was considerate as she offered Zoro some clean water.

She offers Zoro a clean cup of water and assures him that it won't make his stomach hurt. He then takes the cup and drinks the water, putting a smile on her face.
