entities.short_description: Mizerka is a Shinuchi in the Beasts Pirates. After being tamed by Tama, she became an ally of the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance.

entities.name: Mizuira
entities.description:
Mizuira was a little girl from Ohara. She was the daughter of Oran and Roji, the niece of Nico Olvia, and the cousin of Nico Robin.

Mizuira was a little girl with a large smile. She had blonde curly hair, with a ribbon in it.

Very little is known about her personality, but it is evident that she was not close to her cousin Robin as she did not complain when her mother refused to bring the little girl for the family dinner.

Her parents took her out to dinner at a restaurant for her eighth birthday. Roji wanted it to be a private affair so they did not bring Robin along with them. She is assumed to have died after the escape ship was destroyed by Vice Admiral Sakazuki.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mizuira was a little girl from Ohara. She was the daughter of Oran and Roji, the niece of Nico Olvia, and the cousin of Nico Robin.

entities.name: Mocha
entities.description:
Mocha is a little girl who was held captive on Punk Hazard. She was freed with the rest of the children by the Straw Hat Pirates.

Mocha is much larger than an average little girl because of the experiments done to her. She has a large head that is not very proportionate to her body, big purple eyes, and wavy, unkempt, black hair. She wore a white colored sleeveless dress during her time in the Biscuits Room and a coat outside when Kin'emon gave them all warm clothes.

In a photograph held by her mother, Mocha can be seen at a normal size and wearing a dress with a flower pattern and a backpack.

At G-14, she was still huge, but according to Tashigi and herself, she has shrunk down significantly. She also wore a checkered pattern dress.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mocha is a little girl who was held captive on Punk Hazard. She was freed with the rest of the children by the Straw Hat Pirates.

entities.name: Moda
entities.description:
Moda is a milk maiden from the Lulusia Kingdom that Ace met during his cover story. She is the daughter of Koda and Kyuji.

Following the destruction of her homeland, Moda was enlisted by the Revolutionary Army.

Moda is a young girl with shoulder-length blonde hair (light brown in the manga), that is half covered by a white bandanna, and light blue eyes. She wears a long red and pink skirt decorated with an intricate pattern with a light blue shirt and dark blue boots.

After the timeskip, she has notably grown, looking more like an adult woman with defined curves and her hair has become longer. However, her attire is similar to what she wore before the timeskip but has replaced her top with a long-sleeved blouse. Her bandana now has a cow pattern and has long brown boots. One of her teeth has also been chipped.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Moda is a milk maiden from the Lulusia Kingdom that Ace met during his cover story. She is the daughter of Koda and Kyuji.

entities.name: Monet
entities.description:
Monet was a scout and assistant for Caesar Clown and his underlings in the research facility on Punk Hazard. She was, in truth, a member and officer of the Donquixote Pirates and was sent as a deep cover agent by Doflamingo. She was also the older sister of Sugar.

Due to her mission and actions, she could be regarded as the tertiary antagonist of the Punk Hazard Arc.

Monet had long, wavy, light green hair and brown eyes (amber in the anime). She was also considered very attractive, as several Marines commented on her appearance. She had her original human arms and legs replaced with bird limbs, giving her an appearance resembling a . She had white feathered wings instead of arms that faded to light green at the edges, talons instead of feet, and a tail. She had the build of an average human, but her long legs made her much taller. In the manga, Monet's legs had human skin below the cutoff of her pants until the first joint, while in the anime, her legs had all bird skin below the cutoff of her pants.

She wore a green cropped tank top with "HAPPY" written in dark green on the chest and yellow cut-off pants with orange stripes. She had a Baby Den Den Mushi strapped to her belt.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Monet was a scout and assistant for Caesar Clown and his underlings in the research facility on Punk Hazard. She was, in truth, a member and officer of the Donquixote Pirates and was sent as a deep cover agent by…

entities.name: Moodie
entities.description:
Moodie is a woman who Fullbody took to the Baratie.

Moodie is a relatively tall, slender woman, with blonde hair put back, with only two parts hanging down in front. She has brown eyes and wore light red lipstick. During the Baratie Arc, she wore a reddish-pink sleeveless dress that showed off her cleavage.

Moodie is a reasonable person who dislikes violence, as she tried to calm down Fullbody when he got angry and was horrified when Sanji beat him up.

Moodie accompanied Fullbody to the Baratie and dined with him. Enroute to the Baratie Moodie stops Fullbody from further attacking the Straw Hat Pirates. After they toasted, Fullbody tried to impress Moodie with his knowledge of wine. Sanji corrected Fullbody on facts about the bottle they were drinking, but Moodie still commented on Fullbody's knowledge. When Fullbody called Sanji over to the table to try to trick him, Sanji flirted with Moodie. Moodie laughed when Sanji made fun of Fullbody after the Marine pointed out a fly in his soup. She became distraught and tried to calm down Fullbody when he smashed their table in anger, and she watched in horror as Sanji beat him. Moodie was nowhere to be seen when Zeff kicked Fullbody out of his restaurant.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Moodie is a woman who Fullbody took to the Baratie.

entities.name: Mororon
entities.description:
Mororon is the queen of the Tajine Kingdom and one of fifty monarchs who took part in the Levely.

Mororon is a slender and regal-looking woman with teal eyes. Her pale blonde hair is gathered in an updo with sidelocks that curl at her cheeks and a thinner lock of hair on each side of her face that reach pass her shoulders.

She wears a form-fitting blue kaftan dress with dotted pale blue borders as well as wears pink lipstick and nail polish. She also wears a gold tiara shaped like three rectangles, gold hoop earrings, a pink sash around her neck, a tiny red-beaded necklace, and two lilac bracelets on her left wrist. She held a filled red wine glass in each hand during her introduction.

Mororon appears to be a jovial woman, as she made a toast to the people watching her. She appears to like drinking, as she was carrying a glass of wine while heading to the Levely. However, her relationship with her subjects was poor enough for them to attempt an uprising after the Levely.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mororon is the queen of the Tajine Kingdom and one of fifty monarchs who took part in the Levely.

entities.name: Mousse
entities.description:
Mousse was the daughter of Kalgara and Herb and was considered the most beautiful of the Shandia women on the island of Jaya four hundred years ago.

Mousse is a normal sized woman with pale skin. She has black hair, braided in the back with two strands in the front. She has black eyes, and like other Shandia she has small white wings on her back. She wears a green tunic with orange and purple stripes near the neck, and the bottom, where it stopped near her thighs, and white fringe on the sleeves. She also wore brown sandals, and a plaid purple and white hat.

Mousse did not share her father's hot-blooded attitude and was very considerate of the well-being of others. She went to the altar to protect her people, feeling comfort in knowing she would be joining their god. However upon sighting what they believed to be their god, she became very frightened, even freezing when Noland told her to run from the altar. His actions to save her life, and later talk between her and his men, made her become one of the first Shandia to believe Noland was a good man. She was also the only one wise enough to actually go and tell Noland's men why they were being shunned by the villagers, and in return rushed to tell her father their grave error of judgment towards Noland.

After their dying priest had a 'vision', he declared that the only way to stop the "curse" that was plaguing their land was to sacrifice their most beautiful woman. Mousse went willingly to the altar to save all her people. Just before their God devoured her, Mont Blanc Noland appeared and killed the giant snake before trying to convince the Shandia that this plague was curable and not a divine curse.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mousse was the daughter of Kalgara and Herb and was considered the most beautiful of the Shandia women on the island of Jaya four hundred years ago.

entities.name: Mozu and Kiwi
entities.description:
Mozu and Kiwi, also known as the Square Sisters due to their square-like hairstyle, are two women from Water 7 who were part of the Franky Family. They were both very loyal to Franky, going with him everywhere and tending to imitate every pose he made.

They are both allies of the Straw Hat Pirates during the end of the Water 7 and beginning of the Enies Lobby Arc (starting off as minor antagonists in the former). Currently, they jointly manage Blueno's old bar in Water 7.

Although they are not twins, Mozu and Kiwi are identical in all but hair (Mozu's is not as curly as Kiwi's) and eye color (Mozu has a brownish hue while Kiwi's is green). They both have long, pointed noses and get their nickname from having a unique hairstyle shaped in large squares. When they were younger, they wore their hair in afros.

Mozu is the sister with straight-edged hair, a white fur collar, yellow goggles, a bikini top, slacks, and high-heels.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.image_alt: Identification thumbnail for Mozu and Kiwi
entities.short_description: Mozu and Kiwi, also known as the Square Sisters due to their square-like hairstyle, are two women from Water 7 who were part of the Franky Family. They were both very loyal to Franky, going with him everywhere and…

entities.name: Mummy Mee
entities.description:
Mummy Mee is one of the houseparents, alongside Daddy Dee, of a World Government-affiliated orphanage situated on the Conomi Islands.

Mummy Mee is a fair-skinned woman with a long face, long eyelashes, and a pointed chin. She has puffed up purple hair and wears red lipstick and gold earrings. She also wears a fancy purple coat with a fluffy, white fur collar and a yellow-orange button-up shirt with a red dress underneath.

In the anime, Mummy Mee has orange hair instead of purple, pearl earrings instead of gold and, although the color of her coat was still purple, the fur collar was brown and not white. Her shirt was pink and her dress was yellow, as opposed to the yellow-orange and red colors in the manga, respectively. Furthermore, the anime shows her with two parts of her hair splitting from the center and also shows that she wears purple nail polish.

In her initial anime appearance, she had brown hair and the collar of her coat was white and frilly.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Mummy Mee is one of the houseparents, alongside Daddy Dee, of a World Government-affiliated orphanage situated on the Conomi Islands.

entities.name: Muret
entities.description:
Muret is the doctor of the former Bellamy Pirates.

Muret is a young woman with long pink hair tied up in a chignon, with one tuft going down. She is wearing a tight-fitting, cleavage revealing yellow outfit with a zipper running down the middle and boots decorated with crosses. She also seems to have a tiny mole or freckle under her left eye.

As a member of Bellamy's crew, Muret appears to think highly of Bellamy and Sarquiss' strengths. She has almost no interactions with the crew, but when Nami refused Bellamy's offer to buy her off the Straw Hat Pirates, she had been the first to laugh at her response. After Bellamy's defeat, Muret showed her cowardice, refusing to take action against Luffy even when the Straw Hats took all the gold that Bellamy stole.

Muret has not demonstrated much in battle. However, as the Bellamy Pirates' doctor, her talent may lean more on first aid and medical treatment rather than direct confrontation. Also, being the crew's physician, she presumably made the bandage around Bellamy's head that was seen when Doflamingo came to Jaya to punish him. It is unknown how advanced her medical skills are.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Muret is the doctor of the former Bellamy Pirates.

entities.name: Muti
entities.description:
Muti is a middle-aged woman with long, wavy brown hair and a round face. She wears a windowpane sea green shirt and dark pants.

Muti cares heavily for her daughter Koala and was crying of happiness when she returned safely home.

That being said, she had to pragmatically cooperate with the Marines and sell out Fisher Tiger for Koala's protection, given her daughter was a World Noble's slave.

At some point in the past, Muti somehow lost her daughter Koala to the World Nobles.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Muti is a middle-aged woman with long, wavy brown hair and a round face. She wears a windowpane sea green shirt and dark pants.

entities.name: Nefertari Titi
entities.description:
Nefertari Titi was the queen of the Arabasta Kingdom, Nefertari Cobra's wife, and Nefertari Vivi's mother.

Twenty-four years before the start of the series, Titi bore a striking resemblance to her daughter's current appearance; they both have flowing blue hair (though Vivi ties hers in a ponytail at times), slender bodies, and dark eyes. In fact, Vivi is supposedly the spitting image of her mother, so much so that when she was dressed up for her coming of age ceremony, Cobra almost mistook Vivi for her late mother.

Titi was shown to be wearing a purple shirt, a white robe with a pink border over it, a golden neckband, and a gold bracelet.

In a photograph taken sometime after Vivi's birth, Titi had her hair tied in a bun. She also wore earrings and normal regal attire.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Nefertari Titi was the queen of the Arabasta Kingdom, Nefertari Cobra's wife, and Nefertari Vivi's mother.

entities.name: Neggy
entities.description:
Neggy is the queen of the and one of fifty monarchs who took part in the Levely.

Neggy is a tall, slim woman with a long neck, a similarly long face, a protruding chin and dark, wavy hair that reaches down beyond her waist.

She wears a fancy royal gown, lipstick and a crown accompanied by some jewelry over her head.

Neggy appears to be a cordial person, willing to interact with other royals.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Neggy is the queen of the and one of fifty monarchs who took part in the Levely.

entities.name: Negikuma Maria
entities.description:
Negikuma Maria is a resident of Drum Island, and friend of Dalton.

Maria is a big woman roughly twice the height of Luffy. Her body shape looks like that of a Hiking Bear, so much that Luffy and Usopp mistakenly took her as one and bowed their heads. She has curly hair that is in a round shape.

She wears a brown coat with dark brown buttons that covers her whole body, with white fur on the ends of the sleeves, the hood, and the bottom of the coat, along with light brown frills on the chest, and a dark brown stripe where the upper body separates from the lower body. She also wears a light red scarf and dark brown shoes that have white fur at the top.

Maria is leery around pirates because Drum Island had been previously destroyed by them. Otherwise, she is a typical housewife, and she cares for her two children.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Negikuma Maria is a resident of Drum Island, and friend of Dalton.

entities.name: Nerine
entities.description:
Nerine is a member of the Kuja from Amazon Lily.

Nerine is a brown haired, wide headed lady who dresses in purple skimpy clothes.

She is often seen with her notebook and pen with which she takes memos with.

In the opening "Share the World" she originally had blonde hair, was fairly tall, and her clothes were a different color.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Nerine is a member of the Kuja from Amazon Lily.

entities.name: Nico Olvia
entities.description:
Nico Olvia was an archaeologist from Ohara who studied the Poneglyphs two decades ago, the mother of Nico Robin, and the older sister of Oran and paternal aunt of Mizuira.

While sailing with a group of fellow archaeologists, Olvia was captured by the Marines for conducting forbidden research. With the help of Jaguar D. Saul, she was able to return to Ohara and briefly reunite with her daughter, but soon perished in the Buster Call alongside the other archaeologists.

Nico Olvia resembled her daughter (before timeskip appearance) in many ways: they shared almost identical facial and physical features, and had identically shaped and colored eyes (brown in the manga and blue in the anime). However, Olvia's hair was white instead of black. Her hair was also longer and slightly curly, and in the anime, she had a lighter tan skin tone. When she departed from Ohara in order to find the Rio Poneglyph, she had shorter hair.

When she returned from her prison, she sported a completely different attire, consisting of a fur-lined coat over a light blue T-shirt which is slightly too short for her, exposing her bare midriff and belly button and long green trousers. Around her waist, she had a belt decorated by many golden disk-like ornaments. A modest necklace with a thin rope and three little pearls on it circled her neck.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Nico Olvia was an archaeologist from Ohara who studied the Poneglyphs two decades ago, the mother of Nico Robin, and the older sister of Oran and paternal aunt of Mizuira.

entities.name: Nightcrab Girl
entities.description:
Nightcrab Girl is a Gifter in the Beasts Pirates.

Nightcrab Girl is a tall slender woman with long dark purple hair reaching down to her waist. She wears a pink corset-like top, and a light pink skirt. Due to consuming a Crab SMILE, she has a pair of long red crab claws replacing her hands, a pair of antennae on her head, and an extra pair of legs. As a Gifter, she wears a pair of black horns.

In the anime, Nightcrab Girl appears to be wearing gray leggings, while in the Digitally Colored Manga, her legs are bare.

Nightcrab Girl appears to be fairly ambitious, being willing to attack Luffy and Zoro to secure a spot in the Tobiroppo. She loves dancing and drinking, and is known for performing a unique dance at parties, which is commonly met with loud applause.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Nightcrab Girl is a Gifter in the Beasts Pirates.

entities.name: Nojiko
entities.description:
Nojiko is the owner of a mikan farm in Cocoyasi Village and the adoptive older sister of Nami. They were raised together by their adoptive mother, Bell-mère.

She is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Arlong Park Arc.

Nojiko is an average-sized young woman with light blue hair and eyes and tanned skin.

Her right arm and chest are heavily tattooed—a gesture of sympathy and condolence towards Nami, who was ashamed of her tattoo of Arlong's Jolly Roger. In the manga, she also used to wear a bracelet, which she gave to Nami. She is usually seen wearing a beige sleeveless shirt (sometimes a green button-up shirt with yellow stripes), blue trousers, and purple sandals. Furthermore, she appears to wear pink lip gloss.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Nojiko is the owner of a mikan farm in Cocoyasi Village and the adoptive older sister of Nami. They were raised together by their adoptive mother, Bell-mère.

entities.name: Nokotti
entities.description:
Nokotti is a Waiter of the Beasts Pirates who serves as a guard in the Prisoner Mine of the Udon region. She acted as the gyōji during the Sumo Inferno held by Queen.

Nokotti is a slender woman with red lipstick and long blond hair that covers her right eye. She wears a leather bucket hat, a leather bikini top, purple belted jeans and red high-heels.

Little is known about Nokotti's personality, but she takes her role as a gyōji seriously.

Nokotti's authority as a prison guard allows her to punish prisoners for talking back to her with amputation or death.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Nokotti is a Waiter of the Beasts Pirates who serves as a guard in the Prisoner Mine of the Udon region. She acted as the gyōji during the Sumo Inferno held by Queen.

entities.name: Noriko
entities.description:
Noriko is a nori maker who lives in Ebisu Town.

Noriko is an elderly woman with a wrinkled face and a white kerchief on her head. She wears a purple kimono.

Noriko is cheered up just from seeing Yasuie and holds a positive attitude despite not having enough medicine.

She had her emotional expressions stripped away by eating a defective leftover SMILE fruit, causing her to only be able to smile and laugh.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Noriko is a nori maker who lives in Ebisu Town.

entities.name: Nure-Onna
entities.description:
Nure-Onna is a Gifter in the Beasts Pirates who works under Black Maria.

Nure-Onna is a woman with a round face, round eyes with prominent lashes, a pointed nose, and long black hair that is parted in the middle. As a Hognose Snake Gifter, she has a large, snake-like mouth with fangs and a long forked tongue. Her neck is long and spotted, and she is often crouched low with her hands on the ground. She wears a dark-colored kimono with a spotted pattern on it, and she has a flower in her hair above her left ear. In her base form, she wears a green kimono adorned with light yellow circle patterns with dark yellow circles dots with five in each circle and a dark blue obi around her waist. She also wears white tabi.

Nure-Onna is cruel and deceptive, using Black Maria's illusion mist to impersonate Nico Robin's deceased mother to trick her. She is loyal to Black Maria and her fellow Beasts Pirates.

Nure-Onna is strong enough to sustain attacks from Robin's giant hands and continue to fight.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Nure-Onna is a Gifter in the Beasts Pirates who works under Black Maria.

entities.name: Octopako
entities.description:
Octopako is an octopus fish-woman whom Hatchan tried to win over during his cover story, Hatchan's Sea-Floor Stroll.

As an octopus fish-woman, Octopako has six arms and two legs, making a total of eight appendages, all of which are slender.

She wears a tanktop and a round hat with goggles, with her long hair jutting out, as well as sandals.

In the anime, she is depicted with pink skin, dark pink lips, and blonde hair. Her hat is black and white and she wears a light pink tank top with dark pink flower pattern.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Octopako is an octopus fish-woman whom Hatchan tried to win over during his cover story, Hatchan's Sea-Floor Stroll.

entities.name: Oide
entities.description:
Oide is a little girl who lives in Sphinx. She is the owner of Tama.

Oide is a little girl with blushy cheeks, brown pigtails and brown eyes. She wears a short, orange long-sleeved dress and a round wool hat with dots on the brim.

Oide is a cheerful girl who loves her pet, Tama.

Due to her young age, Oide does not seem to know about Devil Fruits, since she refers to the effects of Marco's Tori Tori no Mi as "magic".
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Oide is a little girl who lives in Sphinx. She is the owner of Tama.

entities.name: Okame
entities.description:
Okame was a member of the Sand-Sand Clan and, later, of the Arabasta Rebel Army.

Okame is a skinny woman with bright red cheeks and short black hair. She wears a long pink sleeveless dress, that has purple stripes around the waist, and the kanji 砂 ("sand") on the front. She wears a white hat, and carries a large sword on her back.

As a child, Okame was somewhat chubby. She wore a robe with horizontal stripes and a beret-like hat.

Okame showed support for Vivi instead of Koza when the two fought, possibly sympathizing her because they were both girls. While she did not speak much, she showcased bravery by attempting to protect Vivi from thugs.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Okame was a member of the Sand-Sand Clan and, later, of the Arabasta Rebel Army.

entities.name: Oli
entities.description:
Crone Oli is a pirate captain subordinate to the Red Hair Pirates.

Oli is a slim elderly woman with a wrinkly face and long, curly black hair. She wears a long dark dress with light sleeves, a vertically striped skirt, and a ribbon at the back. On her head she wears a dark cavalier hat with a long plume.

Oli is very attached to Shanks and grateful for the protection his flag grants her crew. However, she is ready to banter with him should he poke fun at her.

Like many other characters, Oli has her own distinct laugh, .

entities.name: Otohime
entities.description:
Queen Otohime was a mermaid, the queen of the Ryugu Kingdom, the wife of king Neptune, and the mother of Fukaboshi, Ryuboshi, Manboshi, and Shirahoshi.

Otohime was a political activist who worked hard for union and peace between fish-men plus merfolk and humans, dreaming of having her people emigrate from the Sea Floor to the surface. Ten years ago, she was assassinated by Hody Jones, who had framed a human pirate as the instigator of the deed. She is one of the two posthumous overarching protagonists of the Fish-Man Island Arc (alongside Fisher Tiger).

Unlike her husband and daughter, Otohime was a normal human-sized mermaid. Her golden blonde hair was partially held up in two loops, much like her daughter Shirahoshi only shorter, by an orange headpiece. She also had green eyes (blue in the anime), thick eyelashes, and wore pink lipstick.

She was usually seen wearing a very long white kimono with a cream-colored carp-scale design along the hem and a sash around her shoulders that floated behind her head much like her children.

entities.name: Pandawomanmi
entities.description:
Pandawomanmi is the female version of Pandaman. She first appeared in the Amazon Lily Arc where Pandaman would not be allowed (as men are forbidden on Amazon Lily).

Like Pandaman, Pandawomanmi has general panda-like features, though they are often depicted vaguely to keep her appearances less obvious. She wears a black bikini style top and wears her hair in the bun style with pigtails, with a more human-looking body than Pandaman's, giving her the resemblance of a young woman.

Pandaman is said to be in love with her, but it is unknown if the relationship is mutual.

entities.name: Pansy
entities.description:
Pansy is a large overweight woman with round eyes, a double chin, and a big nose. She wears red lipstick, and has brownish-red hair, flowing in the back, and in two big curls in the front. Pansy wears a wiggly black and yellow stripped top that shows most of her breast and all of her stomach and is always barefoot.

Not much is know about her personality, but like most other Kuja, Pansy has little knowledge and trust of men and of the outside world, and deeply admires their rulers, the Gorgon Sisters.

Pansy is presumably fairly strong. She was estimated to be stronger than Poppy, which she proved to be correct.

Pansy and Poppy were seen fighting each other in the Kuja Arena pair-ups: Pansy's odds of winning were 1.1 and a Kuja in the stands was willing to bet 1,500 gor on her.

entities.name: Pascia
entities.description:
Pascia is a female dancer, who was to be sold at the Auction House.

Pascia is a young woman with long purple hair and dark brown eyes. She wears a long white dress with some pink details on it, a see-through pink midsection that shows her belly button, and a yellow headpiece with a red gem piece at the front. In the manga, there is no red gem.

Pascia seemed to be a quiet and saddened woman when she was up for auction. After receiving the keys to her chains, however, she, as well as the rest of the slaves, seemed happy and excited about their freedom.

Pascia was born somewhere in the South Blue. At some point in her life, she was captured and taken to the Human Auctioning House.

entities.name: Perona
entities.description:
"Ghost Princess" Perona is a member of the Thriller Bark Pirates and the former commander of the Wild Zombies and Surprise Zombies, prior to Thriller Bark's collapse.

She was introduced as one of the Mysterious Four, the highest-ranking officers of Thriller Bark; however, she was sent to Kuraigaina Island by Bartholomew Kuma before the defeat of Gecko Moria's army. She resided in the island's castle for about two years, and during the timeskip she begrudgingly helped Roronoa Zoro during his training under Dracule Mihawk. She briefly helped the Straw Hat Pirates when they returned to Sabaody, stopping a battalion of Marines with her Horo-Horo ghosts.

Due to her actions, she can be considered a major antagonist in the Thriller Bark Saga and an ally of Roronoa Zoro and the Straw Hat Pirates during the timeskip and Return to Sabaody Arc.

Perona is a short young woman with big, round black eyes and asymmetrical eyelashes on the bottom of each of her eyelids that may represent eyeliner. She has long, waist-length, light pink hair that she keeps tied into two pigtails with black and white flower hairpins. She wears a red crown with a black cross on her head, as well as red lipstick and a thick layer of black eyeliner. Her white long-sleeved shirt with three different black heart shapes was short enough to expose her belly. She wears a red mini cape with a pink ribbon in front. Her black-and-white striped tights completely cover her legs, and she wears a mini-skirt and a red-and-gold belt with a heart belt buckle, as well as red buckled boots. She usually keeps her toes pointing inwards in a pigeon-toed manner and carried around a red parasol shaped like a cute version of a mini devil prior to her battle with Usopp.

entities.name: Poppy
entities.description:
Poppy has wavy black hair, that goes over her shoulders. She is thin, wears bandages on her arms, and is always barefoot. She wears a bluish-white top that shows her cleavage and stomach. She also wears a skirt of matching color in the front, but pink in the back, with a yellow string around it.

Not much is know about her personality, but like most other Kuja, she has little knowledge and trust of men and of the outside world, and deeply admires their rulers, the Gorgon Sisters.

Poppy was estimated to be weaker than Pansy, which proved to be correct.

Poppy and Pansy were seen fighting each other in the Kuja Arena pair-ups: Poppy's odds of winning were 2.6, and a Kuja in the stands was willing to bet 1,000 gor on her.

entities.name: Porche
entities.description:
Porche is a combatant of the Foxy Pirates. She is considered an idol by the crew and is loved by all of the men.

Due to her actions, she is a major antagonist during the Long Ring Long Land Arc, and a supporting antagonist in the Foxy's Return and Spa Island filler Arcs.

Porche is a slender young woman with dark blue hair, blue eyes, and a long pointed nose. She is seen wearing a pink jumpsuit with extremely puffed pantlegs, which is unzipped on the top to reveal a bikini top beneath it. Her outfit is adorned by several large, white puff-balls, the most notable one being the one hanging from her hat. She is also never seen without the standard Foxy Pirate face mask.

In the anime, Porche is also seen wearing a Foxy Team jersey during certain Davy Back Fight events.

entities.name: Portgas D. Rouge
entities.description:
Portgas D. Rouge was the mother of Portgas D. Ace and the lover of Gol D. Roger.

Rouge was a slender woman with long, wavy strawberry blonde hair. She had brown eyes, and freckles on her face that were passed on to her son. She wore a pink hibiscus flower in her hair on the left side of her head. She also wore a long, short-sleeved, light blue dress that reached down to her feet, and sandals.

Very little is known of Rouge's personality but she seemed to be very kind and loving, sacrificing herself so that her baby boy could be born. She also displayed the typical traits of the Will of D. such as a strong will and smiling shortly before death.

Rouge truly loved Roger, as she cared about their child and cried upon learning of Roger's death. She even named Ace using one of the names Roger chose and also used Roger's surname.

entities.name: Pururu
entities.description:
"Trembling" Pururu is the "princess" of the Bourgeois Pirates, a pirate crew subordinate to the Red Hair Pirates.

Pururu is a short woman with a pointy nose, similar to those of the Tontatta Tribe's women, and turquoise curly hair. She has make-up consisting of mascara, lipstick and blush. She wears a dark dress that exposes her shoulders and a bicorne with hearts lining the rim and her Jolly Roger on the center.

Pururu is a panicky individual but puts up a brave front. She is very loyal to Shanks and willing to fight strong enemies for his sake despite her own weakness.

As the "princess" of the Bourgeois Pirates, Pururu has authority over her crew. However, she and her crew are famous for being weak, like other subordinates of the Red Hair Pirates.

entities.name: Quincy
entities.description:
Quincy is a slender woman with curly hair and wearing an elaborate outfit consisting of a round, crown-like hat, a checkered jacket, a giant ribbon around her waist and a light-colored skirt.

Not much is known about Quincy's personality yet.

Quincy was one of the Kid Pirates witnessing her captain fight Big Mom on Onigashima's Live Floor. When Kid managed to significantly injure Big Mom with Punk Corna Dio, Quincy cheered him on.

entities.name: Raki
entities.description:
Raki is one of the Shandia warriors who fought to take back Upper Yard from Enel.

Raki is a tall, black-haired woman, with two large bangs parted to either side of her face on the front, and a long and elaborate ponytail on the back. She has dark green eyes, and her lips are apparently covered with pink lipstick. Like all Shandia, she has two small wings on her back. Raki's outfit consists of a light purple cleavage revealing tunic with a darker pattern that exposes her stomach, and light-red pants, reminiscent of the ones worn by Native Americans, that are open on the inside of her legs. She also has matching colored Skate-type Wavers she wears into battle. After the end of the Skypiea Arc, she wears a more casual version of her outfit.

Since her childhood, Raki, like many Shandia, has usually stayed barefoot instead of wearing shoes; however, Raki does use them sometimes, such as having on a pair of black flats six years prior to her first appearance. Following the events of the Skypiea Arc, Raki starts wearing shoes on a common basis, using a pair with the outfit she had on at the end of the Skypiea Arc when on a walk with her close friends.

After two years, she has two pieces of hair tied on the top of her head instead of one. She also wears the same sleeveless shirt as Conis with a face with wings on it.

entities.name: Ran
entities.description:
Ran is an average-sized lady who has jet black hair parted on one side with an earring on each ear. She wears long black stockings with straps that reach her matching color panties. Around her waist is a decorative belt of rings that is attached to a small flap of blue cloth to cover her rear. Her top is a small orange flowered tank top with a window hole in the middle that seems almost too small for her size. She carries a quiver of arrows slung around her back with a snake that is usually accompanying her. She wears a overcoat, similar to a Marine, like a cape like many of her fellow crewmates.

Ran is a perceptive woman, knowing that Luffy defeated Bacura with brute force. She also seems to be one of the more knowledgeable and prominent Kuja in the pirate crew, telling a little girl about the Gorgon Sisters and their cursed backs (though unknown to Ran, it was in truth a mark of slavery that the three sisters hide in shame).

As a member of the Kuja Pirates, it can be implied that she is very strong as only the strongest warriors are allowed on the Kuja ship. As with most of the other Kuja warriors, Ran uses a snake that can morph into a bow to launch arrows. She is very skilled with her bow, and is considered a master archer.

In the Calm Belt near Amazon Lily, Ran spoke with Vice Admiral Momonga on the Kuja Pirates ship. Ran noticed that Momonga had killed a Sea King. Momonga then handed over a newspaper to Ran while requesting a meeting with Boa Hancock. After Hancock turned Momonga's crew into stone, the Kuja Pirates sailed for Amazon Lily. After returning to the island, Ran gave the newspaper to Elder Nyon. When the Gorgon Sisters were having their bath time, all Kujas left the castle. When a child asked why the sisters are left alone when they bathe, Ran revealed the story behind the Gorgon Sisters' supposed powers. Ran explained that Boa Hancock and her sisters were inflicted with a curse after slaying a gorgon. The three sisters supposedly have cursed eyes on their backs which turn anyone who sees them into stone and that was why no one was allowed into the castle during her their bath time.

entities.name: Rebecca
entities.description:
Rebecca is the daughter of Scarlett and Kyros, the niece of Viola and the granddaughter of Riku Doldo III. She is the former crown princess of Dressrosa, who forfeited her title to live with her father and currently serves as a to her aunt, Viola.

While living under Donquixote Doflamingo's regime, she was imprisoned and forced to fight as a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum. She joined a tournament to compete for the Mera Mera no Mi, winning the D Block and battling in the finals before Sabo claimed the Devil Fruit.

She is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Dressrosa Arc.

Rebecca is a fair-skinned and tall girl, but slightly shorter than Luffy. She has long, light pink hair, which she wears in a braid. She holds a strong resemblance to her mother.

entities.name: Renona Topakka
entities.description:
Renona Topakka was a mermaid and the mother of Kawamatsu.

Topakka was a mermaid with pale greenish skin, blue eyes, and long bright red hair. She wore a short pink kimono with red ring patterns. Due to reaching the age of 30, her tailfin had split into legs.

Topakka cared for her son and feared he would face discrimination for his race, believing it was best for Kawamatsu to lie that he was a kappa.

As a mermaid, Topakka possessed the typical abilities of her race, such as the ability to breathe underwater and the fastest swimming speed among all sea creaures.

entities.name: Rika
entities.description:
Rika is a young girl from Shells Town, and the daughter of Ririka. She currently serves as a waitress at the 153rd Marine Branch.

Rika is a young girl with black eyes, and dark hair done in pigtails. When she first met the Straw Hat Pirates, she wore a striped one-piece dress with what appeared to be a drawstring hood.

After two years, she has become taller and grown her hair out (though she continues to wear pigtails). Her Marine waitress uniform consists of an apron embroidered with a Marine emblem, a cook's bandana, and simple black shoes.

Rika is remarkably compassionate and brave for her age, enough to risk her life for people who have helped her (e.g. Zoro), and even extend friendship to former enemies (e.g., Helmeppo). At the same time, she can easily fall into tears or tantrums when frustrated.

entities.name: Rindo
entities.description:
Rindo is an average-height woman with skin bearing a slightly darker tan than the rest of the Kuja. Her black hair is cut short and tied back into a bun on top of her head. She also always has a cigarette dangling off the side of her mouth.

She wears a fancy orange frilled black jacket with purple spiral snake patterns on it. She lets it hang open, revealing her bosom and midriff. She also wears a loose fitting orange belt which has a yellow and black patterned cloth in front of her waist. Like the other Kuja, her footwear consists of long black stockings with straps attached.

Rindo has often shown to be very respectful and punctual towards her duties and Hancock but is often very aloof, showing no real surprise over the presence of Luffy on the island or the events that took place.

Rindo is the best sniper of the Kuja tribe, and an elite member, strong enough to join the Kuja Pirates.

entities.name: Rint
entities.description:
Rint was one of the archaeologists of Ohara.

Rint was a middle aged, overweight woman with long shaggy purple hair. She had a reddish-purple hat with a horizontal pink stripe around it. She also wore a shirt with hearts on it, and the sleeves rolled up. Her pants were yellow-green with vertical lines.

Rint was a very devoted scholar that stayed behind to help ditch books into a lake in an effort to protect them. She, along with the other scholars, were friendly towards Nico Robin.

She was a skilled archaeologist and had a good knowledge of history. She specialized in the history of culinary science, and was a skilled cook, commonly making the meals for the other archaeologists.

entities.short_description: Rint was one of the archaeologists of Ohara.

entities.name: Ripley
entities.description:
Ripley is a giant from the last generation of Elbaph's warriors and a biology teacher at the Walrus School. She is also the mother of Colon and common-law wife of Scopper Gaban.

Ripley is a giant woman of slender figure. Her most noticeable trait is a streamlined and violet tattoo that runs down the whole left side of her body, from her left temple to her left foot. She has long, pink hair arranged in braids at the front, with bangs partially covering the right side of her face and pink eyes.

Ripley wears a green, midriff-baring tank top with a horned Jolly Roger design imprinted on it, a green fur cape, a green short skirt held up by leather belts, and green fuzzy boots wrapped in bands.

Ripley is a laid-back woman who does not care about personal manners and freely uses rude language, in spite of hypocritically reprimanding bad behavior among her students. Nevertheless, Ripley is a follower of the late King Harald's teachings, which prioritize peace and trading among countries instead of war and conquest. However, she does still value some of Elbaph's old traditions, as she has been shown to encourage her son's desire to become a warrior and has shown interest in Nika, like many other giants.

entities.short_description: Ripley is a giant from the last generation of Elbaph's warriors and a biology teacher at the Walrus School. She is also the mother of Colon and common-law wife of Scopper Gaban.

entities.name: Ririka
entities.description:
Ririka is a bartender who runs a local bar in Shells Town. She is Rika's mother.

Ririka is a woman of average height and weight. She has brown hair that is usually tied back. She wears a light green dress over a dark green shirt and brown sandals.

She is very protective of her daughter, as she made her stay away from Luffy after he punched Helmeppo, fearing for her safety if she was associated with him.

After Monkey D. Luffy punched Helmeppo, Ririka ordered her daughter to get inside and get away from Luffy. She then asked Rika if she had gone to the execution grounds again, which her daughter denied.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Ririka is a bartender who runs a local bar in Shells Town. She is Rika's mother.

entities.name: Roji
entities.description:
Roji was the wife of Oran, the mother of Mizuira, the sister-in-law of Nico Olvia, and the maternal aunt of Nico Robin.

Roji was a large, widely obese woman with thin limbs, wide and thick lips, small sad beady eyes, and curly red hair. She wore a simple short-sleeved orange shirt and black pants.

Roji was extremely rude, abusive, and uncaring towards her niece Robin. She threatened Robin for crying and even treated her like a slave. Roji only cared about herself, her husband, and their only daughter.

When Nico Olvia left Ohara to research Poneglyphs, Roji and her husband, Oran, took in Olvia's two-year-old daughter, Robin, since Oran was Olvia's younger brother. Roji never liked Robin and would threaten to hit Robin if she did not stop crying. She would always make Robin do all the housework and have her eat stale bread. Roji would not allow Robin to join any family celebrations. Roji also scolded Robin for trying out Mizuira's clothes. In essence, Roji treated her niece as a slave. However, Roji's husband would always defend Robin; since he is Robin's maternal uncle, he was the only person in the household to show care for her and would deal with Roji's temper.

entities.short_description: Roji was the wife of Oran, the mother of Mizuira, the sister-in-law of Nico Olvia, and the maternal aunt of Nico Robin.

entities.name: Ronja
entities.description:
Ronja is a student at the Walrus School on Elbaph. She is a .

Ronja is a young giant girl with brown eyes and blonde hair tied in a three-segmented bubble ponytail which curls forwards, resembling the tail of a scorpion. She lacks any upper teeth apart from prominent square-shaped canine teeth. She wears a short fur cape and a patterned dress with light squares formed by dark vertical and horizontal lines.

Ronja has an upbeat personality and remains optimistic even in the face of danger. Like other Walrus School students, Ronja is against violence and fighting. She is also fond of humans. Ronja is very brave, as despite being terrified for her life when Gunko was about to drop her to her death, she tried to reassure the adults and other children that she would be fine and they should not risk Elbaph's history for her sake.

Ronja's father is shown to be concerned for her well-being, and personally rushed to save her when he heard about her kidnapping. Upon seeing her again, he was quick to praise her bravery.

entities.name: Rosward Shalria
entities.description:
Saint Rosward Shalria is a World Noble, the daughter of Saint Rosward Rosward, and the younger sister of Saint Charlos.

Alongside the rest of her family, Shalria is one of the main antagonists of the Sabaody Archipelago Arc.

Like other World Nobles, Shalria is dressed in a thick white suit with medal-like knobs which supplies her with oxygen to save her sharing the same air as commoners. The collar of her suit has a flower-like pattern with lace at the top. The flower pattern on her suit repeats at the sides of her skirt. Her dirty blonde hair inside the bubble is styled upwards, forming a curl above her head. She wears a veil over the lower half of her face and light orange tinted shades over her eyes. She also wears heart-shaped earrings.

Like her fellow Celestial Dragons, Shalria shows no concern for those whose statuses are beneath her and shows no pity, remorse, or regret about how she treats her slaves. In an incident where she lost her slave, she coldly commented on how her father would simply have to buy her another, viewing the slave's demise in such a lowly way she mocked him as barely being a human. She detests the weak more than anything (which is rather ironic considering she has no fighting skill of her own). She also has great pride in her family's ancestry, as she swore to make the Straw Hats suffer a living hell upon capture for what they did to her father and brother.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Saint Rosward Shalria is a World Noble, the daughter of Saint Rosward Rosward, and the younger sister of Saint Charlos.

entities.name: Roxanne
entities.description:
Roxanne is a Baratie regular who was friendly with Sanji. It is not known whether Roxanne is on the left or right. キャラクター検索|trans-title=Roxanne Character Search|website=one-piece.com|access-date=August 27, 2026|lang=ja}}

She can be barely seen, but she is a young woman. She wears a skirt and blouse.

She apparently enjoys eating at the Baratie, since Sanji knows her by name.

She was seen returning with a friend to the Baratie, where Sanji greeted her by name and started flirting.
entities.short_description: Roxanne is a Baratie regular who was friendly with Sanji. It is not known whether Roxanne is on the left or right. キャラクター検索|trans-title=Roxanne Character Search|website=one-piece.com|access-date=August 27, 2026|lang=ja}}

entities.name: Russian
entities.description:
Russian was Senor Pink's wife and the mother of Gimlet.

Russian was a young woman with brown, shoulder-length hair and blue eyes. On her cheeks she had two patches of freckles. When she entered a vegetative state, her eyes appeared blank looking.

Russian was a very caring woman, especially toward her husband and son. However, she expressed a clear hatred for pirates. She also claimed to like rain.

She was very grieved when her son died and became distraught after she found out Senor Pink lied to her. After Russian entered her vegetative state, she became unable to interact with the world or show her feelings; however, after her husband put on Gimlet's bonnet, pacifier and diaper when he visited her, she was able to smile again, showing that she could still subconsciously feel the love and efforts of her husband.

entities.short_description: Russian was Senor Pink's wife and the mother of Gimlet.

entities.name: S-Snake
entities.description:
S-Snake is one of the Seraphim and a Lunarian-based clone of Boa Hancock.

Due to her actions and role, she is a supporting antagonist in the Egghead Arc.

S-Snake resembles Hancock as a child, but with the same hairstyle and earrings as the adult Hancock, and is also significantly larger in size. While she shares an appearance with the adult Kuja, as a seraphim she also possesses lunarian traits, such as brown skin, black wings, and white hair. She has yellow eyes with star-shaped pupils. Several characters consider her appearance "cute", a trait that helps her in combat. She wears a simple white dress and black DOM shoes.

A section of her right upper arm is replaced by a tube that is filled with Green Blood.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: S-Snake is one of the Seraphim and a Lunarian-based clone of Boa Hancock.

entities.name: Sadi
entities.description:
Sadi is a chief guard of Impel Down. She always wants to be addressed as .

Due to her actions, she is a major antagonist in the Impel Down Arc.

Sadi is a relatively slim and tall woman with long, unkempt orange hair and bangs that cover her eyes. She resembles a in design.

She dresses in a very skimpy red (hot pink in the anime) -themed outfit, evident from the horns and the devil's trident. Her outfit covers only the top half of her exposed breasts with fringe, which is also featured around her waist. She has long sleeves that slope into stylized rips. She has a yellow ring on the center of her stomach connecting one strap from above and two from below. These elements, particularly the fringe and the midriff ring, subtly mirror the aesthetic of traditional Arab belly dancing attire.

entities.short_description: Sadi is a chief guard of Impel Down. She always wants to be addressed as .

entities.name: Saki
entities.description:
Saki is a tall, fair-skinned woman with pink hair styled into three points. She wears a light blue kimono with red and dark blue patches on it and an orange sash around her waist.

Saki had her emotional expressions stripped away by eating a defective leftover SMILE fruit, causing her to only be able to smile and laugh.

When Tonoyasu was checking in with everyone in Ebisu Town, he asked Saki how her son was, prompting Saki's son to call out to Tonoyasu.

Saki never appears in the manga and only her name is mentioned. However, she is given an appearance in the anime, holding her baby and giving it to Tonoyasu to hold.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Saki is a tall, fair-skinned woman with pink hair styled into three points. She wears a light blue kimono with red and dark blue patches on it and an orange sash around her waist.

entities.name: Sarahebi
entities.description:
Sarahebi is a Gifter of the Beasts Pirates who works under Black Maria. She was also a school teacher in the Flower Capital.

Sarahebi is a woman of average height with pale purple, shoulder-length hair. She has yellow eyes, light red lipstick, and a small hot-pink flower in her hair. As a Gifter, she has been seen with black sharp horns. She wears a dark purple kimono adorned with blue floral patterns and an obi with red and dark red stripes. She also wears white tabi.

Sarahebi is loyal to her crew, her captain and Kurozumi Orochi as she teaches children propaganda that portrays Kaidou and Orochi as heroes while vilifying Kouzuki Oden and the Nine Red Scabbards.

As a school teacher for all the children in Wano Country, she is responsible for teaching the children lectures and also convincing them that the Kouzuki Clan are evil and Orochi is the hero of Wano Country. She seems charismatic enough for the children to accept her lectures.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Sarahebi is a Gifter of the Beasts Pirates who works under Black Maria. She was also a school teacher in the Flower Capital.

entities.name: Sarfunkel
entities.description:
Sarfunkel is an inhabitant on the Island of Rare Animals. She is described as a barrel woman.

She has long, flowing blond hair, wears a pair of goggles, and is always barefoot. She is stuck within a barrel, similar to how Gaimon is stuck inside a chest. Her barrel has the word "Caution" written on it with a star below it.

Sarfunkel cares deeply about Gaimon, since they have been friends for some time and she was seen feeding him.

While playing a game of during a boat trip, Sarfunkel hid in a barrel. However, the boat she was on was wrecked, and she washed ashore on the Island of Rare Animals.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Sarfunkel is an inhabitant on the Island of Rare Animals. She is described as a barrel woman.

entities.name: Sarie Nantokanette
entities.description:
Sarie Nantokanette is the queen of the Goa Kingdom and Sterry's wife.

Nantokanette is a tall, thin woman with long, bright, wavy blonde hair, blue eyes, and a pointy nose. She wears a yellow-orange dress with flower motifs and a feather in her hair.

She is somewhat optimistic compared to other nobles from her kingdom, as she did not complain about her hotel room in Loguetown. However, Oda stated that she is likely as bad as her husband. She did show concern for Sterry as she was appalled at Vice Admiral Garp's derision of her husband during the reception of the various royals prior to the Levely.

When she speaks, she tends to use a triple negative: Isn’t not not, which ultimately cancels itself out. Nantokanette is also very furious whenever Sterry is ogling at another woman in front of her, as seen when Gismonda showed a picture of Nefertari Vivi to her and Sterry during the search.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Sarie Nantokanette is the queen of the Goa Kingdom and Sterry's wife.

entities.name: Satchels Maffey
entities.description:
Saint Satchels Maffey is a World Noble and a member of the Knights of God 38 years ago. She took part in the God Valley Incident, and was responsible for Shanks and Shamrock splitting up. It is unknown if she is still working as a Knight of God in the current day.

Maffey is a massive woman, towering over her already-large comrades. She has sharpened teeth, wears lipstick, and was frequently seen with a cigar in her mouth. 38 years ago, she had long light and dark hair, which split down the middle, and was fashioned up to look as though it were a crown, as well as dark sunglasses and a pair of horns. She wore an open V-neck frilled shirt, exposing her cleavage and midriff, and two belts above her navel area, as well as a floral skirt and bands around her forearms. She also wore a large fur coat over her shoulders. It seems she wore high heels when Edward Newgate cut her in half.

Like all World Nobles, and similar to other Knights of God, Maffey exhibits a personality of very low morals, accompanied by a mocking, flirtatious tone. She cares very little about the lives of others, and was fully prepared to end the life of a young Monkey D. Dragon for mutiny, without any qualms. Nevertheless, she was happy to do one of her allies a favor, and quickly accomplished her task of reacquiring Shamrock. However, either through bad intel or because she was in a hurry, she did not bother to check if Shanks was even present or if Dragon was truly dead.

Being a World Noble of the Satchels family, Maffey is above the law of the lower world and is permitted to do anything she pleases, so long as it does not go against the laws of the Celestial Dragons. She has tremendous political influence and can summon a Marine Admiral to handle anyone she feels is trying to bring harm to her. However, being one of the Knights of God, she likely possesses more than sufficient combat prowess to defend herself without the needs of an Admiral.

entities.name: Scarlett
entities.description:
Scarlett was the first daughter of the Riku Family and the former crown princess of Dressrosa until falsifying her own death. She was Viola's elder sister, Kyros' wife, and Rebecca's mother. She was killed by Diamante when the Donquixote Pirates took over Dressrosa ten years ago.

Scarlett looked very similar to Rebecca, wearing her pink hair in a braided ponytail with two pieces hanging down from the sides. Her pink hair was a darker shade than her daughter's. She sported a white button-up dress with frills at the bottom during Rebecca's flashback when they were at the Flower Field.

Scarlett cared very much for her daughter and tried desperately to protect her, taking her away from the violence that went on in Dressrosa when Doflamingo took over. She was a kind person, as she once told her daughter not to hurt anyone. Scarlett often showed kindness for the dwarves when they would get yelled at by her father for their mischief, bringing them treats to cheer them up. Another sign of her love for Rebecca was when she risked her life to get food for her, which led to her own death.

Though originally skeptical and distrusting about Kyros' redemption due to his past as a murderer, she came to see him as a good man after he rescued her. She fell in love with him, which led her to willingly give up her status as a princess. Falsifying her own death in order to elope with the man she loves and avoid a scandal, she chose a modest life in a simple cottage with her husband and daughter.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Scarlett was the first daughter of the Riku Family and the former crown princess of Dressrosa until falsifying her own death. She was Viola's elder sister, Kyros' wife, and Rebecca's mother. She was killed by Diamante…

entities.name: Scorpionlady
entities.description:
Scorpionlady is a Gifter in the Beasts Pirates and a member of the crew's Armored Division. After being tamed by Tama, she became an ally of the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance.

Scorpionlady is a normal sized woman, with an hourglass figure. She wears a green skirt with long dark green legging and wears light green gloves. She wears an army helmet with red goggles on them and has small dark green horns pultruding out of it. She also has long wavy purple hair going down to her skirt. Due to the SMILE that she consumed, she has scorpion claws on her waist and four extra scorpion legs behind her human ones.

Scorpionlady appears to be very loyal to the Beasts Pirates, and had no problem with firing on Kouzuki Momonosuke, a child. In the anime, she appears additionally cold-hearted, laughing alongside the rest of the Armored Division when Sasaki made fun of the Kouzuki Family.

As a Gifter, Scorpionlady has consumed a |Sasori no Sumairu}}, giving her claws and extra legs. When she first attained this ability, she had trouble walking with her six legs and stumbled often, but she seemingly became used to it over time.

entities.short_description: Scorpionlady is a Gifter in the Beasts Pirates and a member of the crew's Armored Division. After being tamed by Tama, she became an ally of the Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance.

entities.name: Seira
entities.description:
Seira is a mermaid and one of the top five Mermaid Cafe Dancers.

Seira is a mermaid with brunette hair tied in a ponytail and a pink tail with purple marks.

She wears a pair of shell headphones, a yellow bikini with blue flowery straps, a red pearl necklace and red lipstick.

Like all other mermaids, Seira is kind and caring, and is apparently fun loving. When meeting Luffy, Usopp, Sanji and Chopper for the first time she comments approvingly on their boldness of having entered Fish-Man Island illegally, stating that she loves pirates, which is probably why she seems to like Sanji like the rest of her friends.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Seira is a mermaid and one of the top five Mermaid Cafe Dancers.

entities.name: Shakuyaku
entities.description:
Shakuyaku, most commonly known by her nickname Shakky, is the bartender of Shakky's Rip-off Bar on the Sabaody Archipelago (formerly on Hachinosu over 40 years ago). She lives with her husband Silvers Rayleigh.

Shakky formerly served in the Kuja Pirates as the First Mate of Gloriosa, her captain and the Kuja tribe's empress. She later succeeded Gloriosa as both the Kuja Pirates' captain as well as the Kuja's empress, before eventually being succeeded by Tritoma and Boa Hancock.

During her youth, Shakky was chased by the legendary Marine, Monkey D. Garp. After retiring as empress and captain, she opened her bar at Hachinosu, becoming famous in the world of pirates alongside her bar. While she was beloved by both the Rocks Pirates and Roger Pirates, she only had eyes for Silvers Rayleigh, the Roger Pirates' First Mate. 38 years ago, Shakky was kidnapped and made the ultimate prize for the winner of the Native Hunting Competition on God Valley, which served as one of the major triggers of the God Valley Incident. She was rescued by Rayleigh, which ultimately solidified their romantic relationship.

She is a minor ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Sabaody Archipelago Arc.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Shakuyaku, most commonly known by her nickname Shakky, is the bartender of Shakky's Rip-off Bar on the Sabaody Archipelago (formerly on Hachinosu over 40 years ago). She lives with her husband Silvers Rayleigh.

entities.name: Shelly
entities.description:
Shelly is Tonjit's hooorse and an animal of Long Ring Long Land.

Shelly is a white female horse, but, unlike any other horse, her limbs and neck are extremely long, to the point where Chopper mistook her for a giraffe. This classifies her as a hooooorse, according to Tonjit. She wears a thin brown bridle, with a dark red saddle that has light brown lining.

Shelly is very affectionate nuzzling up to Chopper after meeting him and to Tonjit after his return. She is also very patient and loyal, waiting ten years for her master to return without leaving.

When Tonjit was left stranded in the stilt house Shelly stayed behind waiting for him.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Shelly is Tonjit's hooorse and an animal of Long Ring Long Land.

entities.name: Shimotsuki Furiko
entities.description:
Shimotsuki Furiko is a member of the Shimotsuki Family, a direct descendant of the legendary samurai Shimotsuki Ryuma and the older sister of Shimotsuki Ushimaru. She is also the wife of Roronoa Pinzoro, the mother of Roronoa Arashi, and the grandmother of Roronoa Zoro.

Based on her silhouette, Furiko had long hair and prominent eyelashes.

Furiko was born in Wano Country, but illegally departed from there 55 years ago with her clansman Shimotsuki Kouzaburou, Minatomo, and 22 other people. Three years later, they settled down in what became Shimotsuki Village in the East Blue, where Furiko married a local swordsman named Roronoa Pinzoro. At some point, the couple had a son named Roronoa Arashi.

entities.name: Shimotsuki Kuina
entities.description:
Shimotsuki Kuina was a childhood friend, relative and rival of Roronoa Zoro. She was the daughter of Shimotsuki Koushirou and the granddaughter of Shimotsuki Kouzaburou making her a descendant of Wano Country's famed Shimotsuki Family. Her death at the age of eleven drove much of Zoro's ambitions as a swordsman, including his development of the Three Sword Style.

She had short, dark blue hair and large, dark eyes. She wore a light pink short-sleeved shirt with a three-buttoned placket that she left unbuttoned, dark maroon shorts, and brown shoes. In the anime, while training at the dojo, she wore a white sleeveless shirt and cropped dark green pants.

Outwardly, Kuina was always self-assured and confident, bordering on arrogant toward fellow trainees. This, however, belied her fears—shaped by Koushirou's beliefs—that grown women could not match men in strength. As she dreamed of being the world's greatest swordsman, she came to resent her own body as an obstacle, and especially dreaded the onset of .

These factors led to a complicated relationship between her and Roronoa Zoro, whom she often mocked as weak but simultaneously envied for being male. Eventually, on hearing him rebuke her fears and assert his own, egalitarian views on swordsmanship, she accepted him as both friend and rival.

entities.name: Shin Detamaruka
entities.description:
Shin Detamaruka is a citizen of Dressrosa and a former dancer. She is the grandmother of Shin Jaiya.

Detamaruka is an old woman with white hair and a large number of wrinkles. She wears a pink and purple polka dotted dress.

Detamaruka cares about her granddaughter, wanting to ensure she was safe from the Birdcage despite her impending death.

Due to being advanced in age, Detamaruka is frail, and after a long time running from the Birdcage she collapsed without being able to get back up. However, after being spurred on by former King Riku, she gained the willpower to run fast again.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Shin Detamaruka is a citizen of Dressrosa and a former dancer. She is the grandmother of Shin Jaiya.

entities.name: Shin Jaiya
entities.description:
Shin Jaiya is a citizen of Dressrosa. She is the granddaughter of Shin Detamaruka.

Jaiya is a little girl with a long blonde hair in two pigtails, and brown eyes. She wears a blue long-sleeved dress with white collar.

Jaiya was distraught when her grandmother was unable to get up and was left to be killed by the Birdcage, and cried with tears of joy when she got back up.

Jaiya and her grandmother ran from the Birdcage as Donquixote Doflamingo began closing it. Suddenly, Detamaruka fell and was unable to get back up. She told Jaiya to leave her and keep going, but Jaiya refused. They then listened to their former king, Riku Doldo III, encouraging everyone to keep staying alive and that there was hope, which caused Detamaruka to get back up. As she watched her grandmother ran at a very fast pace, Jaiya cried tears of joy.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Shin Jaiya is a citizen of Dressrosa. She is the granddaughter of Shin Detamaruka.

entities.name: Shinobu
entities.description:
Shinobu is a kunoichi from Wano Country and a retainer of the Kouzuki Family, having once served in the Oniwabanshu of the Kouzuki Shogunate and trained under Kin'emon as his protégée. She is also the younger sister of Shinosuke.

She is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Wano Country Arc.

Despite her stout silhouette, Shinobu is quite tall, standing at 180 cm. However, when standing next to other people, she appears considerably shorter than that. As a middle-aged woman, she is considered rather ugly with her broad eyebrows, fat nose, and overall chubby face. She has brown hair tied in pigtails and wears over-the-top makeup, as well as a pink-colored kunoichi attire.

She was very beautiful when she was younger, able to capture the hearts of many of her foes according to Hanzo. 20 years ago, she wore a hot-pink, short dress with slits at the sides with a plunging neckline, revealing her cleavage. Her pigtails were much more longer and she wore a light-yellow scarf.

entities.name: Shion
entities.description:
Shion is a member of the Kuja. She is never seen but her name appears on the match-ups of the arena battle board.

Little is known about Shion's abilities, but, since her odds of winning were 1:5, it can be presumed that she is stronger than her opponent, Kiku.

Shion's name was seen on the list of match-ups in the arena battles. She was paired against Kiku.

entities.name: Shyarly
entities.description:
Madam Shyarly is a mermaid living on Fish-Man Island. She is the proprietor of the Mermaid Cafe and Arlong's younger half-sister. She used to be a fortune teller until she decided to discard her crystal ball.

Madam Shyarly is a large mermaid with purple nail polish, red lipstick, and blue eyes with slanted pupils that resemble shark eyes. When angry, her eyes take on an ominous appearance, and she shows sharp teeth. She has short black hair that covers over the right side of her face. Her tail is dark blue with a dorsal fin on her lower back where her human and fish halves meet, a white patch below the dorsal fin, smaller fins on the lower front and back, and a lunate caudal fin. Uniquely, the dorsal of her fish attribute is the front of her tail, with the usual ventral attribute facing the back.

She wears a hooded purple blouse that is only buttoned in the middle, revealing her cleavage and stomach, and has a belly-chain around her waist. She is often seen smoking a pipe.

As a child, she wore a light-colored hooded dress with a stripe down the side. However, the anime showed that her dress is the same color as her current outfit.
