Moqueca is a short, rotund middle-aged man with a thin mustache. He wears a frilly shirt, a bead necklace, robes and a colorful, feathered hat resembling a palm tree.

Moqueca is a cheerful, jovial man who enjoys samba.

Moqueca is the king of a nation affiliated with the World Government and one of the few allowed to attend the Levely, which grants him some authority over matters concerning the world.

Nothing is known about the country's geography because it has yet to make an appearance.

The only known citizen of the Taya Kingdom was Aramaki, prior to his recruitment to the Marines.

At some point in the past, Aramaki served as a police officer in the Taya Kingdom, before he was arrested himself after an incident involving a woman. He was later freed from imprisonment by the World Government to be drafted into the Marines due to his reputation for being incredibly strong.

entities.name: Acacia
entities.description:
This town was once full of living toys before the liberation of Dressrosa took place. Like the rest of the island, the crime rate is very high because the women there are extremely beautiful, but also extremely temperamental. Because their passions run high, they often stab men that betray them to death.

There are also restaurants which serve delicious food and have roulette tables.

It is unknown what happened to Acacia after Doflamingo razed nearly the entire kingdom of Dressrosa with his Birdcage.

A Proko was set up to project Vegapunk's worldwide broadcast onto a screen in Acacia.

entities.name: Alubarna
entities.description:
Alubarna is the capital city of Arabasta.

Alubarna is in the northeast part of Arabasta, built on a plateau near an oasis. It is located north of Nanohana and west of Tamarisk. Like several other cities in Arabasta, most of Alubarna's structures follow the conventions of Islamic architecture, such as domed buildings and towers.

Access to the city is done through five long flights of stairs located to the west, southwest, south, southeast and east. The southern gate is considered the main entrance, being the one Koza and his rebel army used to break into the city. The southeastern gate also features a group of ruins nearby, where Usopp and Chopper faced Mr. 4 and Miss Merry Christmas.

During the Arabasta civil war, Princess Nefertari Vivi nearly detonated the palace in a last-ditch attempt to divert the combatants. Her efforts were easily thwarted by the war's orchestrator Crocodile, who almost threw her to her death from the battlements. Shortly after, Crocodile and Luffy held their second battle on the rooftop garden, and the former eventually obliterated it with his Devil Fruit abilities.

entities.name: Bighorn
entities.description:
Bighorn is a town in Drum Island. It is located near the river the Straw Hat Pirates docked in and also neighbors Cocoa Weed. Because it is so close to the Drum Rockies, it is susceptible to avalanches.

Notable inhabitants include Dalton and Negikuma Maria. Domesticated goats and white walkies help out the population with general transportation.

Most of the houses in Bighorn are cylindrical and feature roofs with an unique conical shape. The buildings are distinct enough that Nefertari Vivi was able to recognize the town after getting lost in Drum with Usopp and Roronoa Zoro.

Dalton allowed the Straw Hat Pirates to bring the sick Nami here after their arrival on Drum Island.

entities.name: Coral Hill
entities.description:
The is a restaurant owned by Madam Shyarly in Coral Hill. Camie and several other mermaids work here. The cafe's employees all live in the same dormitory in Mermaid Cove and are young, attractive girls who bring men to the establishment for their charm and beauty like a . It first appeared in Chapter 610 and Episode 529.

Many of the employees also perform dances, and are known as the . Among the dancers are those who are considered the "top five": Ishilly, Kairen, Hiramera, Seira, and Mero.

The cafe's menu includes cake, sea fruits, wakame seaweed brulee, mozuku seaweed tarts, konbu kelp souffle, shellfish meat, scallop sandwiches, and shijimi clam pizza. Aside from shellfish, there are no meat or fish dishes, as merfolk do not consume them.

The cafe is apparently very popular, as one of Gyro's crew members' dream was to visit it, and was incredibly disappointed to be deprived of it, despite the danger they were in. It was due to Hody Jones' actions that the cafe had so few customers for a while, and once he and his crew were defeated by the Straw Hat Pirates, Shyarly believed that the customers should be returning soon.

entities.name: Erumalu
entities.description:
Erumalu was a town located in the Arabasta Kingdom. Once called the , this town was ravaged by the encroaching sea and the extended drought, the latter caused by Crocodile's use of Dance Powder. The inhabitants have long since fled and the buildings are falling apart.

Erumalu was located to the western edge of the Sandora River, southeast of Yuba and east of the Spiders Cafe. Suiren, another ruined town, was located somewhere close to it.

Erumalu is currently nothing more than half-buried crumbled buildings and dead trees, with some skulls laying around the sand. There was once a canal that distributed rainwater around the city, but the constant drought created by Mr. 0 and the Dance Powder eventually caused the water reserves to dry up. According to Vivi, Erumalu used to be much richer in plant life.

It was home to the , according to Miss All Sunday.

entities.description:
Foolshout Island is an island in Paradise where Koala's hometown is located.

The Sun Pirates arrived here to bring back Koala to her mother. They did it successfully but Fisher Tiger met his end in a Marine ambush led by Rear Admiral Strawberry.

Later, Arlong would come back to the island to seek revenge, only to be defeated and captured by Vice Admiral Borsalino.

entities.description:
Gyoverly Hills is one of the wealthier towns on Fish-Man Island.

Pappag lives in a mansion in Gyoverly Hills due to his wealth and fame from designing the Criminal clothing line. On the exterior, it looks like a giant seashell. It has a Criminal clothing store on the first floor. The prices of these clothes are apparently very high. According to a store clerk, 10,000 is below half of the original price. Camie usually travels there to bring Pappag orient clams.

entities.name: Mock Town
entities.description:
Mock Town, known as the , is a port town on the western coast of Jaya. It is inhabited mostly by pirates, despite it looking like a resort.

Pirates who dwell here tend to judge their level of skill and power based on their assigned bounties, meaning those carrying bounties above average (10,000,000-20,000,000 or a 55,000,000 bounty, in the case of Bellamy) are often respected more by the citizens. The town itself is built on the money that the pirates spend inside it freely. For that reason alone, though fighting does occur in the town, the pirates rarely attack the people living there. As stated by the bartender at the pub during Nami, Zoro, and Luffy's visit, a normal person would say they hate the town, but there are not many normal people here.

Pub and Pies is a bar where Luffy first met Blackbeard and later Bellamy. There was an incident where Bellamy tried to test Luffy to see if he was fit to join the New Pirate Age by offering Luffy a drink. But when Luffy was thanking him, Bellamy sees that he is not fit for the New Age so he grabbed Luffy's head and slammed it onto the table, breaking the table in half in the process. This bar serves as the Bellamy Pirates' hangout. The bartender of this bar is Terry.

This is a hotel located in Mock Town. Bellamy and his crew reside there. The owner of this hotel is Spector, and he refused all other customers due to being intimidated by Bellamy.

entities.name: Nanohana
entities.description:
Nanohana is a town in the Arabasta Kingdom. It is a port town known for its great shops and irresistible perfume. Notable residents include Kappa and Yoshimoto.

It was the Straw Hat Pirates' first stop during the Arabasta Arc, where they managed to re-supply and buy clothing for traversal of the Sandora Desert. It is also the place where Monkey D. Luffy reunited with his older brother, Portgas D. Ace, for the first time after leaving Foosha Village.

Nanohana is located south of Alubarna, east to the Sandora River and west of Katorea.

Nanohana resembles a typical middle-eastern desert town, following the conventions of Islamic architecture. It features a crowded and thriving bazaar. As expected of a port town, it has docks where ships can load up or unload cargo.

entities.description:
Pucci is one of the island cities in Paradise connected to Water 7 by the Sea Train. It is known as the .

Fourteen years ago, Pucci was connected to Water 7 to help with trade, as an attempted countermeasure against repeated pirate attacks on merchant ships damaging Water 7's economy.

Bimine, Pucci's mayor, and Iceburg, Water 7's mayor, scheduled a meeting, which Iceburg cancelled.

Two years later, Bimine ordered two ships and cola from Zambai's Company Union of the Galley-La Company while Marumieta peered at the catalog through her binoculars with Yamenahare over her.

entities.name: Rainbase
entities.description:
Rainbase is one of the few cities within the country that continued thriving even during the drought orchestrated by Crocodile, mostly due to its gambling industry. Because of this, it has been referred to as the "City of Dreams".

Rainbase is located to the northwest of Arabasta, with Yuba to the south and Alubarna and the Sandora River to the east. It takes one day to reach Rainbase from Yuba on feet.

Rainbase is a luxurious, booming city with many casinos and restaurants. Some of those include the Golden Slots, the Loose Slots, the Royale, the Fantasia and the Coin Banditts, among several others. There are also stables where steeds like horses and camels can rest.

The Rainbase Lake is a very large oasis, outright resembling a lake, located in the middle of Rainbase. It is where the Rain Dinners building, the city's biggest casino, is situated.

entities.name: Robelle
entities.description:
Robelle is a town located in Drum Island.

This is where Portgas D. Ace asked some of the villagers to tell Luffy that he was going to wait for him at Arabasta only for ten days.

Compared to the rest of Drum, Robelle is a rather flat town with condensed wooden buildings. It has a bridge that leads into it.

The town has at least one restaurant, where Ace ate without paying.

entities.name: St. Poplar
entities.description:
St. Poplar is an island town in Paradise connected to Water 7 and Enies Lobby via the Sea Train. It is notable for being one hour by Puffing Tom from Water 7. Its nickname is the .

Fourteen years ago, St. Poplar became connected to Water 7 with the completion of the Sea Train at a time when the economy in Water 7 was weak due to attacks on merchant ships. Once connected, it supplied wood to Water 7. Years later, Franky sent the Square Sisters here to buy Adam Wood on the black market.

After the fall of Enies Lobby, CP9 was forced to come to this town and raise money to pay for the medical treatment required by Rob Lucci due to the damage he had taken in his fight against Luffy. Sometime after Lucci recovered, they defended the town from the Candy Pirates. They were forced to leave though, after Lucci's excessive brutality towards the pirate captain horrified the citizens.

entities.name: Tamarisk
entities.description:
Tamarisk is a port town located in the Arabasta Kingdom. This is where Nefertari Vivi reaffirmed her bond with the Straw Hat Pirates as they left the country.

Tamarisk is a coastal port town set in hills. Like the rest of Arabasta, Tamarisk has an arid desert climate, but it has some grass and dead trees in it. The buildings are all rectangular with small windows, and many have tall towers attached to them.

It is located to the very east of Alubarna.

Smoker and Hina docked in Tamarisk to reunite with Tashigi and arrest Crocodile.

entities.name: Whisky Peak
entities.description:
Whisky Peak is the only city located on Cactus Island.

This city is inhabited entirely by bounty hunters working for Baroque Works, who capture any bounty heads that land here to help fund the missions of their organization. As such, the city does not have much supplies, as noted by Miss Monday. The citizens here fool pirates into thinking that they are kind and hospitable and proceed to throw a party for them, only to turn them in and steal everything from their ship when the pirates pass out. Whisky Peak is apparently famous for its liquor, but whether that is the truth or an excuse to have many barrels of alcoholic beverages to better subdue pirates without suspicion is unknown. Roronoa Zoro defeated 100 bounty hunters here, including Mr. 9, Miss Monday, Igaram, and Miss Wednesday.

After the timeskip, Mr. 9 and Miss Monday are revealed to be living there and raising a family.

The town itself looks like a northwestern town with pueblo houses.

entities.name: Yuba
entities.description:
Yuba is a small oasis town in Arabasta where Toto lives.

Originally built with the purpose of acting as an intersection for the towns and villages of western Arabasta, Yuba was endlessly struck with sandstorms summoned by the leader of Baroque Works, Mr. 0, a.k.a Crocodile, as part of his plan to agitate the country's rebellion forces.

It once served as the headquarters of the Arabastan rebel army until they moved to Katorea. Unaware of that, Nefertari Vivi and the Straw Hat Pirates came to this town thinking they could meet with the rebels and stop the civil war.

Yuba is a recent town, no older than 8–10 years old. Its location, at the very middle of the western portion of the Sandora Desert, was strategically decided in order to provide Arabasta with a hub that could act as a rest stop for merchants traveling through the desert. Rainbase is located to its north, the Spiders Cafe to its southwest and Erumalu to its southeast.

Its villages and other landmarks have been built atop the tree's branches, resulting in the villages being difficult to travel between and thus quite isolated until the last century. Under the leadership of Harald, new branches were constructed that physically connected the villages, and the invention of the Svarr now allows for travel through the air. Notably, a gigantic longsword appears to pierce the Sun World, reaching all the way down to the Underworld.

The Sun World is high enough above the Underworld on the mainland below that an unobstructed fall will kill a normal giant. There exists an elevator, built from a set of boats tied to thick chains, that enables the easiest access from the Underworld to Sun World. There is also a rope bridge spanning between the Sun World and a castle atop one of the Underworld's highest mountain peaks. Those who sail in and out of Elbaph can directly access the Sun World by using a Painter stone to generate a rainbow to sail on.

The Sun World is dotted with forests of smaller trees and plant life growing from the Adam Tree. Hajrudin has implied that the region's animal life is nowhere near as big or threatening as those found in the Underworld. Since its settlements are built on a tree whose wood is flammable, the Sun World is at increased risk for destructive fires; an unlucky lightning strike may spell doom for entire villages. To mitigate these risks, the kingdom maintains a group of firefighters who operate out of a Svarr.

entities.name: Cocoa Weed
entities.description:
Cocoa Weed is a village located on Drum Island. It neighbors the village of Bighorn and is south of Gyasta.

The only known named resident of Cocoa Weed is Tamachibi.

Cocoa Weed resembles a standard snow town with condensed wooden buildings. It appears to be quite active since the streets are always filled with people.

Cocoa Weed was first mentioned by Negikuma Maria, who told Dalton about Kureha's presence there after Luffy and Sanji left Bighorn with Nami towards Drum Castle (where they thought Kureha was), leading Usopp and Nefertari Vivi to accompany Dalton to Cocoa Weed.

entities.name: Foosha Village
entities.description:
Foosha Village (literally meaning "Windmill Village") is a little port village that is located on Dawn Island and is part of Goa Kingdom. It is the first setting of the Romance Dawn Arc, and is where the story of One Piece starts from.

Foosha Village resembles a typical rural community, with rustic wooden houses, docks and a few windmills. It is located to the east of the Goa Kingdom capital.

A prominent feature of this sleepy village is Mt. Colubo in the background. Several notable mountain bandits live in or around the mountain near the village, causing the occasional chaos to the villagers or assisting them as needed. The town appears to be rather unknown, thus the townsfolk are thrilled and proud that their town might be known for producing an infamous pirate. They are led by mayor Woop Slap who usually is against most ideas presented by the other townsfolk on pirates.

The town also has a local Sea King called Lord of the Coast. However, it is not as big as some of the sea monsters in the rest of the world and there is no indications it is as big of a problem as others of his kind may create. This monster is the reason why Shanks lost his left arm by saving Luffy.

entities.name: Headband Catfish Village
entities.description:
Headband Catfish Village is a small village located beneath the seas of Paradise where many catfish reside.

Headband Catfish Village is located on the Sea Floor, and it is composed of small, shorts dwellings with small round windows. One of the damaged buildings was a medicial facility.

The village's citizens are all catfish who wear carpenters coats and rope headbands. They are also skilled carpenters, building Hatchan's Takoyaki 8 overnight.

Headband Catfish Village was the home of the catfish until it was destroyed by a sunken ship. Octopako laughed at them when she saw their village in ruin. Hatchan, Camie, and Pappag came across the starving villagers as they were struggling to rebuild. Hatchan ran away from his friends and the village, taking all the treasure he found with him. However, he used it to purchase cooking equipment. He and his friends saved the catfish villagers from starvation by making them takoyaki. They returned to the surface, and an old catfish came to Hatchan for takoyaki right before he gave his last batch to Octopako. Hatchan gave it to the old catfish instead of Octopako, and she punched him for it. The catfish villagers decided to reward him by making him a ship that he could use to sell takoyaki.

entities.name: Namonaki Village
entities.description:
Namonaki Village is a small village located on Dawn Island. It appears in Set Sail Pirate Crew!, where it acts as one of the locations visited by the Set Sail Pirates.

Namonaki Village resembles a typical rural community, with small, spread out houses and community centers such as bars and shops. It is built in a large prairie, with a single footpath connecting the buildings and leading into an inland forest.

It is located southeast of Pinwhale Village.

Namonaki Village has a reputation for wild, rough-and-tumble residents, mainly comprised of roaming pirates.

entities.name: Ocean's Navel
entities.description:
Ocean's Navel is the non-canon location of "Adventure in the Ocean's Navel", the first special of One Piece.

It is a huge pit that water flows into, yet the bottom is dry. There is a village where the citizens live by the coast and there is also a ship graveyard full of destroyed ships. Where the village ends there is a huge mountain where the treasure of the Ocean's Navel is.

The villagers lived peacefully until Joke and his crew came and destroyed everything twelve years before the current storyline. After that, the crew went to the mountain of God, where they hoped to find the treasure that would make their wishes come true. But when they reached the treasure room, the crew members betrayed their captain and awakened the treasure's guards, three huge monsters that kept terrifying the islanders for ten years.

When the Luffy's crew reached the island while searching for the treasure, they killed the monsters, which made Captain Joke's body revive. Hamu killed the pirate with the help of his friends and the monsters started guarding the treasure once again.

entities.name: Pinwhale Village
entities.description:
Pinwhale Village is a small village located on Dawn Island. It appears in Set Sail Pirate Crew!, where it acts as one of the locations visited by the Set Sail Pirates.

Pinwhale Village resembles a typical rural community, with small, spread out houses and community centers such as bars and shops. It is built in a large prairie, with a single footpath connecting the buildings and leading into an inland forest.

Just off Pinwhale Village's coast is a small island with a mountain and sea cave, where the Lord of the Coast temporarily took up residence.

It is located north of Foosha Village and northwest of Namonaki Village.

entities.name: 80th Branch
entities.description:
The 80th Branch Base is a Marine base and the seat of the 80th Marine Branch in the West Blue.

It was this base which was called for help two weeks after the Summit War of Marineford by an unknown island of the West Blue. The 80th Branch sent Marine soldiers there to protect it from pirates who had decided to head for the Grand Line after they had learned about the death of the Emperor Whitebeard.

entities.description:
The Ballywood Kingdom is a nation in the West Blue ruled by King Ham Burger.

Nothing is known about the country's geography because it has yet to make an appearance.

The history of the Ballywood Kingdom remains unknown, since it has not yet been depicted in the story.

entities.name: Ilisia Kingdom
entities.description:
The Ilisia Kingdom is a country in the West Blue. It is affiliated with the World Government, and its ruler is allowed a seat at the Levely.

Non-canonically, a has been mentioned as having lived over 100 years ago. While not elaborated upon, she appears to have been a royal of the Ilisia Kingdom.

At some point in the past, Princess Ilusia lived in the Ilisia Kingdom. During her time, she possessed a rare ring, which became famous as the .

About 100 years ago, the ring of Princess Ilusia was stolen by pirates, and was considered missing. It eventually made its way into Flip's hands, though it was later reclaimed by Rapanui Pasqua on the World Government's behalf.

entities.name: Kano Country
entities.description:
The Kano Country is a nation in the West Blue where the Chinjao Family came from.

The country resembles an ancient Chinese city with buildings characterized by Chinese style architecture. It also has several tall rock spires around the city.

The Kano Country was involved in war with another country, but was having trouble because their enemy was being supplied with weapons by the Donquixote Pirates. King Ramen entrusted the Happo Navy with the mission of putting an end to the supply of weapons going to the enemy.

After the Donquixote Pirates were brought down, the war involving the Kano Country ended. Bothered by the fact that Chinjao and the recently appointed Don Sai would be unable to attend, its ruler prepared to attend the Levely.

entities.name: Guanhao
entities.description:
Guanhao is an island in Paradise where the World Government organized a training camp for future Cipher Pol agents.

The island is covered by a forest. The only known building on the island is a high tower with trees on a roof.

The World Government uses Guanhao as a training camp for future Cipher Pol generations. Rob Lucci and other CP9 members had trained on the island until they became strong enough to become full-fledged agents.

Lucci and other CP9 members returned to Guanhao after recovering in St. Poplar. Very Good pursued them but he was easily defeated.

entities.name: Pangaea Castle
entities.description:
Pangaea Castle is a massive castle located in the Holy Land Mary Geoise. It serves as the base of operations for the World Government, where officials like the Five Elders, former Knights of God Supreme Commander-turned Elder Garling, and Commander-in-Chief Kong work, as well as where the rulers of World Government nations convene for the Levely every four years.

Pangaea Castle is highly secure, with its gate being surrounded by a wall which has three other heavily guarded gates. One of these gates is the Celestial Dragon Gate, which is located right next to the Domain of the Gods where the Celestial Dragons live. The other two lead to a path to the bondolas to descend the Red Line. Two moats are between the gates and the castle, with a stretch of land between the outer and inner moat, and there are bridges over them on the paths from the gates.

Beyond the inner moat is the castle, which is built in a style. The outer part of the castle stretches along the outer edges created by the moat, and on the roof is a massive outdoor space. The front of this space is a large outdoor plaza, while the inner castle is located in the back. The inner castle is a fully roofed building, but otherwise is built similarly to the outer castle. Both parts of the castle have towers at various intervals on their walls; the inner castle has slightly higher towers, including one on its roof, which gives the castle the appearance of being a single, massive building to those looking at it from the outside.

The is a throne that supposedly sits at the center of the world. It is kept on top of a three-level platform and has several swords and axes planted in the floor of the first and third levels. The 20 weapons right in front of the throne symbolize the creators of the World Government, and the throne represents a declaration of peace that no one person will ever take full control of the world. When they come to Levely, all royals must pledge to not take the throne.

entities.name: Ape's Concert
entities.description:
The Rainbow Mist is a mysterious fog that appears on the sea without warning. Long associated with vanishing ships and other legends, it is in fact a gateway to another dimension. disconnected from normal space and time.

While it is impossible to know when and where the Rainbow Mist will appear, it has appeared twice near Ruluka Island while no appearances in other places were reported.

Any ship who enters the Rainbow Mist is automatically transported to a strange dimension known as , in which all ships and their crews and passengers are trapped. It is also known as a ship's graveyard because it is filled with wrecked ships, although it is said that there are many treasures in their cargo.

It seems this place is a space loop, which means it takes anyone and anything back to the point in from which they started - when Robin fired a cannonball from the front of the Going Merry, it landed close behind the ship. Time does not seem to pass by as normal here; by the time the Pumpkin Pirates entered the mist, none of the previous prisoners were there. The reason for their deaths is not clear, but it is possible that they were eaten by the Ruluka Sea King, a beast that was also trapped in Ape's Concert.

entities.name: Delta Island
entities.description:
Delta Island is a New World island that appears in the film One Piece: Stampede. It served as the location of the Pirates Festival.

The island is split into three roughly even parts by three large rivers, with a round lake in the center. The land seems to slope upwards to the center lake, with sheer cliffs around it. There are also a few large spikes overlooking the central lake. It is covered in greenery.

The majority of the coastal and riverbanks had been converted into a harbor, with various shops and other buildings being built along side it. There are also a few towns scattered throughout the inland as well as along the coasts. Audience stands were built along the cliffs of the central lake for viewing the events. Underground is a tunnel complex, which Buena Festa used for planning and secret dealings.

After Douglas Bullet used his ability on the island and started rampaging, most of the land was turned to rubble. He also lifted the edges of the island to trap everyone on it, but this collapsed with his defeat.

entities.short_description: Delta Island is a New World island that appears in the film One Piece: Stampede. It served as the location of the Pirates Festival.

entities.name: Firs Island
entities.description:
Firs Island was one of the Endpoints and a Marine base in the New World.

Firs Island has a large volcano on the island, and underneath it houses a heavily armed Marine base, containing a large bridge linking to the inside. Inside the heavy duty security chamber is where the Marines stored the Dyna Stones.

As one of the three Endpoints, Firs Island acts as a seal to the vast quantities of subterranean magma underneath the New World. Should sufficient damage be inflicted onto this Endpoint, it will cause the volcano to erupt in a very devastating burst.

Following Shuzo's defeat at the hands of Luffy and his imprisonment in Impel Down, the Neo Marines arrived at Firs Island.

entities.short_description: Firs Island was one of the Endpoints and a Marine base in the New World.

entities.name: Galzburg
entities.description:
Galzburg was a militarized country in the Grand Line where Douglas Bullet grew up.

Nothing is known about the country's geography because it has yet to make an appearance.

At some point in the past, Galzburg got involved in a large-scale war with another country.

45 years ago, Douglas Gray found a baby Bullet, adopting him and eventually enrolling him as a child soldier in Galzforce, Galzburg's army.

entities.short_description: Galzburg was a militarized country in the Grand Line where Douglas Bullet grew up.

entities.name: Lovely Land
entities.description:
Lovely Land is the headquarters of the Accino Family located deep within Hyokaido.

It is a golden castle with -inspired architecture and a tropical atmosphere completely different from the rest of Hyokaido, due to the presence of Don Accino's powers to create the climate necessary for Lovely Land’s jungle environment. The Accino Family brings their captives here and keeps them imprisoned within glacial caverns to freeze, possibly to death. When the Accino Family later presents the captured pirates to the Marines, the pirates are apparently smiling despite being detained, implying that captivity with the Marines is preferable than at Lovely Land.

Zoro was the first Straw Hat to reach it. In the final battle between Luffy and Don Accino, Lovely Land was destroyed and reduced to rubble and the Accino Family left Lovely Land and sailed on.

entities.name: Rainbow Tower
entities.description:
The Rainbow Tower is a device made possible by Henzo thanks to the taxes gained by Wetton. It took 50 years to build. It is an enormous tunnel device with the sole purpose to link Ruluka with the Rainbow Mist. With it, Wetton hopes to take all the treasures in Ape's Concert. When Luffy arrives to stop him, he decides to destroy Rainbow Tower by making it explode, leaving his family, the Straw Hat Pirates, and the Pumpkin Pirates in the Rainbow Mist.

entities.name: Secon Island
entities.description:
Secon Island was a island of the New World and one of the Endpoints.

Secon Island is an island connected to Dock Island thanks to some Sea Train rails. Its main location is Kazanonsen, a large volcano that also appears to be a tourist attraction. There is a huge town beneath the mountain, dedicated to various hot springs.

As one of the three Endpoints, Secon Island acts as a seal to the vast quantities of subterranean magma underneath the New World. Should sufficient damage be inflicted onto this Endpoint, it will cause the volcano to erupt in a very devastating burst.

Some time after the Straw Hat Pirates' first fight against Z, they learned that the Neo Marines were on Secon Island, and decided to go there via Sea Train (except for Franky, who stayed behind to guard and repair the Thousand Sunny) to get Ain to return Nami, Robin, Chopper and Brook to their normal ages. However, they failed to defeat them, and the island was eventually destroyed after the Dyna Stones Z planted near the island's volcano exploded.

entities.name: Silver Mine
entities.description:
Silver Mine was a deserted island in the New World located near Dressrosa. It was formerly occupied by the Silver Pirate Alliance led by Bill. However, it then sunk into the ocean after Bill created a large downpour of molten ore that destroyed most of the island.

It is the main setting of the Silver Mine Arc.

Silver Mine is a rocky island with its most recognizable feature being a silver fort located in the center of it. Within it Bill built his throne room where he meets with his subordinates, and sends the less able ones to work in the mines at the lower levels.

At some point in the past, Bill came to this island and began mining out silver in order to pay off his debt to Gild Tesoro. He and his collaborators, Peseta and Aveyron, also built a false organization known as the Silver Pirate Alliance with promises of conquering the New World in order to capture criminals with bounties to also pay off his debt. Any members who did not satisfy Bill were forced to work in the mines while prevented from escaping by Averyon. Desire and the other surviving members of Sweet Pirates became members of this organization after being attacked and then tricked by Bill.

entities.name: Trap Tower
entities.description:
Trap Tower is a Marine tower run and operated by Captain Trap. It was destroyed by the Straw Hat Pirates and, accidentally, by the Giant Nine.

Trap Tower is a tall structure with numerous floors and features. A Kung-Fu Dugong statue sits at the top of the tower, and its arm can move and mouth can open when a lever is pulled. Inside the tower, winding tubes with water flowing through them guide captors to various traps. On the outside of the tower, an intricate blue slide can carry ships away at fast speeds. After all of the tubes, traps, and floors, a Seastone prison rests at the bottom of the prison to hold captors.

Because the Straw Hat Pirates escaped partway down the tower's ride, the layout of the lower floors and traps in the tower is unknown.

The tower contains different traps meant to hurt or kill its captors. The first trap, Cutting Hell, is a spinning fan of blades created to chop up ships. The second, Hammer Hell, is an animatronic gorilla with large fists that smash together repeatedly to crush captors. No other traps are named, but they include golden harpoon launchers, a room full of dugong-operated cannons, and a dark pit full of obstructive, jagged pillars.

entities.short_description: Trap Tower is a Marine tower run and operated by Captain Trap. It was destroyed by the Straw Hat Pirates and, accidentally, by the Giant Nine.

entities.name: Trump Castle
entities.description:
Trump Castle is a tower located in Clockwork Island. It is where the Trump Siblings and their forces used to live, before the tower's destruction during the events of the second One Piece movie.

thumb|left|210px|The Diamond Clock. The castle is set on a mountaintop, and is filled with numerous traps, such as a falling ceiling and sliding stairs, and the castle is also the location of the "key". At the top is a pool used to hold captured ships, and on the castle is the , the world's most valuable clock.

At some point prior to the current storyline, Bear King and his crew invaded the Clockwork Island and had the villagers build Trump Castle. The crew made the Trump Castle their temporary home, until the King Cannon was created, in order to rule the seas using it.

After Honey Queen and Boo Jack captured Nami, they brought her to the Trump Castle in order to meet Bear King. After meeting her, Bear King ordered his crew to bring the rest of the Straw Hat Pirates there as well. When they were brought to the castle due to Bear King's desire to marry Nami, the other members were crucified on the top in an attempt to coerce Nami. Eventually, Monkey D. Luffy came to rescue his crew, and in the ensuing battle, Luffy destroyed a big part of the tower. When Bear King fired a bullet of the King Cannon at Luffy, he deflected it back at Bear King, causing the glass floor to shatter and the "key" to be destroyed, which resulted in the entire castle collapsing.

entities.short_description: Trump Castle is a tower located in Clockwork Island. It is where the Trump Siblings and their forces used to live, before the tower's destruction during the events of the second One Piece movie.

entities.name: Yukari
entities.description:
Yukari was an ancient civilization that existed some time in the past few centuries. It was a small, independent city-state, surrounded by larger nations that it was constantly fighting off. It was eventually absorbed by one of its neighbors, and due to the active warzone surrounding its former location, much of the information about it has been lost.

Not much is known about Yukari's geography, but it was surrounded by enemy nations. The country contained a palace built out of stone, though it was destroyed; the kitchen, specifically, was destroyed in a fire. The ground was made of limestone, and as such trees did not naturally grow.

While Yukari functioned largely independently, it did trade with World Government-affiliated countries.

Yukari had its own language and writing system, which was written using a alphabet. The language was discovered to be similar to another language from the same time period called , allowing it to be translated by Nico Robin and Koala. The oral language, meanwhile, is very similar to the language used by the World Government, allowing it to be translated by ear.

entities.name: 8th Branch
entities.description:
The Marine 8th Branch is a non-canon Marine unit active in East Blue, commanded by Nelson Royal.

The division consists of Nelson's flagship and a fleet of at least ten smaller battleships. They also hired Eric the Whirlwind to bolster their military forces, but was betrayed by the mercenary when he found them no use to his personal agenda any longer.

The unit possesses a small fleet of at least 10 ships along with the special flag ship. The main technique which this branch uses to capture pirates is the , which consists of surrounding an enemy with a fleet of battleships and then blocking all escape routes by connecting each battleship with several large chains.

entities.name: Banana Peninsula
entities.description:
Banana Peninsula is a peninsula in the Conomi Islands, located on the same island as Cocoyasi Village. It is where Jingoro lives.

It appears in Set Sail Pirate Crew!, where it acts as one of the locations visited by the Set Sail Pirates.

Banana Peninsula is a short outstretch of land extending from the rest of its island. The peninsula itself is fairly barren, with only small patches of trees. It encloses a large bay fulls of strong currents, debris, and seaweed, and is further enclosed by large rocks, making it difficult to enter and only accessible from one specific point.

The only notable landmarks on the peninsula are Jingoro's house, which also acts as a shipyard, and a whirlpool that can be used as a one-way exit out of the bay, locked behind a sluice gate controlled by Jingoro.

entities.name: Blacksmith Village
entities.description:
Blacksmith Village is a hidden village located in the East Blue. It was established by craftsmen and smiths fleeing from the Hailey Pirates in the ruins of an abandoned village.

Blacksmith Village is hidden deep in the mountains, designed so that it is difficult to find. It is made up of renovated ruins of an old, abandoned village, as well as abandoned fields used for farming.

The village is home to Hinoki and Satetsu, as well as a village elder and many other craftsmen.

The smiths of Blacksmith Village feel strongly about the sanctity of swords. They believe that, though the names of swordsmiths may end up lost to time, the blades they create continue to live on with their wielders, motivating them and their ancestors to continue making blades. This belief is strong enough that it motivated the village's residents to flee from the Hailey Pirates in the first place.

entities.name: Devil's Tower
entities.description:
Devil's Tower is Ganzack's tower which was created in Medaka's home town. It was later revealed to be a hidden cannon designed to destroy the rest of the island.

The tower has a big blue entrance and is surrounded by white walls and pillars with a red gem on top of each one. The tower itself is on top of a black and white structure of some sort. The tower is covered in gold and in the shape of a maned dragon with no arms breathing golden fire.

Herring and all the other male villagers were forced to work on constructing the Devil's Tower, without knowing what it was being made for. Later, during Luffy's battle with Ganzack, it was revealed that Devil's Tower was nothing else than a cannon made with the purpose of destroying the whole island except for Ganzack's pirate ship.

entities.description:
Nazawaka City is a medium-sized city located in the northern East Blue. It was home to the Mihawk Memorial Museum, before it was destroyed.

Nazawaka City is surrounded by city walls, with an iron grate blocking the main gate overnight.

One of the roads that leaves the city leads directly to Shimotsuki Village, only a two hour walk away.

The is a museum dedicated to Dracule Mihawk. It is Nazawaka City's number one tourist spot, with a popular souvenir shop selling various Mihawk memorabilia including pendants, keychains, mugs, and wooden swords with Mihawk's logo.

entities.name: 2000 Year Island
entities.description:
2000 Year Island is a non-canon island rumored to have a hidden treasure of gold pieces, though it's actually just Gaimon's gold tooth.

2000 Year Island is a small, hill-shaped island with a single palm tree in the middle.

Gaimon is, non-canonically, the only resident of the island.

Luffy and Nami travel to 2000 Year Island, hoping to find the 2000 Gold. They successfully find the rumored chest but, instead of gold pieces, discover that it's just Gaimon. He informs them that he has a fake gold tooth, angering Nami and causing Luffy to laugh.

entities.name: Eight Nine Island
entities.description:
Eight Nine Island is a island mentioned by Rice Rice. It is said that it grows Thousand-Year Trees, which is what Thousand-Year Paper is made of.

Not much is known about the island's geography other than that the Thousand-Year Trees grow there.

It is unknown if there are any inhabitants on the island.

Nothing is known about the island's history since it has yet to make an appearance.

entities.name: Gacha Gacha Island
entities.description:
Gacha Gacha Island is a non-canon island appearing in Chin Piece. It is ruled by its , Gachayama Gachao.

Gacha Gacha Island is a small island with a giant functioning capsule toy machine in the center. A small tent rests on the left side of the machine.

Chinpy and Kusopp landed on Gacha Gacha Island while searching for a Roronoa Zoro counterpart for their crew, where they met Gachayama Gachao. He explained his gacha machine, offering to let Chinpy spin it for 10,000, with a chance to win Zoro himself. Chinpy accepted, spinning the wheel and freeing various prizes. Eventually, the prizes began a battle royale, and Chinpy, Kusopp, and Mechayowa Yoro left the island.

entities.name: Gourmet Island
entities.description:
Gourmet Island is a non-canon island filled with food. It acts as the setting of The True Food! Devil Fruit!!.

Gourmet Island is a small but mountainous island, with many small peaks that get higher as they approach the center of the island. In the center, something resembling giant spaghetti rises into the air, with an equally giant fork floating at the top.

The island contains both forested and barren areas, as well as multiple small rivers and ponds.

Gourmet Island is also home to strange weather phenomena, specifically consisting of rain of various foods including meat, cotton candy, chocolate, and milk coffee.

entities.name: Hungry-La Island
entities.description:
Hungry-La Island is a non-canon island known for its abundant ingredients. A giant natural pudding à la mode, the island is the stuff of legends, for a long time thought to not actually exist.

It acts as the setting of the Toriko x One Piece Collab Special episode.

Hungry-La Island is covered in forests, itself formed out of ingredient plants. In the center of the island stands a tall, caramel volcano, home to the local Cocoalas.

The island is actually a giant natural pudding à la mode, produced when the caramel volcano erupts, which in turn causes the Multi-Fruits to settle above it and complete the dish.

entities.name: Judo Island
entities.description:
Judo Island is an island where the world's greatest masters live. They practice .

Little is known about the island's geography, but the island is home to a steep mountain with a seemingly flat top. The word is engraved in the side of the mountain.

Jerry spent two years training on the island, eventually reaching the peak of the island's masters and completing the table tennis fighting style.

entities.name: Soil Island
entities.description:
Soil Island is a non-canon island and the primary setting of One Piece Premier Show 2022.

Soil Island's geography is similar to the structure of 's stage. Notably, it is home to an active volcano.

There is at least one town on Soil Island.

Soil Island was attacked by the Dondoko Pirates, though they were defeated by the Straw Hat Pirates. With the Straw Hats on the island, the Age Age Super Marines followed them, damaging the island's town in their attempts to capture the pirates. Ultimately, the Super Marines were defeated by the Straw Hats and Yehudi was frozen by Kuzan, returning peace to the island.

entities.name: Tou-Chuka Island
entities.description:
Tou-Chuka Island is a non-canon island known for its Chinese food ingredients, including many healthy foods and natural cures.

It acts as the setting of the Toriko x One Piece Collab Special 2 episode.

Tou-Chuka Island is entirely covered in dense forest, with a single mountain covering the center of the island. The base of the mountain is surrounded by large stone walls, and an ancient floodgate encircles the top of the mountain, with a seawater reservoir and a smaller island inside. A giant rests on one of the island's beaches, and giant bamboo shoots protrude from the opposite side of the island.

A monument outside an abandoned temple has the inscription "on the island, where the sea overflows, the fruit grows", hinting at the location of the Seafood Fruit.

entities.name: Welbems Island
entities.description:
Welbems Island is a non-canon island in the North Blue where Hakugan lived prior to joining the Heart Pirates.

After being conquered by the Nagels Pirates, the North side of the island is ruled by Nagels' self-named kingdom.

Welbems Island is split into two halves, the North and South. After the Nagels Pirates attacked and conquered the North side, Nagels established a kingdom there, which he ruled with an iron fist; despite attempts to similarly conquer the South, he was unable to do so.

The island has a warm climate, with long springs and summers, and is known as one of the most comfortable places to live in the North Blue.

entities.name: Branchi
entities.description:
Branchi is a department store located somewhere in Japan. It was accidentally destroyed by a meteor sent by God.

Branchi is a large, window-covered building situated in a downtown area. It has an overhang roof above its entrance with its name, "BRANCHI", written above it, and a similar sign placed at the top of the building proper. A billboard hangs off the side of the building, with the text written on it.

When God decided that Bran needed to be punished for his pickpocketing, he decided to send a meteor to land on his house using the Pen of Fate. However, he accidentally misspelled as "Branchi", sending the meteor to the Branchi department store instead.

Wanting to stop the disaster, God instructed Bran to make sure the store was empty before the meteor hit. To this end, Bran tried to negotiate with the company president, but when he didn't believe him, he resorted to faking a bomb threat in the store. Brandishing a pistol and declaring his intent to blow up the building in 30 minutes, Bran forced everyone to evacuate the store.

entities.name: Door Hoverka Colosseum
entities.description:
The Door Hoverka Colosseum is a colosseum that hosts the competition. It is a parody of the Corrida Colosseum.

Hosted by Carta, the Carta Colisseum consists of a card based on quickly identifying custom-made cards. Carta lays a deck of giant cards with unique images in rows on the ground, before reading a sentence that hints to one of them. Each player must then rush to the specified card, with the first person to reach it getting a point.

However, each card actually has a full body with the speed of a Super Spot-Billed Duck, developed by Carta based on Karoo's speed. The players must chase down the cards and fight through their defensive abilities, which are based on what the card represents.

At the end of the game, the person with the most points wins the game.

entities.name: Great Tree
entities.description:
The Great Tree is an island-sized, flora-based organism created by a now-lost civilization over a millennia ago for the purpose of electing future leaders through ordeals. An entity of immense power, she has the ability to host people's thoughts and create presents whose natures are decided according to the character of her candidates. However, she failed to live up to her purpose and was so thrown away to wander the sea, eventually coming to rest in the latter half of Paradise.

In the present day, the Straw Hat Pirates came across the Great Tree and accidentally reactivated her. Promising the crew a present if they were to clear her ordeals, the Great Tree produced islands with different ordeals on them for the Straw Hat Pirates to clear and created Gaburi, a companion for the crew, to record their actions. When the Straw Hat Pirates became qualified for their present and came to claim it, the Great Tree prepared to turn Gaburi into it, only to get frighten by the evil in human nature and turn Gaburi into the Doom Guardian. Although the Straw Hats Pirates managed to escape with the original piece of Gaburi, they soon returned to the Great Tree and had Gaburi reclaim the Doom Guardian from her for his own survival while making the Great Tree come to an understanding with him about humanity.

The Great Tree serves as the main antagonist of One Piece Unlimited Cruise 1: The Treasure Beneath the Waves and One Piece Unlimited Cruise 2: Awakening of a Hero.

Before taking physical form, the Great Tree's appearance is that of a floating green energy orb at the size of Luffy.

entities.description:
Miraba Elementary School is an elementary school located somewhere in . It is the main setting of MiraBato Strongest Strategy: MiraBato GO!.

Miraba Elementary School is a large, white white with a gold trim. It has a large clock in its center, with the letters "MB" above it.

Little is otherwise known about the school's layout.

The students of Miraba Elementary School attend school every day, freely roaming the halls after classes end. Many of them are Miracle Battle Carddass players, using it to handle disputes amongst themselves.

entities.name: Mountain Zone
entities.description:
Snow-capped Mountains Frozen in Silver: The Mountain Zone is a wintery area of the unnamed island Popora inhabits. It is the fifth area the Straw Hat Pirates explore in One Piece: Unlimited Adventure.

The Mountain Zone is a frigid, snow-covered area named after its mountainous terrain. It has icy foliage and coniferous trees that are resistant to the cold. Most of the ground in the region is covered in either snow or ice, the latter of which is thick enough to support human weight. The uncovered areas are dark and grassless. There are multiple ponds that are somehow not frozen over, and the central mountains have a winding path that ascends up to its peak. On the mountains themselves, parts that are not covered in snow reveal dark grey rock underneath.

The Mountain Zone connects to the Plain Zone, Cave Zone, and Dimension Zone.

The is a One Piece-themed school club founded by Nakatsugawa Usopp. While it was initially an official club, it was disbanded by the student council due to Brook's dirty voice lines, with its status now unclear.

entities.name: Elegia Kingdom
entities.description:
Elegia, known as the , is the main setting of the movie One Piece Film: Red, in which it acts as the location of Uta's live music festival.

Non-canonically, it used to house the , governed by King Gordon. However, the entire population save for Gordon was massacred twelve years ago when Tot Musica was released from its seal.

Elegia seems to be composed of three land masses. The largest island has approximately two-thirds of it's land reconstructed into a concert hall. Behind the concert are what appears to be large green crystals, and behind that is what appears to be a rocky mountain. There also appears to be around five brown stone towers of varying heights on the island.

The smallest islet has a large brown stone tower which is connected to the other two islands by bridges.

entities.name: Gran Tesoro
entities.description:
Gran Tesoro is a massive ship with a metropolis built on it, described as the largest entertainment city in the world. It was formerly ruled by Gild Tesoro, but after he was deposed and most of the population evacuated, Carina took command over the ship.

It is acknowledged as an independent state by the World Government due to Tesoro's wealth, and they also classify it as a demilitarized zone. It is referred to as the "moving country of dreams". Nevertheless, the country is still required to pay a Heavenly Tribute to maintain affiliation with the World Government.

One way of reaching the ship is by Gild Tesoro's Vivre Card, which is considered as a personal invitation by Tesoro himself. The invitation is delivered in a closed envelope sealed by the Gran Tesoro emblem. One invite was given to Mad Treasure by Tanaka so that the treasure hunter could deliver the Pure Gold to him. The envelope was later taken by Nami and the Vivre Card was used to guide the Straw Hat Pirates to the casino.

A large portion of the Gran Tesoro is composed of gold, and its bow resembles a cruise ship, only much more massive in scale. The entire ship is ten kilometers long and a city is built inside it, with no roof covering it. The stern is a large circle with a tall golden tower in the center (designed to look like a wheel), and at the very back is a large green area (designed to look like a card table). The front of the ship allows others ships to enter inside the Gran Tesoro. Its name and two pirate flags can be seen when entering the ship. As a means of locomotion, the ship appears to be drawn by two gigantic sea turtles armed with cannons.

entities.name: Nagels Kingdom
entities.description:
Welbems Island is a non-canon island in the North Blue where Hakugan lived prior to joining the Heart Pirates.

After being conquered by the Nagels Pirates, the North side of the island is ruled by Nagels' self-named kingdom.

Welbems Island is split into two halves, the North and South. After the Nagels Pirates attacked and conquered the North side, Nagels established a kingdom there, which he ruled with an iron fist; despite attempts to similarly conquer the South, he was unable to do so.

The island has a warm climate, with long springs and summers, and is known as one of the most comfortable places to live in the North Blue.

entities.name: Royal Sun Island
entities.description:
Royal Sun Island is a World Government-affiliated island in Paradise. It appears in Legend of the Rainbow Island.

On the Log Pose, it is followed by Great Ground.

Royal Sun Island is a rocky sword-shaped island with little vegetation. In the center of the island is a large mountain with a cave part way up, and a large town sits at the base. Next to the town is a ring-shaped structure and a castle. On the opposite side of the mountain there is a smaller village.

West of Round Village is a forest in which many medicinal herbs grow. However, the path to it is dangerous, so very few people go. Chopper can be found in the forest when Dias is alone. He is there at a hut to get herbs.

entities.name: Strumia
entities.description:
Strumia is a country near Tongari Island that was under strife when its princes, Taylor and Lance attempted to save it.

Strumia's only named citizens are its two princes: Taylor, the older brother; and Lance, the younger brother.

Strumia was under some kind of strife when Taylor and Lance left for Tongari Island, hoping to complete the ordeal of the island's Fountain of Miracles to save their land. When they arrived, they realized that Eric accidentally gave the rainbow-colored honey needed to begin the ordeal to Nami, and they paired up with her and Sabo to complete the trial and return the voices of the Straw Hat Pirates.

entities.description:
Elena was a shipyard and Shuraiya, Adelle Bascùd and Biera's hometown.

Ten years ago the Gasparde Pirates attacked the island, killing Shuraiya Bascùd and Adelle Bascùd's parents. They then stole a huge ship and forced Biera to work for them.

entities.name: Fireworks
entities.description:
Fireworks is an anime-only port town in Paradise where the Fire works Festival is held once a year.

The town has a very basic shape, with mountains at the top. Odama's family workshop is at the top of said mountains. There is also a graveyard near the eastern side of the town where Kodama's parents are buried.

Life on the town revolves around the annual Fire works Festival that takes place when the Straw Hats land. There are many shops and homes near the harbor, but the real focus of the island takes place in the mountainous regions north of there. Odama and his granddaughter Kodama live there, as well as several other Firework Launchers. The family has been making fireworks for 400 years.

For 400 years, Odama's family have made fireworks and launched them in the annual Fire works Festival.

entities.name: Ido
entities.description:
Ido, as a desert town, and as such is surrounded by sand. Despite this, it has somewhat vibrant vegetation, including grass, trees, and bushes. The buildings all look similar, appearing to be built of an adobe-like material.

Besides Camus and his companions, who were only temporary citizens while they traveled across Arabasta, Ido is home to many villagers. Some of its more predominant citizens include Ido's unnamed mayor - a short man with glasses who is quite kind and welcoming to Camus and his companions, and a few unnamed children who look up to and inspire Camus and his companions.

Camus and his three companions arrived at Ido in order to find food, and as such, they posed as Rebel Army soldiers and promised to protect the village from bandits. When the Straw Hat Pirates with Ace and Vivi arrive at Ido, they discovered the fake Rebel Army soldiers' scheme, and after a some discussion, decided to turn the four liars into real heroes. Luffy and his comrades attacked them and, in the middle of the fight, Camus thought about the town children that wanted to be like him when they grew up, just like how he wanted to be like Chaka and Pell. Camus and his friends then prepared to fight the pirates to their deaths, to which the pirates then run away, pretending to be cowards and showing the villagers that Camus and his friends are heroes. The villagers then cheered the four on and thanked them for saving the town.

Afterwards, Camus and his friends remained at the town and continued to defend it.

entities.name: Melias
entities.description:
Melias is an anime-only town located in the Sandora Desert. Like Erumalu, it has become a ruin. Luffy, Vivi, Rasa, and Zaba went there to search for wood to repair the Barbar Pirates's ship. Rasa used to live there before the town went to ruin.

entities.name: Yuba Oasis
entities.description:
Yuba Oasis is a non-canon oasis town in Mr. Kuromaku's version of Arabasta, run by ック・ワークス|Furokku Wākusu}}.

Unlike in the One Piece world, the oasis located here did not dry up, and the location was transformed into a resort by "Furo"que Works. It has a heavy gambling industry, centered around pulling gamblers into debt and forcing them to work it off.

Yuba Oasis is split up into three main sections, being a water park, casino, and underground factory.

The water park contains multiple slides and pools despite the surrounding desert, a testament to the present oasis. It also contains street stalls selling food. This region is used as a draw to customers, with nearly free access; "Furo"que Works intends for visitors to begin here and funnel over to the casino.

entities.name: Goa Kingdom
entities.description:
The Goa Kingdom is a country located on Dawn Island, in East Blue. It serves as a major setting of the Post-War Arc.

The Goa Kingdom's symbol is a yellow daisy with three white feathers. Many nobles wear it somewhere and it can also be found on the police hats. A stylized form is also present on the high town walls.

The kingdom of Goa encompasses the entirety of Dawn Island. The vast majority of its population lives inside or near the large circular wall surrounding the main towns of the kingdom. Goa's main towns are located on the southern shore of the island.

There are different towns separating the different social classes in Goa. Outside the main wall surrounding it lies the Gray Terminal, where the trash collected in the kingdom is thrown. Inside the wall, there is Edge Town, then the Town Center, and lastly the High Town which hosts the Royal Palace.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: The Goa Kingdom is a country located on Dawn Island, in East Blue. It serves as a major setting of the Post-War Arc.

entities.name: Gray Terminal
entities.description:
The Gray Terminal is a massive junkyard located on Dawn Island north of Mt. Colubo, just outside the great gate of Goa.

Filled with unwanted goods and people ejected from the city of Goa, it is a lawless community without proper medical care, leaving many ravaged by disease. Sabo lived here in secret, along with various other refugees. Many, or possibly all of the inhabitants of the Gray Terminal make their livelihood by selling various wares found in the slum or surrounding mountains to the citizens of Edge Town.

In order to pass inspection by the World Government in preparation for the arrival of a World Noble, the royal family planned to burn the Gray Terminal and all its inhabitants. With the false promise of nobility, they hired the Bluejam Pirates to place gunpowder and oil around the Terminal. With their task complete, the pirates set the Gray Terminal on fire, shooting anyone fortunate enough to escape, but were left to die as the king locked the gates with them still trapped in the inferno. However, thanks to the assistance of Dragon and the Revolutionaries, many inhabitants were able to escape to the safety of their ship.

After the inspection was over, and Saint Jalmack departed, the kingdom returned to its old ways, and the Gray Terminal returned to being a dump site for garbage. It is unknown if the place was inhabited again or if it is still deserted.

entities.short_description: The Gray Terminal is a massive junkyard located on Dawn Island north of Mt. Colubo, just outside the great gate of Goa.

entities.name: Iyasare Island
entities.description:
Iyasare Island is a small island in the East Blue, located within the waters aruound Dawn Island. It appears in Set Sail Pirate Crew!, where it acts as one of the locations visited by the Set Sail Pirates.

Iyasare Island is a small island, enough to be completely overshadowed by the nearby Dawn Island. It contains a single mountain with a snowy peak and a rocky outcropping, which features a large cave.

It is located northwest of Namonaki Village.

Iyasare Island is home to Itatabi Wood, being the only known location where it grows.

entities.name: Mt. Colubo
entities.description:
Mt. Colubo is a location on Dawn Island in the East Blue. It is a mountain behind Foosha Village and serves as the home of Curly Dadan and her gang of bandits.

Mt. Colubo is one of multiple mountains in the kingdom, as Higuma, another notorious bandit, also came from one of these mountains.

Foosha Village is located to the south of Mt. Colubo, a bit away from the mountainbase. The Gray Terminal is located to the north. Because of the mountain's closeness to the Midway Forest, a lot of the dangerous fauna that inhabits the latter also roam around Mt. Colubo. The climate is varied, with occasional rain and snow.

Curly Dadan and her gang live in a house in the middle of the wilderness. This is the place where Monkey D. Luffy and Portgas D. Ace were raised for most of their childhood, with Sabo joining in for a brief period. The boys also constructed a treehouse somewhere nearby so they would stay "independent" from Dadan.

entities.short_description: Mt. Colubo is a location on Dawn Island in the East Blue. It is a mountain behind Foosha Village and serves as the home of Curly Dadan and her gang of bandits.

entities.name: Conomi Islands
entities.description:
The Conomi Islands are an archipelago located in the northwestern region of the East Blue. Nami lived there until she joined the Straw Hat Pirates.

It is the setting of the Arlong Park Arc.

Containing at least twenty different communities, the Conomi Islands appear to be largely agricultural, with several plantations of rice and oranges. The Marine 16th Branch appears to have jurisdiction over this region, although other branches like the 77th Branch can also act here if necessary.

The islands were simple and peaceful until the Arlong Pirates landed at Cocoyasi Village. From there, they quickly tyrannized the entire region and extorted a monthly "survival" tax—100,000 for every adult and 50,000 for every child. Failure to pay would result in violent retaliation, up to and including the complete destruction of a town. With the extorted money, Arlong and his crew erected Arlong Park and planned to conquer the entire East Blue, while bribing corrupt officials like Nezumi to minimize attention from the Marines.

entities.short_description: The Conomi Islands are an archipelago located in the northwestern region of the East Blue. Nami lived there until she joined the Straw Hat Pirates.

entities.name: Cozia
entities.description:
Cozia is an island in the East Blue that was attacked by Germa 66 13 years ago.

Not much of Cozia has been seen, but it contains a very large city dotted with palm trees, as well as a mountain range behind it.

Thirteen years ago, Germa 66 crossed from the North Blue to the East Blue to attack the island; the outcome of the battle is unknown. It was here that Sanji escaped from his family and boarded the Orbit.

entities.name: Dawn Island
entities.description:
Dawn Island is an island located in the East Blue and where the Goa Kingdom is situated. It is the home island of Monkey D. Luffy and the starting point of his journey into piracy, as well as the home island of his father, Monkey D. Dragon and grandfather, Monkey D. Garp. This is also the adopted home of Portgas D. Ace after the death of his mother and the home of Sabo and his family.

Goa Kingdom stretches across the entire island, which consists mostly of rural farmland (with at least one village). The capital is a huge, sprawling city surrounded by a chain of low, forested mountains that are home for several groups of bandits. It is unknown how many villages there are or how many people live here.

Seventy-eight years ago, Monkey D. Garp was born on this island.

Fifty-five years ago, Garp fathered and raised his son, Dragon on this island.

entities.name: Gecko Islands
entities.description:
The Gecko Islands is the archipelago where Syrup Village is located. It is the third island the Straw Hat Pirates visited.

It is not known how many towns are here, but there is at least one major town as Merry told Kaya that Klahadore left for another town. There is also a small hamlet, Syrup Village, home of Yasopp and Usopp.

The Gecko Islands has two sloped hills, a forest and a hilly landmark. It seems to be a large island judging when seen in the distance.

Syrup Village - Usopp and Yasopp's home village. The birthplace of Kaya and where the Straw Hats obtained the Going Merry.

entities.name: Goat Island
entities.description:
Goat Island is an island in the East Blue that the Alvida Pirates used as a hideout. It is where Luffy first met Koby and Alvida.

It is a small, rocky island where small rocks covered the shoreline and a small forest is visible.

At some point, the Alvida Pirates made this island their base. After making Koby their chore boy, he planned for years to escape, building a small boat near the forest.

Once Luffy defeated Alvida, Koby was freed, and the Alvida Pirates later merged with the Buggy Pirates. The bases on the island are presumably abandoned since the crew is currently in the Grand Line.

entities.name: Island of Rare Animals
entities.description:
The Island of Rare Animals, alternatively known as the Legendary Treasure Island in the anime, is an island in the East Blue populated by bizarre "hybrid" animals. It is currently known to have only two human inhabitants: Gaimon and Sarfunkel.

The island is completely undeveloped, and mostly overgrown with forest. Its most significant landmark is a tall, almost sheer topped with five empty treasure chests.

The island is named for its distinctive wildlife, most (possibly all) of which blend the traits of two or more conventional animals, e.g., pigs with lion manes and rabbits with snake bodies. These creatures are notably docile, and highly sought-after by poachers.

The animals inhabiting the island include:

entities.name: Kumate Island
entities.description:
Kumate Island is an island located in the East Blue, and the home of the Kumate Tribe.

The island is shaped like a giant bear's paw, representative of the Kumate Tribe's name. It is circle with four mountains protruding on the edges, reminiscent of toes.

Kumate Island is inhabited by the Kumate Tribe, a cannibalistic tribe.

After being run out of Orange Town, the Buggy Pirates - without their captain - landed on Kumate Island, where they held a funeral for him. Soon after, Richie was promoted to captain, and the pirates ran into the Kumate Tribe. Meanwhile, Buggy and Alvida stumble onto Kumate Island, recognizing Buggy's ship on the shore. They rescue the pirate crew from being eaten by the Kumate Tribe, before subsequently leaving the island.

entities.name: Mirror Ball Island
entities.description:
Mirror Ball Island is an island in the East Blue and where Doskoi Panda's headquarters are located. It appears in the "Jango's Dance Paradise" Cover Story.

The island has a large dome on which the namesake mirrorball stands above the island.

The headquarters of Doskoi Panda, a popular brand-name franchise in East Blue, is on Mirror Ball Island.

After sailing away from Syrup Village, Jango traveled to Mirror Ball Island. The Marines were already canvassing the island for him, so Jango disguised himself and entered the island's dance competition. Jango ultimately wins the competition and befriends Fullbody, a Marine and fellow competitor. The Tulip Pirates attack the island, and although Fullbody almost singlehandedly defeats them, the pirates gain the upper hand when they take a woman hostage. After Jango returned and freed the hostage, he and Fullbody successfully defeated the pirates, saving the island. However, Fullbody subsequently arrested Jango for past crimes.

entities.short_description: Mirror Ball Island is an island in the East Blue and where Doskoi Panda's headquarters are located. It appears in the "Jango's Dance Paradise" Cover Story.

entities.name: Organ Islands
entities.description:
The Organ Islands is the archipelago where Orange Town is located.

Forty years ago, this island was empty. Boodle and his people fled here from another town that was destroyed by pirates and decided to settle here. They built a new town, now called Orange Town.

When Buggy attacked Organ Island, the towns people and Mayor Boodle retreated to the hill on the outskirts of the town.

Through the efforts of Monkey D. Luffy, Nami, and Roronoa Zoro, Buggy was defeated and driven out of Orange Town. After Luffy blasted Buggy away, the refuged townspeople returned to town, ready to fight off the invading pirate force. Mistaking Luffy and his friends for the invaders, they chased the Straw Hats out of town, although Chouchou helped with their escape. Luffy also left some of Nami's loot behind in order to help the townsfolk into rebuilding Orange Town. Afterwards Buggy's men Cabaji and Mohji were driven out of town, allowing for the Orange Islands to become a peaceful archipelago once more.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: The Organ Islands is the archipelago where Orange Town is located.

entities.name: Sixis
entities.description:
Sixis is an island in East Blue where Ace was stranded on during the start of his journey.

Not much is known about the island's geography other than the fact that the island is surrounded by weird, rough currents, which left Ace and Deuce stranded on the island with hardly any way to leave.

The island has trees on it, as a branch was used by Deuce in an attempt to kill Ace, and several others were crafted by him into a makeshift raft powered by Ace's newly obtained Devil Fruit powers.

Three years before the start of the series, Portgas D. Ace and Masked Deuce were stranded on Sixis with no way of escaping. The two talked, and Deuce discovered about Ace's heritage, causing him to distance himself from the pirate. Some time afterward, unable to find any food or water, Deuce saw Ace with a piece of fruit and decided to kill him for it. However, his plan failed and to his surprise Ace offered him half of the fruit, fixing their relationship. Upon discovery of fruit's nature, the two built a raft to escape the island.

entities.short_description: Sixis is an island in East Blue where Ace was stranded on during the start of his journey.

entities.name: Foodvalten
entities.description:
Foodvalten is an island in the New World.

Sometime in the past, Foodvalten was one of the many islands protected by Whitebeard, with his Jolly Roger hanging over the town entrance to prove it. However, after his death, the protection fell apart, and the Brownbeard Pirates attacked soon after, claiming control of the island while slashing Whitebeard's flag in half. Brownbeard then maintained control over the island.

However, Brownbeard's rule on the island was brief, as Basil Hawkins and his crew landed on the island, and he crippled Brownbeard and his entire crew, forcing them to leave the island in utter defeat.

entities.name: Gartel Island
entities.description:
Gartel Island is an island in the New World. It is under the protection of the Red Hair Pirates.

Gartel Island consists of a port and a town, with a range of mountains past the town.

Gartel Island was visited by the Barto Club, who defeated the leader of a gang and burned down a couple of buildings. Bartolomeo tried selling Straw Hat Pirates-themed merchandise to the citizens but was informed that the island was under protection of the Red Hair Pirates. In response, Bartolomeo and Gambia burned down the Red Hair Pirates' flag that was hanging above the town, greatly horrifying the citizens.

The Red Hair Pirates then made it to Gartel Island to confront Bartolomeo and his crew. They initially ended up allowing the crew to leave safely, but then Yasopp destroyed their sailing ship just outside the island.

entities.name: Hachinosu
entities.description:
Hachinosu, also known as , is a New World island known to be a that is currently occupied by the Blackbeard Pirates. It is said to be where the Davy Back Fight originated and where the legendary Rocks Pirates were formed.

Following the downfall of the Rocks Pirates during the God Valley Incident, the island was ruled by Ochoku until the Rocky Port Incident, where he was ousted by Blackbeard. Blackbeard intends to turn Hachinosu into a World Government-allied nation, under the preliminary name of .

Hachinosu is a small-to-mid-sized island (still large enough to dwarf Thriller Bark) whose foundation consists of dark-gray rock. Centrally on it are constructions made of yellowish rock, most prominently a large, skull-fashioned formation in its center, towering over all else. A city of many smaller buildings (all square, crudely brick-built ones) surrounds said skull, as do a series of proportionally huge palm trees. When Shakuyaku lived on the island, Shakky's Rip-off Bar was located here.

The skull's inside is carved into what appears to be a fortress (where Blackbeard has been shown to reside), with the "nose" hole being a giant glass window (plus featuring additional, smaller windows dotting the skull here and there), and both "eye" holes go right through the whole structure. On the outside, the skull is carved to look like it is wearing a bandana, including a rocky protrusion on the left side shaped like the ends of a knot. Originally, this rock lacked its eyeholes and was simply described as "fish-like" until Rocks D. Xebec blasted the holes into existence.

entities.name: Hand Island
entities.description:
Hand Island is a non-canon island in the New World, famous for its craftsmen, that was formerly under the protection of Whitebeard. After Whitebeard's death, the island was ruled by the Marine Commodore Bilić, until he was defeated by the Straw Hat Pirates.

The entire island is perfectly shaped like a human hand, thus giving it its name.

Hand Island was under Whitebeard Pirates' protection until Edward Newgate's death in the Summit War of Marineford.

After the Whitebeard Pirates' flag lost its protection value, some pirates began to attack the island and the Marine Commodore Bilić intervened, protecting the island in exchange of inhabitants' submission and male adults' enrollment in the Marines, starting the construction of the base and of the Josephine cannon. At the same time Diego's son, Regis joined the Marines. A year later the cannon was completed and Bilić started to shoot everyday at the island.
