entities.description:
Peak Ode Island is a non-canon island in the New World and former territory of the Whitebeard Pirates.

Peak Ode Island is a circular island, with a mountain range around its border. Part of the island is open to the sea, causing the island to appear like a fighting ring. During Whitebeard and Ace's fight, the top of the mountain range was destroyed.

The island is uninhabited, allowing the Whitebeard Pirates to use the island for destructive activities.

Peak Ode Island was the location of the 100th duel between Whitebeard and Ace. The duel damaged the island, destroying the entire top half of its mountain range.

entities.description:
Port Chibaralta Island is an island that was once the territory of the Whitebeard Pirates. It appeared in One Piece novel A.

Port Chibaralta Island was formerly ruled over by its boss Oliva. However, due to Oliva's involvement in the slave trade, which was forbidden by Whitebeard, he was deposed by the Whitebeard Pirates.

Sometime in the past, Whitebeard claimed Port Chibaralta Island as his territory.

Portgas D. Ace was sent to lead an investigation on Port Chibaralta Island. There, he discovered that the island's boss Oliva was participating in the slave trade, and he forced Oliva to surrender and be arrested.

Samba Island is a non-canon island in the New World, previously protected by the Whitebeard Pirates and later ruled by Chameleone as a tyrant. It became autonomous once Chameleone was ousted.

Samba Island's geography is similar to the structure of 's stage. Not much is known about it.

The only named citizens of the island are Rio and Chameleone, who used to be the tyrant of the island after Whitebeard's death. Rio's brother and other citizens also reside there, but they are not named.

Each year, the residents of Samba Island host an annual . The festival is a specialty of the island and includes an acrobatics tournament. The winner of the tournament receives a prize of the island's Samba Beef.

Tongari Island is a non-canon island located in the New World. It is the setting for Tokyo One Piece Tower, and by extension all of its live attractions and related animations. It is considered territory of the Straw Hat Pirates.

Tongari Island is a small, rocky island with a flattened central section where the main tower is located. The island's secret power is channeled through the central tower, as seen when it came to the aid of Luffy and Trafalgar Law.

Underneath the island's surface are a series of caves that hold some of the island's secrets.

Tongari Island has a number of shops, restaurants, and a casino on the island.

The Yukiryu Island is a winter island located somewhere in the Grand Line.

Yukiryu Island is an island where it is constantly snowing. It has one volcano and several rock formations that resemble a dragon's body going in and out of the ground.

Shanks and his crew were hanging out on the island when Shanks received a call from Rockstar about Whitebeard tearing up the message he wanted to send him and his request to meet him in person.

entities.name: Fron Island
entities.description:
Fron Island is a non-canon island located in the New World, very close to Totto Land. It is home to the Marine Base G-F commanded by Vice Admiral Prodi.

The island was first seen on a map located in Zou that Nami perused, but has not been named except in Weekly Shonen Jump.

Fron Island is a circular-shaped island with a rocky coastline featuring several tall rock pillars. Within it is a giant circular plateau that has a forest growing on top of it, and there is a large basin in the middle of the plateau which contains a Marine Base. There is a small inlet on one side of the island that leads to a gate to an opening through the plateau into the base.

A significant portion of Fron Island hosts a Marine base. Marine ships are able to enter it through a giant gate within the plateau. The base consists of several buildings, including the main place of operations as well as a warehouse storing food supplies.

entities.description:
G-1 is a Marine Base that was located in the New World, now located on Paradise's Marineford (where Marine Headquarters used to be), where Vice Admiral Momonga is stationed.

After the events of the Summit War of Marineford, the base switched locations with the Marine Headquarters at Marineford, as Fleet Admiral Sakazuki desired to have the Headquarters in the sea where the Four Emperors were in order to challenge their domination within the second half of the Grand Line.

Its former location, now called New Marineford, is said to be exactly symmetrical to Marineford on the other side of the Red Line.

G-5, officially , is a Marine Base located in the New World, near the Red Line. It was first mentioned by Aokiji after the Summit War of Marineford and according to him, it is full of problems. Smoker requested a transfer to this branch in order to "keep his targets close".

Initially opposed to the Straw Hat Pirates, the unit teamed up with them and the Heart Pirates to stop Caesar Clown on Punk Hazard, and so they serve as major allies in the Punk Hazard Arc.

The base seems to be very close to the Red Line since Vice Admiral Smoker and Captain Tashigi were the first to intercept the pirates fleeing Fish-Man Island and entering the New World.

The headquarters of the G-5 location has several buildings left tattered or broken and slightly fixed from damages and appears to be left in ruins.

entities.description:
G-8, officially , is a non-canon Marine Base occupying Navarone Island, with buildings along the coast and the most important ones built into a rock formation in the middle of the cape. The only way to enter and exit is through a large gate blocking the cape. It is the main setting of the G-8 Arc, in which the Straw Hat Pirates have to find their way out of the base.

The Marines of G-8 are fiercely proud of their base and island and berate those who undermine its importance. However, the base is "peace crazy"; it is one of the most heavily defended and armed of the marine bases (the main base alone sports a total of 108 cannons ), yet sees very little trouble. This has gotten to the point that the first four rules of G-8 marines involve eating one's meals completely.

The base is located on an island with a cold climate, in close proximity to Egghead.

The base commander of G-14 is Vice Admiral Doll. Rear Admirals Prince Grus and Kujaku are also stationed here.

The G-5 Marines brought the Punk Hazard children here after their rescue. Several members of the SWORD squad were stationed here alongside Vice Admiral Doll. Later, after learning of Koby's abduction by the hands of the Blackbeard Pirates, Vice Admiral Garp sailed to G-14 and requested that Helmeppo join him on a rescue mission to save Koby.

In the live-action series, Smoker and Tashigi's journey to Renaisse is shown, rather than simply mentioned. The island is home to a Marine communications outpost, which Smoker and Tashigi arrived at in the middle of a raid by Miss Thursday and Mr. 11.

entities.name: Eruption Rain
entities.description:
A is a directed movement that determines the way water acts on a sea. They are forces of major importance in the world. Since the Blue Planet is predominantly covered with water, and with little in the way of air travel, currents are used to propel ships to certain destinations at greater speed.

Currents are usually created by changes of temperature in the water, differences in salinity levels (the concentration of salt), tides, wind and the continuous break and mixing of waves, though there are some exceptions. It is even possible to use currents created by massive sea life. The only place where one cannot find sea currents are in the Calm Belts.

Surface currents are currents found in the warmer waters closer to the surface, and are quite fast moving.

Deep currents are currents found in the cooler waters closer to the sea floor, and are quite slow moving. They are larger than the currents at the surface and their flow is independent from that of higher waters. It is said that if a coated ship enters the wrong deep current, it can be trapped in the current for over two thousand years before it can reach the sunlight again.

entities.name: Jewel Ice Sheet
entities.description:
The Jewel Ice Sheet is a treasure cache frozen beneath extremely hard ice.

The ice sheet is very large with dozens of huge icicles jutting out from it. The ice itself is almost impossible to break and seems to be able to reform quickly, shown when even the use of flamethrowers could not melt the ice long enough. Beneath the ice is a cave full of treasure, amassed over centuries.

Thirty years ago, Chinjao broke through the ice with his head, gaining access to the vast riches that lay beneath. He vowed to never let anyone near this treasure, which had been collected by the people in his family.

Sometime later, after losing his drill-shaped head in a battle against Vice Admiral Garp, Chinjao returned to the island and tried to break the ice again, but could not. He then cursed Garp and his family for costing him his access to the treasure, swearing to not even forgive his grandchildren. However, when Luffy defeated him with Gum Gum no Thor Elephant Gun, he inadvertently restored Chinjao's drill-shaped head and as a result, Chinjao let go of his vendetta against Garp and his family, even allying himself with Straw Hat Pirates against Donquixote Doflamingo.

entities.name: Marine Headquarters
entities.description:
The Marine Headquarters is the main division of the Marine organization that has jurisdiction over the Grand Line. It is one of the Three Great Powers in the world, alongside the Four Emperors and the Seven Warlords of the Sea, who were later replaced by the SSG's Seraphim.

The Marines stationed there are considered "super-elites" among their comrades, and a rank at the other Marine bases is about equivalent to three ranks lower at Headquarters.

The Headquarters' base of operations is currently at New Marineford in the New World. It was previously in Paradise's Marineford until Sakazuki moved it after the Summit War of Marineford.

Marineford is the former location of Marine Headquarters. It is located in Paradise, and could only be accessed through the Gates of Justice along with Enies Lobby and Impel Down.

entities.name: Prodence Kingdom
entities.description:
The Prodence Kingdom is a kingdom in the New World, led by Elizabello II.

The royal palace was built with a statue of Elizabello towering over it. The statue is flexing its muscles and is frowning.

In the past, the Prodence Kingdom was saved numerous times by King Riku Doldo III of Dressrosa. With King Doldo's disappearance, the country was subjected to outbreaks of war.

The Prodence Kingdom's army was once involved in a war with another kingdom. King Elizabello II landed a massive punch that created a huge hole in the enemy kingdom's fortress. The reputation of the Prodence Kingdom and its king spread like a wildfire due to this punch.

entities.name: Rabbit Wave
entities.description:
A is a directed movement that determines the way water acts on a sea. They are forces of major importance in the world. Since the Blue Planet is predominantly covered with water, and with little in the way of air travel, currents are used to propel ships to certain destinations at greater speed.

Currents are usually created by changes of temperature in the water, differences in salinity levels (the concentration of salt), tides, wind and the continuous break and mixing of waves, though there are some exceptions. It is even possible to use currents created by massive sea life. The only place where one cannot find sea currents are in the Calm Belts.

Surface currents are currents found in the warmer waters closer to the surface, and are quite fast moving.

Deep currents are currents found in the cooler waters closer to the sea floor, and are quite slow moving. They are larger than the currents at the surface and their flow is independent from that of higher waters. It is said that if a coated ship enters the wrong deep current, it can be trapped in the current for over two thousand years before it can reach the sunlight again.

entities.name: Shakky's Rip-off Bar
entities.description:
The Shakky's Rip-off Bar is a bar at Grove 13 of Sabaody Archipelago, and is run by Shakuyaku. It was originally founded on the Pirate Island Hachinosu in the New World.

It is infamous for its high prices (hence the name Rip-Off Bar), and Shakky's practice of beating up customers who refuse to pay. It is also where Silvers Rayleigh can often be found, as he frequents the bar whenever he is not out doing other activities, such as gambling.

During her time in Hachinosu, she had a policy that customers were not allowed to fight in the bar. Also, it was one of the very few, if not only, places in Hachinosu that is actually peaceful thanks to her beauty and charm. Although she served inferior quality food and beverages for high prices (once again, hence the name "Rip-Off"), none of the customers cared due to being charmed by her beauty.

After retiring as captain of the Kuja Pirates 42 years ago, Shakuyaku settled down on Hachinosu and opened up Shakky's Rip-off Bar, attracting a huge number of clientele including several members of the Rocks Pirates leading to a month-long waiting list for entry. Eventually the bar was relocated to the Sabaody Archipelago.

entities.name: Tontatta Kingdom
entities.description:
The Tontatta Kingdom is a kingdom underneath Green Bit, and home to the , a tribe of dwarves ruled by king Gancho.

The Tontatta kingdom is a kingdom that is located just below Green Bit, inside there is as much vegetation as in the forest itself, even having a waterfall, the flowers are normal size, but compared to the houses of the dwarves they seem to be huge. Dwarf houses are oval, as culturally depicted in folklore. The kingdom has a stone roof, and is large enough for a normal-sized human to stand upright.

The Tontatta Kingdom had an army comprised of at least two squads, the Pink Bee Squad led by Bian, and the Yellow Kabu Squad led by Kabu, before it was disbanded following the events of the Dressrosa Arc. Tontatta Kingdom also has an airline, Tontatta Airline (TAL) that is comprised of insects.

In addition to that, they have Linear Foxes known as the that can hold twenty dwarves. They have been said to be extremely fast. The word "Corn" is a play on kon, a Japanese onomatopoeia for foxes.

In pirate folklore, the sea floor is sometimes referred to as and is where the legendary pirate Davy D. Jones supposedly lives.

entities.name: Underworld of the Sea
entities.description:
The is a deep sea area where light does not penetrate, where normal creatures are not allowed to exist. The creatures here have either had to acquire better eyesight, or, in some cases, bio-luminescence.

The Straw Hat Pirates were carried by the sea currents to this place when Luffy knocked out the kraken that was blocking the way.

Franky stated that this area is approximately 7,000 meters below the surface.

entities.name: Cream Mist
entities.description:
Cream Mist is a non-canon archipelago ruled by Cello. It is where the events of One Piece: Treasure Wars take place.

Cream Mist is known as a powerful producer of different foods. It is home to the , edible jewels hidden across the archipelago. Cello hosted a tournament called the and attracted participants with a reward in order to find them.

As an archipelago, Cream Mist is composed of five islands: Malti Island, Sorbi Island, Oligo Island, Xyli Island, and Granu island.

King Cello hosted a Treasure Wars tournament where participants had to find all five Life Gems for the reward of 100,000,000 and an Eternal Pose to any island of their choosing. The Straw Hat Pirates came to the island after having their Eternal Pose stolen by a crow and decided to participate. During the Treasure Wars, Helsing and Cal went to Cello's palace and threatened him.

entities.name: Elegia
entities.description:
Elegia, known as the , is the main setting of the movie One Piece Film: Red, in which it acts as the location of Uta's live music festival.

Non-canonically, it used to house the , governed by King Gordon. However, the entire population save for Gordon was massacred twelve years ago when Tot Musica was released from its seal.

Elegia seems to be composed of three land masses. The largest island has approximately two-thirds of it's land reconstructed into a concert hall. Behind the concert are what appears to be large green crystals, and behind that is what appears to be a rocky mountain. There also appears to be around five brown stone towers of varying heights on the island.

The smallest islet has a large brown stone tower which is connected to the other two islands by bridges.

entities.name: Kinoko Islands
entities.description:
The Kinoko Islands is a non-canon archipelago in the East Blue, located near the Gecko Islands. It appears in Set Sail Pirate Crew!.

The Kinoko Islands are made up of four small islands, respectively known as the "West", "Left", "Right", and "East" islands (from left to right).

The archipelago is located roughly southeast of Syrup Village, between it and Pescatore Island.

The Kinoko Islands is home to the extremely rare Amanita Truffle.

entities.name: Long Ring Long Land
entities.description:
Long Ring Long Land is an archipelago in the first half of the Grand Line. This is the location of the Long Ring Long Land Arc, and the seventh island visited by the Straw Hat Pirates on the Grand Line.

While following the Log Pose, it is preceded by Skypiea and followed by Water 7.

Long Ring Long Land is a chain of ten islands in a ring shape, with a path between the islands that surfaces once every year. Because the ten islands of the archipelago are actually linked together as one giant island, an Eternal Pose cannot be used to get from one island to another.

The animals that live here are unique in that they are all longer than normal in some way, such as a tall horse with a long neck.

entities.name: Merveille
entities.description:
Merveille, also known as the and the , is a hidden archipelago of floating isles in the sky above Paradise that served as the base of operations for the Golden Lion Pirates. It is where Shiki and his scientist, Indigo, created many mutated animals in the hopes of having an army to overthrow the world. Of these animals shown 22 years ago is a land-walking squid, giraffes as tall as skyscrapers, and a giant turtle-like creature.

Non-canonically, it also contains people who have feathers on their arms that enable flight. The island is also home to the rare IQ plant, in which Indigo used as a basis for his SIQ drugs for creating the mutant army, as well as the Daft Green.

In canon, Merveille was shown to include a lush forest, with numerous mountains and ruins. The mountain peaks are extremely high, reaching up into the clouds. In Film: Strong World, it was shown that Merveille is a collection of small islands, each with their own flora and ecosystem, as well as several bodies of water. Using the Fuwa Fuwa no Mi, Shiki caused these islands to float, causing them to appear suspended in the air. The island with the tallest peak, which reached into the clouds from the surface, became the primary island in the archipelago.

Non-canonically, many of Merveille's human citizens have been mutated to a small degree, likely due to exposure to SIQ. As a result of the mutation, they have grown feathers underneath their arms and given them the ability to fly.

entities.name: Nanatsu Islands
entities.description:
The Nanatsu Islands are an archipelago of seven islands located in the Paradise half of the Grand Line. They are the main setting of One Piece: Great Hidden Treasure of the Nanatsu Islands.

The Nanatsu Islands are a tropical archipelago of islands of varying size. Six of the islands form the shape of a ring with a large empty region of sea in the middle, while the seventh island later emerges in the center of the ring. The islands have volcanoes and large mountains, and the flora consists of tropical plants such as palm trees.

The people of the Nanatsu Islands practice agriculture and fishing as their main sources of food. The buildings on the islands mainly consist of wooden stilt houses.

There appears to be no centralized government, with each village being governed by its own village chief.

entities.name: Polestar Islands
entities.description:
Loguetown is a prominent city situated on the in the East Blue. Spanning nearly the entire island it occupies—save for a few steep hills—it serves as a vital port of call for the surrounding seas. Its strategic location, lying in close proximity to the Reverse Mountain and just beyond the visible reach of the Red Line, makes it an essential stop for almost all East Blue ships, especially pirate ships, seeking to resupply before venturing into the perilous waters of the Grand Line.

The town is famed as both the birthplace and the execution site of the former Pirate King, Gol D. Roger. This dual distinction earned it its poetic epithet: the .

It serves as the principal setting of the Loguetown Arc.

Loguetown lies just north of the Calm Belt and to the northeast of the entrance to the Reverse Mountain. As such, it serves as a crucial stopping point for East Blue pirates, who come to replenish their supplies before embarking on their journey into the Grand Line. Since Smoker assumed command as the captain of the local Marine base, numerous pirates were captured before even setting foot into the Grand Line's treacherous waters.

entities.name: Birka
entities.description:
Birka was a Sky Island far to the southeast of Skypiea that was destroyed by Enel. It is the birthplace of Enel and his followers.

The island shares its name with an ancient city on the Moon.

Some time in the distant past, the three tribes of ancient Birka emigrated from the Moon to the Blue Planet. One of these tribes, later known as the Birkans, settled on Birka. Over time, the three tribes lost any records of their origins, only passing down a myth about the Moon as the "Fairy Vearth", described as a place of dreams.

Enel was born and raised on this island, and collected two hundred Jet Dials from here, but eight years ago he utterly destroyed his homeland with the power of his Devil Fruit, the Goro Goro no Mi. Enel then gathered his followers and left for Skypiea, where he dethroned Gan Fall instituted himself as god.

entities.name: Karate Island
entities.description:
Karate Island is an island in the South Blue, where people can master many types of martial arts.

Nothing is known about the country's geography because it has yet to make an appearance.

Jerry from the CP6 trained there, in order to master the art of boxing.

entities.name: Mamana Island
entities.description:
Mamana Island is a non-canon island in Paradise. It can be used, alongside Samua Island, to locate Shellfish Island.

Mamana Island, Shellfish Island, and Samua Island all form a straight line. Because of this, sailing from Mamana Island to Samua Island, or vice-versa, in a straight line (such as with an Eternal Pose) allows one to reach Shellfish Island, which cannot be reached normally with any Log or Eternal Pose.

At some point in the past, Amanda's father discovered Shellfish Island, establishing that it was reachable by travelling in a straight line between Mamana Island and Samua Island.

After Amanda and her siblings were captured by the Bayan Pirates and escaped with Maccus and Bonney, they travelled to Mamana Island and set off towards Samua Island using an Eternal Pose.

entities.short_description: Mamana Island is a non-canon island in Paradise. It can be used, alongside Samua Island, to locate Shellfish Island.

entities.description:
Nakrowa (literally meaning "Dreamland") is an island known as the . It is unknown if it exists, but Mont Blanc Cricket, Masira, Shoujou and the rest of the Saruyama Alliance decided to search for it after the missing half of Jaya was revealed to be in the sky.

entities.name: Nanimonai Island
entities.description:
Nanimonai Island is an uninhabited island just before the Arabasta Kingdom. In reality, it is not a full island but rather the feces produced after a giant goldfish ate a whole island.

Sometime over a hundred years ago, the Giant Warrior Pirates landed on this island, mistaking it for dry land.

Miss All-Sunday gave Vivi an Eternal Pose to this island to help the Straw Hat Pirates reach Arabasta. However, while Vivi was contemplating whether or not she should accept, Luffy suddenly grabbed the pose and destroyed it, refusing to let an enemy choose their route.

In the anime and live-action series, Nanimonai Island's name was written on the Eternal Pose that Miss All-Sunday gave to the Straw Hats, while it was absent in the manga.

entities.name: Rubeck Island
entities.description:
Rubeck Island is an island in North Blue. Thirteen years ago, it was where a pirate named Diez Barrels was going to trade the Ope Ope no Mi to the Marines in exchange for a hefty amount of money.

Nothing is known about the country's geography because it has yet to make an appearance.

entities.name: Samua Island
entities.description:
Samua Island is a non-canon island in Paradise. It can be used, alongside Mamana Island, to locate Shellfish Island.

Samua Island, Shellfish Island, and Mamana Island all form a straight line. Because of this, sailing from Samua Island to Mamana Island, or vice-versa, in a straight line (such as with an Eternal Pose) allows one to reach Shellfish Island, which cannot be reached normally with any Log or Eternal Pose.

At some point in the past, Amanda's father discovered Shellfish Island, establishing that it was reachable by travelling in a straight line between Mamana Island and Samua Island.

After Amanda and her siblings were captured by the Bayan Pirates and escaped with Maccus and Bonney, they used an Eternal Pose for Samua Island to locate Shellfish Island.

Samuwanai Island is an island in the South Blue and where Ida was born.

Ida was born on this island, before eventually leaving and venturing past the Red Line.

entities.name: Soja Island
entities.description:
Soja Island is a World Government-affiliated island in the West Blue where Issho lived prior to joining the Marines.

Nothing is known about the island's geography as it has yet to make an appearance.

The only known citizen of Soja Island was Issho prior to his joining the Marines.

At some point after the destruction of the Aoi Kingdom, Issho made his way to Soja Island. There, he lost all his money in a gambling house, and was made to work as a bodyguard. He remained there until he was bought by the World Government for a large sum of money.

Not much is known about it except that a pirate named Byron originates from here; he was a descendant from a long line of musicians. He eventually left and traveled to the Grand Line, where he was captured and sold off as a slave.

entities.name: Minion Island
entities.description:
Minion Island is an island in North Blue. It's the place where Trafalgar Law obtained his Ope Ope no Mi powers and Donquixote Rosinante died by the hands of his elder brother Donquixote Doflamingo.

Minion Island is located northeast of Swallow Island and east of Rubeck Island.

The island features several hills, one which contains a ghost town. This town also features a mansion at the very top of the hill, which Diez Barrels and his crew used as a hideout. The island appears to have a snowy climate.

Thirteen years ago, it served as the base of a pirate crew led by Diez Barrels. After learning about Barrels' location from Sengoku, Rosinante and Law headed there in order to retrieve the Ope Ope no Mi so Law could use its power to heal himself from his fatal sickness.

entities.name: Swallow Island
entities.description:
Swallow Island is an island in North Blue. It is found on the south of Minion Island and Rubeck Island.

The island's distinct feature is its central mountain formation taking the shape of a swallow, which is covered with trees. The island is also shaped like the aforementioned bird, according to a map owned by Donquixote Rosinante.

Thirteen years ago, the island was to serve as a temporary base for the Donquixote Pirates following their plan to steal the Ope Ope no Mi from the pirates lead by Diez Barrels. However, the crew never landed on the island when they spotted the Marine ships lead by Vice Admiral Tsuru, who set up an ambush for the crew based on Rosinante's information.

After leaving the Donquixote Pirates, Trafalgar Law would take residence in this island while still grieving for Rosinante's death. He ended up meeting Bepo, Penguin and Shachi by defending the former from the latter two, who were bullying the Mink at the time. Law defeated both Shachi and Penguin, earning their and Bepo's respect and admiration. The three started following Law and eventually formed the Heart Pirates at some point.

entities.short_description: Swallow Island is an island in North Blue. It is found on the south of Minion Island and Rubeck Island.

entities.name: Ballon Terminal
entities.description:
Ballon Terminal is a ruined city located on a Sky Island above the New World.

The sky island is suspended by a multitude of helium balloons along its underside. It is 10,000 meters directly above the Kid Pirates' former base.

Ballon Terminal is the location where all lost helium balloons end up, which keep it floating in the sky. At some point in time, a civilization moved to and thrived on Ballon Terminal, building multiple buildings. Eventually, this civilization ended for unknown reasons, and the buildings fell into ruins.

Urouge retreated here after sustaining wounds against the Big Mom Pirates. He and his Fallen Monk Pirates then encountered Kaidou, who attempted to commit suicide by jumping off the island as they watched.

entities.name: Sky Island
entities.description:
Urouge's homeland is a sky island, although the name of the island has not yet been stated.

Non-canonically, Waford was an artificial sky island, though it has since fallen into the Blue Sea.

The existence of sky islands is largely mocked or ignored by many. To those living in the Blue Sea, the idea of an island in the sky seems illogical, impossible, or unbelievable.

Traveling to a sky island is difficult due to their location, although not entirely impossible. There are two known ways to reach a sky island: to ride a current known as the Knock Up Stream, or through something called the , though details of the summit are unknown.

entities.name: Waford
entities.description:
Waford is a fallen Sky Island that the Straw Hat Pirates shipwreck on in One Piece Odyssey. Until 200 years ago, the island floated on a giant Sabao bubble; however, the bubble was destroyed, and the island fell to the Blue Sea.

While unconfirmed, Nico Robin speculates that Weatheria may be partially built and influenced by remains of Waford from before it fell into the Blue Sea.

Waford is a nature-filled island that is surrounded by storms. It has distinct forested and beach-covered areas, with ruins of a past civilization scattered across it.

The island is shaped like a giant ring. Until 200 years ago, twelve towers stood around the hole in the ring. In the present day, the hole has filled with seawater, with the towers collapsing inwards and floating on the inland sea.

entities.name: Weatheria
entities.description:
Weatheria is an artificial sky island. Nami was sent here by Bartholomew Kuma during the events of Sabaody Archipelago, and spent two years on the island honing her skills.

It appears to be floating on top of a large bubble and it is notable for the study of weather conditions as well as tools that can create various conditions, such as the Wind Knot. The island is constantly drifting with the wind. It was last seen over the Sabaody Archipelago, causing rainfall above the fourth back-up platoon, ruining their gunpowder in order to assist Nami.

The citizens of this country mainly seem to be tall, old men, with long beards who are dressed up as stereotypical wizards. The country seems to lack any law enforcement personnel, with the citizens themselves having to take actions in the event of a crime. However, they all seem to be quite weak and naïve, and are unsure of how to handle crime and violence, though they do have a prison for criminals. This is demonstrated when Nami attempted to steal their technology. They apparently make their living by temporarily landing on islands they pass by and offering to briefly alter their weather for the citizens, for example, bringing rain to a drought-ridden country.

The Wind Knot is a tied rope created on Weatheria. Untying the rope's knots releases gusts of wind.

entities.short_description: Weatheria is an artificial sky island. Nami was sent here by Bartholomew Kuma during the events of Sabaody Archipelago, and spent two years on the island honing her skills.

entities.name: Baterilla
entities.description:
Baterilla is an island in the South Blue where Portgas D. Ace was born.

It was said that Gol D. Roger was acting less like a pirate and more like a man in love while on the island and the World Government searched the island for any signs of his child. Portgas D. Rouge lived here and gave birth to the infant that she would name "Gol D. Ace" after sustaining him in her womb for twenty months to protect the child from the Marines and government officials. After giving birth to Ace, she died from the extended pregnancy.

In a flashback of Ace's birth, it is shown to have palm trees and cabanas, much like a tropical island in the real world. Little else is known about this island.

entities.name: Kutsukku Island
entities.description:
Kutsukku Island is an island located in the South Blue and unaffiliated with the World Government. It is the country where Eustass Kid, Killer, Heat, and Wire were born.

Nothing is currently known about the country's geography beyond the fact that it has four towns.

In the past, Kid, Killer, Heat, and Wire were bosses of gangs ruling the island's four towns. After his childhood friend Victoria was murdered by another rival gang, Kid unified the four groups and took down the rival gang. Afterwards, the unified gangs formed into the pirate crew known as the Kid Pirates.

entities.name: Torino Kingdom
entities.description:
At first glance, the island seems savage, and its inhabitants seem primitive. In reality however, the locals have an extensive library and the great tree in the middle of the island is covered in plants that are excellent for making various medicines.

Tony Tony Chopper was sent here by Bartholomew Kuma during the events in the Sabaody Archipelago Arc. He spent two years here in order to train.

The human inhabitants of the Torino Kingdom have so far been shown as overweight people dressed only in grass skirts with knotted black hair, seemingly having the stereotypical caveman intelligence. Some bear an eye tattoo symbol on either of their upper arms and all adults seem wear a simple necklace. Despite this, it has been revealed that they have a vast library of books about different herbs and their medicinal purposes as well as weapons that suggest a mechanical nature. This implies that they have an advanced culture and perhaps a higher intelligence than what was initially presumed. All of them are extremely short, only being about twice as tall as Tony Tony Chopper's hybrid form. The only named inhabitant of the island is Shanba.

The natives of the island were ruled by the gigantic birds known as |Masukeredomo Goayū Bādo}} that live in the tree above.

entities.name: Esperia Kingdom
entities.description:
The Esperia Kingdom, also referred to as the , was a kingdom in the West Blue. It was Brook's homeland and where he served as a royal guard. The kingdom was famous for making musical instruments and producing music.

62 years ago, the World Government allegedly invaded and destroyed the kingdom due to its inability to pay the Heavenly Tribute and refusal of providing 1000 slaves as substitution, but according to Shuri, the true reason was due to the government demanding she be returned to Mary Geoise, with Reuven refusing to do so.

Esperia used to be a mostly urban island with its primary structure being the massive built at the center of it, part of the castle. It featured a mountainous terrain, with the center of the island rising above the lower sections, as well as a smaller island connected via a bridge.

The overall kingdom appeared to be inspired by , with musical elements, such as notes and clefs, commonly incorporated on the nation's buildings.

entities.name: Thriller Bark
entities.description:
Thriller Bark is the world's largest ship and the former home of the Thriller Bark Pirates, led by the former Warlord Gecko Moria. Originally an island from the West Blue, it was somehow converted into a pirate ship and sailed to the Florian Triangle, where it lurked within the thick fog for 10 years.

The ship was heavily damaged during the battle against the Straw Hat Pirates, and the Thriller Bark Pirates abandoned it after Moria's defeat. It was later reclaimed by Moria, who used it to travel to Hachinosu in the New World. However, it is unknown what happened to it after Moria was imprisoned by the Blackbeard Pirates.

Thriller Bark is the main setting of the Thriller Bark Arc, as well as the ninth island in Paradise that the Straw Hat Pirates visited.

The island is surrounded by a huge outer wall that goes around the ship, with a gate resembling a giant mouth that opens and closes. There are four separate chains that connect from the wall to the mast above the mansion. The island has an old broken inner stone wall encircling it with towers and a moat. There is a mansion in the middle of the island, surrounded by an apparently dead forest. The entire ship somewhat resembles the stereotypical scenery in vampire or horror movies, such as Dracula or Frankenstein.

entities.name: Blue Station
entities.description:
Water 7, known as the and located on , is a city in Paradise known for its shipwrights. It is the main setting of the Water 7 Arc and Post-Enies Lobby Arc.

The Straw Hat Pirates stopped here to trade in their gold for belly, as well as to repair the Going Merry and also to find a new shipwright for their crew. It is part of the route their log was on, heading there directly after Long Ring Long Land, making it the eighth island in Paradise that they visited.

There are waterways and canals that are used for transportation almost like roads, often surrounded by sidewalks along the canals. Many citizens use Bulls, which are seahorse-like creatures that are attached to boats, to move around the city. Also, some shops rent bulls of various sizes, although they rarely rent King Bulls, as they are gigantic in size. There are 3 main types of bulls, of which the 2 smaller sizes are used for transport. The bulls are good to use because they can go up ramps of water and move about the city. Architecture is very colorful, often using a tan or peach color for the walls and roofs, which are many times red and semi-circular; nearly all the roofs are of red color and texture. The houses are tiered to allow for more houses to take up room and are usually made, keeping in mind the city sinks. Some canals are wide enough for ships, but those are mostly just to let some ships enter the city so they may be docked somewhere. The city resembles a giant fountain in a volcano shape because of the tiered system of building houses.

This is where Iceburg lives. It is probably the largest home on the island and is generally well protected. A fight occurred here between the Straw Hat Pirates and CP9, but CP9 quickly beat them since they were unprepared for battle, and CP9 were attempting to get away quickly on the Sea Train but could not find the blueprints they were looking for.

entities.name: Franky House
entities.description:
The Franky House was the headquarters and home of the Franky Family.

While guarding his 200,000,000, Usopp was attacked from behind by the Franky Family, on the streets of Water 7. Angered he had lost the money, Usopp goes to the Franky House and heads inside to try and get the money back. Luffy, Sanji, Zoro, and Chopper follow Usopp's bloody trail to the Franky House where they find him passed out in front. The four of them challenge the Franky Family only to find out that their real target, Franky himself, is gone and has taken the money with him. They then all decided to destroy the house.

After returning from the raid on Enies Lobby, the Franky Family successfully repaired their house. Unfortunately, their new house was very poorly constructed.

entities.name: Human Auctioning House
entities.description:
The Human Auctioning House—euphemistically referred to by the Marines as the —was a center of slave trade and a bidding house for selling living beings as slaves. It is located on Sabaody Archipelago's Grove 1. It was owned by Donquixote Doflamingo until he gave it to Disco, who managed it until it was attacked by the Straw Hat Pirates. Like most of the things affiliated with Doflamingo, it bears the Donquixote Pirates Jolly Roger—a smiley-face with the cancel symbol over it. After the Celestial Dragon Hit-and-Run Incident, Doflamingo stopped running it in favor of other more lucrative pursuits and it went bankrupt, leaving it out of business.

The Human Auctioning House was run and managed by Disco, who was given it by Doflamingo. Disco was accompanied by a number of rotund men with thin limbs and mime-like face paint who helped manage auctions.

In One Piece Premier Show 2010, Disco was accompanied by named henchmen, the most prominent of whom was Nepenta. Others included , , and , though none of them are identifiable within the group of henchmen.

All henchmen are named after Disco clubs in Roppongi, a district in Tokyo known for its disco culture.

entities.name: Owl Library
entities.description:
The Owl Library is a large building located on Branch Route 8 of Elbaph hanging over the Warrior's Spring southwest of Western Village.

The Owl Library is a large building built on Branch Route 8, which rises from the Warrior's Spring.

It contains all the books that Jaguar D. Saul managed to save from Ohara. Biblo is the chief librarian for hundreds of years, and due to his Devil Fruit ability, the Iku Iku no Mi, any normal-sized book brought into the library will instantaneously grow into one more fitting for a giant to read. Fishermen who brought newspapers back would also bring them to the library to achieve this effect for easier reading.

The Owl Library has been around for hundreds of years with Biblo as the chief librarian.

entities.name: Rental Bull Shop
entities.description:
Water 7, known as the and located on , is a city in Paradise known for its shipwrights. It is the main setting of the Water 7 Arc and Post-Enies Lobby Arc.

The Straw Hat Pirates stopped here to trade in their gold for belly, as well as to repair the Going Merry and also to find a new shipwright for their crew. It is part of the route their log was on, heading there directly after Long Ring Long Land, making it the eighth island in Paradise that they visited.

There are waterways and canals that are used for transportation almost like roads, often surrounded by sidewalks along the canals. Many citizens use Bulls, which are seahorse-like creatures that are attached to boats, to move around the city. Also, some shops rent bulls of various sizes, although they rarely rent King Bulls, as they are gigantic in size. There are 3 main types of bulls, of which the 2 smaller sizes are used for transport. The bulls are good to use because they can go up ramps of water and move about the city. Architecture is very colorful, often using a tan or peach color for the walls and roofs, which are many times red and semi-circular; nearly all the roofs are of red color and texture. The houses are tiered to allow for more houses to take up room and are usually made, keeping in mind the city sinks. Some canals are wide enough for ships, but those are mostly just to let some ships enter the city so they may be docked somewhere. The city resembles a giant fountain in a volcano shape because of the tiered system of building houses.

This is where Iceburg lives. It is probably the largest home on the island and is generally well protected. A fight occurred here between the Straw Hat Pirates and CP9, but CP9 quickly beat them since they were unprepared for battle, and CP9 were attempting to get away quickly on the Sea Train but could not find the blueprints they were looking for.

entities.name: Sheep's House
entities.description:
The Sheep's House was an orphanage on Elbaph run by the nun Carmel. It was where a young Charlotte Linlin stayed as a child 63 years ago. After the incident with Linlin, the residents of the Sheep's House moved to another island (later named Whole Cake Island) where the giants built another house with the same design.

It was also used by Carmel, who was actually a renowned child trafficker of the Underworld, to lure in children for her orphan trading.

The Sheep's House was an orphanage where children of any race came under Mother Carmel's care from whatever circumstances that caused them to have no home of their own. The residents range from a former prince who was overthrown, a child sold into slavery due to poverty, and problem children who were abandoned by parents who could not handle them.

Secretly, Mother Carmel would actually welcome orphans with wide open arms only to sell the most promising of them every two years to the World Government, that would in turn raise them into Marines or Cipher Pol agents.

entities.name: Tower of Justice
entities.description:
Enies Lobby was a World Government establishment located on a Paradise island where night never fell. It, along with Impel Down and Marineford, comprised the three major Government strongholds triangulating the Tarai Current via the Gates of Justice.

Reputed worldwide as the , Enies Lobby hosted both CP9 headquarters and the (mostly ceremonial) courthouse for processing Impel Down sentences. These were attended by a mixed garrison of Cipher Pol agents, Marines, and special personnel, totaling some 10,000 troops in all.

After a combined attack from Straw Hat Pirates, the Galley-La Company and the Franky Family—which inadvertently triggered a full-scale Buster Call—the island was completely annihilated, and left in ruins. It is unknown if anything has been rebuilt since.

It was the main setting of the Enies Lobby Arc.

entities.name: Walrus School
entities.description:
The Walrus School is an elementary school and the main educational institution of Elbaph, hosted in the Warrior's Spring alongside the neighboring Owl Library and southwest of Western Village. Giant children between the ages of 18–36 (6–12 in human years) attend the school in order to learn about different subjects and socialize with other children.

It was founded 20 years ago by Jaguar D. Saul under the request of the late King of Elbaph, Harald.

The Walrus School is an immense structure built on Branch Route 8, which rises from the Warrior's Spring coast and has boardwalk stairs built along its body so people can access the main building. The Owl Library is located just next to it, on an adjacent branch.

The school overall resembles an open treehouse, with two large central platforms (where most of the school's facilities are located) surrounded by several smaller structures, which are held aloft by hanging ropes tied to other parts of the branch. Some of those structures resemble playground swings while others spherical huts.

entities.name: Drum Rockies
entities.description:
The Drum Rockies are a chain of drum-shaped mountains on Drum Island.

The Drum Rockies are the namesake of Drum Island thanks to their drum-like format. Because of their steepness, climbing the mountain is extremely difficult, but not impossible for people with superhuman endurance or animals adapted to vertical climbing. Lapahns are known to live in the hills at the base of the Drum Rockies, where they might start avalanches if provoked.

The tallest of the Drum Rockies is called . According to Dr. Kureha, the peak plateau of Drum Rock lies more than a staggering 5000 meters above sea level.

The Drum Castle is where the royalty of Drum Island once lived, being located at the summit of Drum Rock. After Wapol departed his kingdom to escape the Blackbeard Pirates, Kureha took the place over for herself, turning it into her new home.

entities.description:
Kamigata is a nation somewhere in the West.

The Kamigata is a western nation known for its distinctive regional dialect, as mentioned by Brook in the past.

Not much is known about Kamigata, but it appears to have its own linguistic trends. Brook states that the phrase Mindja Own Beeswax originates in Kamigata.

Little is known about Yano Country, but it is described as a "rougher version of Wano Country".

73 years ago, Shiki was born in the Yano Country. At least 48 years ago, he left the country to become a pirate, developing a reputation as a pirate-yakuza.

entities.name: Gyasta
entities.description:
Gyasta is a town located in Drum Island. It was only mentioned as one of Kureha's stops, and a sign pointing to it was shown.

Gyasta is a lakeside town north of Cocoa Weed. Because it borders a lake, ice skating is the most popular activity in this town.

On the outskirts of Gyasta, there is a huge tree that once served as Kureha's home and also the place where she performed her medical examinations.

When King Wapol fled from Drum after the Blackbeard Pirates ravaged the country, Kureha moved out to Drum Castle at some point. The tree, however, was not completely abandoned as a long white rope was tied between it and somewhere atop the Drum Rockies. By running along this ropeway while pulling Kureha's sleigh, Tony Tony Chopper could freely transport her back and forth through both locations.

entities.description:
San Faldo is one of the island cities in Paradise connected to Water 7 via the Sea Train. It is known as the .

San Faldo was connected to Water 7 fourteen years ago with the Sea Train to help with trade, which was very weak at the time due to pirate attacks on merchant ships.

During the Straw Hats' stay in Water 7, Nico Robin mentions that there was a costume party taking place in San Faldo.

entities.name: Suiren
entities.description:
Suiren (Chinese: 燧人, Pinyin: Suìrén, "Fire-maker"), also known as Suihuang (燧皇, Suìhuáng, "The Great Fire-maker"), in Chinese mythology is credited with introducing fire-making to humans.

Whether Suiren was a single individual or a community (燧人氏, Suìrénshì, "Fire-makers"), and whether he used wood-drilling (鑽木取火) or flint-striking (擊石取火) to make fire—the accounts vary. He is included firstly on some lists of Three August Ones (三皇).

Tradition holds that he ruled over China for 110 years. He is sometimes identified as the father of Fuxi (伏羲) through his wife Huaxu (華胥). His legendary capital is associated with Shangqiu in Henan.

entities.name: Drum Kingdom
entities.description:
The Sakura Kingdom (literally meaning "Cherry Blossom Kingdom"), formerly the , is a kingdom located on Drum Island. This is where the Straw Hats' doctor (Chopper) came from. The kingdom is well-known for its extraordinary and skilled doctors.

When the Sakura Kingdom was the Drum Kingdom, it was ruled by the royal family of Drum Island. It once had a kind ruler, and many of the greatest doctors on the Grand Line. But when the king died, and his son (Wapol) came into power, things took a turn for the worse. Wapol issued that the twenty best doctors (the Isshi-20) work exclusively for him, while the rest of the doctors were banished or killed.

Then, the Blackbeard Pirates came and invaded the island, and Wapol fled in fear. Since then, Drum Island was left without a ruling government, and Dr. Kureha took residence in his castle. When Wapol came back to try to retake his kingdom, it was also the same time when the Straw Hat Pirates landed on the island, looking for a doctor to help sick Nami. Wapol then tried to destroy Dr. Hiriluk's flag which was standing on top of Drum Castle. In response to this, Luffy used Gomu Gomu no Bazooka to knock Wapol out of the kingdom.

After Wapol was blown away by Luffy, the people of the kingdom decided to make Dalton the king, who decided to erase the bitter effect of Wapol's actions by renaming the kingdom "Sakura" in memory of Dr. Hiriluk and his goal of using the sakura to cure all diseases of the heart. The new kingdom also uses Dr. Hiriluk's Jolly Roger as the flag.

entities.name: Shikkearu Kingdom
entities.description:
The Kuraigana Island is a dark and gloomy place somewhere in the Grand Line. It was once the home of the now fallen , as well as the ex-Warlord of the Sea Dracule Mihawk. Roronoa Zoro was sent here by Bartholomew Kuma following the Celestial Dragon Hit-and-Run Incident, and spent two years on the island honing his skills.

Kuraigana Island is a densely forested island usually shrouded in fog beneath an overcast sky. The island also has several mountain-like hills with peaks that curl inward, with other structures visible around those hills. Almost all manmade structures on the island are in ruins, the most notable exception being the castle in the center of the island, built partially atop a small lake.

Long ago, Kuraigana Island was home to the Shikkearu Kingdom. But nine years before the current storyline, a terrible war was fought, resulting in the complete collapse of the kingdom and leaving most of its structures in ruins, save for one lone castle. The Humandrills inhabiting the forest, gifted with the capability of learning from humans, watched the conflict, learned how to fight using weapons, and became fearsome fighters.

At some point after the war's end, Mihawk arrived on this island and made the castle his home. Four years before the current storyline, Kuma briefly traveled to this island in search for a cure for his daughter's disease.

entities.name: Bunt Kingdom
entities.description:
The Bunt Kingdom is a country in the New World.

The Bunt Kingdom is located on what appears to be a medium- to large-sized island, with many mountains towards its inland section. The kingdom's capital, including its castle, a wide spread of houses, and a large circus, is located near the island's shore. The shore near the capital appears to be comprised entirely of a cliff's edge, standing taller than the average human ship.

Bunt architecture seems to be based on traditional European building methods such as , with most of the ordinary houses build out of timber. The giants of Elbaph noted that the kingdom's methods of construction were completely different from their own.

The Bunt Kingdom was praised for their spices and hardy yet fine fabric.

entities.name: Kamabakka Kingdom
entities.description:
Momoiro Island is an island in Paradise. It is located close to the Lulusia Kingdom. The island is filled with pink animals and plants. It is home to the , a place where "those with a heart of a maiden" gather. The name of the kingdom literally translates to "full of transvestites", which is exactly what the island is filled with. Sanji was sent to this island by Bartholomew Kuma during the events of Sabaody Archipelago Arc, but still spent two years on the island honing his skills.

The leader of the island is the revolutionary "Queen" Emporio Ivankov, who escaped from Impel Down's level 5.5 and returned to the island with a crew of newkama.

After the destruction of Baltigo, the Revolutionary Army moved their base of operations to this island.

The island and its inhabitants are just as well known as the legendary island of Amazon Lily. While Amazon Lily is comprised only of women who also performs men roles (similar to the Amazons of lore), Momoiro is filled only with queer people who behave similar to women. Even the animals are queer. Nevertheless, like its counterpart, the island's population seems to be comprised of powerful fighters who abide and appear to be totally comfortable with their lifestyle, mostly due to their famous power-enhancing Attack Cuisine. The Okama inhabitants held the Revolutionary Army in utmost respect and esteem due to Ivankov's membership, particularly the top executives Morley and Betty, whom they address with the honorific sama and was excited to see them gather.

entities.name: Pepe Kingdom
entities.description:
The Pepe Kingdom is a kingdom located somewhere in the world. It is extremely impoverished, as it is said that a thousand of its citizens die of hunger each year.

Very little of the Pepe Kingdom has been seen. It appears to have a barren terrain with its buildings being very shoddy, a testament to its destitution.

The Pepe Kingdom has a noted history of poverty and destitution with it being said that it loses a thousand citizens each year to hunger. When the Cross Guild was founded under Buggy, Crocodile, and Dracule Mihawk and started offering monetary bounties for Marines, one Pepe citizen was desperate enough to kill Vice Admiral T Bone which allowed him to feed his family with the reward and welcomed to join Cross Guild.

Kenzan Island is an island somewhere in Paradise, where the is located.

This place seems to be the homeland of the Longarm Tribe, having Chinese-like constructions, and valleys between mountains that have a sword shape, and the island itself is surrounded by whirlpools.

This is where the Longarm Tribe had taken Brook and put him on display. While the Longarms in Kenzan witnessed the living skeleton through in his cage, Brook was able to obtain a newspaper to learn of Luffy's exploits. After that, Brook decided to start a concert to the island's inhabitants.

The population of Kenzan island were among the watchers of Vegapunk's worldwide broadcast.

entities.name: Warland Kingdom
entities.description:
Elbaph is a nation in the New World that is inhabited by giants, and is unaffiliated with the World Government. Officially, contains the , but the nation is commonly referred to by the general term "Elbaph".

Elbaph has always been a fiercely independent nation renowned for its warmongering culture; it is considered to be the strongest country in the world due to its mighty warriors. During the past century, King Harald sought to shift Elbaph's culture to prioritize scholarship and diplomacy, and pursued affiliation with the World Government. However, the government solely valued Elbaph for its fighting power, creating conflicts that resulted in Harald's death. In the present day, the World Government is actively attempting to annex Elbaph by force. Nerona Imu has equated Elbaph's defiance with the Will of D.

It was first mentioned during the Little Garden Arc and was a desired destination of both Luffy and Usopp. It was shown for the first time in a flashback during the Whole Cake Island Arc.

It is the primary setting of the Elbaph Arc.

entities.name: Milky Road
entities.description:
Milky Roads (literally translated as "River of Clouds") are artificial routes in Skypiea, manufactured from clouds. One leads from the Heaven's Gate up to the White-White Sea.

Another connects Angel Island to the Upper Yard and then flows along the whole Upper Yard. People travel through the Milky Roads like through a river, usually using Dial-powered vessels. Milky Dials are also capable of fashioning Milky Roads, which the White Berets use to subdue criminals.

After the timeskip, Nami is able to create these using her Sorcery Clima-Tact.

entities.name: Pumpkin Cafe
entities.description:
The Pumpkin Cafe is a new restaurant that opened in Skypiea during the two year timeskip.

Sometime after the defeat of Enel, the Pumpkin Cafe was opened for business. It is unknown who the founder is, but both Raki and Conis are working here as waitresses and cooks. Known customers include McKinley and Pagaya.

Pumpkins, being a popular fruit in Skypiea since its introduction, is the main ingredient of the food served in this cafe, hence the establishment's name. It is famous for its pumpkin noodles.

In keeping with the pumpkin theme, the bowls and cups are in the shape of pumpkins. Small tables, enough for two seats, are the standard seating arrangements for the restaurant.

Wagomuland is an amusement park that opened in Skypiea during the two-year timeskip. It is a very popular place to visit. Its name, basis, and creation are due to Usopp introducing rubber bands to the Skypieans during his time there.

Wagomuland opened on Skypiea, and Amazon, Aisa, and Nola all became employees. Amazon took a job collecting the entrance fee (30,000,000), and Aisa became a cloud balloon vendor. Nola joined the park as part of the "Nola Bungee."

entities.name: Nebulandia
entities.description:
Nebulandia is a non-canon island in the New World and a Marine base. It is also known as the "Island of Fog".

The island possesses a massive caldera, with several rocky outcrops, which the Marines converted into outposts. The basin of the caldera is below sea level. Around the center of the caldera is a volcano-shaped geyser, that continuously spews out sea water. When night falls, the geyser in the middle of the island spews a mist of seawater, which settles in the caldera's basin. This mist nullifies all Devil Fruit powers. As pointed out by Komei, Nebulandia is a bad place for people with Devil Fruit abilities to enter.

The island contains a vine-like plant which feeds on sea water. As such it possesses the properties of Seastone. For unknown reasons, the plant is triggered by Devil Fruit users and will try to wrap around them, which will weaken them.

Komei captured Zoro, Sanji, Porche, and Hamburg and took them to this island, and the other Straw Hat Pirates as well as Foxy and Kansho went to rescue them. Komei nearly succeeded in capturing all the Straw Hats and nearly killing Luffy. However, Brook, Chopper, and the other Foxy Pirates came to the rescue, along with Kinoconda, whom they befriended on Kinoko Island. The pirates fought off the Marines, with the giant Kinoconda causing massive damage to the outpost, whilst Luffy faced off against Komei. During their battle, Komei, in a move of desperation, broke the caldera walls to let sea water in, in order to weaken the Devil Fruit users, though this completely wrecked the base. However Luffy, together with Foxy, managed to drain the sea water, before the Straw Hat captain defeated Komei with his Gomu Gomu no Red Hawk. The pirates then left Nebulandia, returning to Kinoko Island.

entities.name: New Marineford
entities.description:
New Marineford is an island in the New World that currently contains Marine Headquarters. It formerly contained the Marine Base G-1 until after the Summit War of Marineford, when Fleet Admiral Sakazuki switched the bases' locations.

Little is known about the geography surrounding the Headquarters, but part of it appears to be rocky. Small bubbles populate the air, similar to those produced by the Yarukiman Mangrove in the Sabaody Archipelago.

The Marine Headquarters is built in a mainly western style, in contrast to the one on Marineford which resembled ancient Japanese architecture. The biggest feature of the base is two massive arches that converge on the center of it. The base is surrounded by a circular stone wall lined with turrets, and rising above the wall from within it is a stone tower that has the Headquarters surrounded by a circular wall on top of it. The main Headquarters building has an ancient Japanese design just like the one on Marineford, with a large entrance and a pagoda-shaped upper structure.

After being promoted to Fleet Admiral, Sakazuki moved Marine Headquarters to New Marineford, and the G-1 Marine Base on this island was relocated to Marineford.

entities.name: Promise Land
entities.description:
Promise Land is a non-canon island in the New World ruled by Marine Vice Admiral Wilder.

Promise Land's geography is similar to the structure of 's stage.

Wilder and Pokke are stationed on Promise Land, and Pokke's unnamed father also resides there.

On Promise Land, keeping a promise is considered more important than life.

entities.short_description: Promise Land is a non-canon island in the New World ruled by Marine Vice Admiral Wilder.

entities.name: Clockwork Island
entities.description:
The Clockwork Island is the main setting and non-canon location of Clockwork Island Adventure, the second One Piece movie. Though the island itself is small, there is a tall tower at the center that supports a large city. The most important part of the island is the "key" that supports the city's weight. When it was destroyed, the city collapsed and fell into the ocean. Thankfully, all of the citizens escaped with parachutes and declared that they would build a new city closer to the ground. The city was built so high in the sky in order to protect them from enemy attacks.

entities.name: Crescent Island
entities.description:
Crescent Island is an island in the Polestar Islands in the East Blue.

It appears in Set Sail Pirate Crew!, where it acts as one of the locations visited by the Set Sail Pirates.

Befitting its name, Crescent Island is shaped like a crescent moon, with water filling its center. It has a gate where the crescent opens into the ocean, and a village directly opposite it.

After kidnapping Nami from Gonarock Island, Skullface sailed to Crescent Island. He dropped her off on the island, assuring her it was safe, and left.

entities.name: Farce Island
entities.description:
Farce Island is an island in the East Blue. It appears in Set Sail Pirate Crew!.

Farce Island is a large, mostly sand-covered island. It has little vegetation, mostly clustered along its shores, with palms trees dotted across the land. Additonally, the island contains many individual rocky mountains spread across it, with small forests clustered around them. It hosts at least two lighthouses, as well as many standalone buildings such as towers and shops.

The island is large enough to have wide rivers full enclossed within the island. They are so large, in fact, that standalone islands exist fully contained within them.

It is located between Dawn Island and the Grand Line.

entities.short_description: Farce Island is an island in the East Blue. It appears in Set Sail Pirate Crew!.

entities.name: Gold Island
entities.description:
The Gold Island is the island where Woonan lived and died. Woonan was famed to have hidden all of his treasures there, but in fact he returned all the gold he stole to its original owners before passing away.

Gold Island is small and relatively uninhabited, with no known civilizations or communities found native to the island. It is mostly covered in normal deciduous greenery and some rocky areas. Other than its few landmarks, there is nothing remarkable about Gold Island's structure.

The only known inhabitants of the island were Woonan and Ganzo when they were kids.

entities.name: Gonarock Island
entities.description:
Gonarock Island is an island in the Conomi Islands in the East Blue.

It appears in Set Sail Pirate Crew!, where it acts as one of the locations visited by the Set Sail Pirates.

Gonarock Island is a large, roughly circular island, with a massive waterway that connects to the ocean and spreads throughout the island like a maze. It is surrounded by floating debris, making it hard to access; despite this, it is a hub for seafaring vessels of all kinds, and the island proper is dotted with cannons.

Near the center of the island, there is a deep cave, which Arlong used as a temporary hideout after his defeat in Cocoyasi Village.

entities.name: Hyoutan Island
entities.description:
Hyoutan Island is a small island in the Conomi Islands in the East Blue.

It appears in Set Sail Pirate Crew!, where it acts as one of the locations visited by the Set Sail Pirates.

Hyoutan Island is a small, gourd-shaped island, befitting its name. It has a small mountain range on one end and a singular mountain on the other, with a village situated between them.

Somewhere on the island is an owl shopkeeper, who is the only known seller of Resistant Tar.

entities.name: Pescatore Island
entities.description:
Pescatore Island is an island in the East Blue.

It appears in Set Sail Pirate Crew!, where it acts as one of the locations visited by the Set Sail Pirates.

Pescatore Island is a large, grassy island, composed primarily of flatlands. It has a few small beaches spread across its coastline, and a few small, rocky hills towards its center.

It is located southeast of Syrup Village, past the Kinoko Islands.

entities.name: Tabetsukusare Island
entities.description:
Tabetsukusare Island is a non-canon island in the East Blue. It appears in Chopperman.

Tabetsukusare Island is surrounded by sheer cliffs on all sides, with large rock spikes sticking out and curving upwards. The entire island is covered in dense forest.

After Wapoln attacked the island, parts of the forest have large bite marks, though they were later covered in flowers by Robiflowan.

The island is also home to a particularly rare flower that grows along its border.

entities.short_description: Tabetsukusare Island is a non-canon island in the East Blue. It appears in Chopperman.

entities.name: Tony-Tony Island
entities.description:
Tony-Tony Island is a non-canon island in the East Blue. It is the home island of Chopperman in the Chopperman manga.

The island is also home to the Cross Power.

Chopperman's hideout is located on Tony-Tony Island, and is where Chopperman and Namifia live and work. It's exact location is unclear.

After Spanda attempted to kidnap Giant Luffy Bomber and left money on the island, Namifia upgraded the hideout.

entities.short_description: Tony-Tony Island is a non-canon island in the East Blue. It is the home island of Chopperman in the Chopperman manga.

entities.name: Warship Island
entities.description:
Warship Island, also known as "Battleship Island", is one of the anime-only places visited in the Warship Island Arc. The island, which is in the shape of a battleship, is where the Sennenryu, a thought-to-be extinct race of dragons that live for 1000 years, come to die and be reborn.

The Dragon's Nest is an area found underneath Warship Island. It rises from the ocean every 1000 years, during which time the Sennenryu gather to give birth and die.

entities.name: Applenine Island
entities.description:
Applenine Island is an island in the New World and one of the three islands neighboring the country of Dressrosa.

The island was shown to have houses with a roof in the shape of an apple, befitting the island's name. The houses were shown to be covered in snow and the citizens were wearing winter clothing.

The most distinct geographic feature of the island is the colossal apple in its center, which dwarfs the nearby mountains. There are five smaller apples around its base, and three more around its top, near the stem, making nine in total.

After the fall of Donquixote Doflamingo and his regime, Vice Admiral Maynard broadcast a message to all three islands neighboring the country of Dressrosa. When the message was shown in Applenine Island, the citizens were afraid of Doflamingo's regime. They were astonished to see the island's state, and again when Admiral Fujitora knelt and apologized to the former king, Riku Doldo III.

entities.name: Broc Coli Island
entities.description:
Broc Coli Island is an island in the New World.

A war-struck land, fighting on Broc Coli Island was fueled by Donquixote Doflamingo's weapons trade, and later concluded by the hiring of Germa 66.

The island is very heavily forested, with the tallest trees resembling broccoli, giving the island its name. There exists at least one big city that has been damaged by war. Several of these tall, broccoli-shaped trees can be seen scattered across the island, alongside giant mounds and cliffs.

It is located about two days away from Whole Cake Island when traveling by ship.

entities.name: Elbaph
entities.description:
Elbaph is a nation in the New World that is inhabited by giants, and is unaffiliated with the World Government. Officially, contains the , but the nation is commonly referred to by the general term "Elbaph".

Elbaph has always been a fiercely independent nation renowned for its warmongering culture; it is considered to be the strongest country in the world due to its mighty warriors. During the past century, King Harald sought to shift Elbaph's culture to prioritize scholarship and diplomacy, and pursued affiliation with the World Government. However, the government solely valued Elbaph for its fighting power, creating conflicts that resulted in Harald's death. In the present day, the World Government is actively attempting to annex Elbaph by force. Nerona Imu has equated Elbaph's defiance with the Will of D.

It was first mentioned during the Little Garden Arc and was a desired destination of both Luffy and Usopp. It was shown for the first time in a flashback during the Whole Cake Island Arc.

It is the primary setting of the Elbaph Arc.

entities.short_description: Elbaph is a nation in the New World that is inhabited by giants, and is unaffiliated with the World Government. Officially, contains the , but the nation is commonly referred to by the general term "Elbaph".

entities.name: Enishi
entities.description:
Enishi is an island located in the New World. It is a non-affiliated nation, independent of the World Government, and is historically notable for having provided crucial aid to the giant kingdom of Elbaph during a severe famine.

Enishi is characterized by high coastal cliffs and a sprawling, verdant mountain range. The island's primary port lies along the coastline and is distinguished by numerous wooden homes built seamlessly into the craggy landscape. Several docks extend into the water.

63 years ago, Enishi played a pivotal role in supporting Elbaph during a devastating famine, responding to a diplomatic appeal from King Harald. The aid provided by Enishi and other nations helped sustain the giant kingdom through this difficult period.

At least 42 years ago, Enishi faced direct interference from the World Government. A group of agents was dispatched to the island for reasons that remain unknown, taking several residents hostage. By coincidence, King Harald had returned to the area at the same time, seeking to repay the island's previous generosity. When Harald confronted the agents and protested their treatment of Enishi's citizens, the lead agent warned him to stay out of the matter, citing potential political repercussions for Elbaph's relationship with the World Government. The situation escalated when the agent shot one of the hostages, prompting Harald to leap from his ship and destroy the assailants' vessel. While Harald's actions succeeded in saving Enishi's people, his defiance of the World Government led to a series of government-sanctioned publications that tarnished his reputation.

entities.name: Karai Bari Island
entities.description:
Karai Bari Island is an island in the New World which was occupied by Buggy's Delivery, which has since integrated into the Cross Guild.

The island is dotted with palm trees, and has mountains in the background. The pirate dispatch organization Buggy's Delivery has set up a large town named which resembles a gathering of circus tents. This Town is now the base of operation for the new organization, Cross Guild.

At an unknown point during the timeskip, the Buggy and Alvida Alliance set up a Pirate Dispatch Company, the Buggy's Delivery on the island, and it appears to have become their base of operations.

When the Seven Warlords system was abolished, the island became surrounded by Marine battleships who were sent to apprehend Buggy and his crew. However, Crocodile came and sank the fleet, intending to have Buggy repay a huge loan in order to start his new company, the Cross Guild. Buggy, having no money to pay, offered to have his own company integrate into the upcoming one, but his overzealous followers distributed a flyer with Buggy as the foremost member of the Guild. Although displeased at first, Crocodile and Dracule Mihawk agreed to use Buggy as a figurehead leader, thus transforming the base of operation for Buggy's Delivery to that of Cross Guild's.

entities.short_description: Karai Bari Island is an island in the New World which was occupied by Buggy's Delivery, which has since integrated into the Cross Guild.

entities.name: Raijin Island
entities.description:
Raijin Island is one of the three islands in the New World which someone has to travel to if they are following their Log Pose after passing through the Red Line via Fish-Man Island.

The only known resident is Kasa, though in the anime she was accompanied by some other people in cloaks.

When the Roger Pirates went to the New World after visiting Fish-Man Island, their first stop was on Raijin Island. Kouzuki Oden and an unnamed member of the crew were seen getting electrocuted by the lightning of the Island.

Raijin Island was first seen as a stop for the Fallen Monk Pirates in the New World. Intimidated by the island's endless lightnings, Urouge was approached by Kasa, who offered to sell him an umbrella.

entities.short_description: Raijin Island is one of the three islands in the New World which someone has to travel to if they are following their Log Pose after passing through the Red Line via Fish-Man Island.

entities.name: Winner Island
entities.description:
Winner Island is a New World island northeast of Wano Country.

Winner Island is a rocky island with large geological formations that have rounded protrusions and sparsely placed trees. The sea level portion of the island looks to be densely forested, with a barren coast.

Winner Island is one of three islands that follow Wano Country in the New World, alongside Egghead and Elbaph.

Trafalgar D. Water Law selected the Northeastern route from Wano Country using a Log Pose, and his crew departed on course for Winner Island.
