entities.short_description: Winner Island is a New World island northeast of Wano Country.

entities.name: Zou
entities.description:
Zou is an island located on the back of a Naitamie-Norida elephant named Zunesha that roams the New World. It is known as a due to Log Poses being unable to point to it. It is home to the Mokomo Dukedom of the Mink Tribe as well as where the Heart Pirates resided while waiting for their captain to return from Dressrosa.

Zou is the third island visited by the Straw Hats in the New World, and it is the primary setting of the Zou Arc.

Zunesha is a massive, living, and sentient elephant; as a result, it cannot be tracked by a Log Pose or Eternal Pose like regular islands can, with only Vivre Cards as a way to track it. Having walked through the New World for over 1,000 years, Zunesha's body has been left damaged by time and the elements; its ears are torn, its eyes are sunken into its skull, and its skin is frail and weak. Its legs are very tall, making it difficult to scale the elephant and get onto the island.

The ground on Zou is made up of Zunesha's rough and rippled skin, which makes it difficult to traverse; Sanji's group was impeded by it after they arrived and were on the run from Kaidou's subordinates, and once Monkey D. Luffy's group arrived, they were similarly inconvenienced while walking on the paths of elephant skin. The ground also has strange trees sporting spherical formations of scale-like leaves growing from it.

entities.name: Banaro Island
entities.description:
Banaro Island is an island that was ransacked by Blackbeard and his crew. The island is very close to Water 7, but is not part of the Sea Train route.

This island is known to have huge rocks that face up in different directions called . It was situated near the town where the Ace vs. Blackbeard fight occurred. It was destroyed during the battle.

There was an unnamed town on the island where Ace finally encountered Blackbeard after his long search. The town had an old Wild West theme. It was destroyed by Blackbeard when he decided to show off his Yami Yami no Mi powers to Ace.

Portgas D. Ace eventually found Blackbeard, and a huge fight soon ensued. The citizens evacuated to the outskirts of the island and could only watch as their town was destroyed. Blackbeard showed Ace the powers he was given by the Yami Yami no Mi. The island is where Ace was defeated, and then soon handed over to the Marines. The island's fate is unknown, but the incident was later referred to as the Duel at Banaro Island.

entities.short_description: Banaro Island is an island that was ransacked by Blackbeard and his crew. The island is very close to Water 7, but is not part of the Sea Train route.

entities.name: Cactus Island
entities.description:
Cactus Island is an island in Paradise. It is the first island in the Grand Line visited by the Straw Hat Pirates and the setting of the Whisky Peak Arc.

On Cactus Island there are several rock mountains with multiple graves on top. The shape of the mountains, along with the tombstones, gives the mountains the appearance of giant cacti.

There is a river flowing through the island, allowing ships to dock inland.

Whisky Peak is the only town on Cactus Island and the home of all of its inhabitants.

entities.short_description: Cactus Island is an island in Paradise. It is the first island in the Grand Line visited by the Straw Hat Pirates and the setting of the Whisky Peak Arc.

entities.name: Drum Island
entities.description:
Drum Island is a Winter Island in Paradise. It is the location of the Sakura Kingdom, formerly known as the Drum Kingdom; the birthplace of Tony Tony Chopper, the doctor of the Straw Hat Pirates; and the setting of the Drum Island Arc.

It was the third island on the Grand Line visited by the Straw Hats.

The local kingdom of Drum Island was formerly known as the Drum Kingdom, and was ruled by Wapol's family. During Wapol's reign, he fled the country after an attack from the Blackbeard Pirates, leaving the kingdom without a ruler. Wapol later tried to return and take the kingdom back by force but was defeated by Monkey D. Luffy. Dalton was then elected king by the population.

The kingdom is famous for having some of the best doctors in the Grand Line, with most of them forming the Isshi-100, currently led by Kureha.

entities.name: Jaya
entities.description:
Jaya is a lawless island in Paradise popular with pirates. 400 years ago, it—with more than twice its current landmass—was the homeland of the Shandia.

Canonically, it is the fifth place visited by the Straw Hat Pirates on the Grand Line and the main setting of the Jaya Arc.

Jaya consists mostly of tropical rainforests inhabited by gigantic insects and the elusive South Birds. The island itself has the shape of a jagged "U".

In truth, Jaya's landmass was physically halved some 400 years ago. Originally, Jaya was in the shape of a skull, with current Jaya featuring just the skull's "jaws". Due to over half of it being launched into the White-White Sea by the Knock Up Stream (which was possible due to seismic activity shattering the island's crust), only the part that made up the skull's mouth remains. The Shandia civilization once inhabited Jaya, but them and their legendary city were shot up in the sky alongside Upper Yard.

entities.short_description: Jaya is a lawless island in Paradise popular with pirates. 400 years ago, it—with more than twice its current landmass—was the homeland of the Shandia.

entities.name: Karakuri Island
entities.description:
Karakuri Island is an island somewhere in Paradise on which resides the . It was first featured in Enel's cover story. This is where Dr. Tsukimi built his own automata. The country specializes in advanced technology, such as cyborgs and mechanical structures. As such, it is hailed as the "Future Country" and the birthplace of the genius, Vegapunk. After Bartholomew Kuma sent him to the island, Franky spent two years studying Vegapunk's technology.

When Vegapunk lived on the island in his youth, he created a laboratory that housed many experiments, most of which were never finished. His lab and everything inside is considered a treasure of mankind and is more valuable than money, guarded by the Marines. Vegapunk modified the local animals into cyborgs, such as beetles, lions, gorillas, and snakes to use as a labor force to build an in-ground heating system for the island's people. He was never able to finish it due to his young age as well as a lack of the skills and funding necessary to make it a reality. It is visible from the island as two giant bolts lodged in the mountain. Because of this, the people found his kindness to be all the warmth they need.

At some point, Dr. Tsukimi built his own automata, Spacey, Cosmo, Galaxy, and Macro, while living on Karakuri Island. The five were enjoying dumplings while watching the moon. When part of it blew up, Tsukimi died and was buried by his automata there, and the four of them traveled to the moon vowing to avenge their fallen creator.

Bartholomew Kuma visited the island during his journey to find a cure for his daughter, Jewelry Bonney.

entities.name: Kenzan Island
entities.description:
Kenzan Island is an island somewhere in Paradise, where the is located.

This place seems to be the homeland of the Longarm Tribe, having Chinese-like constructions, and valleys between mountains that have a sword shape, and the island itself is surrounded by whirlpools.

This is where the Longarm Tribe had taken Brook and put him on display. While the Longarms in Kenzan witnessed the living skeleton through in his cage, Brook was able to obtain a newspaper to learn of Luffy's exploits. After that, Brook decided to start a concert to the island's inhabitants.

The population of Kenzan island were among the watchers of Vegapunk's worldwide broadcast.

entities.name: Kuraigana Island
entities.description:
The Kuraigana Island is a dark and gloomy place somewhere in the Grand Line. It was once the home of the now fallen , as well as the ex-Warlord of the Sea Dracule Mihawk. Roronoa Zoro was sent here by Bartholomew Kuma following the Celestial Dragon Hit-and-Run Incident, and spent two years on the island honing his skills.

Kuraigana Island is a densely forested island usually shrouded in fog beneath an overcast sky. The island also has several mountain-like hills with peaks that curl inward, with other structures visible around those hills. Almost all manmade structures on the island are in ruins, the most notable exception being the castle in the center of the island, built partially atop a small lake.

Long ago, Kuraigana Island was home to the Shikkearu Kingdom. But nine years before the current storyline, a terrible war was fought, resulting in the complete collapse of the kingdom and leaving most of its structures in ruins, save for one lone castle. The Humandrills inhabiting the forest, gifted with the capability of learning from humans, watched the conflict, learned how to fight using weapons, and became fearsome fighters.

At some point after the war's end, Mihawk arrived on this island and made the castle his home. Four years before the current storyline, Kuma briefly traveled to this island in search for a cure for his daughter's disease.

entities.name: Kyuka Island
entities.description:
Kyuka Island is an island located in Paradise. It is where Mr. 3 and Miss Goldenweek took their days off when they were not on missions.

Kyuka Island is a tropical island with several buildings, including hotels. On the mountain in the center of the island, there is a large tree with an umbrella-shaped cup and a building on top. The islands architecture features many archways, balconies, and swimming pools.

Mr. 3 and Miss Goldenweek were vacationing on Kyuka Island for a few days when they received orders to take out Vivi and the Straw Hat Pirates after Mr. 5 failed to do so.

After leaving Little Garden, Miss Goldenweek, Mr. 5 and Miss Valentine were dropped on the island by the pterodactyl Miss Goldenweek had controlled using Colors Trap. A little roughed up, the three wander the island, but when Miss Goldenweek tries to buy them ice cream cones, Mr. 5 and Miss Valentine's Day notice that there are Marines on the island. Hina, Fullbody, and Jango were vacationing on the island while hunting for Mr. 3.

entities.name: Momoiro Island
entities.description:
Momoiro Island is an island in Paradise. It is located close to the Lulusia Kingdom. The island is filled with pink animals and plants. It is home to the , a place where "those with a heart of a maiden" gather. The name of the kingdom literally translates to "full of transvestites", which is exactly what the island is filled with. Sanji was sent to this island by Bartholomew Kuma during the events of Sabaody Archipelago Arc, but still spent two years on the island honing his skills.

The leader of the island is the revolutionary "Queen" Emporio Ivankov, who escaped from Impel Down's level 5.5 and returned to the island with a crew of newkama.

After the destruction of Baltigo, the Revolutionary Army moved their base of operations to this island.

The island and its inhabitants are just as well known as the legendary island of Amazon Lily. While Amazon Lily is comprised only of women who also performs men roles (similar to the Amazons of lore), Momoiro is filled only with queer people who behave similar to women. Even the animals are queer. Nevertheless, like its counterpart, the island's population seems to be comprised of powerful fighters who abide and appear to be totally comfortable with their lifestyle, mostly due to their famous power-enhancing Attack Cuisine. The Okama inhabitants held the Revolutionary Army in utmost respect and esteem due to Ivankov's membership, particularly the top executives Morley and Betty, whom they address with the honorific sama and was excited to see them gather.

entities.name: Namakura Island
entities.description:
Namakura Island is an island located somewhere in the Paradise region of the Grand Line. It is home to the nation of , also known as the . Brook was sent to this island by Bartholomew Kuma during the events on the Sabaody Archipelago.

The only location on Namakura Island mentioned is Harahettania, a kingdom including a Satan-worshiping tribe run by Pekkori.

Namakura Island is defined by a fairly barren landscape, with dry soil and grasslands, interrupted by numerous scattered clusters of jagged rocks and a few trees. Its architecture mainly features small, dilapidated buildings, constructed in the style of feudal Japan.

Namakura Island is a land ravaged by hardship and decay, and its people live in poverty. The turmoil in this country can be largely attributed to the actions of the Longarm Tribe. In desperation, the populace turned to a rite of demon-summoning, hoping thus to deliver themselves from their plight.

entities.name: Pants Hazard
entities.description:
Pants Hazard is a joke location created by a fan in the SBS and jokingly accepted by Oda. It is an island in Paradise located south of Karakuri Island that Vegapants, Vegapunk's cousin, originates from.

Little is known about Pants Hazard's geography, with what is known being composed entirely of a single town.

The town features a collection of small houses with underwear-shaped decorative pieces above each one, and a tower in the center of town. The tower is thin at the base with windows along its side until a large ring, before it continues in a thinner upper portion. It is topped with a large glass dome that is decorated with a recreation of a pair of women's underwear over its top.

Pants Hazard has a culture of everyone wearing women's underwear over the top of their head. This is a common enough practice that even grown men participate in it.

entities.name: Sandy Island
entities.description:
The Arabasta Kingdom is a desert kingdom in Paradise. It was the fourth place that the Straw Hat Pirates visited on the Grand Line, and the events here resulted in Luffy's bounty being raised to 100,000,000, and Zoro acquiring a bounty of 60,000,000.

It is where the poneglyph showing the location of Pluton is located, and one of the twenty founding countries of the World Government. It is ruled by the Nefertari Family, who, unlike the other families of the First Twenty, did not leave their home country to live in Mary Geoise.

Arabasta is an established kingdom with a long history. It is located on |Sandi Airando}}; roughly half-way through the first part of the Grand Line. Sandy Island is a Summer Island. It is arguably one of the largest islands the Straw Hats have visited in the Grand Line, containing several cities and towns and a massive river.

Arabasta's architecture is very similar to Egyptian, Ancient Egyptian, Las Vegas, Indian, Middle Eastern, and Moorish buildings. However, the styles vary between cities.

entities.name: Shipbuilding Island
entities.description:
Water 7, known as the and located on , is a city in Paradise known for its shipwrights. It is the main setting of the Water 7 Arc and Post-Enies Lobby Arc.

The Straw Hat Pirates stopped here to trade in their gold for belly, as well as to repair the Going Merry and also to find a new shipwright for their crew. It is part of the route their log was on, heading there directly after Long Ring Long Land, making it the eighth island in Paradise that they visited.

There are waterways and canals that are used for transportation almost like roads, often surrounded by sidewalks along the canals. Many citizens use Bulls, which are seahorse-like creatures that are attached to boats, to move around the city. Also, some shops rent bulls of various sizes, although they rarely rent King Bulls, as they are gigantic in size. There are 3 main types of bulls, of which the 2 smaller sizes are used for transport. The bulls are good to use because they can go up ramps of water and move about the city. Architecture is very colorful, often using a tan or peach color for the walls and roofs, which are many times red and semi-circular; nearly all the roofs are of red color and texture. The houses are tiered to allow for more houses to take up room and are usually made, keeping in mind the city sinks. Some canals are wide enough for ships, but those are mostly just to let some ships enter the city so they may be docked somewhere. The city resembles a giant fountain in a volcano shape because of the tiered system of building houses.

This is where Iceburg lives. It is probably the largest home on the island and is generally well protected. A fight occurred here between the Straw Hat Pirates and CP9, but CP9 quickly beat them since they were unprepared for battle, and CP9 were attempting to get away quickly on the Sea Train but could not find the blueprints they were looking for.

entities.name: Ukkari Hot-Spring Island
entities.description:
Ukkari Hot-Spring Island is a Paradise island, located somewhere in the proximity of the Arabasta Kingdom. It is where Gedatsu landed and resettled after being defeated in Skypiea.

Ukkari Hot-Spring Island is full of holes created by Goro, so he could build his hot spring resort. It has a forest with three odd-shaped trees and is connected to Arabasta via tunnels.

Dreaming of running a hot spring resort, Goro began digging holes around the island in order to find a hot spring. After Gedatsu landed on the island, he joined Goro in digging. They ended up finding the Dirt Boss, whom Gedatsu beat up and then got to dig the island for them. With the Dirt Boss's help, they finally reached hot water for the resort. They were then approached by the Forest Boss, whom Gedatsu also beat up. While the others left to continue digging a tunnel, the Forest Boss and his workers built the resort's structure.

This island was later linked to Yuba of Arabasta via a tunnel, and now both are connected because of the Hot Spring Resort that they run.

entities.name: Lodestar Island
entities.description:
Lodestar Island is the penultimate island in the Grand Line, and the last island in the New World that can be reached by any conventional Log Pose route.

All the different paths on the Grand Line ultimately meet at Lodestar Island. According to Inuarashi, travelers who reach the island become aware of the Poneglyphs, the civilization that created them, as well as the hidden final island of Laugh Tale.

Since the Roger Pirates were the first known people to visit Lodestar Island in 800 years, it is implied that reaching it is extremely difficult. Additionally, for some unknown reason, the Log Pose cannot reset and point toward the next island on Lodestar Island and instead the needles will just spin indefinitely.

Thirty-nine years ago, Gol D. Roger and his crew were able to reach this island. Upon reaching it, they somehow realized that there was one more island ahead, but the Log Pose was unable to register it. Roger then began a new journey to discovering the route to Laugh Tale.

It was first mentioned by Vice Admiral Smoker. Although it hasn't made an entry to the anime or manga, it has been briefly introduced.

entities.name: Alexandra
entities.description:
The Alexandra is a non-canon Marine ship which Drake used during his appearance in the 4th One Piece movie.

The Alexandra has a similar design to most Marine vessels. It has a green hull with brown lining. It also has an individualistic brown railing not commonly found on Marine vessels. It has two large masts and one smaller that have a total of five sails. In its interior, it has a technically advanced communications room.

The Alexandra was used by Drake when he was chasing the Straw Hat Pirates. It made a reappearance when Drake was shown at G-8 at the end of the Dead End Race.

entities.name: Escar
entities.description:
The Escar is the ship used by Rice Rice to sell Den-Den Company products.

The Escar is a large sea snail with a front mirror. The interior has enough space for Rice Rice and a large amount of inventory to fit, and it has a hatch door to get in and out.

The Escar is a living being, exhibiting emotion and sharing Rice Rice's fear of the Straw Hat Pirates.

Being a sea snail, Escar is able to move underwater and, having space inside himself, transport people and objects.

entities.name: H-1
entities.description:
The H-1 is an anime-only boat that Henzo designed.

The ship is a small, metal raft shaped like a bullet. It is yellow with green underneath, and has a red "H-1" painted on the front. The craft can also mount Henzo's Rainbow Mist tracking device on the back of it. The ship is pedal operated.

Henzo first used the H-1 to travel out to the sea to investigate the Tarielishin. When he found nothing on the ship, he said H-1 couldn't go to the Rainbow Mist, because she wasn't designed to be capable of going long distances.

entities.name: Lady Mary
entities.description:
The Lady Mary is an anime-only ship that the Alvida Pirates and Nami both tried to rob. The plan to loot the ship was thwarted by Luffy.

The Lady Mary is a large yellow and brown cruise ship. Inside the ship a large ballroom is seen. Its size is almost double the Miss Love Duck's.

The Lady Mary is staffed by a group of sailors wearing white-and-blue uniforms, led by a young male captain. Only three sailors and the captain appear, with two of the sailors being Shiro and Tomeo.

The Lady Mary was a luxury cruise ship, ferrying passengers between deserted islands to throw lavish parties. It appears the Buggy Pirates have stolen from the Lady Mary at one point, as the note in the safe that Nami found stated that Buggy had already stolen the treasure, and had the Buggy Pirates' Jolly Roger printed on it.

entities.description:
The Marubenny is a non-canon ship created as part of the Adventure of the Marubenny collaboration project and advertising campaign. Based on the general trading company Marubeni, the ship travels around the One Piece world, interacting with various locations and characters using Marubeni's technology.

The Marubenny is a normal-sized ship with two masts and a large "M" emblem as its figurehead. Its front mast bears the Marubeni logo and name, with the slogan "Global crossvalue platform" between them.

Its unique features tie into different parts of Marubeni's business:

The Marubenny first met the Straw Hat Pirates in the New World. Together, they installed floating offshore wind turbines.

entities.description:
The Pine Peak is an anime-only Marine ship stationed at the G-8 Base. It attempted to capture the Going Merry, but failed.

The Pine Peak has a green hull and brown lining, along with standard marine sails. Other than that, it has the appearance of normal Marine ships.

Originally stationed at G-8, the Pine Peak attempted to capture the Straw Hats onboard the Going Merry and after they attempted to escape Marine Base G-8, but was unable to catch them.

entities.name: Randolph Theater
entities.description:
Randolph Theater is a theater troupe that debuted in Episode Special 3. The troupe was owned by Randolph before his retirement.

Randolph's troupe were about to have their final performance as Randolph was going to reitre. However, three of the troupe's actors, including Lola decided to leave right before the final performance. With the loss of three actors, Luffy and his crew became actors to help the play go on.

However, during the intermission, the Marines led by Governor fired a cannonball at the ship and soon arrested Randolph. Lola, who resented the Randolph Theater for its marginal profits, planted weapons in the troupe's ship, and gave a false testimony that she and her fellow actors were forced by Randolph to smuggle illegal weapons or risk losing their jobs. The Straw Hat Pirates assisted in letting the play go on by fighting off the Marines. In the end the play is completed with Randolph acknowledging the pirates, with him even changing the ending as a newfound respect for the Straw Hat Pirates.

entities.description:
The Yamato Maru is Yamato's personal ship in One Piece School. It is one of .

The Yamato Maru is a small wooden boat with a hut in the center. It has the text written on the roof of the hut, and "Yamato Maru" written on the side of the ship.

At some point in the past, the Yamato Maru washed up on the shore of Onigashima Middle School. Yamato recovered the boat, disguising it as a cargo ship and naming it.

With the ship disguised, Yamato began using the Yamato Maru to sneak out of the school.

entities.name: Judicial Ship
entities.description:
The Judicial Ship was a traveling court that can judge a person anywhere in the world. It carried Jorge to sentence Tom to death in Enies Lobby. It was later destroyed by Spandam using the Battle Frankies as part of his plot against Tom.

The vessel was a large brown ship, with a similarly large courtroom within it. On the outside, there was a structure similar to the entrance to Enies Lobby. The ship had three large sails and flew the World Government flag on top of the crow's nest.

The ship came to judge Tom, but he was given a ten-year extension on his sentencing by Jorge in order to build the Sea Train. After the ten years were up, the ship was destroyed by Spandam who used Franky's Battle Frankies to blow it up, who pinned the blame on Tom and got him sentenced to death.

entities.description:
The Migohai Gaimika was Donquixote Mjosgard's personal ship.

The Migohai Gaimika was a large ship with four masts. The first mast had a single sail with the World Government's symbol printed on it, and the latter three had two large sails each. The figurehead of the ship was a smirking mouse or rat's head, wearing a crown. It had cannons lining its sides.

The masts were tall enough to be visible from most of the Ryugu Kingdom.

Mjosgard took the Migohai Gaimika to travel to Fish-Man Island in search of his escaped slaves. While sailing down, the ship was attacked by the Sea Floor's fauna, wrecking the ship and leaving Mjosgard as the only survivor.

entities.name: Orbit
entities.description:
Orbit was a cruise ship from East Blue. Sanji was a trainee chef aboard it.

The Orbit was a large cruise ship with four large rectangular main sails and a lateen sail in the back. The figurehead was a large bottle of wine with a cork in it. It also flew a flag. In the anime, the orbit is pink.

Thirteen years ago, the Orbit was docked at the East Blue nation of Cozia when it was attacked by Germa 66. After the assault commenced, a young Sanji escaped from the Germa Kingdom and boarded the Orbit, thereafter becoming a trainee chef.

Two years later, during one of its voyages, the Orbit was attacked by Zeff and his crew. However, before the pirates could celebrate their victory, a storm appeared and the Orbit, along with the Cooking George, was destroyed by a tidal wave, leaving Sanji and Zeff alive but stranded on a deserted rock.

entities.name: Shimashima Shopping
entities.description:
The Shimashima Shopping was a small ship personally owned by Sanji, normally stored at the Baratie. It was briefly used by Sanji, Luffy, and Yosaku to travel to the Conomi Islands—a journey it ultimately did not survive.

The Shimashima Shopping is a relatively small vessel, painted in green stripes, with apparently no armaments. It has a single deckhouse designed to look like an upside-down saucepan, which contains a fully-functional kitchen (complete with a chimney that is apparently built into the mast).

During the events of the Baratie Arc with Don Krieg, Nami had stolen the Going Merry. In order to find out the reason why she did so, Usopp, Johnny, Yosaku, and a heavily wounded Zoro set off after her. They discovered she is heading into Arlong's territory, Nami's home island. Sensing possible danger, Yosaku went back to the Baratie via panda shark to get Luffy. Upon Yosaku's arrival, Luffy decided to go to the island to aid his friends but was having problems doing so as he did not have a boat to use. That was when Sanji decided to join Luffy's crew as Luffy's cook. Sanji managed to get a boat for them to use, the boat used by the Baratie to stock on supplies.

While sailing towards their destination, Sanji prepared some food for Luffy and Yosaku dine on as the latter of the two explained the situation. The food, however, attracted the giant sea cow, Momoo who wanted to eat the food as well all those onboard the boat. The beast was easily defeated by Sanji for causing such a ruckus. After being subdued, Momoo was tied to the boat and forced to pull it the rest of the way. Due to some ridiculous steering by Luffy, Momoo crashed into the sea wall surrounding Nami's island and flung the little boat far into the island. The boat crashed into the forest, causing quite a mess and severely damaging it.

entities.name: St. Briss
entities.description:
The St. Briss was an exploration ship that came from the Briss Kingdom.

The St. Briss was a great, brown ship, rigged with three masts: two bearing twin sails, and a third set with a solitary sheet. Upon the foremost mast, the largest of the sails bore the ship's name, St. Briss., emblazoned boldly on the lower part of the topsail, while the lower, broader canvas displayed the royal emblem of its kingdom: a disc surrounded by a thin circle with four arrowheads emerging on each side. At the prow loomed the figurehead—a reptilian head, with its scaly neck arched forward and its jaws and teeth bared in a silent snarl. The teeth were also darkened with tar in accordance with that nation’s curious custom for their preservation.

The ship became a wreck and was ultimately destroyed by the assault of a giant sea turtle.

The St. Briss set sail from the Briss Kingdom 210 years ago. During the voyage, one of the crew members fell ill and died. Within a few years of setting sail, the ship made it to Skypiea, where the crew managed to acquire a Waver and a map of the nation. However, for unknown reasons, the ship and its crew were eventually condemned to Cloud Drifting, causing everyone on board to perish. Two centuries later, the prison cloud finally dissolved, sending the ship plummeting back to the Blue Sea.

entities.name: Swanda Express
entities.description:
The Swanda Express was a vessel crewed by Mr. 2 and his men during the Arabasta Saga.

Built with a swan theme, the ship had a swan's head and was white in color. Another feature were hand operated paddle wheels. Its size is similar to the Going Merry. The Swanda has "Okama Way" (おかま道) written on the sail, as well as written in English on the ship itself, although the English says "Kama Way".

After the defeat of Baroque Works, Mr. 2 made up with the Straw Hat Pirates, declaring himself to be their friend. He and his crew helped the Going Merry and its crew to escape but were captured by Captain Hina of the Marines, resulting in Mr. 2's ship being sunk in the process.

entities.name: Battle Frankies
entities.description:
The Battle Franky is a line of special battleships built by Cutty Flam (now known as Franky), respectively named "Battle Franky" with a call number from 1 through 35. While no bigger than lifeboats, each one is heavily armed with cannons and other weaponry. Some of the ships even have armor, turrets, and various mechanical devices. This makes these small crafts as dangerous as actual battleships.

Franky originally built the craft to hunt Sea Kings. After several failed attempts, he succeeded in defeating one with BF 35. Three days later, Spandam and the CP5 stole the ships and used them to sink the Judicial Ship, frame Tom, Iceburg, and Franky for the crime, and in the process destroy the majority of the ships.

After being struck by the Sea Train, Franky's body was heavily injured, so he turned himself into a cyborg, building weapons into his own body and continuing the count of the Battle Franky line.

After being hit by the Sea Train Puffing Tom, Franky's body suffered severe damage. When he drifted to an abandoned ship, he used the scrap metal to rebuild himself into a cyborg with a different body structure and added weapons, and labeled himself as "BF 36", even though he is not a battleship.

entities.name: Northheim
entities.description:
The Northheim was the ship Mont Blanc Noland used to explore the Grand Line.

The Northheim is a huge ship, with six large torn up sails. Printed on one of the front sails is "LVNEEL.K.D". In the middle of the ship is a large dome structure shaped like a chestnut. Rather than a figurehead, it has a large chestnut hanging from a rod jutting out from the ship's bow.

The Northheim was seen as Noland and his crew were traveling the Grand Line. The ship docked at Jaya, and later sailed back to the North Blue.

Several moths later, the crew sailed toward Jaya again, with the king of Lvneel, and again went through a rough sea on their way. Upon arrival, they discover the island was drastically changed, and Noland was labeled a liar for his story, and was sentenced to death.

entities.name: Wind Granma
entities.description:
Wind Granma is a ship used by Monkey D. Dragon, leader of the Revolutionary Army.

Wind Granma is a large ship that has a figurehead and theme of an actual dragon, complete with a small dragon tail.

This ship was kept around for at least ten years, as seen when Dragon used it to rescue the citizens from the Gray Terminal, and when they landed at another island to get supplies.

After the Summit War of Marineford, it was seen moored outside of the Revolutionary Army headquarters at Baltigo.

entities.name: Marine Ships
entities.description:
Marine Ships are ships that serve the Marines, acting as their transportation and means of fighting naval warfare.

They have two to four masts with two to three sails per mast. The decorations and paint job is always kept within the same style and there is little variation between ships beyond size and armaments. The standard paint covering the outer hull is normally a bluish green basis, patterned with darker streaks of the same, a style also found on the exterior of most Marine bases. Superstructures are usually painted black. Only a few notable Marines have ships that do not follow the standard design and paint job.

Marine ships are among the few vessels in the world that can safely traverse the Calm Belt. The two features that make this possible are Seastone, which lines the bottom of the ships and makes them undetectable by Sea Kings, and paddle-wheels, which propel the ship forward despite a complete lack of wind. Only battleships have been seen with these features.

The standard ship is a cruiser-like vessel that has three masts, two with two sails and one with a lateen sail. It has six cannons on each side of its hull and four larger cannons situated on the bow. A large circular structure is located in the middle of the ship, and the Marine symbol and name are painted on the sides. They come in two standard sizes, "Small" and "Midsized", with the naming convention stemming from their size compared to the Marine's ubiquitous Battleship.

entities.short_description: Marine Ships are ships that serve the Marines, acting as their transportation and means of fighting naval warfare.

entities.name: Stan Maley
entities.description:
The Stan Maley was an anime-only Marine ship that was damaged in a storm on its way to Navarone.

The Stan Maley had green hulls with brown lining, along with standard Marine sails. It had the appearance of a normal Marine ship, but it is now damaged due to the storm.

The Stan Maley arrived at G-8 Base from Marine Headquarters. The base almost refused allowing its entry because some pirates were reported to have invaded the base.

Later, the captain of the Stan Maley was ordered by Commander Shepherd to aid in the capture of the Straw Hat Pirates.

entities.short_description: The Stan Maley was an anime-only Marine ship that was damaged in a storm on its way to Navarone.

entities.name: Bezan Black
entities.description:
The Bezan Black is the primary ship of the Black Cat Pirates.

The Bezan Black is a simple red and black pirate ship with a black cat as a figurehead, and a pair of ornamental cat claws on the sides. Its hull has a green base. The front part of her keel, along with the figurehead, was torn off by Luffy during his battle against the Black Cat Pirates.

Kuro commanded the ship as captain of the Black Cat Pirates for years, up through his "final" battle against Morgan's Marine unit. During this time Nugire Yainu served as the ship's mechanic, until he was forced to act—and executed—as Kuro's decoy.

On succeeding Kuro, Jango assumed command and led the ship through several more years of successful plunder.

entities.name: Big Top
entities.description:
Big Top is a brightly colored ship, which imitates a circus feel. It has many circus tent designs on it, furthering Buggy's theme. Its figurehead is an elephant with the trunk as a cannon. The prow also has two cannons on it. The foremost sail bears the crew's Jolly Roger. The back sail on the top contains the word "BUGGY", and has the crew's flag on top of it. The ship overall is fairly large compared to the other ships on the sea.

Big Top was first seen moored on the shores of Organ Island when Buggy and his crew took over Orange Town. After Buggy was defeated by Monkey D. Luffy and sent flying off the island, the remainder of the crew took the ship and fled the island as the townspeople chased them.

Soon the ship took the crew to Kumate Island, where the crew would unfortunately run into a tribe of cannibals there. Richie, who became the new captain while defeating Mohji and Cabaji in his sleep, was captured by the cannibalistic tribe and was about to be cooked when he was rescued by Buggy, who returned after an adventure of his own, bringing Alvida with him as an ally.

After escaping Marine Captain Smoker from Loguetown, the Buggy Pirates took the Big Top and entered the Grand Line.

entities.name: Bliking
entities.description:
The Bliking is Wapol's submersible attack ship.

The Bliking is a large round ship, different than most regular ships. Along with the ship's White Walkie figure head, one of the ship's unique features is the large steel plating around the ship, with a star like pattern. Two large gears are seen towards the side of the ship.

While trying to return to Drum Island, the Bliking crossed paths with the Going Merry. Wapol had the ship surface so they could acquire a Log Pose or Eternal Pose to Drum Island from the Straw Hat Pirates; however, the Straw Hats did not have one for the island. After Monkey D. Luffy launched Wapol off the Merry, the Bliking Pirates returned to their ship and rushed off to save the king before he could drown.

After successfully saving Wapol, they eventually found their way to the island. The ship docked on the coast, and the Bliking Pirates disembarked and defeated the citizens who tried to stop them.

entities.name: Cutie Wagon
entities.description:
The Cutie Wagon is a vessel used by Porche, Capote and pulled by Monda during the Donut Race portion of the Davy Back Fight.

The vessel is shaped like half of a giant pink seashell. The ship could be said to resemble a seashell or a pink sleigh with a tapered front.

With Monda pulling, it was a fast craft. Despite this, the Cutie Wagon only won the race due to the interference of the cheating from Foxy. Monda stood in front, and Porche was the attacking force, while Capote rowed the oars (both located vertically in the "Seashell" over-flap).

entities.name: Flying Dutchman
entities.description:
The Flying Dutchman is a legendary ship from maritime folklore, and is largely infamous as a ghost ship. It is the main vessel of the Flying Pirates and was once captained by the original Vander Decken and his descendants, up until Vander Decken IX.

The Flying Dutchman resembles the stereotypical representation of a ghost ship: old and worn from time. The sails are torn and tattered, moss and barnacles are growing out from various spots of the ship, and the mast is similar to a clock tower in design. On the bottom front sail is the name "FLYING DUTCHMAN", and the top one bears the crew's Jolly Roger, a fanged skull with cutlasses, their blades pointing down in place of crossbones. The ship's figurehead bears the same skull and swords. The Flying Dutchman is a large ship, being as large as Wadatsumi, a fish-man who dwarfs even Shirahoshi.

The ship is not coated with resin since the crew can survive the underwater environment due to being fish-men. The vessel can also withstand the underwater pressure of 10000 feet below sea level due to already being full of holes that equalize the water pressure inside and outside the hull. Only a small portion on the deck is coated for their captain to reside in (as the current holder of the title, though being a fish-man, ate a Devil Fruit).

The Flying Dutchman is described as a ship that is unable to make port, and must wander the endless sea forever. This was due to the ship's deranged captain Vander Decken committing atrocious crimes. As a result, he brought about God's wrath, who then punished him by cursing both him and the ship. It is a bad omen when the ship does appear.

entities.name: Hitsugibune
entities.description:
The Hitsugibune is a small craft used by the former Warlord, Dracule Mihawk.

The black boat resembles a coffin and has candles lit on the edges that burn with green fire. The ship is only big enough for one person. At the center is a mast that resembles a large crucifix, similar to Mihawk's sword, with black sails and a seat for himself.

This meager craft has no apparent significance, but Mihawk was able to sail the unforgiving seas of the Grand Line on it, which is a testament to his skills.

Mihawk sailed Hitsugibune to the Baratie in pursuit of the Krieg Pirates and sliced through their ship. He got off the boat to face Zoro and leaves quickly after defeating the pirate and deflecting artillery from Krieg.

entities.name: Little Gerais
entities.description:
The Little Gerais is a ship used by the Little Pirates.

The Little Gerais is a massive, wide-set ship with a brown hull, a gold-colored bow, white railing, and a figurehead that resembles the crew's jolly roger, except with the horns pointed down. It has a single, tall mast with three large sails on it, two bearing the crew's jolly roger and a striped one in the middle with two sun emblems on it. The mast is topped with a crow's nest and a flag bearing the jolly roger.

The ship was among the fleet of Whitebeard's allies when they went to war at Marineford. The status of the ship is unknown, as its captain was last seen unconscious on the battlefield.

entities.name: Miss Love Duck
entities.description:
The Miss Love Duck is the ship Alvida had when she was first introduced in the story.

The Miss Love Duck is a large pink ship, with four sails, one higher than the other three. Each sail has a pink heart, and the ship herself has two hearts on each side. The figurehead is a duck and the Alvida Pirates Jolly Roger flies on the mainmast.

The ship was first seen docked at Alvida's island base. It is unknown what happened to it after Alvida was defeated by Luffy, as she was using a different boat when she picked up Buggy.

Originally in the manga, the ship was simply seen being docked at Alvida's base when she was first seen. In the anime however, instead of being docked at the base, it was first seen being used to attack a cruise ship full of guests.

entities.name: New Witch's Tongue
entities.description:
The New Witch's Tongue is the ship used by the Bellamy Pirates.

The New Witch's Tongue is a simple pirate ship with pink edges and many cannons. The figurehead is that of a skeletal spinal-cord like, with a spherical shaped head that has Donquixote Doflamingo's insignia, a crossed out smiley, on it. This insignia is also on the front lower sail. Bellamy's own Jolly Roger, which is that of red lips with a tongue sticking out, and crossbones behind it, is on the top sail. This symbol is also on a black flag on top of the ship's mast.

With Eddy, the crew's navigator, guiding them, the Bellamy Pirates approached Jaya and Cricket's house on board the New Witch's Tongue.

The current state of the New Witch's Tongue is unknown after Bellamy left his crew to join the Donquixote Pirates.

entities.short_description: The New Witch's Tongue is the ship used by the Bellamy Pirates.

entities.name: Numabou
entities.description:
Numabou was a ship belonging to the Caribou Pirates. After being destroyed by Surume, it was later rebuilt, but Caribou was forced to abandon it.

Numabou is a small ship with three masts and a moose figurehead. It is slightly larger than the Thousand Sunny, and it has a dark-colored strip along the side.

After escaping the Sabaody Archipelago, the Caribou Pirates pursued the Straw Hat Pirates under the sea with their coated ship, which was pulled by Momoo. The Numabou got close enough to the Thousand Sunny for Caribou to board it, but Momoo pulled away Caribou's ship after seeing Nami. The Caribou Pirates forced Momoo to follow the Sunny again, but when they found Caribou and the Straw Hats, the Kraken Surume crushed the Numabou.

After rebuilding the ship, the Caribou Pirates were sailing underwater when they happened to encounter Caribou who was in Jinbe's custody. They chased after Jinbe and Caribou, but the fish-man outsped them.

entities.name: Perfume Yuda
entities.description:
Perfume Yuda is the ship of the Kuja Pirates.

The Perfume Yuda is a giant red ship, resembling a . The front have two Yuda harnessed, allowing them to move through the Calm Belt with ease. The ship has paddle wheels at the rear, a cabin with the architecture resembling those from ancient China, the front sail with the crew's Jolly Roger and the back sail with the kanji for "Kuja".

The Perfume Yuda was taken to the Calm Belt so Boa Hancock could meet up with Vice Admiral Momonga. Here, she refused the call of the Marines to fight in the Summit War of Marineford, before leaving and returning to Amazon Lily.

After Hancock agreed to help Monkey D. Luffy to save his sworn brother, she smuggled him under her long coat while having the Perfume Yuda sail back to Momonga's ship.

entities.name: Striker
entities.description:
The Striker is a skiff used by Portgas D. Ace.

Striker is a waterproof, one-man, yellow skiff shaped like a half crescent. It has an engine in the back, two paddle-wheels on the sides, and a small mast, all linked to a central seat. Its black sail (white in the anime) bears the Whitebeard Pirates' infamous Jolly Roger.

Striker is powered by Ace's Mera Mera no Mi powers from the front seat, which is linked to the engines on the sides and back. It is also capable of diving underwater for short periods, and resurfacing without Ace's direct control.

After being shipwrecked on Sixis together, Ace and Masked Deuce built the Striker to escape on. Under Deuce's instruction, Ace trained his new flame powers to carve material for, and safely propel, the craft.

entities.name: Utan Sonar
entities.description:
Utan Sonar is the Shoujou Pirates' ship and one of the vessels of the Saruyama Alliance.

Utan Shonar is a wide-hulled ship, with giant trees serving as its masts. It has an orangutan face-shaped figurehead. In addition, the sides of the ship have many doors with ladders that lead to the water to aid the Utan Divers in their work monitoring sonar reverberations. The vessel also has two large paddles, one on each side of the ship, that hold the special chambers where the Utan Divers actually work.

Utan Sonar was sailing through the Mouth Bay of Jaya when it stopped to dive, activating the Utan Divers' Search Sonar. Once the divers detected a nearby vessel, Shoujou directed his and his crew's attention to the Going Merry. When Shoujou attacked the Straw Hat Pirates with his Havoc Sonar, his crew tried to stop him, as his own attack was damaging Utan Sonar.

Utan Sonar was docked on the shore of Mont Blanc Cricket's hideout until it and Victory Hunter escorted the Going Merry to the Knock Up Stream. As the Imperial Cumulus approached, the Utan Divers detected a giant current and whirlpool, and the ship was shaken by the rising waves. Utan Sonar stayed back, outside of the current of the whirlpool, and watched as the Blackbeard Pirates approached the Straw Hats. The ship was rocked when the Knock Up Stream erupted and launched the Going Merry into the sky.

entities.short_description: Utan Sonar is the Shoujou Pirates' ship and one of the vessels of the Saruyama Alliance.

entities.name: Victory Hunter
entities.description:
Victory Hunter is the Masira Pirates's ship and one of the vessels of the Saruyama Alliance.

The figurehead, also known as the ハンター|Baruko Hantā|literally meaning "Hull Hunter", VIZ: "Barco Grabber"}}, is a monkey striking two cymbals that was eaten by a gigantic turtle. It was later replaced temporarily with a simple face of the monkey. After the timeskip, a new figurehead similar to the original Barco Hunter was attached to the ship, restoring the ship's initial design.

Masira's ship also has rows of palm trees going along the sides of his ship and two banana-shaped poles serving as pulleys for the Barco Hunter. Also on the sails is Masira's Jolly Roger: a monkey's head with two bananas.

While the Straw Hat Pirates were diving to look at the wreckage of St. Briss, the Masira Pirates approached the Victory Hunter for a salvage operation. To salvage the wreck, the crew set the ship's cradle and lowered the Barco Hunter to connect to it. Once connected, Masira used his breath to inflate the wreck before diving down to investigate the people on board. Almost immediately, the Barco Hunter and the wreck were eaten by a gigantic turtle. Victory Hunter was pulled along briefly by the turtle before darkness set in, stopping the turtle and both crews in terror as giant shadows loomed over them.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: Victory Hunter is the Masira Pirates's ship and one of the vessels of the Saruyama Alliance.

entities.name: Full
entities.description:
The Full is a ship used by the Baroque Works organization.

The Full is a large purple ship with a yellow crocodile figurehead and a tall white smokestack located forward. The Baroque Works Jolly Roger is painted on the base on the smokestack.

Crocodile supplied the Full with Dance Powder and used it to cause drought and confusion in the Arabasta Kingdom. The ship was captured by the Marines when Smoker discovered Crocodile's plan to incite a civil war in Arabasta.

At Smoker's request, Hina took the Full (along with the defeated Crocodile) into custody.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: The Full is a ship used by the Baroque Works organization.

entities.name: Leap Out Jewelry
entities.description:
The Leap Out Jewelry was Kuma's personal ship.

The Leap Out Jewelry is a large ship with three masts, each with two sails. The two front sails are black, with the bottom displaying Bonney's drawing of Kuma and his name and the top displaying a target symbol. The deck features a church-like structure with a cross at the top.

The upper part of the ship, primarily the deck and church, are light blue, with ornaments similar to bear ears on either side. The hull is purple, and the keel of the ship is brown with a dark brown dot pattern similar to Kuma's hat and pants.

Bartholomew Kuma acquired the Leap Out Jewelry about three and a half years ago, decorating the sail with a drawing Bonney had made of him.

entities.short_description: The Leap Out Jewelry was Kuma's personal ship.

entities.name: Numancia Flamingo
entities.description:
The Numancia Flamingo is the main ship of the Donquixote Pirates.

The Numancia Flamingo is a somewhat large ship whose main exterior and masts are dark red. Its figurehead design is a flamingo's neck and head, with the flamingo wearing Doflamingo's signature sunglasses. On each side of the ship are designs of flamingo wings. The ship possesses two masts, with the first mast's sail bearing the Donquixote Pirates' Jolly Roger and the name "Donquixote". Under the second mast is a circular cabin leading belowdeck. Part of the area inside the ship contains an ornate dining room where Doflamingo and his executives were seen having tea.

The ship was first seen being used 16 years ago in the North Blue, when the Donquixote Pirates departed from Spider Miles toward Reverse Mountain. As the crew stopped at and attacked various locations, they were also frequently pursued by Tsuru and the Marines.

The crew stopped at Minion Island to obtain the Ope Ope no Mi and intercept their treasonous executive Donquixote Rosinante. Doflamingo killed Rosinante, but failed to find the Devil Fruit, and the crew was forced to flee when the Marines came.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: The Numancia Flamingo is the main ship of the Donquixote Pirates.

entities.name: Polar Tang
entities.description:
The Polar Tang was the submarine serving as the ship of the Heart Pirates. It was broken in half and sunk during the battle between the Heart Pirates and the Blackbeard Pirates at Winner Island.

It was built by Wolf, and originally given the name .

The Polar Tang was a yellow submarine with a light green underside lined with torpedo cannons. Unlike most pirate ships, it was mostly made out of metal and ran on engines instead of sails. However, the upper decks was made of wood, and there were two tall masts on both the front and back levels. These two masts had retractable sails that are to be used when its engines were not activated, with the front mast having a rectangular dark-colored sail bearing the Heart Pirates' Jolly Roger on it. Circular windows line the craft, and the Heart Pirates' Jolly Roger and Law's "DEATH" tattoo were plastered on the exterior. There were also lights resembling streetlamps on the outside in order to allow sight underwater.

Inside the ship is an advanced medical room, where Law can perform operations on patients.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via One Piece Fandom Wiki. Character / franchise art © Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha / Toei Animation (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.
entities.short_description: The Polar Tang was the submarine serving as the ship of the Heart Pirates. It was broken in half and sunk during the battle between the Heart Pirates and the Blackbeard Pirates at Winner Island.

entities.name: Snapper Head
entities.description:
The Snapper Head was a ship belonging to the Sun Pirates. It was destroyed by the Big Mom Pirates after the Sun Pirates sacrificed it.

The ship has a figurehead of a fish, with flames around the neck part, while the rudder resembles a fish tail. The cabin on the middle and the back of the ship also resembles fishes. There are cannon ports on the sides of the vessel. Its overall appearance is a giant fish. The ship has five sails. The front two are dark blue, and they bear the Jolly Roger of the Sun Pirates. The middle one is dark blue, but is blank. The second one from the back is light blue. The last sail on the back is striped between blue green and green. The flag of the crew is on top of the foremost sail. After it was rebuilt, the ship had different colors on the front sail.

The Snapper Head was built by Fisher Tiger many years ago. He and his crew the Sun Pirates sailed on it until they were ambushed by the Marines on Foolshout Island, and the ship was sunken by cannon fire.

Eventually, the Sun Pirates managed to salvage and rebuild the Snapper Head, and they disembarked from Whole Cake Island on it as they attempted to leave Totto Land and cut off ties with the Big Mom Pirates. However, they stayed to protect their former captain Jinbe and his new crew the Straw Hat Pirates, and when their ship the Thousand Sunny was in peril from the Big Mom Pirates, Wadatsumi replaced it with the Snapper Head, resulting in the latter ship being destroyed by the Queen Mama Chanter's cannon fire.

entities.name: Catapult
entities.description:
The Catapult was a submarine used by Douglas Bullet.

The Catapult was a very large submarine made nearly entirely out of iron, with a design similar to that of an Island Whale. It was completely grey with only a large red '9' stencilled on the front, and the name 'Bullet' painted along the side, between the pectoral and tail fin. On its back was a structure resembling a normal submarine. It was filled with various weapons.

In the movie, Douglas Bullet used the Catapult as the core of his Gasha Gasha no Mi ability. When he used Union Armado on it, it became a giant gray humanoid robot, with a small head in comparison to the massive body and a spiked spine and tail. Though Bullet mainly used brute force, he was also capable of creating cannons from its palm. Its size exceeded even that of Capone Bege's Big Father transformation.

After Bullet is driven back by the members of the Worst Generation, he breaks open the island they were battling on to reveal the Catapult, which he promptly uses his ability on to turn it into a giant robot. With it he manages to quickly wipe out the Worst Generation. As he is about to finish off Luffy, he finds himself being under the constant yet seemingly ineffective fire of Usopp's Pop Green. As he reaches out for the sniper, one of the seeds grows into a vine, snapping one of the Catapult's fingers. In the end, he decides to dispose of Usopp by growing a cannon out of its palm and firing it at him.

entities.name: Shark Submerge III
entities.description:
The Shark Submerge III is a deep-sea exploring submarine shaped like a shark that can carry three people. It is a part of the Thousand Sunny's Soldier Dock System and can be deployed by the number 3 channel.

The Shark Submerge III is a small three-man submarine shaped like a shark. It was built by Franky in order to aid the Straw Hat Pirates whenever they come across a situation that requires going underwater. The passengers keep in contact with the ship above through a Den Den Mushi. The Shark Submerge III has a diving limit of 5,000 meters. Going below any further than that would cause the sub to crack due to the surrounding water pressure.

In the anime, the Shark Submerge III has an automated Franky voice providing status such as depth, visibility, oxygen, and available cola.

Originally in the manga, the Shark Submerge III was first shown to the Straw Hats when Franky explained the Soldier Dock System in Thriller Bark. While shown, however, it was not until the crew reached the second half of the Red Line that the submarine was seen being used to look for a way to Fish-Man Island. In the anime, the Shark Submerge III was first shown being used during the Ice Hunter Arc. It is also used again during the Z's Ambition, Caesar Retrieval, and Marine Rookie Arcs.

entities.name: Sister Anko
entities.description:
The Sister Anko is a dessert ship which is part of an expansion to Baratie. It is managed by Patty.

The submarine is built to look like an angler fish. It has a large main door that says "DESSERT" on it, with a small platform for people to stand on when above the water to allow entry and two window hatches for "eyes". The craft has a domed roof with large metal bumps on it and a periscope in the center. Like an angler fish, it has a light hanging just above the two hatches.

The main dining area is in the middle of the submarine, and is a circular room with glass walls. The main support beam is in the center of the room. Below the submarine is a giant paddle wheel that allows the submarine to move, and there is a giant fin in the back that acts as a rudder.

During the two year timeskip, a dessert ship—run by Patty—was built as an addition to the Baratie.

entities.name: Umibozu
entities.description:
The Umibozu is a submarine belonging to the Laotour Bandits.

The Umibozu is a relatively small submarine with a white and orange frame. It has several circular windows and three barrels on each on side of it. There is a periscope at the top of it and a propeller at the back. The bow has a large spiked decoration.

The Umibozu was first introduced to the Straw Hat Pirates by Otsu for their mission to invade the Fortress of Zilpah on Hi Island. Later, the Straw Hats use the Umibozu to dive through an underwater cavern connecting the sea to Muika Lake on Mu Island.

entities.name: Nerona Imu
entities.description:
Saint Nerona Imu is the King of the World who occupies the Empty Throne, giving him sole authority over the World Government. One of the First Twenty responsible for the creation of the World Government and the only one alive today, his status has been kept an absolute secret from the world at large for over 800 years since the Void Century.

With the ambition of finally bringing the Great War to a decisive conclusion, Imu directed his subordinates the Five Elders to procure Dr. Vegapunk's invention, the Mother Flame, and ordered the Knights of God to annex Elbaph in an invasion that he eventually personally participated in.

Imu first appeared during the Levely Arc. Due to his status and actions, he is the overarching antagonist in the Egghead Arc, the main antagonist of the Elbaph Arc, and one of the primary overarching antagonists of the Final Saga and the One Piece series as a whole.

Imu has only been fully seen while in his partial devil transformation. He is shown to possess unique facial features with a defined nose and mouth, long eyelashes, dark skin, and long light hair that covers his left eye; with sharp, almond eyes with red irises, each having a thin ring around the pupil, with his irises having multiple rings within them. He has two curly horns, long, sharp, black nails, and circuit-like tattoos on his forearms that take the shape of an eye on the back of his hands, a jagged line tattoo from the left side of his face down his left torso, and white dots all over his arms, legs, and torso.

entities.name: Akuma no Mi
entities.description:
The Akuma no Mi is a Devil Fruit that allows its user to transform into a devil at will, allowing access to numerous demonic abilities. The user can bestow these abilities upon others in exchange gaining varying degrees of control over their minds and bodies. The fruit was eaten by Nerona Imu.

This ability's name is unique among Devil Fruits, as it is a single three-syllable word rather than a two-syllable pattern repeated once. The name is homophonous with the Japanese term for Devil Fruits in general; the only difference is that is spelled using katakana instead of kanji.

To distinguish this fruit's name from Devil Fruits in general, the VIZ translation has rendered it as "The Devil's Fruit". It is the only officially translated fruit name to utilize the possessive (the particle can be used to indicate possession).

Imu's devil transformation appears to resemble common depictions of . While his complete transformation is still silhouetted, it is extremely large, being roughly equivalent to the Five Elders' massive Mythical Zoan Beast Forms in size and occupying a considerable portion of the enormous platform beneath the Empty Throne. In the form displayed on Elbaph, Imu is several times larger than an average human, but is still much smaller than a giant. The transformation affords numerous demonic features and accessories, such as a pair of curly horns on the user's forehead and a long dark tail which bears at least three horned skulls on it. The tail appears to be tattered, or has an essence which is not entirely solid. The user also possesses a pair of large, feathered black wings that they can appear and disappear at will.

entities.name: Blue Planet
entities.description:
The Blue Planet is the celestial body on which One Piece takes place. While similar to real-life in many aspects, it is drastically different in others. The Blue Planet primarily consists of the Blue Sea, with the Red Line as its only continent above sea level. Much of the population lives on assorted islands scattered across the Blue Sea, which is divided into the East Blue, North Blue, South Blue, West Blue, Calm Belts, and the Grand Line, itself made up of Paradise and the New World.

According to Dr. Vegapunk, the Blue Planet used to have a different configuration a millennium ago, with far more landmasses and less ocean until the events of the Void Century, which caused sea levels to rise and whole continents to disappear. As of the present, there are over 20,000,000 islands in the world, and Vegapunk predicts that these islands will soon be entirely sunk into the Blue Sea.

Since the end of the Void Century 800 years ago, the World Government governs most of the Blue Planet, having played a large role in its current geographical configuration. Throughout history, many prominent figures and organizations have gone against the World Government in power struggles for various parts of the world.

The term is first revealed in Enel's Great Space Operations and confirmed to be the name of the planet in SBS Volume 111. The ancestors of the sky island inhabitants, a race of alien beings from the moon, are the first group in the story to use the term Blue Planet on the cover page of Chapter 472.

entities.name: Blue Sea
entities.description:
The Blue Sea is a huge body of water spanning across the entire Blue Planet. Nearly everything in the world can be found on the Sea, save for sky islands such as Skypiea and Weatheria. The term "Blue Sea" is in fact an exonym only used by those who live on the White Sea and the White-White Sea.

Nearly a millennia ago, the Blue Sea used to be around 200 meters lower than its current levels, but the events of the Void Century caused it to rise by that much, sinking many continents in the process. Dr. Vegapunk predicts that the Blue Sea is set to engulf the rest of the world's landmasses in the future.

The Blue Sea itself is divided into five oceans by the Red Line and the Calm Belts:

The main governmental body of the Blue Sea is the World Government which currently exercises control over a hundred-seventy countries. The Revolutionary Army is the main force opposing the World Government and they control multiple islands including Baltigo and Momoiro Island. The Four Emperors are the four strongest pirates who rule over the New World. Moving from one section of the Four Blues to another is no easy task, as they are separated by either the Red Line or the Calm Belt, which would entice a full voyage to go through.
